VVD MPs asked the government whether it supports a bus driver who refused to continue with a niqab-wearing passenger, whether the face-covering ban is being applied consistently in public transport, hospitals and other institutions, and what steps will be taken to clarify enforcement with police and operators. The minister answered that operators and staff should first ask the person to remove the covering or leave, that police should be called if needed, that the practice is being clarified with sector bodies, and that the government will keep monitoring implementation.

The cabinet supports compliance with the law by institutions, paying attention to how the procedure is designed so that it takes account of safeguarding a safe public task and the roles that employer and employee have in compliance with this law.

Het kabinet ondersteunt de naleving van de wet door de instellingen, met aandacht voor de invulling van de werkwijze die rekening houdt met het zorgen voor een veilige publieke taak en de rol die de werkgever en werknemer bij deze wet met betrekking tot de naleving hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht ‘Dure blunder van het UWV’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a UWV error in which reclaim notices (stuitingsbrieven) for benefits recovery were not properly evidenced, leading to claims lapsing, and about five years without enforcement action. The minister acknowledged the pre-2016 administrative gap (2,425 claims worth EUR 11.8 million at risk), described the enforcement process and planned digital and extra safeguards, and committed to raising the issue in the Fraud Council and with other departments.
The risk that earlier-sent reclaim letters from before 2016 are judged by the court to be insufficient, causing the claims to lapse, is however not excluded.
Het risico dat eerder verzonden stuitingsbrieven van voor 2016 door de rechter als onvoldoende worden beoordeeld, waarmee de vorderingen alsnog komt te vervallen, is hiermee echter niet uitgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over de berichten “Werkende is kind van de rekening” en “Hoe kan dat: krapte op de arbeidsmarkt én dalende lonen?”

MP Wiersma asks the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports on falling real wages despite labour scarcity, probing causes, the labour income share, sectoral wage growth, and whether data on failed collective bargaining are kept. The minister attributes weak wage growth mainly to slowing productivity growth, says the government sets no wage target, declines to monitor all bargaining or to ask the SER for a fresh inquiry, and notes a rising wage trend.
The cabinet plays no direct role in wage developments or in stimulating wage growth.
Het kabinet speelt geen directe rol in de loonontwikkeling of in het aanwakkeren van loonstijging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer, Veldman en Wiersma over het aantrekken van personeel door startups

MPs Wörsdörfer, Veldman and Wiersma asked whether startups face barriers in recruiting foreign talent, including income requirements, the partner labour market access and BTW registration for foreign entrepreneurs. The government answered that a pilot residence scheme for essential startup staff with a lower salary threshold will be created, that partner labour market access is being arranged, and that foreign entrepreneurs do not need to register physically at the tax office.
It was chosen to create a separate residence scheme in the form of a pilot rather than to adjust the knowledge migrant scheme.
Er is gekozen voor een aparte verblijfsregeling in de vorm van een pilot en niet voor aanpassing van de kennismigrantenregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Wiersma over het bericht ’Lerarentekort? In Brabant zitten 300 basisschoolleraren in de WW’

MPs Heerema and Wiersma asked why hundreds of qualified primary-school teachers in Brabant are on unemployment benefits while schools face a teacher shortage, and whether UWV should be obliged to match them to vacancies. The minister acknowledges the problem, describes re-integration efforts via the Participatiefonds and regional coordinators, provides a provincial table, and says a research report will be sent before summer without committing to a UWV obligation.
I agree that employers and job seekers must be able to find each other and that the parties with a role in the education labour market must do everything to ensure this happens.

Ik ben het met u eens dat werkgevers en werkzoekenden elkaar moeten kunnen vinden en dat de partijen die een rol vervullen op de onderwijsarbeidsmarkt er alles aan moeten doen om ervoor te zorgen dat dit ook gebeurt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht ‘Patstelling aan cao-tafels’

MP Wiersma (VVD) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of a deadlock at collective bargaining tables, including the number of concluded CAOs, failed negotiations, alternative arrangements like Jumbo's, and the government's role. The minister answered that CAO numbers do not show a systemic breakdown, that failed negotiations are not recorded, that bargaining is for unions and employers, and that no government initiative is planned.
Data on the number of failed or broken-off CAO negotiations are not kept.
Gegevens over het aantal mislukte of afgebroken cao-onderhandelingen worden niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Middendorp over het bericht ‘Rechter moet tussenbeide komen bij ICT-ruzie binnen UWV’

MPs Wiersma and Middendorp (VVD) asked about reported internal conflict over UWV's ICT reorganisation, including new IV-director posts, decentralisation of ICT staff, software maintenance costs and coordination with other agencies. Minister Koolmees answered that the transition is UWV's own responsibility as an autonomous body, that the implementation is temporarily suspended for talks with the works council, and that no new management layer is added.
As an autonomous administrative body, however, the Executive Board of UWV is itself responsible for the proper organisation of the agency.
Als zbo is de Raad van Bestuur van UWV echter zelf verantwoordelijk voor een goede inrichting van de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over de berichten ‘FNV daagt onlinebezorger Picnic voor de rechter’ en ‘Picnic bijt van zich af in conflict met FNV’

MP Wiersma asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the FNV lawsuit against Picnic and whether a sector-specific collective agreement for e-commerce or mediation was needed. The Minister answered that collective bargaining is for employers and employees themselves, that the cao system needs no change, and that he would invite the parties for a conversation but would not mediate or intervene in the pending court case.
My role in this is limited, as I also indicated in my answer to question 2.
Mijn rol in deze is beperkt, zoals ik ook heb aangegeven in mijn antwoord op vraag 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het artikel ‘Werkgevers overstelpt met loonsancties UWV over uitvoering ziektewet’

An MP asks the minister whether UWV sanctions on private sick-pay self-insuring employers have risen sharply and whether UWV applies looser standards to employers who entrust the work to UWV, plus related questions on re-integration duties, level playing field and parliamentary follow-up. The minister says no separate figures exist, denies any change in policy, explains that self-insuring employers face stricter post-employment re-integration duties than UWV-administered cases, and says he sees no reason to change the rules while committing only to inform the House if needed.
UWV does record the number of sanctions, but in its regular policy and accountability information it does not distinguish between sanctions imposed on publicly and privately insured employers.

UWV houdt namelijk het aantal sancties bij, maar maakt in de reguliere beleids- en verantwoordingsinformatie geen onderscheid in sancties die zijn opgelegd aan publieke en privaat verzekerde werkgevers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange en Wiersma over het bericht dat zzp’ers geen schuldhulp krijgen

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about reports that self-employed people (zzp'ers) with debts often do not get municipal debt assistance, and what is causing this. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, said the Wgs does not exclude the self-employed but the 2012 explanatory memorandum causes confusion, and promised a Wgs amendment, a 2019 knowledge-sharing initiative, and further information.
I find it worrying that self-employed people with debts still have insufficient access to municipal debt assistance.
Ik vind het zorgwekkend dat zelfstandigen met schulden nog onvoldoende toegang krijgen tot de gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Van Kent over het bericht ‘Werkgever worstelt met transitievergoeding bij ontslag na langdurige ziekte’

MPs Wiersma and Van Kent asked the minister about employers' uncertainty over compensation for the transition payment when dismissing long-term sick workers, including which documents are required and where employers can get help. The minister answered that UWV is implementing the scheme from 1 April 2020, that documents and an information campaign will follow, and that a bank statement alone is not sufficient for compensation.
I will ensure together with UWV that information on the precise documents employers must provide to UWV from 1 April 2020 forms part of this information campaign.
Ik zal samen met UWV zorgen dat de informatie over de precieze documenten die werkgevers vanaf 1 april 2020 aan UWV moeten verstrekken onderdeel vormt van deze voorlichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over de berichten 'Robotisering noopt tot snelle omscholing' en 'Werkgevers zitten te springen om praktisch personeel'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that robotisation requires rapid retraining and that employers want practical staff, including the labour shortage across sectors and the position of SMEs in lifelong learning. The minister answered that labour shortages create opportunities, provided vacancy data and sector figures, and committed to €1.5 million for SME learning culture and to working on a parliamentary motion for €48 million.
I will get to work vigorously on elaborating this motion.
Ik ga voortvarend aan de slag met de uitwerking van deze motie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en El Yassini over het bericht ‘Sociale partners belemmeren duurzame inzetbaarheid scholing en training van flexwerkers in de bouw’

MPs Wiersma and El Yassini asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Education about a construction-sector collective agreement clause that allows apprenticeship (bbl) contracts only with direct employees, excluding temp agency workers, and whether this harms flexworkers and bbl places. The ministers answer that sectoral social partners may set such terms, that they expect more bbl places in the tight labour market, and that the government is promoting bbl places but sees no reason to reopen talks with the social partners.
The registration of the SBB cannot show how many bbl students were placed at a training company via a temp agency construction.
Uit de registratie van de Samenwerkingsorganisatie Beroepsonderwijs Bedrijfsleven (SBB) kan niet worden afgeleid hoeveel bbl-ers via een uitzendconstructie bij een leerbedrijf zijn geplaatst.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over de berichten ’26.488 bijstandsklanten maar niemand wil of kan trucker worden’, ‘Bestuurslid Ondernemend Venlo: ‘Venlose werklozen willen niet werken’ en ‘Omscholen? Deze beroep

Wiersma (VVD) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports claiming benefit recipients refuse jobs such as truck driving despite labour shortages, and about proposals for a learning-work obligation. The Minister answered that jobseekers must actively seek work under the Participatiewet and WW rules, outlined training and reintegration funding, and said a study of successful municipal approaches will be published in spring 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht ‘Werkgevers: langer doorwerken ondergeschoven kind in cao-overleg’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about employers' and unions' failure to make concrete collective agreements keeping older workers employable, and about training, age-related exemption measures and a proposed personal work check. The minister acknowledged room for improvement, cited cao data and existing subsidy schemes, and said social partners must decide on concrete measures.
The cabinet therefore strongly focuses on improving the labour market position of workers aged fifty and over.
Het kabinet zet daarom stevig in op het verbeteren van de arbeidsmarktpositie van vijftigplussers.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht 'Bom onder poldermodel leggen was geen vooropgezet plan’ en ‘FNV vreest tweede ‘Jumbo-debacle’ bij marktleider Albert Heijn.’, en ‘Meer cao’s zonder handtekening FN

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about Jumbo's use of a workplace conditions arrangement agreed with the works council instead of a collective labour agreement, and about FNV's criticism of it. The minister answered that such arrangements are legally distinct from CAOs, that the choice belongs to the parties within legal limits, and declined to comment on negotiating positions or media statements.
It is not for me to assess why the need for this has arisen or may arise.
Het is niet aan mij om te beoordelen waardoor de behoefte hieraan is ontstaan of kan ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht ‘Schreeuwende tekorten, maar scholing van flexwerkers is voor bedrijven geen prioriteit.’

An MP asked the ministers of Education and Social Affairs about ROA research showing flex workers receive far less work-related training than permanent staff, and about the planned individual learning account. The minister acknowledges the gap, says employers and employees bear primary responsibility, and promises a letter to parliament before the October committee meeting on lifelong learning.

On the policy to achieve a breakthrough in strengthening the Dutch learning culture, including the design of the individual learning account, parliament will be informed by letter before the October committee meeting.

Over het beleid om te komen tot een doorbraak bij de verdere versterking van de Nederlandse leercultuur, waaronder de vormgeving van de individuele leerrekening, wordt uw Kamer voorafgaand het algemeen overleg in oktober per brief geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Basisscholen missen 1300 leraren, na de zomer dreigt lesuitval’

Two VVD MPs asked about reports of 1,300 missing primary school teachers, including the extension of the chain-employment rule, use of the supplementary unemployment benefit pool, part-time and retired teachers, and vakleerkrachten for physical education. The minister answered that the chain-rule exemption for substitutes took effect in August 2018, that re-integration results were not previously tracked but monitoring starts in September, and that several proposals (such as Vervangingsfonds coverage for self-employed teachers) are being reviewed or are not the government's responsibility.
As a result, data are currently lacking to factually answer how many benefit recipients return to teaching.
Hiermee ontbreken dus momenteel gegevens om de vraag feitelijk te kunnen beantwoorden hoeveel uitkeringsgerechtigden terug keren voor de klas.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Wiersma over het bericht van RTL Nieuws dat tientallen criminelen een uitkering ontvangen ondanks een openstaande celstraf

Two MPs asked why convicts evading an open prison sentence still receive benefits, and whether the state can recover them and tighten the law. The minister says the practice is unjustifiable, describes a CJIB-UWV data-matching process and a pilot letter scheme to meet Centrale Raad van Beroep rulings, and sees no need for a law change.
For this small remaining group, I am therefore, together with my colleague at SZW, taking an additional step to stop the benefit.
Voor deze kleine resterende groep zet ik daarom samen met mijn ambtsgenoot van SZW nog een extra stap om de uitkering stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over de berichten 'Langdurig werklozen vaak onvindbaar systemen UWV' en 'Werkloze is te anoniem'

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that long-term unemployed people are hard to find in UWV systems and that anonymous CVs reduce job chances, including data on CV publication, exemptions from the job-search obligation, and matching improvements. The minister answers that most CVs are public, that anonymous CVs do not reduce job chances because employers can still contact jobseekers, and outlines ongoing ICT and matching improvements.
Since it is always possible to contact a jobseeker and because important information is visible to employers, posting an anonymous CV need not lead to fewer job chances.

Aangezien het altijd mogelijk is om in contact te komen met een werkzoekende en omdat belangrijke informatie voor werkgevers zichtbaar is, hoeft het plaatsen van een anoniem cv niet te leiden tot minder kansen op een baan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over de gevolgen van de uitspraak van de CRvB over de toepassing van het woonlandbeginsel

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether social benefits exported abroad should be adjusted to local cost levels after a Central Appeals Tribunal ruling on the residence-country principle, and why earlier warnings about twenty treaties did not reveal the problem sooner. The minister answers that adjustment is needed, that thirteen treaties must now change, that roughly 1.2 million euros in extra spending is at stake, and that renegotiations are ongoing with several countries, promising to inform parliament of progress and of any failure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Lange en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Zelfstandige ondernemers met schulden kunnen vaak niet bij hun gemeente terecht’

MPs De Lange and Wiersma asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about reports that self-employed people with debts are often turned away by municipalities, and why municipal practice differs. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for debt assistance access and quality, that the Wgs does not exclude groups in principle, that the Bbz2004 is a suitable instrument, and that the government will support municipalities with knowledge development and funding.
Municipalities are responsible for access to and the quality of debt assistance for their residents.
Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor de toegang en de kwaliteit van de schuldhulpverlening aan hun inwoners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over het bericht ‘Werkgevers wordt Loonkosten Voordeel onthouden omdat Doelgroep jongeren stage bij ze hebben gelopen’

Rep. Wiersma (VVD) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether employers lose a wage-cost subsidy (up to 6,000 euro) when a youth on a BBL apprenticeship contract had earlier done a paid internship with them, and whether the UWV or the minister can still grant the eligibility declaration. The minister answered that the subsidy is available regardless of a prior paid internship, that the declaration must be requested within three months of the internship start, that the UWV will inform employers, and that he is examining a one-off exception for 2018.

For the year 2018 I am examining the possibility of making an exception so that employees from the target group who entered an employment contract with the same employer directly after a paid internship in 2018 can still apply for a target group declaration for both the internship period and the contract period.

Voor het jaar 2018 onderzoek ik de mogelijkheid een uitzondering te maken in die zin dat werknemers uit de doelgroep die direct aansluitend aan een betaalde stage in 2018 een arbeidscontract zijn aangegaan met dezelfde werkgever alsnog een doelgroepverklaring kunnen aanvragen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen, Wiersma en Nijkerken-de Haan over de voorgenomen sluiting van HOVO in Limburg per 1 mei 2018

Three VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about Hogeschool Zuyd's decision to end HOVO (higher education for older people) in Limburg from 1 May 2018, covering its funding, causes, comparisons with other provinces and the government's levers. The minister answered that HOVO is a non-subsidised activity that must be cost-covering, that the decision followed failed attempts to make Limburg's programme self-financing, and that the government has no direct responsibility for non-formal courses, pointing to a forthcoming letter on lifelong learning.
I am not responsible for the course offerings or for ensuring a regionally comprehensive course supply for older people or other target groups.
Ik ben niet verantwoordelijk voor het cursorisch aanbod en de zorg voor een regionaal dekkend cursusaanbod voor ouderen of andere doelgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Wiersma over meer arbeidsslaven in Europa dan sekswerkers

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports of more labour exploitation than sex trafficking in Europe, the claimed halving of registered trafficking cases in the Netherlands, prosecution and sentencing statistics, and progress on the coalition agreement's plans to strengthen the fight against trafficking. The Secretary of State answered that the rise in labour exploitation is worrying, that registered victims fell from 1,256 in 2014 to 952 in 2016 with a slight recovery in 2017, provided statistics on victims, prosecutions and sentences, and said a pimping ban and a broader interdepartmental plan are in preparation.
There is no question of a halving.
Er is geen sprake van een halvering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Wiersma over het bericht “Rotterdamse droogdok is al drie jaar besmet”

MPs Dijkstra and Wiersma asked about reports that Rotterdam dry-dock work on cruise ships has dropped since a 2014 Inspectie SZW fine, raising level-playing-field concerns. The minister acknowledged the uncertainty, promised an inventory of rules and enforcement in neighbouring countries before summer, and declined to disclose details of the ongoing court case.
There is currently a court case ongoing and during that period I cannot make statements.
Er loopt op dit moment een rechtszaak en gedurende die periode kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Nijkerken-de Haan over het bericht “VNO wil UWV-lijsten openbaar"

MPs Wiersma and Nijkerken-de Haan asked the minister and state secretary of Social Affairs about VNO-NCW's call to make UWV and municipal candidate lists public, and about the labour market mismatch. The government answered that it is working through regional matching programmes, data exchange between UWV and municipalities, extra funding for personal services, and a forthcoming follow-up letter, but did not commit to opening the lists.
We share your concern about mismatches on the labour market.
Wij delen uw zorg betreffende mismatches op de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Wiersma over onterecht betaalde uitkeringen door het UWV

MPs Peters and Wiersma asked the Minister of Social Affairs about benefits wrongly paid out by UWV, the causes, and measures to recover every defrauded euro and intervene earlier. The minister said about €420 million in fraud-related claims were imposed in 2013–2017, outlined how extra anti-fraud funds were spent and some programmes ended, and committed to recovering all wrongly paid amounts within the statutory ten-year period.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Wiersma over het bericht 'Te veel leraren ziek, basisschool moet dicht'

Two MPs asked the minister whether the temporary-contract chain rule under the Wet werk en zekerheid is causing school closures due to teacher sickness, and what options and timelines exist for relief. The minister answered that the chain rule exemption for winter sickness substitutes applies only in January to March, that schools are using many workarounds, and that a statutory fix is planned for 2018 with entry into force by 2020.
The cabinet wants to submit the legislation in the course of 2018.
Het kabinet wil de wetgeving in de loop van 2018 indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over de berichten ‘Minister Koolmees: nieuwe zzp-wet is één van mijn grotere uitdagingen’ en ‘Zo zou de nieuwe zzp-wet eruit moeten zien volgens kenners’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports on the planned replacement of the DBA employment-relations law for self-employed workers, including whether the outcomes of a stakeholder meeting would be shared and how concerns about the client declaration would be handled. The minister answered that meeting minutes will be published, that stakeholders are involved through the planned approach, that the timeline to 1 January 2020 is very ambitious and earlier entry into force is not feasible, and that a high-level letter will follow before the summer recess.
In that connection, in line with the remark by Mr Hasekamp, it was noted that the timeline for the new legislation to take effect on 1 January 2020 is very ambitious.
Daarbij is, in aansluiting op de opmerking van de heer Hasekamp, opgemerkt dat het tijdpad van inwerkingtreding van de nieuwe wetgeving per 1 januari 2020 zeer ambitieus is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over de berichten “Scholingsplan dure grap”, “Opleidingsfondsen nodig voor een leven lang leren” en “O&O-organisaties krijgen werknemers in de schoolbanken”

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports on sectoral training funds (O&O fondsen), including whether their reserves are underused, whether individual training budgets would help low- and middle-educated workers, and whether fiscal barriers to training exist. The Minister replies that reserves are necessary, that funds do not report how many workers they train, and that the government will agree on lifelong learning with social partners and education institutions, with no concrete new step beyond planned letters and a future individual learning account.
It is not possible to state how many people in total, or per O&O fund, have been trained through these funds, because the funds do not report this way.
Het is niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel mensen in totaal, of per O&O fonds, geschoold zijn door middelen van deze fondsen, omdat fondsen dat niet op deze manier rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Wiersma en El Yassini over het bericht 'Ernstig tekort aan bouwvakkers dreigt nu de economie weer bloeit'

MPs Koerhuis, Wiersma and El Yassini asked the ministers whether the projected shortage of 70,000 construction workers threatens the housing target and quality, and what the government will do about training, innovation and secure building pipelines. The minister answered that employers bear primary responsibility, pointed to existing measures (tax cuts on labour, Matchen op Werk, Techniekpact, UWV retraining budget, BBL subsidies), and said she would talk with stakeholders and regional parties without giving firm commitments.
The responsibility to attract sufficient qualified personnel lies primarily with the employers themselves.
De verantwoordelijkheid om voldoende gekwalificeerd personeel aan te trekken ligt primair bij de werkgevers zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en El Yassini over het bericht 'MeerGGZ maakt bezwaar tegen cao ggz'

MPs Wiersma and El Yassini asked the minister about objections by Platform MeerGGZ to extending the GGZ collective agreement by decree (avv), including claims it is inflexible and may hinder innovation. The minister said the objections will be handled in the written avv procedure, declined to comment on the individual case, explained that avv only prevents wage undercutting, and pointed to options for MeerGGZ to obtain exemption through its own collective agreement.
I do not want to make statements about this ongoing individual procedure before I have gone through all the steps of the procedure.
Over deze lopende individuele procedure wil ik geen uitspraken doen voordat ik alle stappen in de procedure doorlopen heb.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over kinderbijslag in het buitenland

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether child benefit paid to parents with children in other EU countries should be indexed to local price levels, and whether the Netherlands will press Germany and other member states on this. The minister replies that EU law (Regulation 883/2004, art. 67) bars applying the country-of-residence principle within the EU, that there is insufficient support among member states, and that no action will be taken for now, including on a motion asking the government to pursue indexation.
This is not the right moment for that.
Hier is nu het moment niet voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over techniekopleidingen die ingehaald worden door nieuwe ontwikkelingen

An MP (Wiersma, VVD) asks the Minister of Education whether vocational technical training is keeping pace with labour market needs and whether private providers should be publicly funded via demand financing; he also asks about the shortage of technical teachers and whether mbo should move to accreditation. The Minister answers that the mbo has been made more responsive through reforms and a regional investment fund, rejects private demand-financed providers and accreditation, and calls on employers to offer more apprenticeships and internships.
I do not share this view.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en De Hoop over ruim tweehonderd docenten die achter het net vissen bij hun aanvraag voor een Lerarenbeurs

Two PvdA MPs asked why over 200 teachers were refused Lerarenbeurs funding for 2023 and are forced to wait a year, given that similar shortfalls were fixed by budget top-ups in 2020. The ministers answer that the budget was insufficient, that rejected first-time applicants get priority in 2024, and that the government is pursuing a national professionalisation programme via the Growth Fund.
Teachers who applied for the first time this year and were rejected because the subsidy ceiling was reached will receive priority over teachers applying for the first time next year.

Leraren die dit jaar voor het eerst een aanvraag hebben gedaan en afgewezen zijn vanwege het bereiken van het subsidieplafond, krijgen komend jaar voorrang ten opzichte van leraren die dan voor het eerst aanvragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Baarle over het toezicht op informeel onderwijs

MP Van Baarle asked the minister for Primary and Secondary Education, in 85 numbered questions, to justify the planned supervision of informal education, challenging the evidence base, the consistency with the government's earlier position, and the proportionality and privacy implications. The minister answered that the government considers the signals sufficient, that the inspectorate will carry out signal-driven supervision, and that concrete examples are largely available only in publicly known reports and the AIVD annual report, with some examples withheld for security and privacy reasons.
Because of the AIVD's remit and privacy considerations, I cannot share all examples with you.
Vanwege de taakstelling van de AIVD en om privacyoverwegingen kan ik niet alle voorbeelden met u delen.
Antwoord op vragen van Kamerlid Ephraim over het afnemend psychisch welbevinden onder jongvolwassenen

An MP asked the government about declining psychological wellbeing among young adults, including school-related pressure, the Welbevinden op School programme, loneliness initiatives and the role of education in parenting. The state secretary answered that schools and programmes are being supported, that pressure in education is acknowledged, and that a study on synergy between help initiatives will be carried out.
This autumn I will have a study carried out into possible synergy between various existing initiatives.
Dit najaar laat ik een onderzoek uitvoeren naar mogelijke synergie tussen verschillende bestaande initiatieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht ‘De woedeaanvallen van minister Wiersma zijn geen incident, maar een patroon’

An SP MP asked 13 questions about a newspaper report describing a pattern of angry outbursts by the minister for Primary and Secondary Education, including whether the Chamber can monitor his self-improvement, staff departures, communication staffing and local journalism. The answer is a cross-reference to a separate letter published in response to a Woo request, so the substance of the answers is not given in this document.

The written questions from MP Kwint (SP) to the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Primary and Secondary Education about the report 'The rage attacks of Minister Wiersma are not an incident but a pattern' (2023Z09138) have been answered by means of a letter (Publication of documents following a Woo request regarding conduct of former Minister Wiersma).

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kwint (SP) aan de Ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en voor Primair en Voortgezet Onderwijs over het bericht «De woedeaanvallen van Minister Wiersma zijn geen incident, maar een patroon» ( 2023Z09138 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over diverse berichten aangaande minister Wiersma

The SP MP Kwint asks the government about reports that Minister Wiersma behaved aggressively during a work visit and towards the Inspectorate of Education, including what the complaint and 'difficult conversations' involved and how the inspectorate's independence will be safeguarded. The minister refers the questions to a letter on Woo-published documents concerning Wiersma's conduct, without answering them substantively in this reply.

The written questions from MP Kwint (SP) to the Ministers of Education, Culture and Science and of Primary and Secondary Education about various reports concerning Minister Wiersma (2023Z11630) have been answered by letter.

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Kwint (SP) aan de Ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en voor Primair en Voortgezet Onderwijs over diverse berichten aangaande Minister Wiersma ( 2023Z11630 ) zijn beantwoordwoord middels brief
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over ZZP’ers in het onderwijs

An MP from Groep Van Haga asks the minister about the use of freelance (ZZP) teachers in education, whether offering permanent contracts could drive them away, the basis for the 80% permanent-contract target and the added regulatory burden. The minister answers that structural work should be done under permanent contracts, that no signals suggest freelancers would leave if offered permanent contracts, that the 80% floor reflects the national average, and that the bill will be assessed by the ATR, with the explanatory memorandum expected in early 2024.
The bill on strategic personnel policy aims to curb the growth of external hiring, including freelancers, by limiting schools to spending at most 5% of their budget on it.

Het wetsvoorstel strategisch personeelsbeleid heeft tot doel de groei van externe inhuur, waaronder zzp’ers, af te remmen, door te bepalen dat scholen daar nog maximaal 5% van hun budget aan mogen besteden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bouchallikh over de subsidiëring van jongerenorganisaties

MPs Westerveld and Bouchallikh asked about government subsidies and study-grant (bestuursbeurzen) schemes for youth organisations, including who qualifies, representativeness, rejected applications and the treatment of vocational students. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that no integral overview exists, explained the eligibility criteria and rejections, and largely declined to change the scheme's scope beyond planned extensions for mbo students.
There is no integral overview of all youth organisations that receive facilities or subsidies from the national government.
Er is geen integraal overzicht van alle jongerenorganisaties die faciliteiten of subsidie krijgen van de landelijke overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over Confucius Classrooms in het voortgezet onderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Education about a Confucius Classroom opened at a Haarlemmermeer secondary school and whether foreign state influence in Dutch schools is acceptable and how it is monitored. The minister said such interference is undesirable, that the Confucius Classrooms have no influence on lesson content, that no concrete signals of interference exist, and that no new rules are planned for now.
I currently see no reason to tighten the rules on contacts with China in secondary education, but I am keeping an eye on the theme.
Ik zie momenteel dus geen aanleiding om de regels voor contacten met China in het voortgezet onderwijs aan te scherpen, maar ik hou het thema wel in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht dat veel stagiaires aan lerarenopleidingen geen stagevergoeding krijgen

An MP asks the minister about reports that many teacher-training interns receive no internship allowance, and about the union's survey findings, the motion on minimum allowances, LIO contracts and school boards' agreements. The minister agrees the situation is undesirable, points to the mbo internship pact, ongoing talks on higher education and a forthcoming monitor, and calls on employers and unions to agree on allowances.
I agree that it is undesirable when interns do not receive an appropriate allowance.
Ik ben het ermee eens dat het onwenselijk is wanneer stagiairs geen passende vergoeding krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Verkuijlen over het artikel 'Zorgen om online bedreigingen leerlingen: ’Doet een beetje denken aan de kogelbrief’'

MPs Paul and Verkuijlen asked the ministers about online threats against pupils and schools, including how often they occur, how schools should respond, and whether perpetrators are caught. Minister Wiersma answers that no national trend data exists, points to a planned incident-reporting duty in a forthcoming bill, and describes existing protocols and support organisations, without committing to new structural oversight measures.
There is no national picture of how often these kinds of threats occur.
Er is geen landelijk beeld hoe vaak dit soort bedreigingen voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over het recordaantal uitvallers in het mbo door groenpluk van het bedrijfsleven

An MP asked the education ministers about the record number of early school leavers in vocational education, the causes (labour market, corona, lighter exam rules), the binding study advice, employer responsibility, diploma incentives, and budget cuts to the VSV scheme. The minister attributes dropout to a combination of lighter exam rules, corona-related motivation and mental health problems, and a strong labour market, plans a VSV action plan after the summer, and says the VSV scheme ends in 2024 with funds redirected.
It is therefore not possible to make a breakdown of which share of early school leavers stops for which reason.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk om een verdeling te maken welk deel van de voortijdig schoolverlaters om welke reden stopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het door schoolbesturen weigeren van gebedsruimten en gebedsmogelijkheden

An MP asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education whether schools refusing prayer rooms or prayer opportunities breach religious freedom and the 2000 equal-treatment ruling, and whether the Inspectorate will check. The minister said a public school is not obliged to provide prayer rooms, that praying is not banned, that the current rules are clear enough, and declined new guidelines or inspection instructions.
I am continuously in discussion with umbrella organisations and schools on numerous topics.
Ik ben voortdurend met koepels en scholen in gesprek over tal van onderwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Eindtoets basisschool wordt doorstroomtoets’

MP Van Meenen asked whether the 2023-2024 doorstroomtoets window for the south of the Netherlands overlaps with carnival and whether the date should be moved. Minister Wiersma explained the statutory window of the first two full weeks of February, withdrew earlier wording suggesting schools should move carnival, and said the window will be evaluated.
In that evaluation we will also pay attention to the examination period in relation to, among other things, school holidays and carnival.
Daarin zullen we ook aandacht hebben voor de afnameperiode in relatie tot onder meer de vakantieperiodes en carnaval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Amhaouch en Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Ministerie plant eindtoets basisscholen tijdens carnaval en suggereert: verplaats carnaval maar’

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education whether the 2024 end-of-primary test (doorstroomtoets) clashes with carnival and whether the ministry suggested carnival be moved. The minister says the test window is set by law at the first two full weeks of February, that schools can schedule around carnival, and withdraws the ill-chosen wording suggesting carnival be moved, while stating no change to the test window is planned for now.
In answering a citizen's question there was an unfortunate choice of words, which I hereby withdraw.
Bij het beantwoorden van een burgervraag is sprake geweest van een ongelukkige woordkeuze, die ik hierbij wil terugnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Maatoug over de totstandkoming van de Kamerbrief 'Vrij en veilig onderwijs'

MPs Westerveld and Maatoug asked how the government letter 'Vrij en veilig onderwijs' on supervision of informal education was prepared, including ministry objections, the role of the Inspectorate, the complaint reporting point and a criminal complaint by Islamic organisations. The ministers answered that advice from officials was considered, that the Landsadvocaat's advice was sought, that the Inspectorate will do signal-based oversight, and that the reporting point operates with privacy safeguards, while noting that the Inspectorate still has concerns and that the Public Prosecutor saw no grounds for investigation.
The Minister for Primary and Secondary Education will take the Inspectorate's persistent concerns into account in further elaborating the bill.
De Minister voor Primair en Voortgezet Onderwijs neemt de aanhoudende zorgen van de inspectie in de verdere uitwerking van het wetsvoorstel mee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de Week van de Lentekriebels en ander onderwijs gericht op seksuele voorlichting en vorming van jonge kinderen

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about sexual education for young children, the Week van de Lentekriebels, Rutgers' materials, and whether these sexualise children. The minister replied that schools freely choose materials, that relational and sexual education is a legal obligation since 2012, and that the Inspectorate received only a few dozen calls, with no central registration of complaints.
I will share the requested communication as soon as possible after sending these answers.
Ik zal de door u opgevraagde communicatie zo snel mogelijk delen na verzending van deze antwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de 'Week van de lentekriebels' en de berichtgeving daarover

An MP asked the minister whether the 'Week van de lentekriebels' sex-education theme week had become more explicit over the years, whether its material was age-appropriate, and whether parents should be able to opt children out. The minister replied that participation is voluntary, the material follows expert and WHO-based standards, parents have a shared responsibility, and no change to the programme is planned.
I trust that schools and teachers can make a sound judgement in choosing teaching materials or programme packages.
Ik vertrouw erop dat scholen en leraren een goede afweging kunnen maken in de keus voor lesmateriaal of lespakketten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht van Omrop Fryslân op 30 november 2022 'Grote stroom aan nieuwe leerlingen op internationale scholen levert problemen op'

MP Becker asked the minister about reports of long waiting lists for ISK international bridge classes for newly arrived young migrants, the two-year funding start date, data gaps, inspection and PABO attention to newcomer education. The minister acknowledges severe capacity shortages, promises an emergency bill for temporary arrangements by early June, will review funding timing, admits lack of registration and monitoring data, and commits to a later exploration of regular newcomer education.
At present there is no statutory obligation to register newcomer education as such.
Op dit moment is er geen wettelijke verplichting om het nieuwkomersonderwijs als dusdanig te registreren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het risico op genitale verminking en het aanzetten daartoe in een religieuze context

An MP asked the government about calls to female genital mutilation in a religious setting, whether such statements incite violence, which legal or administrative tools exist, and how girls at risk abroad are protected. The government answered that incitement to violence is criminal regardless of context, that statements not amounting to crime cannot be countered administratively, and it outlined prevention measures, airport alertness indicators, and a planned bill on informal education.

Statements about female genital mutilation that do not constitute a criminal offence are protected by freedom of expression under Article 7 of the Constitution and Article 10 of the European Convention on Human Rights.

Uitlatingen over vrouwelijke genitale verminking die geen strafbaar feit opleveren, worden beschermd door de vrijheid van meningsuiting, hetgeen is vervat in artikel 7 van de Grondwet en artikel 10 van het Verdrag tot bescherming van de rechten van de mens en de fundamentele vrijheden (EVRM).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Beertema over het bericht ‘Steeds meer Nederlandse leerkrachten in Vlaanderen’

Two MPs asked the minister whether the rising number of Dutch teachers working in Flanders is known, and whether Flemish teaching culture (theoretical grounding, teacher authority) explains it. The minister confirms awareness, lists possible reasons (school systems, pay, housing, culture, personal motives, Antwerp/Brussels Dutch communities), says Dutch teacher salaries are generally not lower, and outlines retention measures and a progress letter before summer.
Before the summer, my colleague, Minister Dijkgraaf, and I will inform you of the progress.
Voor de zomer informeren mijn collega, Minister Dijkgraaf en ik u over de voortgang.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Drost, Bisschop, Pouw-Verweij, Beertema en Van der Plas over de antwoorden op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Kwint en Westerveld over het feit dat veel reformatorische scholen nog al

Five MPs asked the minister about a school identity statement that was misquoted in earlier answers as rejecting homosexuality. The minister confirmed the statement does not address sexual orientation, apologised, rectified the record, and said a broader review of the motions on identity statements will be reported to parliament later this year.

In the wording of the parliamentary questions and in the answers to them, a link was unintentionally made between a passage from the Gomarus College identity document and views on marriage and sexual orientation.

In de vraagstelling van de Kamervragen en de beantwoording van de Kamervragen is onbedoeld de link gelegd tussen een passage uit het identiteitsdocument van het Gomarus College en opvattingen over het huwelijk en seksuele oriëntatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Drost, Stoffer, Pouw-Verweij en Palland over de beeldvorming van leven met downsyndroom

MPs from five parties asked the government about a biology textbook passage on Down syndrome, its implications for inclusion, prenatal counselling and support for people with disabilities. The minister said the publisher withdrew the passage, that schools must promote democratic basic values, and described existing policy on inclusion, counselling and support, but declined to evaluate the effects of the prenatal screening funding change.
I am always open to societal signals following funding changes, but an investigation is not appropriate.
Ik sta altijd open voor maatschappelijke signalen naar aanleiding van bekostigingswijzigingen, maar een onderzoek ligt niet voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het artikel 'Op deze school werden kinderen geslagen. Toch mochten de leerkrachten blijven'

An MP asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education how corporal punishment at the Plato school could have happened and whether current rules and inspection prevent it, and whether stricter rules and oversight of private and informal education are needed. The minister answered that the government is tightening rules: a reporting obligation for serious incidents, stronger complaint procedures, more school safety monitoring, and a bill for signal-based inspection of informal education expected in mid-2023, while noting no comparable cases are known to the inspectorate.
That is why I announced in my letter to the House of 18 November that I will work on a bill enabling signal-based inspection by the inspectorate of informal education.
Daarom heb ik in mijn brief aan de Kamer van 18–11 jl. aangekondigd om aan de slag te gaan met een wetsvoorstel dat signaalgericht toezicht van de inspectie op informeel onderwijs mogelijk maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel 'Ruimtegebrek dreigt door extra gymlessen Hardenbergse scholen: 'Vooral in Dedemsvaart''

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about shortages of gym space threatening the new two-hour weekly physical education norm, and whether all municipalities can meet it. The minister answered that municipalities and schools share responsibility, that a follow-up study by VSG is underway, and that schools are expected to meet the norm by the new school year, with the Inspectorate monitoring.
The Inspectorate of Education will also, as part of its broad supervision, monitor sufficient and good physical education.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs zal in het brede toezicht ook toezien op voldoende en goed bewegingsonderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Podt over het bericht 'Schakelklassen voor gevluchte jongeren vrijwel allemaal vol'

MPs Van Meenen and Podt asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about reports that international bridging classes for refugee youths are full and some schools no longer accept refugees. The Minister acknowledged the waiting lists as undesirable, said regional coordinators and LOWAN monitor the situation, and announced an emergency bill for temporary arrangements, expected in mid-May.
To guarantee this as well as possible, I have decided to come forward shortly with an emergency bill that will enable temporary arrangements for newcomers in education.

Om dit zo goed mogelijk te garanderen heb ik besloten om op korte termijn met een spoedwetsvoorstel te komen waarmee voor nieuwkomers in het onderwijs tijdelijke voorzieningen mogelijk worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Verkuijlen over het artikel ‘Zorgen om schade aan schoolgebouwen in heel Nederland door geweld hangjongeren’

Two VVD MPs asked about damage to school buildings from youth vandalism, how often damages and parents are held liable, convictions, Halt referrals, and whether cameras on school playgrounds should be promoted. The minister answers that no data on damage, claims, or convictions are kept, cites Halt figures, points to the ongoing exploration of expanding parental liability, and refers to municipalities and schools for camera decisions.
There are no figures available on the extent of damage to school buildings.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over de omvang van schade aan schoolgebouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht dat een jongen al een jaar thuis zit na een onterechte schorsing

MP Van Baarle asked the minister why a 9-year-old boy has been out of school for over a year after an unlawful suspension, and what the school and responsible bodies will do. The minister says the inspectorate will investigate the school's compliance with law and duty of care, that a new school place is being sought, and that Stichting Gedragswerk has been contacted to help.
The Inspectorate of Education will, following the above, conduct further investigation into the school's compliance with laws and regulations, including the procedures for suspension and expulsion.

De Inspectie van het Onderwijs (hierna: inspectie) zal naar aanleiding van bovenstaande nader onderzoek doen naar de naleving van de wet- en regelgeving door de school, onder andere rondom de procedures voor schorsing en verwijdering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over leerlingen van het speciaal onderwijs die noodgedwongen thuiszitten.

MP De Hoop asks the minister about special-education pupils who are forced to stay at home because of waiting lists, including at the Ambelt schools in Zwolle, and about the role of school boards, municipalities and staffing shortages. Minister Wiersma answers that schools must find an interim solution, that waiting lists are being mapped with a monitor, that school housing is a municipal responsibility, and that staffing measures are being taken.
I will inform the House about this before the summer.
Ik informeer uw Kamer daarover voor de zomer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Paul over het bericht ‘Ondanks ophef wijzen meer reformatorische scholen homohuwelijk af’

MPs Van Meenen and Paul asked the Minister about reports that many reformed schools still reject same-sex marriage and same-sex relationships in their guides, and about inspectorate oversight of social safety, school-identity statements and guest lectures. The Minister says such school statements are undesirable, that the Inspectorate supervises school climate and will intervene, and describes tightened inspection procedures and complaint handling, while deferring a decision on banning some identity statements to a later letter.
I will inform the House later this year about possibly banning (certain forms of) identity statements in response to the Kwint et al. and Gündoğan/Simons motions.
Ik informeer uw Kamer in de loop van dit jaar over het mogelijk verbieden van (bepaalde vormen van) identiteitsverklaringen in reactie op de motie-Kwint c.s. en de motie-Gündoğan/Simons.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sylvana Simons en Koekkoek over het bericht 'Ondanks ophef wijzen meer reformatorische scholen homohuwelijk af'

MPs Simons and Koekkoek asked the minister how reformed schools' identity statements rejecting homosexual or transgender lifestyles can be reconciled with a parliamentary motion to end such statements, and what will be done about indirect exclusion of LGBTIQA+ pupils. The minister says such statements are unacceptable, the inspectorate will intervene, and a fuller response on implementing the motions will follow later this year.
I am currently examining how I can implement the Gündoğan/Simons motion, as well as the Kwint et al. motion, which call for banning (certain forms of) identity statements in education.
Op dit moment onderzoek ik op welke manier ik uitvoering kan geven aan de motie-Gündoğan/Simons, net als aan de motie-Kwint c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over de brandbrief van een basisschool die voltijdonderwijs voor hoogbegaafde kinderen aanbiedt

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about a school letter reporting that full-time gifted education is becoming unavailable to more pupils, and about schools refusing pupils from other partnerships due to funding. The minister acknowledged the situation, said partnerships (samenwerkingsverbanden) are responsible for a complete offer, pointed to a new subsidy scheme and extra funding, and said talks with the letter writers are ongoing.
The partnership is responsible for providing sufficient suitable educational provisions for the entire giftedness spectrum.
Het samenwerkingsverband is verantwoordelijk voor het bieden van voldoende passende onderwijsvoorzieningen voor het gehele begaafdheidsspectrum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Kwint en Westerveld over het feit dat veel reformatorische scholen nog altijd homoseksualiteit afwijzen en identiteitsverklaringen hanteren

MPs De Hoop, Kwint and Westerveld asked why reformed schools still use identity declarations rejecting homosexuality, and how this fits with the Inspectorate lifting extra supervision at Gomarus. Minister Wiersma answered that such declarations are not yet banned, that she finds conditioning admission on signing them undesirable, that the Inspectorate will intervene where pupils are rejected, and that she is studying how to implement the motions to ban such declarations, to be reported later this year.
I do not consider it desirable for schools to express themselves in this way and to make admission conditional on signing such a declaration.
Ik vind het niet wenselijk dat scholen zich op deze wijze uitdrukken en toelating voorwaardelijk maken op het ondertekenen van zo'n verklaring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul, Van der Woude, El Yassini en Rajkowski over kunstmatige intelligentie in het onderwijs

MPs from the VVD asked the education and economic affairs ministers about the risks and opportunities of AI such as ChatGPT in schools, teacher preparedness, research, and cooperation with the Dutch AI Coalition. The ministers answered that they support schools through Kennisnet, SURF, the national education lab NOLAI and funding, but offered no measures to check or constrain executive power.
It is important that school boards and teachers are sufficiently aware of the risks of AI for education, in addition to its opportunities.
Het is belangrijk dat schoolbesturen en leraren naast de kansen ook voldoende op de hoogte zijn van de risico's van AI voor het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over initiatieven voor thuiszitters die dreigen te verdwijnen

MP Kwint asked the minister why initiatives supporting home-sitting children still face funding problems, why the motion giving the Inspectorate binding power to order school boards to cooperate has not been implemented, and how many initiatives take part in the experiment. The minister acknowledged the problem, rejected the Inspectorate option as inconsistent with its independent supervisory role, noted 39 of 41 experiment applications were approved, and committed to developing legislation within a year after the experiment's start.
As I already indicated in my answer to question 1, I am working on several tracks to improve the truancy approach.
Zoals ik al in mijn antwoord op vraag 1 aangaf werk ik op verschillende trajecten aan het verbeteren van de verzuimaanpak
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Westerveld over het voortduren van het gebrekkige onderwijsaanbod voor kinderen in asielopvangvoorzieningen

MPs Kröger, Westerveld and Piri asked about the continuing shortfall in education for children in asylum reception facilities, including delays, placement policy and whether gaps are structurally addressed. The State Secretary answered that data on children missing schooling is not yet available, that placement of families in crisis emergency shelters is undesirable but cannot always be refused, and that a bill and evaluations are in preparation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dekker-Abdulaziz en Van Meenen over de ontwikkelingen op het gebied van kunstmatige intelligentie

Two MPs from D66 asked several ministers about recent developments in artificial intelligence, including ChatGPT's effects on education, the labour market, business use and national AI policy. The government answered that the effects are not yet fully known, outlined existing support programmes and monitoring, and promised to keep following developments; it did not answer question 12 about the debate timing as substance.
We have tried to answer the questions for the committee debate, but unfortunately this has not succeeded.
Wij hebben geprobeerd de vragen te beantwoorden voor het commissiedebat, maar dit is helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid De Hoop over de gevolgen van de stakingen in het streekvervoer voor leerlingen speciaal onderwijs

An MP asked whether the strikes in regional public transport, which disrupt special-education pupils' travel, will be prevented, whether staff pay and working conditions will be improved, and what the social costs are. The State Secretary answers that municipalities are responsible for pupil transport, that the strike is a labour dispute between employers and employees the government cannot influence, and that the social costs cannot be mapped.
Municipalities in the Netherlands are, however, responsible for pupil transport.
Gemeenten zijn in Nederland echter verantwoordelijk voor het leerlingenvervoer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de eetstoornis ARFID

An MP asked the State Secretary for Health about ARFID, an eating disorder: prevalence, treatment capacity, professional training, GP and youth-care knowledge, parent information, and whether free school meals account for it. The State Secretary answered that prevalence and treatment numbers are not known, outlined existing training, guidelines and information websites, and said school meals would be voluntary with school-level arrangements for individual pupils.
It is not known how many children and adults currently receive treatment for ARFID or are on a waiting list specifically for ARFID treatment.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel kinderen en volwassenen momenteel een behandeling voor ARFID krijgen of op een wachtlijst staan specifiek voor een behandeling van ARFID.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Alkaya en Van der Plas over het bericht dat sluiting dreigt voor groen vmbo in Noord-Brabant wegens nieuwe aanbesteding van het openbaar vervoer

Three MPs asked whether the threatened closure of a green vocational school in Andel, linked to a provincial public transport tender cutting pupil buses, is acceptable, and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that the closure threat is premature, that the province guarantees accessibility in its draft programme of requirements, and that it is for decentralised authorities to decide, so the government declines to intervene.
Since both municipalities and the province have their own democratically elected checks, the government exercises restraint here.
Aangezien zowel gemeenten als de provincie hun eigen democratisch verkozen controles hebben past de regering hier terughoudendheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over groene vmbo-scholen en de mogelijke sluiting daarvan

An MP asked the minister whether the Curio Prinsentuin Andel green vocational school must close because the province of Noord-Brabant is re-tendering the dedicated school bus service, and what the government would do to keep the school open. The minister replied that closure is premature, that funding would only be affected by a three-year enrolment shortfall, that the province is responsible for accessibility and says it will guarantee it, and that the government trusts the province's assessment.
The province, as concession grantor, is responsible for the accessibility of this school.
De provincie is als concessieverlener verantwoordelijk voor de bereikbaarheid van deze school.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat er onbevoegde docenten voor de klas staan

An SP MP asked the minister for a full overview of unqualified teachers in front of classes, the Inspectorate's stance on unqualified teachers, its enforcement, and when the teacher shortage will be solved. The minister gave trend figures showing 1.6-1.8% of primary teachers unqualified, noted that individual qualification progress is not tracked, said the Inspectorate will report on shortage impacts in 2024, and described its enforcement through regular supervision and remedial orders.
How many of the unqualified persons in the various sectors have since obtained a qualification cannot be traced one-to-one, because this data is not kept at individual level.

Hoeveel van de onbevoegde personen in de verschillende sectoren inmiddels een bevoegdheid hebben gehaald, is niet één op één te herleiden, omdat deze gegevens niet op individueel niveau worden bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over de berichten ‘Studenten met STAP-budget niet tevreden over commerciële opleiders’ en ‘Stapbudget maakt meerjarige studie vaak juist duurder dan voorheen.’

An MP asked the ministers about reports that STAP-budget students are dissatisfied with commercial providers, that multi-year courses are not well covered and became more expensive, and about the lottery-like allocation of the budget. The ministers answered that quality safeguards are being tightened, that multi-year funding for follow-on years will be introduced around July 2023, that a transitional arrangement for students affected by the tax-deduction switch is being considered, and that the application process will be reviewed.
The cabinet considers it necessary that citizens must be able to trust the suitability and quality of the training offered through the STAP budget.
Het kabinet acht het noodzakelijk dat burgers moeten kunnen vertrouwen op de geschiktheid en de kwaliteit van de opleidingen die worden aangeboden middels het STAP-budget.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Peter de Groot en Paul over het bericht ‘Helft van scholen aan nieuwbouw of renovatie toe, extra geld onzeker’

MPs Peter de Groot and Paul (VVD) asked the ministers for Housing and for Primary and Secondary Education about a report that nearly half of Dutch schools need renovation or replacement and that extra funding is uncertain. Minister Wiersma answered that a national picture is still being compiled, that responsibilities are split across municipalities, school boards and the central government, and promised a funding task force reply and further information in Q1 2023.
In the first quarter of 2023 I will inform you of the outcomes of the research.
In het eerste kwartaal van 2023 zal ik u informeren over de uitkomsten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Peters over de onderwijsbevoegdheid voor de lerarenopleidingen ITEPS en ITESS

MPs Van der Molen and Peters asked whether graduates of the ITEPS and ITESS teacher programmes, which overlap with pabo and teacher training but do not confer a Dutch teaching qualification, can be deployed in classrooms and quickly obtain a qualification given the teacher shortage. The ministers answered that the programmes are separate, were approved on labour-market grounds, that graduates can enter schools under conditions while completing top-up training, and that they will hold a conversation with the institution.
In the conversation we announce in answer to question 5, we will also pay attention to differences between the various programmes.
In het gesprek, dat wij in antwoord op vraag 5 aankondigen, zullen wij ook aandacht hebben voor verschillen tussen de verschillende opleidingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het initiatief 'Agora Underground'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about the Roermond 'Agora Underground' initiative to run a digital school for truant pupils, including whether the Inspectorate's finding that it fails the Compulsory Education Act should be reconsidered and what steps will provide education to around fifteen thousand truants. The Minister says the government sees digital distance learning as a promising tool, that the Inspectorate will assess such initiatives constructively but found quality and regular school attendance lacking, and that a fuller digital school design will be reported to parliament in spring 2023.
With Agora Underground, however, it has become apparent that the quality of education and the guidance of pupils do not meet the law, so that the basic quality of education falls short.
Bij Agora Underground is echter gebleken dat de onderwijskwaliteit en de begeleiding van leerlingen niet voldoen aan de wet waardoor de basiskwaliteit van het onderwijs tekort schiet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over Bijlesbureaus die misbruik maken van ouders

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about commercial tutoring agencies pressuring parents, whether the Chamber's earlier motion against advertising via schools has been implemented, and what rules apply to tutors. The minister acknowledges the problem, promises stricter sector guidelines, a VOG requirement bill, and a monitor, but gives no firm timeline and has not answered the questions before the budget debate.
I will introduce a bill for internet consultation this winter stating that schools may only hire staff from providers of supplementary education who hold a certificate of conduct (VOG).
Daarom breng ik nog deze winter een wetsvoorstel in internetconsultatie waarin staat dat scholen alleen personeel van aanbieders van aanvullend onderwijs mogen inhuren die een VOG bezitten.
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Maatoug, Westerveld en Ellemeet over de inhuur van externe arbeid in publieke sectoren

MPs Maatoug, Westerveld and Ellemeet asked ministers about the use of external and flexible labour in the public and semi-public sectors, its effect on care quality and costs, and government steps to curb it. The government answered that it is pursuing measures to make employment under contract more attractive, tighten rules on self-employment and monitor agency and tariff arrangements, while stating it cannot provide sector-level data on many questions.
Apart from the figures below on external hiring within central government, education and care and welfare, no data are kept for (semi-)public sub-sectors.
Behalve onderstaande cijfers over inhuur van externe arbeid binnen de Rijksoverheid, het onderwijs en zorg en welzijn, worden geen data bijgehouden voor (semi)-publieke (deel)sectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over de berichten dat het aantal tijdelijke contracten in het primair en voortgezet onderwijs ondanks de krappe arbeidsmarkt stijgt

An MP asks the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education about rising temporary contracts in education despite a tight labour market, including the share of temporary teaching contracts, the role of temp agencies, and the effect of NPO funds. The minister acknowledges temporary contracts are undesirable, promises agreements with social partners to raise permanent contracts and cites ongoing measures, but gives no binding commitment and attributes trends to pensions, new hires and falling pupil numbers.
My ambition is to give this concrete substance as soon as possible, preferably still this school year.
Mijn ambitie is om hier zo snel mogelijk, liefst nog dit schooljaar concreet invulling aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over verlaging van de urennorm

MP De Hoop asked the minister whether lowering the teaching-hours norm for teachers should be pursued to ease the teacher shortage and workload, and how this relates to the sector's proposals and past motions. The minister answered that the matter is being discussed with social partners, noting complex consequences for quality and equity, and promised further information before the 15 December debate.
I will look into this as part of further agreements with the social partners.
Ik ga hiernaar kijken als onderdeel van verdere afspraken met de sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over voortgezet onderwijs voor kinderen, die in de residentiele jeugdzorg en GGZ geen onderwijs of geen passend onderwijs hebben kunnen volgen

An MP asked the ministers of Education and of Primary and Secondary Education about routes to higher education for youths in youth care who missed schooling, including lowering the age for the colloquium doctum, dropping the binding study advice, reinstating the propedeuse diploma, extending vavo funding, and applying the thumb rule to state exam candidates. The ministers declined most proposals, citing uniform diploma rules and existing support, while promising to explore case-specific deviations on the colloquium doctum and to inform parliament in spring 2023.

We will check with relevant parties such as secondary schools, universities of applied sciences and universities whether in specific cases a deviation from the age limit for the colloquium doctum can be made.

We zullen daarom met betrokken partijen zoals vo-scholen, hogescholen en universiteiten nagaan of er in specifieke gevallen afgeweken kan worden van de gehanteerde leeftijdsgrens voor het colloquium doctum.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Thijssen over het bericht 'Grote energieleverancier in de problemen; scholen ongerust'

MPs De Hoop and Thijssen asked the ministers about reports that energy supplier DVEP had stopped sending invoices and closed to new customers, leaving schools worried. The minister said billing delays were caused by a system upgrade, that the ACM was alerted but does not comment on specific investigations, and that no emergency plan exists beyond general rules for small consumers, with compensation for school energy costs being considered in the budget.
The ACM, however, makes no statements about whether investigations into specific suppliers are ongoing or not.
De ACM doet echter geen uitspraken over al dan niet lopende onderzoeken naar specifieke leveranciers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht ‘Busje komt weer niet: schrijnende crisis in leerlingenvervoer’

An MP asked the minister whether children missing school due to the pupil transport crisis face home visits and threats of proceedings at Bureau HALT, and what protections exist. The minister said such signals are unknown, that such measures are unacceptable and not at issue, and that absences caused by transport problems are excused.

I find it unacceptable if truancy officers visit and threaten to draw up a official report for Bureau HALT for children who do not go to school when the cause lies solely in the pupil transport crisis.

Ik vind het onacceptabel als er leerplichtambtenaren op bezoek komen en dreigen met het maken van een proces-verbaal bij Bureau HALT bij kinderen die niet naar school komen als de oorzaak alleen bij de crisis in het leerlingenvervoer ligt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht dat grote steden extra hulp willen bij onderwijs aan asielkinderen

Van Haga asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education about big cities requesting extra help for education of asylum children, linking population growth to teacher shortages, workload and social cohesion, and asked whether the government would push to curb population growth. The minister acknowledged the pressures and pointed to teacher-shortage measures and a civics expertise point, but declined to commit to pushing for curbing population growth, referring the question to a state commission reporting in 2023.

The State Commission on Demographic Developments, which started this autumn, will advise on 1 November 2023 on scenarios, possible policy options and the government's courses of action regarding the societal consequences of demographic developments

De Staatscommissie Demografische ontwikkelingen die dit najaar van start is gegaan, brengt 1 november 2023 advies uit over scenario's, mogelijke beleidsopties en handelingsperspectieven van de regering
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Podt over het bericht 'Honderden asielkinderen op wachtlijst voor onderwijs, Den Haag wil hulp van kabinet'

Two D66 MPs asked the education minister about reports of hundreds of asylum-seeking children on waiting lists for schooling and whether the government would act. The minister confirmed the problem across many municipalities, said the regular newcomer education remains preferred, and promised to explore alternative temporary provisions and further steps with stakeholders.
I will explore what the options are for another type of temporary educational provision, more tailored to the heterogeneity of this target group.
Ik ga verkennen wat de mogelijkheden zijn voor een ander type tijdelijke onderwijsvoorziening, meer toegespitst op de heterogeniteit van deze doelgroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Piri over het gebrekkige onderwijsaanbod voor kinderen in asielopvangvoorzieningen

MPs Kröger and Piri asked about children in asylum reception being moved to a cruise ferry without education in place, and why this happens, how often, and what measures will prevent repetition. The government admits the move should not have happened, acknowledges pressure on newcomer education, and points to planned legislation and a flexibilisation agenda to reduce relocations.
Since not all necessary facilities in Velsen were ready for the group, this group should not yet have been moved.
Aangezien voor de groep nog niet alle noodzakelijke voorzieningen in Velsen gereed waren, had deze groep echter nog niet verhuisd moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over onderwijs en zorg

An MP asked the education and health ministers about children with support needs who do not receive suitable education for financial reasons, the tension with inclusive education ambitions, funding of municipalities and specialist providers, and reserves in schools. The minister responded that the government will pursue inclusive education, promised further letters and action plans, and acknowledged that excessive school reserves are undesirable but described them as temporary.
At national level it is not tracked how many children use support hours to follow education, or how many hours this concerns.
Op landelijk niveau wordt niet bijgehouden hoeveel kinderen gebruik maken van ondersteuningsuren om onderwijs te volgen, of om hoeveel uren dit gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Groep 7/8 van cbs De Wegwijzer moet op zoek naar een andere school'

MPs Peters and Van der Molen (CDA) asked the minister whether teacher shortages forcing two classes at a village primary school to seek another school would become more common, how the closure norm should be handled, what distances children may travel, and who is responsible for keeping primary education accessible in regions. The minister acknowledged the concern, said there are no concrete signals of wider effects, pointed to regional cooperation and a national teacher strategy, and stated the acceptable distance limits set by law.
That is why all options must be opened up to tackle the shortages.
Daarom moeten alle registers open om de tekorten aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de uitspraak van de Afdeling Bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State over het Cornelius Haga Lyceum
