MP Van Baarle (DENK) asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education how the government could have labelled the Cornelius Haga Lyceum guilty of mismanagement, given the Council of State ruling that there was no wanbeheer or unjust enrichment, and asked for apologies, lessons and an external review. Minister Wiersma largely rejected the accusations of error and stigmatisation, defended the inspectorate-based intervention, acknowledged the court's finding that the instruction was disproportionate, and refused an apology and external investigation.

With the bill expanding the administrative instruments, which I informed your House about in letters of 30 May 2022 and 28 June 2022, I expect to be able to intervene more quickly in a comparable situation in the interest of pupils.

Met het wetsvoorstel Uitbreiding bestuurlijk instrumentarium waarover ik uw Kamer in de brieven van 30 mei 2022 en 28 juni 2022 heb geïnformeerd ga ik ervan uit dat ik in een vergelijkbare situatie in het belang van de leerlingen sneller kan ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over thuiszitters in het funderend onderwijs

An MP asked the minister about the number of school truants, the rising number of compulsory-education exemptions under article 5(a) of the Leerplichtwet, the procedure for granting them, and the role of school boards and digital or part-time schooling. The minister reported about 4,300 long-term truants in 2020-2021, promised further research and a bill tightening the exemption procedure around mid-2023, and said there was no explanation yet for the rise in exemptions.
Based on the figures I receive via municipalities, I have no explanation for the increase.
Op basis van de cijfers die ik via gemeenten ontvang heb ik geen verklaring voor de toename.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Rajkowski over Privacy van leerlingen

MPs Paul and Rajkowski asked the minister about claims that children's online activity, including at school, is recorded and commercially exploited, and about media literacy and EU child-advertising rules. The minister replied that schools must not use pupil data commercially under the GDPR and a privacy convenant, that digital literacy core goals are being developed, and that EU rules ban targeted advertising to minors.
School boards, as data controllers, are themselves responsible for compliance and must make agreements with suppliers of those products that process pupils' data.

Schoolbesturen zijn als «verwerkingsverantwoordelijke» zelf verantwoordelijk voor de naleving daarvan en moeten afspraken maken met leveranciers van die producten waarin gegevens van leerlingen worden verwerkt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peters over het bericht ‘Onderwijs ontsnapt aan chaos met overname schoolboekenleverancier TLN’ en het bericht ‘Schoolboeken te laat geleverd: ‘Rommelig begin van nieuw schooljaar’’

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about late delivery of school textbooks to over a million students after supplier problems and about textbook price increases and price transparency. The minister acknowledged delivery failures, blamed logistics and outsourcing, reported 3-4% annual price rises, said pricing is a matter between schools and suppliers, and promised an evaluation and binding agreements with market parties.
Based on the outcomes of this evaluation, I will convene a meeting with school boards, market parties and SEM.
Ik zal op basis van de uitkomsten van deze evaluatie een gesprek beleggen met schoolbesturen en marktpartijen en SEM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht dat uitgeverijen boeken pas leveren in november en dat tienduizenden mbo’ers nog zonder boeken zitten

An MP asked the education ministers about late delivery of textbooks by publishers to vocational (mbo) and secondary school students and whether publishers should be obliged to deliver. The ministers answered that logistics problems caused delays, that schools improvised with alternative materials, that digital licences were decoupled from print delivery, and that they expect parties to find solutions while market and Wet Gratis Schoolboeken issues will be addressed in a later policy response.
We therefore expect institutions to work with students, where possible, towards appropriate solutions to prevent and limit any learning delays.
Van instellingen verwachten wij daarom dat zij waar mogelijk samen met studenten tot passende oplossingen komen, om eventuele leerachterstanden te voorkomen en te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat boeren de schoolklassen van de gemeente Bergen (Limburg) langsgaan

An MP asked the education minister whether farmers visiting primary schools in Bergen (Limburg) spread misleading nitrogen messages to children and whether schools and the government should prevent this. The minister answered that schools choose their own guest speakers and materials, that content is the schools' responsibility, and that the inspectorate can intervene if rules are breached, without committing to new action.
It is not for the government to assess the tone adopted by a school or school board regarding a particular teaching method or guest speaker.
Het is niet aan de overheid om de toonzetting van een school/schoolbestuur m.b.t. een bepaalde lesmethode/gastspreker te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de aanpak van het lerarentekort

An MP from the Labour party asked the education ministers how they would tackle the teacher shortage, including whether pabo students who fail the entrance test may continue, whether school closures and four-day school weeks are stopgap measures, and how these fit the Primary Education Act. The ministers answered that the teacher shortage is a risk to quality, that a strategy and an independent advisory team (Van de Bunt) will propose cooperation, that the pabo entrance-test experiment gives students one extra year, and that four-day weeks are allowed only seven times a year and are not acceptable beyond that, with the inspectorate ordering a remedy plan.

The inspectorate, which has intensive contact with the school, has given the school board a remedy order to come up with an action plan so that children can return to five-day school weeks as soon as possible.
De inspectie, die intensief contact heeft met de school, heeft een herstelopdracht gegeven aan het bestuur om met een plan van aanpak te komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht 'Duizenden leerlingen speciaal onderwijs te laat op school door personeelstekort'

Van Baarle (DENK) asked the minister about reports that thousands of special-education pupils arrive late at school because of staff shortages in pupil transport, and about the lack of contact with transport firms. Minister Wiersma answered that gemeenten are responsible, that emergency solutions and structural measures are being pursued, and that she will engage the VNG and KNV, though no new funding is committed.
Although the legal responsibility for implementing pupil transport lies with the municipalities, I will not refrain from extra or targeted action.
Hoewel de wettelijke verantwoordelijkheid van de uitvoering van het leerlingenvervoer bij gemeenten ligt, zal ik extra dan wel gerichte actie niet nalaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Nispen over het artikel 'KVLO: 'Tekort sportaccommodaties brengt bewegingsonderwijs PO in gedrang''

MPs Heerema and Van Nispen asked the minister about a KVLO report warning of too few gymnasium places to deliver two hours of physical education in primary schools, and whether municipalities were using their funds properly and preparing in time. The minister answered that municipalities have no earmarked funds and that the matter is local, that an inventory was done and a communication plan will be drawn up, but gave no figures on the shortfall or on intervention.
Gymnasium capacity is a local matter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Kathmann over het bericht dat er steeds meer tijdelijke contracten worden gegeven in het onderwijs

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports that temporary contracts in education are increasing and whether this undermines retention amid teacher shortages. The ministers answered that permanent work should be the norm, outlined measures such as tightening rules on temporary contracts and strategic HRM legislation, and provided university and hogeschool contract ratios for 2015-2021.
The cabinet's starting point is that structural work is in principle organised on the basis of permanent employment contracts.
Het uitgangspunt van het kabinet is dat structureel werk in principe wordt georganiseerd op basis van arbeidsovereenkomsten voor onbepaalde tijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Peters over het bericht 'Moeder vraagt om hulp: 10-jarige Arianny kan op Bonaire niet naar school'

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about a news report on a 10-year-old on Bonaire unable to attend school, and about special education and compulsory schooling for children with disabilities in Caribbean Netherlands. The minister answered that the child has been placed, that a specialist facility opened in September 2022, that no new study is needed given the 2020 Berenschot evaluation, and that a new education agenda will explore structural provision.
No, there is a publicly funded primary school specifically aimed at pupils who need extra support, the Strea Briante.
Er is een bekostigde school voor primair onderwijs die zich specifiek richt op leerlingen die extra ondersteuning nodig hebben, de Strea Briante.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over het bericht 'lucratieve bijverdiensten voor fulltime topbestuurders'

MPs Westerveld and Bromet asked whether top executives in the (semi-)public sector who earn above the WNT pay cap through side functions as supervisors should be restricted, and about their workload and transparency. The minister answered that the anti-cumulation rule was deliberately limited to executive posts, that no data on cumulative earnings exist, that a public side-function register would add administrative burden, and that the government will examine tightening the rule within a planned WNT amendment.
As part of the planned WNT amendment that the cabinet recently announced, I am willing to examine the pros and cons of further tightening the anti-cumulation provision.

In het kader van de wetswijziging Wnt die ik namens het kabinet onlangs heb aangekondigd, ben ik wel bereid om nader uit te laten zoeken wat de voor- en tegens zijn van het verder aanscherpen van de anticumulatiebepaling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid het lid Dassen over het bericht ‘Scholen die gedwongen hun energiecontract opzegden zijn tot twaalf keer duurder uit’

An MP asked the ministers about reports that schools forced to terminate energy contracts face up to twelve times higher costs, asking about the scale of bills, financial risks, monitoring, compensation and energy-efficiency targets for school buildings. The minister replied that no national overview of energy contracts or school finances exists, that a targeted support motion is being implemented with a report due by 1 December, that schools can report acute liquidity problems to the ministry, and that monitoring relies on annual accounts plus a sample inquiry.
There is no national overview of which school boards have which energy suppliers or what prices they pay.
Er is geen nationaal overzicht welke schoolbesturen welke energieleveranciers hebben of welke prijzen zij betalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Thijssen, Peters en Bontenbal over het artikel 'Scholen die gedwongen hun energiecontract opzegden zijn tot twaalf keer duurder uit'

Four MPs asked the ministers about schools forced to cancel energy contracts with Gazprom and face sharply higher costs, including the scale of the problem, scenarios, quality of education, building insulation and inequality. The minister answered that no national overview exists, that schools in acute liquidity problems can report to OCW, that a motion asks for targeted support to be reported by 1 December, and that a subsidy scheme for sustainable public buildings opens on 3 October.
There is no national overview of which school boards have which energy suppliers.
Er is geen nationaal overzicht welke schoolbesturen welke energieleveranciers hebben.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen, Paul, De Hoop, Beertema, Segers, Kwint, Bisschop en Westerveld over de berichten Klachtenregen van ouders over Trevvel: Ik kwam elke dag te laat op mijn werk en verloor zo mijn

MPs asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education about reports of late or missing school transport for pupils in special education, caused by driver shortages. The minister acknowledged the problem, said municipalities are responsible for pupil transport, promised to pressure the VNG, gather information on affected regions, and await a monitoring study due by year-end.
However, for privacy reasons it is not possible to make the results public per municipality.
Het is vanwege privacy echter niet mogelijk om de resultaten per gemeente openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over Het beroep op vrijstelling wegens richtingbezwaren

MP Bisschop asked the government whether a Zuid-Holland Zuid truancy region's practice of asking parents for their specific religion or belief when claiming exemption on grounds of objection to a school's denomination is lawful, whether it breaches GDPR and due-care principles, and whether it wrongly involves youth health care and Veilig Thuis. Minister Wiersma answered that asking for the specific belief is necessary and lawful under the Supreme Court's case law and the GDPR, that the municipality rather than the minister is responsible for enforcement, that a well-argued exemption alone is not grounds for a Veilig Thuis report, and that the regional policy document has been adjusted on that point.
Enforcement of compulsory education is first and foremost a matter for the municipal authorities concerned.
De handhaving van de leerplicht is op de eerste plaats een zaak van de betrokken gemeentebesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de antwoorden op Kamervragen over ondermaatse motoriek basisschoolleerlingen

An MP asked the minister to explain differences between ALO-trained and post-initial HBO-trained physical education teachers, the evidence on their effectiveness, and policy on hiring ALO teachers to address declining motor skills and teacher shortages. The minister answered that both routes give starting competence, that research shows little difference in parent and child satisfaction, that two weekly lessons alone are insufficient for children with serious motor deficits, and that schools decide on staffing while the ministry promotes specialist teachers via funding and a planned survey.
Two hours of physical education per week, however, is not sufficient to bring children with serious motor skill deficits up to a sufficient level.
Twee uur bewegingsonderwijs per week is echter niet voldoende om kinderen met ernstige achterstanden in de motorische vaardigheden op een voldoende niveau te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over burgerschapsonderwijs

Parliamentary questions from MP Bisschop (SGP) asked the Minister whether the Inspectorate's framework for new schools, which rejected applications over civic education, was vague, overly detailed, and poorly explained. The Minister replied that the framework follows the legal civic education duty, requires only aimed and coherent education goals rather than detailed lesson-level plans, that the Inspectorate provides hearing rights and written motivation, and that the procedure will be evaluated and refined.
I attach value to the Inspectorate having motivated its advice in writing, and offering initiators the opportunity to request further explanation.
Ik hecht er waarde aan dat de inspectie de adviezen schriftelijk heeft gemotiveerd, en initiatiefnemers de gelegenheid biedt om een nadere toelichting te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Bikker over het bericht 'Veel schoolleiders hebben geen idee wanneer de ventilatie in de klas op orde komt'

MPs Segers and Bikker asked about reports that many school leaders do not know when classroom ventilation will be fixed, and about CO2 meters, subsidies and the risk of a new COVID wave. Minister Wiersma acknowledged the urgency, explained the ventilation subsidy scheme of 140 million euros and said schools themselves are best placed to choose CO2 meters.
I acknowledge the urgency of getting ventilation in schools where insufficient steps have been taken recently up to standard as quickly as possible.
Ik erken de urgentie om de ventilatie op scholen waar de afgelopen tijd nog onvoldoende stappen zijn gezet zo snel mogelijk op orde te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Paul over Financiële en bestuurlijke chaos op de Amsterdamse As Siddieq scholen

MPs De Hoop and Paul asked the education minister about financial mismanagement and governance failure at the As-Siddieq schools, including roughly €300,000 spent unlawfully, the impact on pupils, whether the board can fix the problems, recovery of funds, publication of the inspectorate report, and linking the case to pending legislation. The minister confirmed the inspectorate's findings, said recovery and sanctions against the board are underway, and declined to link the live case to the pending bill.
The procedure to recover the approximately €300,000 has already been initiated.
De procedure om de circa € 300.000 terug te vorderen is reeds in gang gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over passend onderwijs

An SP MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about the delayed national baseline support norm for inclusive education, thuiszitters, leerlingenvervoer, and samenwerkingsverband financing. The Minister answers that the norm will first be developed for three support areas with delivery expected by early 2023, promises a bundled verzuim approach, a 2023 onderwijszorgarrangementen experiment with a doorzettingsmacht figure, but declines to give the Inspectie direct enforcement power as the motion requested.
As previously indicated to your House, this is not an appropriate solution.
Zoals al eerder aangegeven aan uw Kamer, is dit geen passende oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Brekelmans, Ceder en Slootweg over actuele problemen van Oekraïense ontheemden

MPs asked the state secretary and ministers about problems faced by Ukrainian displaced persons, including education, income, childcare, information and housing. The government answered that municipal education choices are acceptable, rejected a fully Ukrainian curriculum for children in the Netherlands, and described existing benefit, childcare and housing measures.
It is essential that children receive a full educational offer that suits their development.
Het is namelijk essentieel dat kinderen een volwaardig onderwijsaanbod krijgen dat past bij hun ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over zij-instromers die moeilijkheden ervaren om aan de slag te gaan in het onderwijs

An MP from the VVD asked the education ministers why career changers who want to become teachers are turned away because teacher-training intakes start only twice a year, and what will be done to make hiring them easier and support them. The ministers acknowledge the concern, point to a higher subsidy for career changers, regional cooperation and extended RAP funding, but do not commit to changing the twice-yearly start dates.
We expect that, through the increase in the subsidy budget for guiding and training career changers, it will become attractive for school boards to hire career changers.
Wij verwachten dat het door de verhoging van het subsidiebudget voor het begeleiden en opleiden van zij-instromers aantrekkelijk wordt voor schoolbesturen om zij-instromers aan te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel ‘Het Woud gymt alleen nog buiten, óók als het regent’

An MP asked the minister about a newspaper report that a school gymnasium only offers outdoor PE, and whether schools can meet the two-hour PE requirement without adequate indoor facilities. The minister said outdoor PE is legally permitted, that 53 percent of primary schools gave less than two 45-minute PE lessons, and that a list of municipalities lacking facilities cannot be shared because the research was anonymized, though a sports-facility inventory will be shared before summer.
Sharing a list of these is not possible, because OCW did not carry out the research itself but a research agency did.
Een lijst hiervan delen is niet mogelijk, omdat OCW niet zelf het onderzoek heeft uitgevoerd, maar een onderzoeksbureau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over de huisvesting van onderwijsexpertisecentrum De Berkenschutse

An MP asks whether municipality Heeze-Leende can finance new premises for the special-education centre De Berkenschutse, and whether small municipalities generally can fund school buildings with regional functions. The minister answers that municipalities are responsible for school housing, funded via the general fund without earmarking, that the Education Expertise Centres Act offers no room for school boards to co-finance, and that ministry officials will visit the school on 1 July 2022 and report after the summer.
It is the responsibility of the municipality to provide suitable housing for the school that meets the legal requirements, as set out in the Building Decree.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente te voorzien in passende huisvesting van de school, die voldoet aan de wettelijke vereisten, zoals opgenomen in het Bouwbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het lesmateriaal en de leerlijn van COC over genderdiversiteit en het voornemen tot doorontwikkeling

An SGP MP asked the minister whether COC's primary school materials on gender diversity, which tell young pupils that fluid gender identity is normal, respect children's psychological safety, and whether the inspectorate should review them. The minister answered that schools are free to choose materials within their legal duties on respect for sexual and gender diversity and social safety, that the government sees no current reason to consider the materials anti-democratic, and that a planned ban on anti-democratic learning materials is being worked out.
We currently have no reason to assume that COC's materials lead to anti-democratic or anti-rule-of-law education.
We hebben nu geen aanleiding om aan te nemen dat materiaal van het COC leidt tot antidemocratisch of antirechtsstatelijk onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over koppelverkoop door educatieve uitgeverijen

An MP asked whether the LiFo licence-plus-book model used by educational publishers amounts to tying (koppelverkoop) that forces schools to buy time-limited online licences, and what the government will do about it. The minister said tying is for the competition authority ACM to establish, that ACM sets its own agenda, that schools choose materials and can articulate demand via SIVON, and that the government will respond after summer in its reaction to the Free School Books Act evaluation.
Tying is a form of abuse of a dominant economic position. It is up to the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) to establish tying in specific cases.
Koppelverkoop is een vorm van misbruik van een economische machtspositie. Het is aan de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) om koppelverkoop in specifieke gevallen vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Paul over de toegankelijkheid van leermiddelen voor kinderen met een visuele beperking

MPs De Kort and Paul asked whether the European Accessibility Act, which does not cover education, could be extended to schoolbooks and digital learning materials for pupils with visual impairments, and whether this fits the curriculum review. The minister said amending the Act would be lengthy and uncertain, so national options and agreements with publishers are being explored, while pointing to existing subsidies and the curriculum work.

In that light, I am already in discussion with the parties involved, including the Mediafederatie and Koninklijke Visio, to look for ways to ensure publishers make their digital learning materials accessible to pupils with a (visual) impairment.

In dat licht ben ik al in gesprek met de betrokkenen waaronder de Mediafederatie en Koninklijke Visio om te zoeken naar mogelijkheden om ervoor te zorgen dat uitgevers hun digitale leermiddelen toegankelijk maken voor leerlingen met een (visuele) beperking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over opmerkingen van buurtsportcoach mevrouw N. Haarman tijdens het rondetafelgesprek ‘bewegingsarmoede’ op 21 februari jl.

An MP asked whether municipalities using neighbourhood sports coaches as physical education teachers, paid under the sports collective agreement rather than the education one, circumvents co-financing duties and should be banned. The minister said the arrangement is undesirable, will discuss it with the municipalities concerned and VSG, and will examine the practice in the upcoming revision of the regulation.
On substance, I find it undesirable if such a construction leads to the neighbourhood sports coach being deployed solely in education.
Inhoudelijk vind ik het onwenselijk als een dergelijke constructie leidt tot enkel de inzet van een buurtsportcoach in het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Becker over het nieuwe inspectierapport over het Cornelius Haga Lyceum

MPs Paul and Becker (VVD) asked the minister why the Cornelius Haga Lyceum's education quality deteriorated, why the school remains open despite serious concerns, and what sanctions and faster intervention are possible. Minister Wiersma answered that the inspectorate rated all departments very weak, outlined sanctions already applied and options still available, and said she will inform parliament before summer on faster intervention for underperforming schools.
If education does not improve within a year, the limit has been reached and I will intervene.
Indien het onderwijs niet binnen een jaar verbetert, is de maat vol en zal ik ingrijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Becker over het bericht ‘Menstruatie meteen melden bij de juf – straks ook in het Westland’

MPs Paul and Becker asked the Education and Social Affairs ministers about an Islamic school board's rule requiring girls to report menstruation to teachers before joining prayer, and about citizenship education and oversight of Islamic schools. The minister answered that the rule was unacceptable, that the Inspectorate contacted the board which agreed to remove it, and that the government will use the Inspectorate, the safety duty and a planned expansion of administrative powers, while stating the matter would be raised with the municipality.
In this case, the inspectorate discussed the entire identity policy, as it appeared on the website, with the board.
In dit geval heeft de inspectie het hele identiteitsbeleid zoals dat op de website stond besproken met het bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over het bericht 'Ons belastinggeld komt niet goed in de klas terecht'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education whether the 300 million euros for reducing teacher workload in secondary education will reach teachers quickly, how spending will be monitored, and whether team-level or individual-level measures are preferred. The minister answered that cao agreements require school boards to pass the funds to schools, involve staff in spending decisions, and that an evaluation of the workload funds will be started.
The evaluation research will show whether the funds have led to the desired effect.
Uit het evaluatieonderzoek zal blijken of de middelen tot een gewenst effect hebben geleid.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Peters over het lerarentekort in Nederland

An MP asked the minister whether qualified Surinamese teachers could be allowed to work in the Netherlands to ease the teacher shortage, and what could be done to make exceptions possible. The minister answered that Surinamese teachers lack full qualifications and need a combined residence and work permit, which requires a labour market test, and pointed to existing routes such as career changers and schools' ability to pursue creative solutions within the rules.
Before the summer, my colleague, Minister Dijkgraaf of OCW, and I will send you a letter on the approach to the shortages, of which career-changer inflow is part.
Voor de zomer sturen mijn collega, Minister Dijkgraaf van OCW en ik u een brief over de aanpak van de tekorten, waar zij-instroom deel van uitmaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Podt over het bericht ‘Surinaamse leerkrachten kunnen ons lerarentekort opvangen, maar ze mogen niet komen’ en de uitzending van Kassa van 5 maart 2022

MPs Van Meenen and Podt asked why Surinamese teachers were refused residence and work permits in the Netherlands despite a teacher shortage, and whether Suriname has a teacher surplus. The minister answered that permits are refused when Wav conditions, including qualifications and priority supply, are not met, that there is no evidence of a surplus in Suriname, and that the Netherlands will focus mainly on domestic recruitment and retention.
The reason for refusal was that the conditions set in the Foreign Workers Employment Act (Wav) were not met, including possessing the correct qualifications.
Reden voor afwijzing was dat niet voldaan werd aan de voorwaarden die in de Wet arbeid vreemdelingen (hierna: Wav) worden gesteld, waaronder het beschikken over de juiste kwalificaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Hoop over het bericht dat bovenbouwleerlingen lesgeven aan onderbouwleerlingen

MP De Hoop asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education about a report that upper-grade pupils were teaching lower-grade pupils because of teacher shortages, and about safety, monitoring and the wider teacher shortage. The minister replied that the report did not reflect reality since pupils only gave extra tutoring, that the school board is responsible for safety, and pointed to existing monitoring and plans to intensify the approach.

The school board explained that the news report does not reflect reality; upper-grade pupils do not independently stand in front of the class at the school but assist lower-grade pupils who need extra tutoring in specific subjects.
Het bestuur van de school heeft toegelicht dat het nieuwsbericht geen recht doet aan de werkelijkheid; bovenbouwleerlingen staan op de school niet zelfstandig voor de klas
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over onderbetaling werknemers bij inhuur juridische ondersteuning bij Rijksoverheid

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister about underpayment of temporarily hired legal staff at central government ministries and agencies, including unequal pay for equal work via staffing agencies, and whether the government would stop such arrangements and enforce chain liability. The government answered that pay is a matter between staffing agencies and employees, that the framework contract's general terms require compliance with labour law, and that it will investigate how accountable client oversight of hired staff can be improved and report in the 2022 annual report.
It is up to the client bodies within central government to ensure, through good and regular consultation with the suppliers of the deployed staff, that the contract conditions are also complied with.
Het is aan de opdrachtgevers binnen het Rijk om in goed en regelmatig overleg met de leveranciers van de ingezette medewerkers ervoor te zorgen dat de contractvoorwaarden ook worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de mondelinge examens in het voortgezet speciaal onderwijs

An MP asked why vso students receive their central written exam results only after the oral college exams, and whether examiners' knowledge of those results could be shared earlier. The minister confirmed the timing, explained that N-terms and grading are not ready before oral exams start in June, and said the CvTE is examining, under the Verbeteragenda Staatsexamen, how earlier release could be made possible.
To ensure that all state exam candidates begin the oral college exams from the same starting position
Om ervoor te zorgen dat alle staatsexamenkandidaten vanuit dezelfde startpositie aan de mondelinge college-examens beginnen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het artikel 'MQ Scan: 24% van basisschoolleerlingen heeft ondermaatse motoriek; Zorgwekkende piek onder negenjarigen'

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about a press report that 24% of primary pupils have below-average motor skills, and what will be done about it, including gym capacity and whether specialist PE teachers should be mandatory. The minister answered that a statutory two-hour PE requirement from 2023, subsidy schemes and a gym-capacity inventory are underway, but declined to set a threshold for mandatory specialist teachers, citing the labour market and school choice.
As soon as these are available, I will share them with your House.
Zodra deze beschikbaar zijn, zal ik dit met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen over de voorbereidingen in het funderend onderwijs op de komst van Oekraïense vluchtelingen

An MP asked how education for Ukrainian refugee children and young adults is being prepared, including lessons from the Syrian influx, LOWAN capacity, trauma support, funding for newcomer pupils and data linkage with COA and DUO. The ministers answered that temporary facilities and newcomer schools are being scaled up, LOWAN is reinforced with extra funds, funding rules are adjusted to cover Ukrainian pupils, and that data are incomplete, with an estimated 6,000–7,000 pupils of compulsory school age.
The precise number of pupils subject to compulsory education is not yet available, but based on inflow data and J&V estimates of the minor share (37%), about 6,000–7,000 pupils are assumed.

Het precieze aantal leerplichtige leerlingen is nog niet beschikbaar, maar op basis van gegevens over de instroom en inschattingen van J&V over het percentage minderjarige (37%) wordt uitgegaan van ongeveer 6.000–7.000 leerlingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht dat nog steeds niet alle middelbare scholen duidelijk maken dat de vrijwillige ouderbijdrage echt vrijwillig is

Two MPs asked the Minister why many secondary schools still do not clearly state that the voluntary parental contribution is optional and that children may not be excluded from activities if parents do not pay. The Minister agrees this is unacceptable, reports 88 Inspectorate signals since August 2021 with remedy orders and possible fines, and announces a new communication campaign and extra Inspectorate attention.
The Inspectorate is giving extra attention to the voluntary parental contribution in its supervision this year.
De Inspectie heeft in haar toezicht dit jaar extra aandacht voor de vrijwillige ouderbijdrage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Rudmer Heerema over de voorkeur voor de vakleerkracht bewegingsonderwijs

MPs Van Nispen and Rudmer Heerema asked whether all physical education lessons in primary schools should be given by ALO-qualified specialist teachers, including what barriers exist and whether a law change is planned. The minister replied that the current mix of specialist and qualified group teachers should remain, that a full switch is unrealistic given teacher shortages and funding, and that no law change is warranted.
Given the current education labour market, I see no reason to change the law on this point.
Ik zie, gelet op de huidige onderwijsarbeidsmarkt, geen aanleiding om de wet op dit punt te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Smals over het bericht ‘Meerderheid scholen weigert inzet zzp’ers ondanks lerarentekort’

MPs Paul and Smals asked the government about a report that most schools refuse to deploy freelancers (zzp'ers) despite teacher shortages, and about enforcement moratorium, the DBA web module and legal uncertainty over flexible contracts. The minister answered that there are no signs refusals worsen teacher shortages, that enforcement moratorium remains in force with exceptions for malicious cases and unfollowed instructions, that the web module is only indicative and a broader policy letter will follow before summer 2022.
Before the summer we will inform you further about the elaboration of this ambition in the coalition agreement.
Voor de zomer zullen wij u nader informeren over de uitwerking van deze in het coalitieakkoord opgenomen ambitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Hoop over de verlenging van het Nationaal Programma Onderwijs

An MP asked whether the drop in per-pupil funding for primary schools to about €500 would change how school effort and results are assessed, and whether schools can deliver the same interventions on that amount. The minister replied that the allocation was reshaped toward secondary education, with about €500 per pupil for primary and €820 for secondary, and that indicative amounts will be communicated earlier, with more funding directed to schools with greater disadvantage.
My intention is that approximately €820 per pupil will be available for secondary education and €500 per pupil for primary education.
Mijn intentie is dat er voor het vo een bedrag van ongeveer € 820 per leerling beschikbaar is en voor het po een bedrag van € 500 per leerling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over Gorillas

An MP asked whether Gorillas became a Dutch holding to avoid stronger German co-determination rules and whether it sought to block a works council in Germany, and asked for a comparison of Dutch and German and European co-determination law. The minister said the company's choices are its own responsibility, could not confirm a link to German rules, noted a Berlin court rejected Gorillas' request to end works council elections, and gave a detailed overview of differences in works council rights and EU directives without committing to any action.
It is the responsibility and authority of a company to weigh the strategy and policy it pursues.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid en bevoegdheid van een bedrijf om een afweging te maken over de te voeren strategie en beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.

Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Kwint en Westerveld over het bericht dat schoolbesturen jarenlange partnerschappen sluiten met commerciële uitzendbureaus voor de inhuur van flexibel onderwijspersoneel

MPs Kwint and Westerveld asked the minister about school boards outsourcing flexible teacher staffing to commercial temp agencies at high cost, and whether this conflicts with a motion to limit agency use. The minister answered that agency staffing is sometimes needed, that regional procurement can control costs, that stricter rules for private partnerships will be drafted with sector councils, and that data on agency spending and teacher numbers are not available.
This precise information is not available.
Deze precieze informatie is niet voorhanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Paul over het voorstel in de Maastrichtse gemeenteraad om het openbaar voortgezet onderwijs af te schaffen

Two MPs asked the minister whether a Maastricht council proposal to abolish public secondary education and centralise schools on one campus undermines the constitutional guarantee of public education, whether a draft covenant overreaches council powers, and whether large-scale schooling harms the human scale of education. The minister replied that conversion from public to special-denomination schools is possible under legal conditions, that the public-education guarantee remains a municipal responsibility and cannot be transferred by covenant, and that evidence does not link school size to human scale.
However, a covenant cannot transfer or set aside (constitutional or statutory) legal tasks.
In een convenant kunnen echter geen (grond)wettelijke taken overgedragen of opzijgezet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Peters over het bericht 'Bijlesbedrijven schieten als paddenstoelen uit de grond'

MPs Segers and Peters asked whether the rapid growth of private tutoring firms (schaduwonderwijs) is undesirable, given risks to educational inequality and possible subsidy funding. The minister agreed the growth is undesirable, said NPO funds may be used for private tutoring, and deferred the full research and action plan to later reports.
My intention is not to repeat this research before the National Education Programme has been completed.
Mijn voornemen is om een herhaling van dit onderzoek niet eerder te doen dan na het afronden van het Nationaal Programma Onderwijs
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Van Beukering-Huijbregts over werkenden en studenten met Long Covid

Two MPs from D66 asked ministers about workers and students with long-covid, covering occupational care for self-employed, WIA disability inflow, paramedical recovery care coverage, and university support. The government answered that research on long-covid is ongoing, WIA inflow is partly explained by structural factors while UWV investigates the rest, paramedical care is capped at two six-month periods, and it will not extend this limit.
I do not intend to extend the maximum treatment period of twice six months.
Ik ben niet voornemens de maximale behandeltermijn van tweemaal zes maanden te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over "mislopen hypotheekrenteaftrek in de bijstand en woonkostentoeslag"

An MP asked whether mortgage interest tax relief is counted as income in welfare benefits, causing eigenwoningbezitters to lose it and possibly fall outside housing cost allowance, and whether this could push people onto the street. The minister confirmed the tax refund counts as income under the Participatiewet, pointed to case-by-case discretion and early-warning schemes, and said the Participatiewet reform would be examined.

In addition, people are entitled to (temporary) special assistance in the form of housing cost allowance when, in the college's judgement, their situation involves necessary costs arising from exceptional circumstances that cannot be met from available resources.

Daarnaast hebben mensen recht op (tijdelijke) bijzondere bijstand in de vorm van woonkostentoeslag wanneer er in hun situatie naar het oordeel van het college sprake is van, uit bijzondere omstandigheden voortvloeiende noodzakelijke kosten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Kuik over het artikel 'In veel branches wordt werk geruild voor seks'

Two CDA MPs asked whether trading work for sex in various industries, reported by AD, falls under prostitution rules, whether it amounts to exploitation of vulnerable people, and what measures, reporting options and advertisement restrictions exist. The State Secretary answered that exchanging services for sex is not prostitution, is not prohibited but is condemned when it involves abuse, pointed to a pending bill on sexual offences, reporting options and branch self-regulation, and promised to draw branches' attention to the law.

The cabinet will ensure that the bill now with the Council of State, which makes it punishable to know or ought to know that the other person does not want sexual contact, is explicitly brought to the attention of the branches.

Het kabinet zal ervoor zorgen dat het wetsvoorstel dat bij de Raad van State ligt, waarmee geregeld wordt dat je strafbaar bent als je weet of had moeten weten dat de ander geen seksueel contact wil, uitdrukkelijk onder de aandacht wordt gebracht bij de branches.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over Long COVID en de wet poortwachter

An SP MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether Long COVID, a poorly understood and possibly chronic condition, should be handled under the Wet verbetering poortwachter reintegration rules and whether social security policy should be changed for Long COVID patients. The Minister replies that the rules apply equally regardless of cause, that tailored reintegration is possible within existing policy, and that no policy change is needed.
I see no need to change social security policy for Long COVID patients.
Zie ik geen noodzaak om het beleid rond de sociale zekerheid voor Long COVID-patiënten aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het bericht Nederlanders met niet-Westerse migratieachtergrond financieel kwetsbaarder

An MP from DENK asked the government about an AFM report and news that Dutch residents with a non-Western migration background are more financially vulnerable, including that 40% of pensioners in this group live below the poverty line, and about low uptake of the AIO supplementary pension benefit, barriers to financial services, Wwft effects and Islamic finance products. The State Secretary acknowledged the vulnerability, cited CBS data showing 25.5% of potentially eligible non-Western pensioners did not claim AIO, and listed measures such as a data-sharing pilot between SVB and UWV, financial literacy programmes and a consumer choice action plan, while stating that the Wwft requires individual risk assessment.

I share the message behind it. A considerable share of pensioners with a non-Western migration background is financially vulnerable and relies on assistance in the form of the supplementary income provision for elderly people (AIO).

Ik deel de boodschap die erachter zit. Een aanzienlijk deel van de pensioengerechtigden met een niet-Westerse migratie-achtergrond is financieel kwetsbaar en is aangewezen op bijstand in de vorm van een aanvullende inkomensvoorziening voor ouderen (AIO).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over “de restitutie van transitievergoeding voor werkgevers.”

An SP MP asked whether employers lose the right to recover the transition payment when a worker with a fast-tracked full incapacity benefit (IVA) leaves via a settlement agreement before the 104-week sick-pay period ends, and whether this is being litigated. The minister confirms the rule under Article 7:673e BW, says UWV has won all past appeals and 12 are pending, and rejects changing the rule because it would undermine the dismissal ban during sickness.
No, I do not agree with that.
Nee, daar ben ik het niet mee eens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat verzekeraars jagen op miljarden in het nieuwe pensioenstelsel.

An SP MP asked the government about reports that insurers are targeting pension assets of company pension funds under the new pension system, including the effects on participants, solidarity, insurer profits, lobbying and meetings with insurers. The Minister replied that the choice of pension provider is for employers and funds, that a careful process with DNB oversight and fund-body rights applies to transfers, and that the government does not expect pension interests to be harmed, while many questions were answered only generally or said the information is not available.
It is not possible to provide an overview of the requested information, because this information is not available.
Het is niet mogelijk om een overzicht van de gevraagde informatie te geven, omdat deze informatie niet beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Van der Laan over het bericht ‘Thuiszorghulp heeft voortaan ook recht op sociale zekerheidsregelingen’

MPs Van Beukering-Huijbregts and Van der Laan asked the government about a court ruling that personal care helpers paid via a PGB (personal budget) are entitled to unemployment insurance (WW) under indirect sex discrimination, and about its consequences for premiums, informal work, and social security for domestic workers. The minister answered that the ruling is under appeal at the CRvB and should not be extrapolated, that UWV continues to apply the exemption pending the appeal, and that extending WW coverage would have far-reaching implications for the system, so no change is planned.
This concerns a ruling by one court in an individual case. There is therefore no settled case law.
Het betreft hier een uitspraak van één rechtbank in een individuele casus. Daarmee is geen sprake van bestendige jurisprudentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Westerveld en Kwint over de gevolgen van de veranderende bekostigingssystematiek voor het primair onderwijs

Three MPs asked whether the new education funding system from 2023 would force primary school boards to draw down reserves by about 500 million euro, and whether this would reduce money for education. The minister answered that the change is a purely accounting adjustment with 100% of funding still paid out, that the inspectorate will treat affected boards leniently for five years, and that no real funds are lost.
As indicated, this is a technical, accounting exercise and in practice no money disappears from school boards.
Zoals aangegeven gaat het hier om een technische, boekhoudkundige exercitie en verdwijnt er feitelijk geen geld bij besturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kwint over 'een kinderopvangbedrijf dat betaalde uren kinderopvang niet levert, maar ook niet compenseert'

An MP asks why a childcare provider lets prepaid hours lapse without compensation or extension, and whether this takes state subsidy for undelivered services. The minister answers that the arrangement is a private contract matter, that the provider does incur costs when a child is absent, and that the ministry has no role in such disputes.
How childcare hours that could not take place are handled is set out under private law in the contract the parent and the childcare provider agreed before care began.

Hoe omgegaan wordt met kinderopvanguren die niet hebben kunnen plaatsvinden is privaatrechtelijk vastgelegd tussen de ouder en de kinderopvangorganisatie in het contract dat ze voor de start van de opvang overeen zijn gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Ceder over het bericht ‘Medewerkers van GGD moeten weg na drie tijdelijke contracten’

MPs Bikker and Ceder asked the ministers about reports that GGD staff on test and vaccination sites must leave after three temporary contracts, and whether covid financing could allow permanent contracts. The government answered that GGD organisations are responsible for their own personnel policy, that permanent contracts and redundancy procedures are possible, that VWS will finance certain extra costs under a cost-reimbursement scheme, and that talks will continue.
I have asked the GGDs whether they can quickly map the size of the group(s) of employees, as well as the financial implications that follow from this.
Ik heb aan de GGD’en gevraagd of zij op korte termijn de omvang van de groep(en) werknemers in kaart kunnen brengen, evenals de financiële implicaties die hieruit voortvloeien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over het bericht 'Rechtbank Arnhem fluit uitkeringsinstantie terug om te strikte toepassing wet'

An MP asked the minister about a court ruling that overturned UWV's strict application of the WIA daily-wage rules, which left a claimant with a lower benefit because of one day of work in the reference period. The minister answered that the rules are binding, that UWV had no discretion, that UWV will not appeal, and that the government is examining possible adjustments and a hardship clause.
UWV has indicated that it will not appeal this ruling.
UWV heeft aangegeven niet in beroep te gaan tegen deze uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de te lage thuiswerkvergoeding in het licht van de stijgende prijzen en corona-lockdown

An SP MP asked the government whether the 2 euro per-day telework allowance, set against rising prices and a COVID lockdown, should be raised, and whether the Nibud should recalculate it, while also questioning wage growth and poverty. The ministers answered that the allowance would not be adjusted early, only indexed from 2023, and pointed to energy-tax cuts and a municipal compensation scheme instead.
The cabinet sees no reason to adjust the flat-rate allowance because of the higher inflation, which is mainly a consequence of rising energy prices.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding het forfait aan te passen vanwege de hogere inflatie die vooral een gevolg is van de stijgende energieprijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over belemmeringen zzp’ers bij aanvraag coronasteunmaatregel

An MP asks why municipalities handle the simplified Bbz benefit for self-employed differently, whether the viability test and cost-sharing norm delay support, and why the Tozo was not reinstated. The minister answers that municipal variation is intended within legal bounds, that the simplified Bbz is temporary, that excessive information requests were addressed, and that the government will keep the Tozo closed and extend the simplified Bbz.
In those cases, the VNG was asked to contact the municipality concerned to communicate about this.
In die gevallen is de VNG gevraagd contact met de betreffende gemeente op te nemen om hierover te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kathmann over het bericht dat meer dan de helft van de Amsterdamse taxichauffeurs betrokken was bij strafzaken in de afgelopen drie jaar

MPs Kathmann asked the Minister of Justice and Security how the government responds to a report that over half of Amsterdam taxi drivers were involved in criminal cases in three years, including whether this occurs elsewhere, how drivers are made resilient, how supervision works, and whether large taxi platforms should be restricted. The minister answered that the report is noted, that a joint integral approach with multiple agencies is being explored, that licensing and VOG screening are in place, and that platform rules will be reviewed in the periodic taxi law evaluation due in 2023.

Together with the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, the municipality of Amsterdam, the Inspectorate for the Living Environment and Transport, the Public Prosecution Service, the police, the Regional Information and Expertise Centres and the Tax Authority, measures that could be taken in response to the Bureau Beke study are being explored.

Met het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat, de gemeente Amsterdam, de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport, het Openbaar Ministerie, de politie, de Regionale Informatie en Expertise Centra en de Belastingdienst wordt naar aanleiding van het onderzoek van Bureau Beke verkend welke maatregelen er kunnen worden getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het onlangs gesloten coalitieakkoord (Hoofdstuk arbeidsmarkt en inkomen)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment and the Minister for Poverty Policy about the labour market and income chapter of the new coalition agreement, including regulation of flexible contracts, WW duration, the AOW link to the minimum wage, arbeidsmigranten and UWV. The government mostly answered that the advisory reports serve as a guideline and that details will follow after further elaboration, while confirming the AOW will be decoupled from the extra minimum wage increase.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this when the elaboration takes place.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover bij de nadere uitwerking geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Leijten over “de verplichting door gemeenten tot een alimentatieverzoek als al vaststaat dat dit geen kans van slagen heeft”

SP MPs asked whether it is acceptable that municipalities can require welfare recipients to file hopeless alimony claims, as criticized by a court, and asked about scope, costs, cost recovery and ending such practices. The State Secretary acknowledged the court's criticism, said such obligations must be used carefully and not where a claim has no chance, declined a broad inventory as unfeasible, and committed to alerting municipalities in Gemeentenieuws.
I consider a broad inventory as you propose too far-reaching in that light, and I also consider such an inventory unfeasible.
Ik vind een brede inventarisatie zoals u voorstelt in dat licht te vergaand en ik acht een dergelijke inventarisatie ook onuitvoerbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over de schrijnende huisvesting van arbeidsmigranten

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked the government about substandard housing of migrant workers, overcrowding linked to high rents, and enforcement by municipalities and employment agencies. The minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to the Goed Verhuurderschap bill, certification plans for employment agencies, housing funding and a coming Jaarrapportage, but gave mostly general commitments without new enforcement powers for the central government.
Municipalities will soon get an additional instrument with which they can act better against abuses.
Gemeenten krijgen straks een extra instrument in handen waarmee ze beter kunnen optreden tegen misstanden.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Kent over de situatie van arbeidsmigranten in Boskoop

An SP MP asked the government whether it considers living conditions for migrant workers in a Boskoop accommodation (beds on the floor, housing separated only by a fence) inhumane, and asked for sanctions on the agency and inspections of this and other locations. The minister replied that the municipality reports no violations after two unannounced inspections, points to planned Goed Verhuurderschap legislation and a housing handbook, and sees no reason for further checks.
It is after all the responsibility of the municipality to oversee compliance with the granted permits and adherence to the Building Decree.
Het is immers de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente om toe te zien op de naleving van de verleende vergunningen en het voldoen aan het Bouwbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Strolenberg over de Grenseffectenrapportage 2021 dossier 2 'Impact analyse van de toekomst van thuiswerken voor grensarbeiders na COVID-19' van de Maastricht University

An MP asks the State Secretary of Social Affairs about the Maastricht University impact analysis on post-COVID cross-border remote work, including social security and tax consequences, the timing of a long-term vision, extension of temporary measures, a remote-work percentage, and a Benelux or EU agreement. The government agrees the effects are real, reports agreement with Belgium and Germany to extend tax treaty arrangements and a half-year extension of EU social security rules, says temporary measures are tied to force majeure, and proposes exploring a bilateral agreement under Article 16 while promising a forthcoming vision letter.
Yes, I agree that the possible consequences of increased remote work mentioned in the report may have an impact on social security and taxation of cross-border remote workers.
Ja, ik ben het eens dat de in het rapport genoemde mogelijke gevolgen van het toegenomen thuiswerk impact kunnen hebben op sociale zekerheid en fiscaliteit van thuiswerkende grensarbeiders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de petitie van 700 distributiemedewerkers van GXO

MP Van Kent asked the State Secretary about a petition by 700 GXO distribution workers concerning a security check during breaks, H&M's refusal to accept the petition, and whether an unannounced inspection would be carried out. The State Secretary answered that employers are primarily responsible for safe work, that break rules are enforced civilly and via the Inspectorate SZW, that individual cases cannot be commented on, and that the Inspectorate conducts risk-based, often unannounced inspections and investigates all reports submitted via works councils or unions.
No statements are made about individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smals over het bericht dat het pensioenfonds ABP uit fossiel stapt

An MP asked the Secretary of State about ABP's decision to stop investing in fossil fuel companies, probing participant influence, employer consultation, climate effectiveness, DNB guidance, engagement cooperation, and whether pension funds should pursue social themes over pension returns. The government answered that the fund board is responsible for investment policy under the Pensioenwet, that the effect on climate goals is uncertain though it reduces portfolio climate risk, and that DNB guidance is advisory and not enforceable.
The pension fund board is responsible for implementing the pension scheme, including investment policy.
Het pensioenfondsbestuur gaat over de uitvoering van de pensioenregeling, inclusief het beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Brandbrief grote steden: duizenden vluchtelingen veroordeeld tot falend inburgeringsstelsel’

Two MPs asked the state secretary about a letter from big-city municipalities warning that thousands of refugees would be stuck under the old integration system after the new Integration Act takes effect. The state secretary answered that a transitional arrangement was rejected for legal-equality and legal-certainty reasons, that municipalities would be supported and a motion would be explored, but could not provide all answers in time.
Unfortunately, I have not been able to do that.
Dat is mij helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Paulusma over het bericht 'Dure betalingsregeling van Infomedics maakt de tandarts onbetaalbaar'

MPs Kat and Paulusma asked whether dental-clinic payment arrangements run by billing firm Infomedics, which charge patients service fees, are acceptable, and whether such fees should be banned. The minister said such fees should be avoided, that a ban is not under consideration, and that the sector and Infomedics will be consulted on practical solutions.
The cabinet has set itself the goal of preventing collection costs as much as possible and acting quickly on early payment arrears.
Het kabinet heeft wel als doel gesteld om incassokosten zoveel mogelijk te voorkomen en snel te acteren bij beginnende betalingsachterstanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Woude, Kamminga en Becker over het bericht 'French government protests EU Commissioner meeting with 'Islamist' NGO'

MPs Van der Woude, Kamminga and Becker asked ministers about an EU Commissioner's meeting with the FEMYSO network, reported as Islamist, and about whether Dutch student associations linked to FEMYSO received university funding. The government declined to endorse the French criticism, said it supports broad civil-society consultation, reported limited funding details from universities, and said the Taskforce on problematic behaviour and undesirable foreign financing would act only if concrete problematic conduct arose.
The cabinet has confidence that our higher education institutions are well able to critically assess applications for financial support for student organisations
Het kabinet heeft er vertrouwen in dat onze instellingen voor hoger onderwijs uitstekend in staat zijn om aanvragen voor financiële ondersteuning voor studentenorganisaties kritisch te beoordelen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht "Lange wachtlijst kinderopvang dwingt ouders minder te gaan werken"

An MP asked the state secretary about long childcare waiting lists, the shortage of childcare staff, the decline in registered childminders from about 33,000 to 22,000, and municipal fees for childminder registration. The state secretary answered that staff shortages are a concern, that childminding is a flexible option, that the causes of the decline are unknown pending research due in summer 2022, and that improvement measures will be decided by the next cabinet.
Due to the required legislative amendment, financial coverage and the caretaker status of the cabinet, decision-making on improvement measures is ultimately for the next cabinet.
Vanwege de benodigde wetswijziging, financiële dekking en de demissionaire status van het kabinet, is besluitvorming over verbetermaatregelen uiteindelijk aan het volgende kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Kent over een gemeente die gesprekken over uitkeringen filmt

MPs Leijten and Van Kent asked whether filming benefit conversations in the municipality of Dronten is acceptable, whether it undermines trust, and how the municipality complies with privacy law. The minister answered that filming privacy-sensitive talks needs a legal basis and must be necessary and proportionate, that the municipality has halted filming pending a review, and that the Dutch data protection authority and courts will judge its admissibility.
At present filming has been completely halted and the municipality is carrying out a review examining which means can be used and the advantages and disadvantages of each.
Op dit moment is het filmen geheel stil gelegd en voert de gemeente een onderzoek uit waarin gekeken wordt welke middelen kunnen worden ingezet en wat per middel de voor- en nadelen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Beukering-Huijbregts over de rol en representativiteit van vakbonden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about whether trade unions truly represent workers in a sector, including young workers, and about the union subsidy paid by employers and the role of unions versus works councils in pensions. The State Secretary replied that the union and collective agreement system enjoys broad satisfaction, that membership growth lags and may affect representativeness, and that he is willing to discuss representation with social partners.
That does not alter the fact that I consider good representation of all employees important, including employees not covered by a collective agreement.
Dat neemt niet weg dat ik een goede vertegenwoordiging van alle werknemers van belang acht, inclusief de werknemers die niet onder een cao vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over de tv uitzending Radar ‘De rol van de gerechtsdeurwaarder’

An MP asked the government about a Radar broadcast on a bailiff collecting disputed debts for a dubious company, and about bailiff oversight, dispute handling, complaint statistics and legal protection. The minister condemned any improper pressure, declined to judge the individual case, pointed to existing supervision by the BFT and the Kamer voor gerechtsdeurwaarders, and noted pending incasso quality legislation.
I cannot make statements about an individual case.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over een individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het artikel 'Geregistreerde Schuld Regeling ontvangen'

An MP (D66) asked about a proposal for a registered debt scheme run by bailiffs to reduce repeated attachment costs borne by debtors, and about related risks, legal changes and foreign models such as Belgium's IOS procedure.
