The minister acknowledges the cost problem, points to a planned bill on coordinating third-party garnishment and a further deepening exercise, but declines a substantive assessment of fraud and legal-protection risks and says the Belgian model is not to be introduced.
I refrain from a substantive response and assessment of the risks of fraud and negative legal protection for the debtor because I do not yet want to anticipate the aforementioned deepening exercise.

Ik onthoud mij van een inhoudelijke reactie en beoordeling van de risico's op fraude en negatieve rechtsbescherming van de schuldenaar omdat ik nog niet vooruit wil lopen op de hiervoor genoemde verdiepingsslag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het bericht ‘Door schuldhulpverlener kampen Arnhemmers met nieuwe schulden: ‘Dit moet binnen een week zijn opgelost’’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports that Arnhem residents accumulated new debts through a municipal debt-assistance contractor (PLANgroep), and about quality standards, procurement, oversight and risks of outsourcing debt help to commercial parties. The State Secretary acknowledged the errors, said municipalities remain responsible for quality under the Wet gemeentelijke schuldhulpverlening, pointed to the NVVK quality framework and procurement rules, and said complaints go to the municipality.
The municipal executive and the municipal council are responsible for quality assurance.
Het college van burgemeester en wethouders en de gemeenteraad zijn verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteitsborging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de oproep van de FNV om Black Friday dit jaar over te slaan

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs and the Minister for Health whether Black Friday should be cancelled given FNV's call and last year's crowding and infection risks for retail staff. The government answered that employers remain responsible for safe workplaces, that retailers spread Black Friday over longer periods, that burgemeesters retain intervention powers, and that this year's Black Friday proceeded safely without needing intervention.
Intervention by the mayors has therefore not proven necessary.
Ingrijpen door de burgemeesters is daardoor niet nodig gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de opgelopen inflatie en de gevolgen voor de koopkracht in 2022

Omtzigt asked the Social Affairs state secretary about the rise in inflation to 3.4% (CPI) and 3.7% (HICP) in October 2021, the lower tax indexation factor, and the implications for purchasing power in 2021 and 2022. Wiersma confirmed the figures, noted that annual inflation is likely higher than the 1.9% forecast, said purchasing-power figures will be updated only after the CPB's March 2022 forecast, and listed a set of measures already adopted.
I will continue to closely monitor inflation developments.
Ik blijf de inflatieontwikkelingen goed monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over mogelijk onterecht in rekening gebrachte kosten door de deurwaarder

Two SP MPs asked whether bailiffs may charge debtors €84.64-€85.36 for bank-account information requests under art. 475aa Rv even without subsequently seizing funds, and whether this is justified. The Minister defended the separate tariff as comparable to EAPO work, rejected evidence of abuse, promised to raise transparency and tariff concerns with the bailiffs' association, but refused to drop the tariff.
I will continue to raise the practical operation of this bank-inquiry arrangement in my regular discussions with the KBvG.
Ik zal in mijn reguliere gesprekken met de KBvG aandacht blijven vragen voor de praktijkwerking van onderhavige regeling omtrent bankbevragingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het artikel ‘Zieke uitzendkrachten worden ontslagen, terwijl dat wettelijk niet mag’

An MP from the PvdA asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about reports that sick temporary agency workers are dismissed via the temporary-work clause despite legal limits, and about the rise in sickness-benefit claims, extra premiums, and loopholes. The State Secretary answers that case law and literature are unclear on dismissal during sickness, that the Wet Werk en Zekerheid bars dismissal during illness across all sectors, that the Supreme Court is pending on the issue, and that tightening temporary-contract rules will be left to a future cabinet.
I consider it important to await that ruling.
Ik acht het van belang die uitspraak af te wachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tielen over het bericht ‘Zieke uitzendkrachten worden ontslagen, terwijl dat wettelijk niet mag’

An MP asked the State Secretary about reports that sick temporary agency workers are dismissed via the agency clause, despite the statutory ban on dismissal during illness, and about UWV's handling of such cases. The State Secretary answered that the clause may currently be invoked, UWV does not yet change its practice pending a Supreme Court ruling, and that the Commission Regulation of Work's advice to ban it during illness will be considered later, without committing to a proposal now.
The Employee Insurance Agency (UWV) does not yet adjust its implementation practice following the Court of Appeal of The Hague ruling, partly because it is awaiting the Supreme Court ruling.

Het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) past de uitvoeringspraktijk vooralsnog niet aan naar aanleiding van de uitspraak van het Gerechtshof Den Haag, mede omdat er gewacht wordt op de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat zieke uitzendkrachten worden ontslagen terwijl dat wettelijk niet mag

An SP MP asked the state secretary how the government responds to reports that sick temporary agency workers are being dismissed despite the legal prohibition, and whether the uitzendbeding (temp-agency clause) can be invoked during illness, including questions on cao enforcement and preventing agencies from ignoring court rulings. The state secretary answered that the question is pending before the Hoge Raad, declined to anticipate the outcome, said new routes to avoid responsibility are undesirable, and stated UWV will not refuse benefits in the meantime.
I do not want to anticipate the outcome of the mentioned court case, since it is still before the court.
Ik wil niet op de uitkomst van de genoemde rechtszaak vooruitlopen nu deze nog onder de rechter is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de situatie van arbeidsmigranten in Boskoop

An SP MP asks the government about housing conditions for migrant workers in Boskoop, including a visitor being confronted by police, mould, windowless rooms, SNF certification enforcement, and the Roemer committee recommendations on floor space and separate leases. The minister answers that residents may receive visitors, that SNF inspects and handles complaints but cannot share company-specific data, and outlines the Goed Verhuurderschap bill and planned measures, often without a concrete commitment on timing.
I cannot make a statement about this specific situation.
Ik kan geen uitspraak doen over deze specifieke situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beukering-Huijbregts over het stappenplan ‘OR zoekt jonge collega’s’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about the SER step-plan 'OR zoekt jonge collega's' and how to encourage young people to join pension fund accountability and beneficiary bodies. The State Secretary answered that diversity matters, that the sector itself is primarily responsible, pointed to existing initiatives and the diversity norm, and agreed to discuss a similar step-plan with the Stichting van de Arbeid and the Pensioenfederatie.

I would like to enter into discussion with the Stichting van de Arbeid and the Pensioenfederatie to see whether a similar step-plan can be made to increase the number of young people in accountability and beneficiary bodies.

In aanvulling daarop ga ik graag in gesprek met de Stichting van de Arbeid en de Pensioenfederatie, om te bezien of er ook een soortgelijk stappenplan gemaakt kan worden om het aantal jongeren in verantwoordingsorganen en belanghebbendenorganen te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het artikel 'Elke maand 1.050 euro voor thuisloze jongeren: het werkt'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about a Eindhoven project giving homeless youths a monthly allowance and whether such experiments and a basic income-type approach would be scaled up. The State Secretary said the project overlaps with national income policy, will seek independent legal advice from the Landsadvocaat, and declined to compile an overview of such experiments while pointing to existing pilots and the ZonMw programme.
I will therefore call in the Landsadvocaat for independent legal advice.
Ik zal daarom de Landsadvocaat inschakelen voor onafhankelijk juridisch advies.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over het wetsvoorstel Het niet-indexeren van het basiskinderbijslagbedrag en het extra bedrag van de kinderbijslag in de Algemene Kinderbijslagwet over de jaren 2022, 2023 en dee

The MP asks why the government said the non-indexation of child benefit formed a balanced 'dekkingspakket' with cuts to the IACK, and how that package was agreed and communicated to parliament. The State Secretary answers that the package was disclosed in the 2021 legislative debate and bill explanation, was agreed within the former coalition, and that the cuts were split evenly (27% child benefit, 27% IACK, 45% Aof premium) to finance parental leave and implementation agencies.
As I indicated in the plenary debate of 13 October, it would have been better had the measures of the overall package been submitted and considered as a whole.
Zoals ik in het plenair debat van 13 oktober jl. heb aangegeven, was het beter geweest als de maatregelen uit het totaalpakket als geheel zouden zijn ingediend en behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Gijs van Dijk over de uitspraak van de Centrale Raad voor Beroep inzake werken vanuit de bijstand

MPs Maatoug and Gijs van Dijk asked the State Secretary about the Central Appeals Tribunal ruling on working while on welfare benefits (bijstand) and the risk of income falling below the welfare level. The Secretary answered that about 40,000 cases a year are affected, that most municipalities are adjusting their practice while some systems are still being changed, and that she is working with VNG, Divosa and the G4 and on the Simpel Switchen project, but declined to adopt a 50% generic income disregard.
Welfare recipients whose benefit has been terminated since the CRvB ruling and who believe the termination was wrongful can turn to their municipality.
Bijstandsgerechtigden van wie de bijstandsuitkering sinds de uitspraak van de CRvB is beëindigd en die het idee hebben dat de beëindiging onterecht is, kunnen zich richten tot hun gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het gebruik van de deeltijd-WW nu werk afneemt door de stijgende energieprijzen

An SP MP asked whether companies can use short-time work (werktijdverkorting) exemptions because of rising energy prices, and what the government will do to prevent dismissals and fund retraining. The Secretary of State said energy price rises are a normal business risk that rarely qualifies for an exemption, that no firm currently has one, and pointed to existing retraining schemes and tax relief for businesses.
There are no companies that have an exemption from the ban on short-time work citing rising energy prices.
Er zijn geen bedrijven die onder verwijzing naar de stijgende energieprijzen een ontheffing hebben van het verbod op werktijdverkorting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bikker over de gevolgen van de coronacrisis voor mensen in de prostitutie

An MP asked whether COVID-19 closure measures and high infection rates would push sex workers into unsafe work and whether support schemes would reach them. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, said support schemes including VLN and bijstand zelfstandigen are open to sex workers who meet the conditions, and promised continued monitoring with municipalities.

Furthermore, the cabinet, together with the VNG, Divosa and municipalities, is monitoring whether additional measures or funds are needed to bridge this limited lockdown for people facing a sudden drop in income.

Verder houdt het kabinet samen met de VNG, Divosa en gemeenten vinger aan de pols of er aanvullende maatregelen of middelen nodig zijn om deze beperkte lockdown te overbruggen voor mensen die te maken krijgen met een plotseling terugval in inkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Ceder over de situatie van arbeidsmigranten in Tiel

MPs Van Kent (SP) and Ceder (ChristenUnie) asked the State Secretary of Social Affairs about homeless EU labour migrants living outdoors in Tiel and how the government will implement the motion Segers/Marijnissen calling for a tailored plan. The State Secretary says the municipality offered help and cleared the camp, and that an interdepartmental Plan van Aanpak for vulnerable homeless EU citizens is being finalised with the VNG and G4 and will be sent to parliament once agreed.
Once the necessary coordination, interdepartmental and with municipalities, is completed, the plan of action will be sent to your House.
Zodra de daarvoor benodigde afstemming, interdepartementaal en met gemeenten, is afgerond, wordt het plan van aanpak aan uw Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het wijzigen van het asbeststelsel

An SP MP asks the State Secretary of Social Affairs why the government plans to drop air measurements by accredited laboratories after certain asbestos removal projects, weakening independent final inspection, and questions the cost savings, the reliance on models, and the removal of certification. The State Secretary rejects the concerns, arguing that air measurements are unnecessary where fibres are not expected, that the change is risk-based, and that certification remains for higher-risk applications.
Performing air measurements to establish whether it is safe is not always necessary and should only be used in situations where fibres could actually be expected in the air.

Het doen van luchtmetingen om vast te kunnen stellen of het veilig is, is daarbij niet altijd nodig en zou alleen ingezet moeten worden in situaties waarin ook daadwerkelijk vezels in de lucht te verwachten zouden kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en El Yassini over het bericht ‘Zoveel banen en toch niet aan de bak: voldoe niet aan profiel’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about a news report of a 60-year-old long-term unemployed woman rejected for not fitting a 'profile', and whether this masks age, gender or ethnic discrimination. The State Secretary cited research on perceived discrimination, said the government will not yet judge the specific case, pointed to its anti-discrimination action plan and a bill on equal opportunities in recruitment, and described re-integration and training support for older jobseekers.
For now I refrain from an opinion on the appearance of age discrimination in this case, because a complete picture of the facts and circumstances is lacking.
Vooralsnog onthoud ik mij van een opvatting over de schijn van leeftijdsdiscriminatie in de onderhavige casus, omdat een volledig beeld van de feiten en omstandigheden ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over het toezicht op de kinderopvang

An MP asks the State Secretary about large variation between municipalities in childcare inspection outcomes, the funding of GGD GHOR, the AEF report on cooperation in childcare supervision, and rising administrative burden. The State Secretary answers that supervision is decentralised so differences are not necessarily undesirable, that the national partners' overlap structure was revised, that evaluations of supervision and the Wet IKK start this autumn, and that results will be sent to parliament.
I will inform your House of the outcomes.
Over de uitkomsten zal ik uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en De Hoop over "ongelijke toeslagen voor studenten met een beperking"

MPs Gijs van Dijk and De Hoop asked why students with disabilities still receive less individual study allowance than promised, what steps were taken to get municipalities to pay 300 euro, which municipalities underpay, and whether funding or the Breed Offensief bill should be split to fix this. The state secretary answered that municipalities hold the authority and responsibility for setting the allowance, urged them to pay 300 euro from age 21 within current law, said national government lacks municipal-level data, and declined to split the controversial bill or grant extra funds, saying municipalities have sufficient budget.
The national government does not have information on the level of the individual study allowance in individual municipalities.
De rijksoverheid beschikt niet over informatie over de hoogte van de individuele studietoeslag in afzonderlijke gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland, Amhaouch en Peters over het bericht ‘Kloosters kijken nog steeds uit naar coronasteun’

MPs asked the government about religious institutions such as monasteries, churches and mosques that reportedly struggle with lost income and get little corona support. The government answered that religious organisations can use the TVL and NOW schemes on the same terms as others, reported 79 religious TVL applications (66 granted, EUR 1,001,482), and said it had held talks with religious umbrella bodies.
For the NOW, it was not separately registered whether religious institutions made use of the NOW.
Voor de NOW is niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd of religieuze instellingen gebruik hebben gemaakt van de NOW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over ‘het niet-indexeren van de kinderbijslag en het feit dat dat honderden miljoenen meer gaat opleveren voor het rijk door de toegenomen inflatie’

MP Omtzigt asks whether non-indexation of child benefit under bill 35 845, which was meant to raise about 100 million euro for ICT costs, would yield far more if inflation is higher, and asks the government to amend the bill and cap the structural yield. State Secretary Wiersma answers that the bill's cumulative and structural cover depends on inflation forecasts, that the government sees no need for an amendment now, and that it will send answers before the plenary debate.
I acknowledge the possibility of rising inflation, which means non-indexation of child benefit could ultimately generate more revenue than estimated when the bill was drafted.

Ik onderschrijf de mogelijkheid van een stijgende inflatie waardoor het kan zijn dat de niet-indexering van de kinderbijslag uiteindelijk meer opbrengsten genereert dan geraamd tijdens het opstellen van het wetsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kat over het aanvragen van loonkostenvoordelen door werkgevers

An MP from D66 asked the state secretaries about how employers apply for wage-cost subsidies for hiring people with work disabilities, including whether the correction deadline is clear and whether a legal succession changes entitlement. The government answered that guidance is published in several places, that corrections are possible until 1 May of the following year, and that the subsidy right does not pass to a successor company in a takeover or legal merger.
I am of the view that the conditions and the process are sufficiently clear because sufficient communication has taken place about them.
Ik ben van mening dat de voorwaarden en het proces voldoende duidelijk zijn omdat hierover voldoende wordt gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Ellian, Brekelmans en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Asielzoeker waarschuwde voor moordplan Iraanse geheime dienst'

VVD MPs asked whether the IND and AIVD were warned in advance about an Iranian-directed assassination plot and what Dutch and EU responses to Iran and to Iranian dissidents are. The state secretary declined to comment on individual cases or on AIVD working methods, pointed to existing reporting structures and the sanctions and diplomatic measures already taken, and gave no concrete new commitment.
As you know, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals u weet doe ik over individuele zaken geen mededelingen.

No figures are available on this specific question.
Over deze specifieke vraag zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Haan en Smals over het bericht ‘werkloze ouderen komen nog altijd moeilijk aan een baan’

MPs Den Haan and Smals asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether older workers and people with chronic illness have very low odds of finding paid work within a quarter, and what the government will do about labour market activation. The minister disputes the framing, gives labour market statistics and describes existing and planned measures (Seniorenkansenvisie, banenafspraak, communication on working after AOW age), while stating the effects of abolishing zero-hour contracts on pensioners' participation will be assessed.
Yes, I am aware of the report.
Ja, ik ben bekend met het bericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smals over heldere en toegankelijke publiekscommunicatie over de Wet toekomst pensioenen

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about unclear public communication on the Wet toekomst pensioenen, misconceptions among citizens, the campaign plan, information for vulnerable elderly, derde pijler coverage and checking contact data. The minister answered that a phased, partner-based campaign will run from 2023 to 2026 via Pensioenduidelijkheid.nl, FAQs, offline information points, and pension-fund outreach, and committed to tightening the campaign based on questions received.
Together with trade unions, employers' organisations and pension administrators I have developed a campaign to inform people aged 18 and over about the new pension rules.
Samen met vakbonden, werkgeversorganisaties en de pensioenuitvoerders heb ik een campagne ontwikkeld om personen van 18 jaar en ouder te informeren over de nieuwe pensioenregels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smals en De Kort over het artikel 'Stijging ziekteverzuim in 2022 naar 5,6%: hoogste ooit'

MPs Smals and De Kort asked the Minister of Social Affairs about sick-leave rising to 5.6% in 2022, its link to labour shortages, SME support, WIA/IVA inflows and cooperation with occupational physicians and UWV. The minister answered that the rise is mainly driven by COVID and flu rather than work, that prevention is primarily employers' responsibility supported by government schemes, and that the government is working on WIA backlogs and reintegration, without introducing structural changes to executive oversight.
This high sick-leave figure is worrying.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Den Haan en Smals over het bericht ‘Aanzienlijk onbenut arbeidspotentieel onder gepensioneerden’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about an ESB report on unused labour potential among retirees, including barriers for employers and flexibility in contracts. The minister answered that existing instruments already allow flexible retirement timing, that awareness campaigns will be launched, and that the zero-hours contract ban and basiscontract proposal will be monitored in consultation without new exemptions for older workers.
Given the information already known, I see no need for further research.
Gezien de reeds bekende informatie, zie ik geen noodzaak voor verder onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smals over het bericht 'UWV: geen zzp-verzekering voordat achterstanden zijn weggewerkt'

An MP asked whether an opt-out from the public UWV disability insurance for self-employed workers would reduce the burden on UWV, which faces capacity bottlenecks, and how the process could be made workable. The minister answered that an opt-out is meant to offer choice and tailored cover rather than to reduce UWV workload, that private insurers would assess disability, and that the government is consulting insurers and UWV and will publish a bill for consultation in summer 2023 that addresses ensuring equivalent cover and premium.
For insured persons who have chosen an opt-out, the relevant private insurer will be responsible for determining (the degree of) incapacity for work.
Voor verzekerden die hebben gekozen voor een opt-out zal de desbetreffende private verzekeraar verantwoordelijk zijn voor het vaststellen (van de mate) van arbeidsongeschiktheid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Smals over het bericht 'Vanaf morgen weer subsidie voor opleiding, maar niet als je boa wil worden'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Smals asked why training to become a buitengewoon opsporingsambtenaar (boa) is excluded from the STAP subsidy scheme and whether this deters future boas. The ministers answered that the training is the employer's responsibility, that the government is exploring whether zij-instromers could be funded under STAP, and that recruitment and retention are the job of employers and municipalities.
The cabinet understands that funding boa training with STAP budget could add value for lateral entrants and is willing to examine this further.
Het kabinet begrijpt dat financiering van boa-opleidingen met STAP-budget voor zij-instromers een meerwaarde kan zijn en is bereid dit nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Smals, Van Beukering-Huijbregts en Sahla over het bericht ‘Werkgevers niet happig om mensen meer in te zetten, ondanks personeelstekort’

Four MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Long-Term Care about a news report that employers are reluctant to offer more hours despite staff shortages, and about measures to reduce involuntary part-time work. The government answered that it urges employers to talk with staff, points to the Flexible Working Act while saying it cannot oblige employers to offer full-time contracts, and describes ongoing studies and pilots on a multi-hours bonus and combination jobs.
The cabinet cannot, however, oblige employers to always offer full-time contracts or more working hours when employees ask for them, and to make this standard.
Het kabinet kan echter werkgevers niet verplichten om werknemers altijd voltijdcontracten of meer uren werk aan te bieden als zij erom vragen en dit standaard te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Smals over het artikel 'Tien jaar stilstand reden recordkrapte'

Two VVD MPs asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and of Poverty, Participation and Pensions about labour shortages and how to get people with a distance from the labour market or older workers into work, including the no-risk policy, employer support points, the labour market infrastructure, dismissal and sick-pay rules, and cao provisions. The ministers answered that the government is pursuing employer incentives, a pilot for a no-risk policy, a regional 'Werkcentrum' plan due by summer 2023, and further reports on flexible contracts and sick-pay reform, while declining to give some figures yet.
In recent years, since the jobs agreement, there has been a lot of attention to the importance of hiring people with a disability.
Er is de afgelopen jaren, sinds de banenafspraak, veel aandacht geweest voor het belang van het aannemen van mensen met een arbeidsbeperking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smals over het artikel '40-urige werkweek botst met onze cultuur'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about the Dutch part-time work culture, whether full-time contracts should be standard in shortage sectors, and whether a full-time bonus should be pursued. The minister answered that part-time work has benefits but limits women's economic independence, that employers cannot be forced to offer full-time contracts, and that a full-time/extra-hours bonus is being explored first in care and education.
However, the cabinet cannot oblige employers to always offer full-time contracts to employees who ask for them and to make this standard.
Het kabinet kan echter werkgevers niet verplichten om werknemers altijd voltijdcontracten aan te bieden als zij erom vragen en dit standaard te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Smals over het bericht 'Jezelf ontdekken in Parijs? Het kan op kosten van de overheid'

MPs Paul and Smals (VVD) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that course providers misuse the STAP training budget, for example by offering free trips and overnight stays, and about quality control, value for money, and whether the scheme should be evaluated early and targeted at shortage sectors. The minister replied that non-necessary costs are excluded, that the Toetsingskamer has asked providers to remove over 2,000 courses and is pursuing four providers for non-compliance, and that an invoeringstoets and a full evaluation will follow, but declined to target the budget at shortage sectors for now.
If the STAP budget is used to fund unnecessary items, action will be taken.
Indien het STAP budget wordt aangewend voor het bekostigen van niet-noodzakelijke zaken, wordt actie ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paul en Smals over het bericht ‘Meerderheid scholen weigert inzet zzp’ers ondanks lerarentekort’

MPs Paul and Smals asked the government about a report that most schools refuse to deploy freelancers (zzp'ers) despite teacher shortages, and about enforcement moratorium, the DBA web module and legal uncertainty over flexible contracts. The minister answered that there are no signs refusals worsen teacher shortages, that enforcement moratorium remains in force with exceptions for malicious cases and unfollowed instructions, that the web module is only indicative and a broader policy letter will follow before summer 2022.
Before the summer we will inform you further about the elaboration of this ambition in the coalition agreement.
Voor de zomer zullen wij u nader informeren over de uitwerking van deze in het coalitieakkoord opgenomen ambitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Smals over “het bericht dat UWV op illegale wijze wachtlijsten wegwerkt: uitkeringen worden verstrekt zonder de beoordeling van een arts”

MPs De Kort and Smals asked the minister whether UWV unlawfully granted disability benefits without medical assessment in a pilot to clear waiting lists, and what follow-up is planned. The minister called the pilot undesirable and not in line with the law, said UWV's board admitted the decision process went wrong, and promised to inform parliament by spring after an evaluation.
I find it undesirable that such pilots are started without my knowledge and that of your House.
Ik vind het onwenselijk dat dergelijke proeven zonder mijn medeweten en dat van uw Kamer worden gestart.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil en Smals over de berichtgeving in de media t.a.v. het tekort aan behandelaren waardoor er lange wachtlijsten zijn in de GGZ en instellingen zich genoodzaakt voelen tot een pati

Two VVD MPs asked about media reports of a shortage of GGZ practitioners causing long waiting lists and patient intake stops, and about the 2020 use of unfilled clinical psychologist training places to train extra GZ-psychologists. The State Secretary answered that the Capacity Body's projections should remain the guideline, that the shifted funding was a political choice rather than freed-up money, that master-psychologists already work in care, and that waiting lists are only loosely linked to the vacancy rate used in projections.

I would like to invite the parties to have investigated and substantiated how the clinical psychologist training can be made more attractive and how inflow into the KP training places can best be stimulated.

Ik zou de partijen willen uitnodigen om te laten onderzoeken en onderbouwen hoe de opleiding tot KP aantrekkelijker gemaakt kan worden en hoe de instroom in de KP opleidingsplaatsen het beste kan worden gestimuleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smals over het bericht dat het pensioenfonds ABP uit fossiel stapt

An MP asked the Secretary of State about ABP's decision to stop investing in fossil fuel companies, probing participant influence, employer consultation, climate effectiveness, DNB guidance, engagement cooperation, and whether pension funds should pursue social themes over pension returns. The government answered that the fund board is responsible for investment policy under the Pensioenwet, that the effect on climate goals is uncertain though it reduces portfolio climate risk, and that DNB guidance is advisory and not enforceable.
The pension fund board is responsible for implementing the pension scheme, including investment policy.
Het pensioenfondsbestuur gaat over de uitvoering van de pensioenregeling, inclusief het beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smals over de uitzending van RTL Boulevard over Stichting SIGNI van zondag 28 februari 2021

MP Smals asks the Minister of Social Affairs about an RTL Boulevard broadcast and a fine imposed by the Inspectorate SZW on volunteer search foundation SIGNI for diver safety violations, asking about the effect on volunteer initiatives, the legal basis for volunteer diving, and dialogue. The minister confirms the fine is under objection, says volunteers are covered by safety rules for hazardous work, and offers talks with SIGNI.
The Inspectorate SZW always looks at the facts and circumstances of the individual case when determining sanctions.
De Inspectie SZW kijkt bij het bepalen van sancties altijd naar de feiten en omstandigheden van het individuele geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smals over het bericht ‘Arbeidsinspectie gaf werkgevers jarenlang onterechte en te hoge boetes’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that the Labour Inspectorate imposed unjustified and excessive fines, including how often objections succeed, how fines are reduced or withdrawn, and how hardship and fine policy are handled. The Minister answered that about 12% of objections were fully upheld and 18% led to reduced fines, that payment arrangements are routinely granted, and that the policy respects the subsistence minimum while a broader review of the enforcement system is planned.
I also want to answer that question openly and jointly with employers' and employees' organisations, researchers and stakeholders.
Die vraag wil ik ook in alle openheid en gezamenlijkheid met werkgevers-, werknemersorganisaties, wetenschappers en stakeholders van een antwoord laten voorzien.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smals en Van Gent over het bericht ‘Zoektocht naar 70 duizend extra stembureau leden: veel meer mensen nodig dan normaal' in de uitzending van WNL op maandag 30 november 2020

MPs Smals and Van Gent asked the ministers how they would address a shortage of about 70,000 polling station workers for the March 2021 elections, including whether vocational (mbo) students could fill roles, as an alternative to internships. The minister confirmed the proposals are being explored with the MBO council, VNG and other partners, and promised a January survey of municipalities and a possible regional or national reserve pool.
To get a good picture of the situation regarding the number of required polling station members, I will hold a survey among municipalities in early January.
Om een goed beeld te krijgen van de stand van zaken rond het aantal benodigde stembureauleden houd ik begin januari een peiling onder de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Smals en Van den Berge over het bericht  “Ik ga waarschijnlijk niet over naar het volgende jaar” op 14 september 2020

MPs Smals and Van den Berge asked the Minister of Education about the shortage of internship places for MBO students during the coronavirus crisis, including government and municipal placement numbers, how places will be expanded, and whether diploma requirements can be relaxed. The minister answered that central government internship places fell in 2020, that interdepartmental efforts and an action plan through SBB are underway, and that schools have flexibility on internship hours, while municipal data is not collected.
Inquiries with the VNG, IPO and Union of Water Boards show that no data is collected on the number of internship places at decentralised governments.
Uit navraag bij de VNG, IPO en Unie van Waterschappen blijkt dat er geen gegevens worden verzameld over het aantal stageplekken bij de decentrale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smals over het bericht "Je bent 'officieel' niet te oud, maar die baan is voor een ander"

An MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about a news report on age discrimination in hiring and about recruitment practices in government. The government answered that discrimination is unacceptable, described existing recruitment rules, age profile data for civil service staff, and planned tools and pilots, without committing to new binding measures.
Discrimination in the labour market is unacceptable.
Discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt is onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma, El Yassini en Smals over het voorkeursbeleid van de TU Eindhoven

MPs from the VVD asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the College voor de Rechten van de Mens ruling that TU Eindhoven's temporary preference policy for women in academic appointments (Irène Curie Fellowship) was disproportionate and amounted to near-absolute exclusion of men. The Minister said the College is independent, that the TU/e is responsible for revising its policy, and that she trusts it to act on the ruling, without committing to her own intervention.
It is not for me to redo the assessment the College has made in this case.
Het is niet aan mij om de beoordeling die het College in dit geval heeft gegeven over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smals over de impuls regeling praktijkleren

An MP asked the Minister of Education why the impuls regeling praktijkleren excludes agriculture, hospitality and recreation, and whether stage places in those sectors are being monitored and protected. The Minister defends the exclusion by pointing to the separate motion-Heerma funding for those sectors, says SBB monitors placements and will report to parliament in September, and declines for now to extend the scheme.
In September this will be shared with the House.
In september zal dit worden gedeeld met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smals over het bericht ‘Nieuwe ROC-topman heeft grote plannen: Waarom zou een bakker Engels moeten leren?’

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether it is acceptable that a new ROC director questioned the need for English for a baker, and whether mbo general subjects are safeguarded. The minister answered that language and arithmetic requirements are built into the qualification structure, that the director does not dispute the triple qualification, and that the Inspectorate monitors compliance.
Individual administrators have no influence on this. The Inspectorate of Education monitors that sufficient attention is paid to language and arithmetic education everywhere.
Individuele bestuurders hebben hierop geen invloed. De Inspectie van het Onderwijs ziet erop toe dat overal voldoende werk wordt gemaakt van taal- en rekenonderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smals over het bericht ‘Maximaal bedrag dat erkende leerbedrijven ontvangen uit de subsidieregeling Praktijkleren voor iedere bbl-studenten’

An MP asked the Minister of Education about the falling per-student subsidy under the Praktijkleren scheme for BBL vocational students, the SEO cost-benefit study, and whether the scheme should be reformed or funded from the budget. The Minister acknowledged the falling subsidy (from EUR 2,700 to EUR 2,217), defended the scheme and the study, and declined to reform it now, promising only an evaluation in 2022 that will be reported to parliament.
In 2022 the Praktijkleren subsidy will be evaluated.
In 2022 wordt de subsidie Praktijkleren geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smals en Remco Dijkstra over het artikel "KLM onderzoekt blootstelling aan chroom-6"

MPs Smals and Dijkstra asked about KLM's investigation into past chromium-6 exposure of workers and the Inspectorate's role, inspections and sector risks. The state secretary answered that the employer bears responsibility, the Inspectorate has inspected KLM and checks chromium-6 risks, and the advisory commission's report on occupational disease compensation is now expected by 1 April 2020.
The Inspectorate SZW oversees compliance with the Working Conditions legislation and, in that role, has no involvement in KLM group's investigation.
De Inspectie SZW ziet toe op de naleving van de Arbeidsomstandighedenwetgeving en heeft vanuit die rol geen betrokkenheid in het onderzoek van de KLM-groep.
Antwoord op vragen van het de leden Smals en Kuik over het bericht ‘Alarm over vervalste mbo-diploma’s’

MPs Smals and Kuik asked the Minister of Education about reports of rising fraud with vocational (mbo) diplomas, including risks in healthcare and whether forged diplomas can be registered in the BIG register. The minister replied that only a few cases per year are known, that no increase can be established, that employers can verify diplomas via DUO's Diplomaregister, and that fraud should be reported to police, with the issue raised with the Justice Ministry.
I therefore see no reason to investigate how large the group is that is active on the labour market on the basis of a forged diploma.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om te onderzoeken hoe groot de groep is die op basis van een vervalst diploma actief is op de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Smals over het artikel 'Vraag naar personeel met mbo-opleiding stijgt snel op banensites'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Education about a news report on rising demand for mbo-trained workers on job sites, including labour market forecasts, shortage sectors, retraining of jobseekers and the flexible-work link. The minister answered that demand for mbo workers has risen with the economy, described forecasting and retraining instruments, and rejected the idea that mbo graduates are mostly trained for unemployment.
It has never been the case that mbo graduates are in many cases trained for unemployment.
Het is nooit zo geweest dat mbo'ers in veel gevallen worden opgeleid voor werkloosheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Smals over ‘de Nieuwsuurreportage over arbeidsmigranten’

MPs Tielen and Smals asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Nieuwsuur report on migrant workers, including inspection complaint figures, enforcement capacity, EU posted-worker rules, and labour market matching. The minister answered that complaints rose from 1182 in 2015 to 1817 in 2018, described inspection priorities and the extra funding, and outlined EU-level and domestic measures while largely restating existing policy.
The number of complaints and signals increased from 1182 in 2015 to 1307 in 2016, 1382 in 2017 and 1817 in 2018.
Het aantal klachten en signalen is toegenomen van 1182 in 2015 naar 1307 in 2016, 1382 in 2017 tot 1817 in 2018.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Van den Berg en Ellemeet ter vervanging van nr. 7 over het vervallen van het opheffen van de omzet-, personeels- en activagrens en een vergunningplicht voor kleine aa
Removes the turnover, staff and asset thresholds for small care providers' admission and adds an annual report requirement, with licence revocation possible if reports are deficient.
Amendement van de leden Van den Berg en Ellemeet over het vervallen van het opheffen van de omzet-, personeels- en activagrens en een vergunningplicht voor kleine aanbieders
Removes the licensing requirement for care providers with more than ten staff and requires small providers with ten or fewer staff to publish a one-off annual report.
the submitters of this amendment wish to remove this subsection from the Health Care Market Regulation Act
willen indieners van onderhavig amendement dit artikellid uit de Wet marktordening gezondheidszorg verwijderen
Motie van het lid Mutluer c.s. over het structureel inzetten van jongerenrechtbanken bij seksueel grensoverschrijdend gedrag op scholen
Asks the government to explore with the Stichting Jongerenrechtbanken whether youth courts can be used structurally for sexual boundary-crossing behaviour in schools.
requests the government, in consultation with the Stichting Jongerenrechtbanken, to explore whether and how youth courts can be structurally deployed
verzoekt de regering in samenspraak met Stichting Jongerenrechtbanken te verkennen of en hoe de jongerenrechtbanken structureel kunnen worden ingezet
Amendement van het lid Van der Werf c.s. over gelijke maximumstraffen voor schuldverkrachting en voor opzetaanranding

Amendment to the criminal code bill lowering the maximum sentence for sexual coercion (schuldverkrachting) from four to five years and lowering the maximum for intentional assault from six to five years.
This amendment equalises the maximum sentence for sexual coercion with that for intentional assault.
Met dit amendement wordt de maximumstraf voor schuldverkrachting gelijkgesteld aan de maximumstraf voor opzetaanranding.
Amendement van de leden Mutluer en Ellemeet over een evaluatie na drie jaar
Requires the Minister of Justice and Security to report to parliament within three years on the effectiveness and effects of the law expanding mayors' power to close homes.
sends to the States General within three years of the law entering into force a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice
zendt binnen drie jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk
Motie van de leden Mutluer en Ellemeet over onderzoeken of gewaarborgd is dat bij toepassing van de sluitingsbevoegdheid geen kwetsbare mensen dakloos raken
Asks the government to investigate and report on whether vulnerable residents are protected from becoming homeless when mayors use their home-closure power.
to investigate whether it is guaranteed that when the closure power is applied no vulnerable people become homeless
te onderzoeken of gewaarborgd is dat bij toepassing van de sluitingsbevoegdheid geen kwetsbare mensen dakloos raken

Amendement van de leden Bushoff en Ellemeet over zeker stellen dat donorkinderen geïnformeerd worden over een genetische aandoening als het College niet beschikt over de contactgegevens van het donork

Clarifies in the law that providing the mother's details to the clinical geneticist aims to enable compliance with the professional guideline for actively informing at-risk relatives such as donor children.
This amendment clarifies that providing the mother's details aims to enable the clinical geneticist to comply with the guideline on informing relatives about hereditary conditions.

Met dit amendement wordt verduidelijkt dat het verstrekken van de gegevens van de moeder als doel heeft om de klinisch geneticus in staat te stellen te kunnen voldoen aan de «Richtlijn Informeren van familieleden bij erfelijke aandoeningen»
Tweede nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Mohandis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 21 over een evaluatie na drie en daarna periodiek na vijf jaar
Requires the minister to report to the Staten-Generaal within three years of entry into force and then every five years on the effectiveness of the healthcare fraud law.
The minister sends the Staten-Generaal a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice within three years of its entry into force and then every five years.

Onze Minister zendt binnen drie jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet en vervolgens telkens na vijf jaar aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.
Motie van het lid Ellemeet c.s. over onderzoeken hoe het maximumaantal gezinnen ook van toepassing kan zijn op donoren die buiten de kliniek werken en hoe overtreding bestraft kan worden
Asks the government to study whether the maximum number of families for donors applies to donors working outside clinics and how such violations could be punished.
requests the government to investigate how the maximum number of families can also apply to donors working outside the clinic
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken op welke manier het maximumaantal gezinnen ook van toepassing kan zijn op donoren die buiten de kliniek werken
Amendement van de leden Bushoff en Ellemeet over een grondslag voor bewaring en verwerking van gegevens van het donorkind

Amendment creates a legal basis for the college to collect, store for at least eighty years and process data of donor-conceived children so they can be informed of their origins and donor genetic risks.
Donor children should not have to depend on their parents or care provider to obtain information about genetic conditions in their donor.
Donorkinderen zouden niet afhankelijk moeten zijn van hun ouders of zorgverlener voor het verkrijgen van informatie over genetische aandoeningen bij hun donor.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Paulusma c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 13 over het vervallen van de leeftijdsgrenzen
Removes the age limits of 12 and 16 in the donor data act so donor-conceived persons can access donor information regardless of age.
the age limits of 12 and 16 years are to lapse
de leeftijdsgrenzen van 12 en 16 jaar komen te vervallen
Motie van de leden Ellemeet en Bikker over in Europees verband richtlijnen afspreken over toezicht op het maximumaantal donorkinderen en de uitwisseling van persoonsidentificerende gegevens
Motion asks government to agree EU-level rules on supervision of the maximum number of donor children and exchange of identifying donor data.
requests the government to agree guidelines at EU level on supervision of the maximum number of donor children
verzoekt de regering in Europees verband richtlijnen af te spreken over het toezicht op het maximumaantal donorkinderen
Amendement van de leden Bushoff en Ellemeet over het informeren van het donorkind over erfelijke aandoeningen
Requires the executive's donor-register body to collect and keep identifying data of donor-conceived children so it can inform them of hereditary conditions.
With this amendment the College is obliged to provide the doctor with the identifying characteristics of donor children so they can be informed of a risk of a hereditary condition.
Met dit amendement wordt het College verplicht de arts de persoonsidentificerende kenmerken van donorkinderen te verstrekken om deze te kunnen informeren over een risico op een erfelijke aandoening.
Amendement van het lid Paulusma c.s. over het vervallen van de leeftijdsgrenzen
Removes the age limits of 12 and 16 in the donor data and artificial insemination law, so donor children can access donor information regardless of age.
With these proposed changes the submitters intend that the age limits of 12 and 16 years be dropped.
Met deze voorgestelde wijzigingen beogen de indieners dat de leeftijdsgrenzen van 12 en 16 jaar komen te vervallen.
Tweede nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Mohandis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 16 over een evaluatie na drie en daarna periodiek na vijf jaar
Amendment adds a statutory evaluation report to parliament three years after entry into force and then every five years on the effectiveness of the health care fraud law.
Within three years of this law entering into force, and then every five years, the Minister sends the States General a report on the effectiveness and effects of this law in practice.

Onze Minister zendt binnen drie jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet en vervolgens telkens na vijf jaar aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van deze wet in de praktijk.
Motie van het lid Drost c.s. over ervoor zorgen dat bij de uitwerking van de green deal 3.0 ideeën van zorgpersoneel worden gestimuleerd
Asks the government to ensure that ideas from healthcare staff on sustainability are encouraged in implementing the green deal 3.0 and to inform the House.
requests the government, together with the other signatories, to ensure that ideas of healthcare staff are also encouraged in the implementation of green deal 3.0
verzoekt de regering samen met de andere ondertekenaars bij de uitwerking van de green deal 3.0 ervoor te zorgen dat ook ideeën van zorgpersoneel op de werkvloer worden gestimuleerd
Motie van de leden Van Esch en Ellemeet over het verder uitbreiden van de pilot met heruitgifte van medicijnen
Asks the government to expand the pilot on re-issuing medicines so that a logistics project's re-issue of returned medicines can be restarted.

Amendement van het lid Ellemeet c.s. over het financieren van het niet verhogen van het eigen risico uit het Zorgverzekeringsfonds

requests the government to talk with health insurers on the basis that access to the pgb must be as low-threshold as possible

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Ellemeet over een uitzending van Argos over de dood van Sammy Baker

MPs Mutluer and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Justice and Security about an Argos broadcast on the death of Sammy Baker, the adequacy of the handling framework for people with confused behaviour, and whether the treatment of fatal incidents involving police should be investigated. The Minister said the Public Prosecution Service sees no reason to revisit its earlier decision not to prosecute (self-defence), that the framework gives no powers to arrest, that she will not assess the lawfulness of force and sees no need for a new study, and referred to existing measures for a cross-domain approach.
It is then up to other authorities – where appropriate the judge – to assess whether the use of force was lawful or not.
Het is daarna aan andere autoriteiten – in voorkomende gevallen de rechter – om te beoordelen of er wel of niet sprake is van een rechtmatige geweldsaanwending.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Mutluer over de onterechte verdenking van aanwezigheid bij een klimaatprotest op luchthaven Schiphol

MPs Ellemeet and Mutluer asked how the Public Prosecution Service and Marechaussee identified about 400 climate protesters detained at Schiphol in November 2022, after some of the 176 warning letters went to people who were not present, and whether this was careful conduct. The minister explains that photos were matched using social media, open sources and a facial recognition program under art. 55c Sv, that eight people received apology letters, and that an internal review is ongoing with commitments to remove wrongly processed data and learn lessons.
In a number of cases it later turned out that the identification was incorrect.
Bij een aantal personen bleek achteraf sprake te zijn van een onjuiste identificatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Ellemeet over het niet uitvoeren van de aangenomen motie Van Esch/Ellemeet over het verder uitbreiden van de pilot met heruitgifte van medicijnen

MPs Van Esch and Ellemeet ask why the government will not carry out the adopted motion to extend the re-dispensing pilot, asking about the EU law blocking it, the scientific basis for quality concerns, and European steps. Minister Kuipers answers that re-dispensing is barred by EU medicines directives, the pilot is being extended to fourteen hospitals, and he is pursuing EU support for changing the rules, without a timeline.
The fact is, however, that re-dispensing of medicines is not permitted under current European legislation, and that is why I cannot carry out this motion.
Feit is echter dat heruitgifte van geneesmiddelen met de huidige Europese wetgeving niet is toegestaan en dat ik daarom deze motie niet kan uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Ellemeet over het bericht 'Nieuwe Wet Zeggenschap nog onbekend onder zorgmedewerkers'

MPs Tielen and Ellemeet asked the health minister why only 11 percent of care workers know about the new Wet Zeggenschap (decision-making rights for care staff) and how awareness, action plans and subsidy use are being monitored. The minister acknowledges the need for awareness, points to communication, sector bodies, subsidies and a planned monitor from September 2023, and says the effects will become clearer after the subsidy projects end.
To be able to see the effect of the legal amendment in practice, I agree that awareness of the amendment is a prerequisite.
Om het effect van de wetswijziging in de praktijk terug te kunnen zien ben ik het met u eens dat bekendheid met de wetwijziging voorwaardelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over ‘de grootschalige verzameling van data over demonstranten door de politie’

An MP asked the Justice and Security minister about police collecting large-scale personal data on demonstrators, its legal basis, proportionality, and privacy oversight. The minister defended the practice as necessary for managing demonstrations and proportionate, refused to give case-level detail or provide demonstrator-group statistics, and declined to request an Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens review.
It is not possible to give the House insight into the queries, because these concern personal data of individuals.
Het is niet mogelijk om de Kamer inzage te geven in de bevragingen, omdat dit persoonsgegevens van individuen betreffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Westerveld over de rechtszaak van stichting Farma ter Verantwoording tegen farmaceut AbbVie

MPs Ellemeet and Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the Health Minister about excess profits on AbbVie's Humira, the pending lawsuit by Farma ter Verantwoording, price transparency, public R&D funding and a binding duty of care for pharmaceutical firms. The minister said the individual case is sub judice, that the state can set maximum prices but not limit company profits, and pointed to tools such as the pricing gateway, transparency efforts and a joint regulator work agenda, while rejecting a binding duty of care for now.
I will not address the individual case of AbbVie and the drug Humira because the case is before the court.
Op de individuele zaak van AbbVie en het medicijn Humira ga ik niet in omdat de zaak onder de rechter is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Mutluer, Teunissen, Sylvana Simons en Ellemeet over het bericht 'politie keek heimelijk mee in chatgroepen van Extinction Rebellion'

MPs asked the Justice Minister whether police secretly monitored Extinction Rebellion chat groups, under which legal powers, and how this relates to the right to demonstrate. The Minister declined to comment on the specific case pending a court ruling, described general police information-gathering powers, and said the proportionality assessment lies with the police and the mayor.
I cannot address this specific question because the court is still considering the case concerning the suspicion of incitement.
Op deze concrete vraag kan ik niet ingaan omdat de rechter zich nog buigt over de zaak betreffende de verdenking wegens opruiing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Kuiken, Ellemeet en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Poliklinieken moeten patiënten met postcovid weigeren, de zorg is niet meer te betalen’

MPs asked the Minister of Health about news that two academic post-COVID clinics would stop accepting patients because standard reimbursements do not cover costs, and about research funding. The Minister said reimbursement is a matter between hospitals and insurers, that no proven effective treatment yet exists, that over 14 million euros has been allocated to research, a knowledge agenda is due in 2023, and extra budget for multi-year research and an expertise centre is planned.
I expect to be able to give definitive clarity on this in May and will then inform your House.
Ik verwacht daarover in mei definitief uitstelsel te kunnen geven en zal uw Kamer daarover dan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Kröger over de aanhouding van klimaatactivisten

MPs Ellemeet and Kröger asked whether the preemptive arrest of climate activists for incitement was proportionate, whether it chilled the right to demonstrate, and what concrete threat justified it. The Minister answered that the eight people were arrested for incitement that had already occurred, released the same day with a area ban that courts partly upheld, and that the police acted under the prosecutor's authority, while not addressing the preventive-arrest and proportionality concerns in detail.
The eight arrests were made because of the suspicion of a criminal offence, namely incitement.
De acht aanhoudingen zijn verricht als gevolg van de verdenking tot een strafbaar feit, namelijk opruiing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de renseigneringsverplichting

Green Left MP Ellemeet asked why healthcare providers must report payments to third parties (UBD) despite VAT exemptions, why the deadline is 1 February 2023, and whether they should be exempted or consulted on regulatory burden. The State Secretary answered that the obligation is generic and necessary for income-tax pre-filling and checks, that healthcare providers will not be exempted, that the rules are not retroactive, and that case-by-case deadline extensions are available.
No, I do not want to exempt healthcare providers from this obligation.
Nee, ik wil zorgaanbieders niet uitzonderen van deze verplichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bushoff over de druk van de zorgverzekeraar op de huisarts voor het gebruik van een nieuw, onbekend en goedkoper spiraaltje

Two MPs asked the Minister of Health about insurer VGZ pressuring GPs to use a newer, less familiar and cheaper hormonal IUD (Levosert) under its preference policy, and whether quality is sacrificed to cost. The Minister says preference policy is acceptable if quality is safeguarded, acknowledges the poor introduction, notes VGZ has revised the policy to a regional, phased rollout, and points to existing quality rules and the Integraal Zorgakkoord.
In this specific case, this initially did not go well; VGZ has since revised its preference policy for the hormonal IUD.
Dat is in deze specifieke casus in eerste instantie niet goed gegaan; inmiddels heeft VGZ het voorkeursbeleid voor de hormoonspiraal herzien.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Bouchallikh, Bromet, Bushoff, Ellemeet, De Hoop, Kathmann, Kröger, Van der Lee, Maatoug, Mohandis, Mutluer, Nijboer, Piri, Thijssen en Westerveld over de voortgang van de k

MPs from GroenLinks and PvdA asked the Prime Minister to confirm 17 cabinet targets for 2030 and to give the latest forecasts, whether each target is on track, and how gaps would be shown to parliament. The Prime Minister confirmed the targets with qualifications and deferred the forecasts, sufficiency assessments and gap-closing plans to the responsible ministers, while noting he had raised the questions in the Council of Ministers.
Providing the most current forecasts is a matter for the ministers who are primarily responsible for these subjects.
Het aangeven van de meest actuele prognoses is een aangelegenheid van de voor deze onderwerpen eerst verantwoordelijke bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Ellemeet over de behandeling van politieagenten die hebben meegewerkt aan de documentaire De Blauwe Familie

MPs Mutluer and Ellemeet asked the Justice Minister about the treatment of police officers who took part in the documentary De Blauwe Familie on racism within the police, including reports of no recognition or rehabilitation, a single commendation while others faced criminal proceedings, and a claimed unanswered call from the police chief. The Minister condemned racism, said the police leadership has contacted each participant and will be urged to pursue reconciliation, announced an action plan and a coordinator, and declined to comment on individual cases.
It is not appropriate for me to comment on individual cases.
Het past mij niet om in te gaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Maatoug, Westerveld en Ellemeet over de inhuur van externe arbeid in publieke sectoren

MPs Maatoug, Westerveld and Ellemeet asked ministers about the use of external and flexible labour in the public and semi-public sectors, its effect on care quality and costs, and government steps to curb it. The government answered that it is pursuing measures to make employment under contract more attractive, tighten rules on self-employment and monitor agency and tariff arrangements, while stating it cannot provide sector-level data on many questions.
Apart from the figures below on external hiring within central government, education and care and welfare, no data are kept for (semi-)public sub-sectors.
Behalve onderstaande cijfers over inhuur van externe arbeid binnen de Rijksoverheid, het onderwijs en zorg en welzijn, worden geen data bijgehouden voor (semi)-publieke (deel)sectoren.
Antwoord op vragen  van de leden Westerveld en Ellemeet over terhandstellingskosten

MPs Westerveld and Ellemeet asked whether pharmacy dispensing fees (terhandstellingskosten), which can exceed the cost of small-quantity medicines, can be capped nationally or excluded from the deductible. The minister replied that pharmacy tariffs are free, so no national caps are set, that excluding dispensing fees from the deductible is not desirable, and pointed to existing measures such as the frozen deductible and the capped cost-sharing for medicines.
I do not consider it desirable to exclude dispensing from the deductible, even in the case of repeated dispensing to the same patient.
Ik vind het niet wenselijk om de terhandstelling uit te zonderen van het eigen risico, ook niet als het gaat om herhaalde terhandstellingen bij dezelfde patiënt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Kröger over het bericht 'Krappe roosters en mondige patiënten: steeds drukker op huisartsenposten in Overijssel'

GroenLinks MPs Ellemeet and Kröger asked the Health Minister about reports of overstretched GP out-of-hours posts in Overijssel, who is responsible for solving the GP shortage, what steps have been taken, and whether GP practices refusing Ukrainian refugees will be addressed. The minister acknowledges pressure on GP access, outlines causes and measures under the Integraal Zorg Akkoord, and points to insurers' duty of care and regional/local options while stating that the State Secretary for Justice has no reports that opening stops led to care being refused.
Health insurers have a duty of care towards their insured and must ensure that an insured person receives the care they are entitled to.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben een zorgplicht voor hun verzekerden en moeten zorgen dat een verzekerde de zorg krijgt waar hij of zij recht op heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh, Bromet en Ellemeet over het PFAS-schandaal

MPs Bouchallikh, Bromet and Ellemeet asked the government about the PFAS contamination scandal, including breast milk levels near Dordrecht, the export of PFAS waste to Antwerp, Rijkswaterstaat permits for PFOA and GenX discharges, and the EU-wide PFAS ban. The state secretary answered all twelve questions in substance, defending existing health norms, the permitting framework and the planned EU restriction, while promising further study of exposure routes.
For a number of pending export permit applications, the ILT has requested additional information from the notifiers and the Flemish authorities.
Voor een aantal lopende aanvragen voor exportvergunningen heeft de ILT aanvullende informatie opgevraagd bij de kennisgevers en de Vlaamse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Ellemeet over het bericht 'Cardiologen krijgen zonder toestemming miljoenen euro’s van medische bedrijven'

MPs Kuiken and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Health whether the reported payments of millions of euros from medical companies to cardiologists without hospital board knowledge are concerning, whether the IGJ and the self-regulating Gedragscode Medische Hulpmiddelen function adequately, and whether the IGJ should play a more active enforcement role. The Minister agreed the situation is concerning, said he will talk with the IGJ and the GMH foundation about compliance and report in Q1 2023, and noted the IGJ will raise the case in ongoing supervision and evaluate self-regulation, though he saw no need for new measures beyond existing ones.
Following the news report, I will shortly discuss compliance and oversight with the Stichting Gedragscode Medische Hulpmiddelen (GMH) and the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ).

Naar aanleiding van het nieuwsbericht ga ik op korte termijn met de Stichting Gedragscode Medische Hulpmiddelen (GMH) en de inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) in gesprek over de naleving en het toezicht hierop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Ellemeet over de problemen met zorg voor mensen in CNO-locaties

MPs Kröger and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Health how healthcare for asylum seekers at crisis emergency shelters (CNO) is coordinated, supported and funded, and whether the Minister would take a coordinating role. The Minister confirmed awareness of the NGO letter, explained that COA organises care through contracted partners and that the Minister declines a coordinating role because the legal duty lies with COA under the State Secretary for Justice and Security.
No, because the statutory obligation to organise care for asylum seekers rests with COA under the responsibility of the State Secretary for Justice and Security.
Nee, omdat de wettelijke verplichting voor de organisatie van zorg aan asielzoekers is belegd bij het COA onder verantwoordelijkheid van de Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ellemeet en Dassen over het vastleggen van het recht op abortus in het Europees Handvest van grondrechten van de Europese Unie

MPs Sjoerdsma, Ellemeet and Dassen asked the Foreign Minister about the US Dobbs ruling restricting abortion, funding of anti-abortion groups, and whether abortion access should be anchored in the EU Charter of Fundamental Rights. The minister expressed concern, said abortion is mainly a member-state competence, and noted that anchoring it in the Charter would require treaty change, which support among member states may lack.
The cabinet is closely following the discussion on anchoring the right to abortion in the Charter and will further examine the feasibility of this initiative.
Het kabinet volgt de discussie over het verankeren van het recht op abortus in het Handvest op de voet en zal zich verder verdiepen in de haalbaarheid van dit initiatief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Mutluer over demonstraties bij abortusklinieken

MPs Ellemeet and Mutluer asked the minister whether a national ban on demonstrations at abortion clinics is desirable, given reported intimidation of women and inconsistent local rules. The minister answered that demonstrations are protected by fundamental rights, that content cannot ground restrictions, that local mayors and police/prosecutors handle enforcement, and that he will consult clinics and the NGvA, without committing to a national ban.
Taking measures is therefore a local matter, and it is up to the police and the Public Prosecution Service (OM) to enforce.
Het treffen van maatregelen is dus een lokale aangelegenheid, en het is aan de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) om te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de eigen bijdragen voor haarwerken

An MP asked the Minister of Health why 56% of wig users paid more than the reimbursement, why some pay up to 1,600 euro, and whether men with alopecia are excluded. The minister answered that the basic insurance caps the wig reimbursement at 457.50 euro, that the NIVEL median co-payment of 466 euro applies only to those who paid, and that he has no plans to raise the cap or cover men's non-medical hair loss.
I do not intend to revise the maximum reimbursement for a wig.
Ik ben niet voornemens om de maximale vergoeding voor een haarwerk te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Ploumen en Paternotte over het recht op abortus in Polen

MPs Ellemeet, Ploumen and Paternotte asked the government about the abortion ban in Poland, prosecutions of activists, the lack of access for Polish and Ukrainian refugee women, and what the Netherlands can do. The minister stated that Dutch clinics can treat foreign women without state financial support, that funding goes to rights organisations rather than individual abortions, and that the government shares concern over regressive pressure in Poland.
However, this is not a right and the Dutch state does not provide financial support to these individual women.
Dit is echter geen recht en de Nederlandse staat biedt deze individuele vrouwen geen financiële ondersteuning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de Rijswijkse moordzaak

An MP asked the Justice Minister about the 1985 Rijswijk triple murder, whether the investigation was closed due to links to the Surinamese regime, and whether the case should be reopened after a podcast. The Minister said the investigation covered several scenarios including mistaken identity, closed for lack of leads, cannot disclose details for privacy and investigative reasons, and that prosecution is no longer possible because the offences are time-barred.

Since this is an unsolved case still under the attention of the Den Haag police cold case team, there is, in view of investigative interests and the privacy of victims and relatives, no reason to make investigation data public.

Nu het een niet-opgehelderde zaak betreft die nog onder de aandacht is van het cold caseteam van politie Den Haag, is er – met het oog op de belangen van opsporing en de privacy van slachtoffers en nabestaanden – geen aanleiding om onderzoeksgegevens openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Kroger over capaciteit en bereidheid van Nederland voor de opvang van eventuele vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne

MPs Ellemeet and Kroger asked about Dutch capacity and willingness to receive refugees from Ukraine, including EU solidarity, reception numbers at COA, and activation of the Temporary Protection Directive. The government answered that Afghan evacuees are being transferred despite capacity concerns, that municipalities and safety regions are preparing thousands of reception places, and that the Temporary Protection Directive was activated at the JBZ Council.
The cabinet is receiving the first reports that surrounding countries are reaching the limits of their reception capacity.
Het kabinet ontvangt de eerste berichten dat omringende landen aan de grenzen van de opvangcapaciteit zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de cultuur bij het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken over het artikel: ‘Een old boys-network: over de ‘zwijg- en angstcultuur’ bij Buitenlandse Zaken’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the choice of a man over a woman for a top post, the diversity strategy at the ministry, and claims of a culture of silence and fear. The minister declined to discuss the selection on personnel-confidentiality grounds, and otherwise stated commitments to diversity, a 50% female leadership target by 2025, and gender parity in the top within five years.
Regarding the considerations and conclusions within a selection process concerning employees, I do not provide statements due to the confidential nature of personnel matters.
Over de afwegingen en conclusies binnen een selectieproces ten aanzien van medewerkers doe ik vanwege het personeelsvertrouwelijke karakter geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Ellemeet over endometriose

MPs Klaver and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Health about endometriosis, including diagnostic delay, prevalence, treatment, education, guidelines and research funding. The minister answered that prevalence is uncertain, that awareness and education are mainly for professional bodies, that ZonMw will be asked about gender-sensitive research, and that talks with NVOG and LHV/NHG are willing to be held.
I am willing to sit down with the NVOG and the LHV/NHG to see which steps need to be taken to make diagnoses faster.
Ik ben bereid om met de NVOG en de LHV/NHG om de tafel te gaan om te zien welke stappen er gezet moeten gaan worden om sneller een diagnose te kunnen stellen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Agnes Mulder, Ellemeet, Van der Graaf, Piri, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu en Teunissen over het bericht 'Polish coalition dynamics complicate rule-of-law talks, says EU’s justi

MPs asked the government whether the EU rule-of-law conditionality mechanism would be activated before Hungary's April 2022 elections and why it had not yet been used, and urged the Netherlands to press the Commission. The minister replied that the Commission had delayed the mechanism pending guidelines and a Court of Justice ruling (issued 16 February 2022), that the procedure takes at least three months so cannot be finished before the Hungarian vote, and that the Netherlands continues to urge swift guidelines and activation.

The government continues to urge the Commission to fully use the MFK rule-of-law regulation by establishing guidelines as soon as possible and starting the procedure to suspend or stop payments of EU funds.

Het kabinet blijft er bij de Commissie op aandringen om de MFK-rechtsstaatverordening volledig te benutten, door nu zo snel mogelijk richtsnoeren vast te stellen, en de procedure om tot de opschorting of stopzetting van uitkering van EU-middelen te komen, te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Ellemeet over het bericht ‘China financiert onderzoek naar mensenrechten aan VU’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and of Education, Culture and Science about Chinese funding of a human rights research centre at the VU, raising concerns about academic independence and Chinese influence in Dutch universities. The minister answered that academic freedom can coexist with third-party funding, that the national knowledge security guideline was published, that the RUG Hanban chair was not renewed, and that the government is concerned about human rights in Xinjiang.
I will, together with other ministries and services, keep a close eye on this.
Ik zal daarbij, samen met andere ministeries en diensten, een vinger aan de pols houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Ellemeet over het afnemen van het aantal restitutiepolissen

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the health minister about the decline in restitution health insurance policies, premiums, conversions to combination policies, uninsured numbers, coverage details, and whether insurers can cut reimbursement or change conditions for mental and physical care providers. The minister answered with figures on policy counts and premiums, said insurers set their own policies and must inform insureds of changes, and stated that selective contracting by insurers is important for steering to appropriate care.
In the spring I can inform your House about the definitive figures for 2022.
In het voorjaar kan ik uw Kamer informeren over de definitieve cijfers voor 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Ellemeet over polio in Bilthoven
