MP Ellemeet asked the Health Minister how often poliovirus has been found in Bilthoven over ten years, whether other municipalities were affected, and what measures, and roles for water boards, municipalities and the IGJ, exist to prevent such incidents. The minister reported six detections in Bilthoven since 2020, outlined surveillance, a planned Gezondheidswet and Wpg amendment with a WHO-certification route, and explained that water boards need no extra powers while municipal powers and voluntary IGJ inventories are described.
I therefore see no added value in extra powers for the water boards.
Ik zie dan ook geen toegevoegde waarde van extra bevoegdheden voor de waterschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Ellemeet en Ploumen over het artikel "De Deense zaad-invasie: hoe Deense klinieken profiteren van een ongereguleerde markt"

MPs Jetten, Ellemeet and Ploumen asked the health minister about a Follow the Money article on Danish sperm clinics exploiting an unregulated market, including the donor-limit rules, cross-border donor supply, monitoring, and the Wdkb amendment. The minister answered that the Wdkb amendment is pending (expected March 2022), that a 12-family cap per donor applies under the national standard, that monitoring is by individual clinics with no central oversight yet, and that internet/private donation is not regulated.
There is currently no central monitoring in the Netherlands of the maximum number of children per donor.
Er is op dit moment geen centrale monitoring in Nederland van het maximumaantal kinderen per donor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Ploumen en Ellemeet over het moedwillig fout informeren van jongeren over abortus

MPs De Hoop, Ploumen and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Education whether he would act against schools giving young people deliberately false information about abortion, and how widespread such lessons are. The minister said the Inspectorate does not track the content of individual lessons, that schools must ensure students' safety and wellbeing, and that the Inspectorate will consider the signals in its supervision, without committing to a specific new step.
There is therefore no overview available of which information is provided, at what frequency, and by which school.
Er is dan ook geen overzicht beschikbaar van welke voorlichting, in welke frequentie, door welke school gegeven wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Ellemeet, Koekkoek en Teunissen over het bericht over mogelijke push back van een groep van 27 vluchtelingen op het Griekse eiland Lesbos

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary about reports of a group of 27 refugees hiding on Lesbos to avoid alleged pushback, including claims of a pushback of a minor, unlawful strip searches of detained activists, Greek laws criminalising aid and restricting lawyers, and the status of an independent EU monitoring mechanism. The government answered that it awaits findings from Greek and EU investigations, supports an independent monitoring mechanism, notes the Commission is responsible for enforcement, and does not accept that pushbacks are normal practice.
In the absence of independent information, I await the results of such investigations.
Bij het ontbreken van eigenstandige informatie wacht ik de resultaten van dergelijke onderzoeken af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het gebrek aan daadkracht om fatsoenlijke noodopvang voor asielzoekers in te richten

An MP asked the State Secretary why emergency reception for asylum seekers in Ter Apel was overcrowded, what action was taken after the August letter, why the October Veiligheidsberaad targets were not met, and about unaccompanied minors without guardianship or care. The State Secretary answered that about 6,500 extra mostly temporary places were realised, that the regional safety councils' options could not be realised quickly, and that unaccompanied minors aged 17.5 and over would be moved to adult facilities on a one-off basis.
At present the deployment of the former prison in Zoetermeer has not been concretely worked out.
Het is op dit moment is de inzet van de voormalige gevangenis in Zoetermeer niet concreet uitgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over abortus voor ongedocumenteerden

GroenLinks MP Ellemeet asked whether abortion access should be guaranteed for undocumented women, whether they can afford the roughly 700 euro cost, and whether the CAK reimbursement scheme or the abortion clinic subsidy should be extended to cover them. Minister De Jonge answered that uninsured women can be charged flexible lower rates, that a survey of clinics found only limited contact with undocumented women, that extending the schemes would be legally difficult and open to abuse, and that he will ask clinics to record such cases.
I am willing to ask abortion clinics to keep track of whether, and if so how often, they encounter undocumented women who are financially unable to pay for abortion care.
Ik ben bereid abortusklinieken te verzoeken om bij te houden of, en zo ja, hoe vaak, zij te maken krijgen met ongedocumenteerde vrouwen die financieel niet in staat zijn abortuszorg te bekostigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het basispakket van Pro Life

MPs Ellemeet asked whether Pro Life's basic health policy excluding abortion, euthanasia, donor insemination, IVF for same-sex couples and transgender care, and related questions about stigma, legal limits, and palliative care, is acceptable. Minister De Jonge replied that the exclusions are permitted under article 11(5) Zvw, that the NZa judges compliance case by case, that Pro Life will clarify its website, and that no legislative change is planned.
I do not intend to prepare a legislative amendment.
Ik ben niet van plan een wetswijziging voor te bereiden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Kathmann, Kuik, Van Nispen, Van der Staaij, Pouw-Verweij, Ellemeet, Gündoğan, Omtzigt en Van Esch over de daadwerkelijke inwerkingtreding van de Wet kansspelen op afstand en het be

MPs from several parties asked the government about protecting minors and vulnerable groups from online gambling advertising, the 30% youth-audience interpretation in the industry gambling advertising code, enforcement by the Kansspelautoriteit, and the implementation of the Vos motion and amendment on warnings. The minister answered that the ban on targeting youth is absolute, enforcement lies with the Ksa, a time-slot restriction is currently not feasible, and a new warning text is being developed via Trimbos.
The Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) supervises compliance with advertising restriction measures laid down in laws and regulations.
De Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) houdt toezicht op de naleving van reclamebeperkende maatregelen die zijn neergelegd in wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het faciliteren van illegale pushbacks

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about Dutch marechaussee support to Frontex in Lithuania, alleged illegal pushbacks of asylum seekers from Belarus, deaths at the Polish-Belarusian border, and EU funding for alleged pushbacks in Croatia. The State Secretary answered that the Netherlands supplied six personnel to Frontex, that responsibility for border conduct lies with member states and the Commission, that the Netherlands raised fundamental rights concerns with Poland, and deferred the Croatia funding question to a separate reply.

It is for the Commission to ensure that border management in member states is carried out in accordance with applicable European law, and for Frontex to ensure that fundamental rights are guaranteed during Frontex operations.

Het is aan de Commissie om erop toe te zien dat de grensbewaking in lidstaten wordt uitgevoerd conform de geldende Europese wet- en regelgeving en aan Frontex om erop toe te zien dat de fundamentele rechten tijdens Frontex operaties worden gewaarborgd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Ceder en Ellemeet over het rapport van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State over de Wijziging van het Vreemdelingenbesluit 2000, in verband met het regelen van de aanmeldfase

Opposition MPs from D66, ChristenUnie and GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the Council of State's criticism of the new asylum pre-registration phase, which drops the first hearing and lacks safeguards such as legal aid and medical checks before the initial hearing. The State Secretary defended the change, saying safeguards are not needed for the brief initial questioning, that statements in pre-registration do not weigh against credibility, and that an evaluation will be published in mid-2022.
The cabinet is of the view that the brief questioning on asylum motives can be justified without yet meeting the safeguards named by the Council of State.
Het kabinet is van oordeel dat de korte uitvraag van asielmotieven verantwoord kan zonder dat al aan de door de Afdeling genoemde waarborgen is voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Van Ginneken, Kuiken, Ellemeet en Simons over het faillissement van de ggz-instelling voor transgenderzorg 'Stepwork'

MPs from D66, PvdA, GroenLinks and BIJ1 asked about the bankruptcy of Stepwork, a major transgender care mental health provider, its impact on waiting lists and continuity of care, and what government could have done earlier. The State Secretary answered that continuity of care is secured through takeover by Genderhealthcare, that the government had intervened repeatedly since 2019, and that a review of the psychological assessment requirement is being prepared via ZonMw.
The policy of the Ministry of VWS is aimed at continuity of care for patients and clients, not at continuity of individual institutions.
Het beleid van VWS is gericht op continuïteit van zorg voor patiënten en cliënten, en niet op continuïteit van individuele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Ellemeet over de onrechtmatige staatssteun aan Siriz

MPs Jetten and Ellemeet asked the state secretary about Siriz's unlawful state aid, its subsidy history, contacts with the ministry, and the Court of Audit's findings. The state secretary acknowledged that the subsidy constituted unlawful state aid, gave a year-by-year payment table, but declined to make the 2019 state-aid assessments available and said recovery is not possible while no Commission or court ruling exists.
There are no documents containing full state-aid assessments that can be sent to your House.
Er zijn geen documenten met integrale staatssteuntoetsen die aan uw Kamer kunnen worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Van der Lee en Ellemeet over de voortgang van evacuaties uit Afghanistan

MPs Bromet, Van der Lee and Ellemeet asked the government how people covered by the Belhaj motion can still contact the Dutch state after the evacuation mailbox closed, what further evacuation efforts are planned, and how the Taliban treat those groups. The government answered that it continues limited evacuations, a special scheme for two groups is planned, about 20,000 unique emails were received, and it cannot yet confirm the Taliban's conduct clearly.
It is difficult to obtain a clear picture of the situation in Afghanistan and the conduct of the Taliban.
Het is moeilijk een eenduidig beeld te krijgen van de situatie in Afghanistan en het handelen van de Taliban.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Michon-Derkzen en Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Achterstand van honderden zedenzaken bij politie Midden-Nederland’

MPs Bikker, Michon-Derkzen and Ellemeet asked about reported backlogs of sexual offence cases at the Midden-Nederland police, the progress of the motion-Klaver capacity funding, support for victims and police staff. Minister Grapperhaus answered that 820 cases nationally (233 in Midden-Nederland) have been pending over six months, that capacity expansion and shortened training are underway with full staffing targeted for 2023, and that victim support and staff welfare measures exist, while acknowledging the backlog persists.
Of course, I will inform your House about progress in this area.
Uiteraard zal ik uw Kamer over de voortgang op dit terrein informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Ellemeet over het onderzoek van het Europees Parlement naar Frontex

MPs Ceder and Ellemeet asked the State Secretary about the European Parliament's Frontex inquiry, which found Frontex was aware of alleged pushbacks but did not act, and about the role of director Leggeri and what should be done. The government acknowledged the failure of reporting and complaint mechanisms, called for better follow-up and strengthened Management Board steering, but declined to share Dutch Management Board statements and said no new investigation is needed.
The government's main conclusion from the FSWG report is that the existing reporting, complaints and monitoring mechanisms have not worked sufficiently.
Het kabinet trekt als voornaamste conclusie uit het FSWG-rapport dat de bestaande rapportage-, klachten- en monitoringsmechanismen onvoldoende hebben gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het uitzetten van kinderen in verband met een tweede nationaliteit van de ouders

MP Ellemeet asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the deportation of Syrian children who have lived in the Netherlands for five years, because their mother was given Moroccan nationality through her father, and whether dual nationality alone can justify rejecting asylum and how the best interests of the child are weighed. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual cases, explained the country-of-origin and dual-nationality rules and the best-interests weighing, and stated that the discretionary power was reshaped to discourage long-term residence and that a review of policy is ongoing but fundamental choices must await a new cabinet.
As your House is aware, I cannot comment on individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ginneken, Van der Laan, Ellemeet, Kathmann en Simons over het bericht 'Kabinet biedt excuses aan voor oude transgenderwet'

MPs asked why the compensation scheme for the former transgender sterilisation requirement was not published by 1 July, how the Transgender and Intersex Collective was involved, and why the amount is EUR 5,000. The minister said publication was delayed, the Collective was consulted and its input shaped the scheme, the amount follows an earlier scheme for youth care abuse victims, and the scheme will be published in the Staatscourant with applications from 18 October 2021.
It has become apparent that drafting the scheme and preparing its implementation required more time than originally estimated.
Het is gebleken dat de totstandkoming van de regeling en het voorbereiden van de uitvoering meer tijd vereisten dan op voorhand was ingeschat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Amhaouch, Ellemeet en Bromet over de wateroverlast in Limburg

MPs asked the government about the flooding in Limburg: the adequacy of responders, damage estimates, applying the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen to victims, flood buffers and climate adaptation funding, and the long-term aid. The minister answered that the government will apply the compensation law, outlined eligible damage categories, said a damage quick scan is being prepared, and described responder support, climate-adaptation programmes and a planned evaluation table.
Given the nature and scale of the disaster, the cabinet has decided to apply the Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts).
Het kabinet heeft besloten om, gelet op de aard en de omvang van de ramp, de Wet tegemoetkoming schade bij rampen (Wts) toe te gaan passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de bejegening van een journalist in de uitoefening van de journalistieke taak

An MP asked the Justice Minister about a demonstration location change linked to FDF leader Van den Oever, a tractor driving provocatively, and police advising a journalist not to speak with a farmer, asking whether this limits press freedom. The minister said the mayor decides locations on security grounds without infringing rights, police may advise journalists for safety, and the government is committed to press protection and has written letters on journalist threats.
In doing so, there was in no way any infringement on the right to demonstrate or the right to freedom of expression.
Daarbij is op geen enkele manier inbreuk gemaakt op het recht op demonstratie of het recht op vrijheid van meningsuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet inzake de weigering om meer geld te reserveren voor echtscheidingszaken

The Member Ellemeet asked the Minister for Legal Protection why the government refuses to reserve more money for divorce cases, after the Bar Association suspended cooperation on legal aid packages, and whether divorce lawyers' fees will fall by thirty percent. The Minister acknowledges that fees in family law lag most, earmarks EUR 28 million through 2024, rejects the thirty percent claim, and promises a meeting with the Bar Association.
I will enter into discussion with the NOvA in the short term to see how we can continue the cooperation.
Ik zal op korte termijn in gesprek met de NOvA treden om te bezien hoe we de samenwerking kunnen voortzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht 'Strenge wet dupeert asielkinderen'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about reports that the strict Afsluitingsregeling for long-staying children leaves asylum children out, including how many applications were refused and on which grounds, and whether children known only to municipalities were excluded. The State Secretary answered with detailed figures, explained the availability criterion, and stated that no forced departures of rejected children were planned at the time of the question.

There were 43 applications by principal applicants refused on the basis of the criterion that the foreign national was out of sight of the national government for longer than the permitted period and did not meet the availability criterion.

Er zijn 43 aanvragen van hoofdpersonen afgewezen op basis van het criterium dat de vreemdeling langer dan de toegestane periode uit beeld was van de rijksoverheid en niet voldeed aan het beschikbaarheidscriterium.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek en Ellemeet over het monitorrapport 'Leefomstandigheden van kinderen in de asielopvang'

MPs Koekkoek and Ellemeet asked about a monitoring report on children's living conditions in asylum reception centres, including feelings of insecurity, frequent relocations and the role of COA child contact persons. The State Secretary acknowledged the report, said some improvements have been made and that recommendations are being studied, but did not commit to adopting all of them and gave only general commitments on relocations and contact persons.
I am grateful to the members of the Werkgroep Kind in azc and the involved organisations for the research and the monitoring report.
Ik ben de leden van de Werkgroep Kind in azc en de betrokken organisaties erkentelijk voor het onderzoek en het monitorrapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de betrokkenheid van Frontex bij illegale pushbacks

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about Frontex's involvement in alleged illegal pushbacks, Frontex's support to the Libyan coast guard, Dutch personnel deployed to Greece, and oversight of the agency's Management Board. The government answered at length, pointing to ongoing reviews by the Management Board working group, the European Ombudsman, the European Parliament and OLAF, and committing to consider a standing working group on fundamental rights and to inform parliament on the Dutch position.
The cabinet cannot of course anticipate the outcomes of the various ongoing investigations by the European Parliament, the Ombudsman and OLAF.
Het kabinet kan uiteraard niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van de verschillende lopende onderzoeken van het Europees Parlement, de Ombudsman en OLAF
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de berichtgeving ‘Aantal online bedreigingen tegen agenten afgelopen jaar verdubbeld’

The MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the reported doubling of online threats against police officers and the practice of doxing, and what measures can curb them. The Minister acknowledges the problem, announces a bill before summer recess introducing a new criminal offence for doxing, and describes existing police, prosecutorial and civil-law tools and support protocols.
Following a motion by MP Michon-Derksen (VVD), I will put a bill out for consultation before the summer recess introducing an additional criminal offence for doxing.

Ik ga, mede naar aanleiding van een daartoe strekkende motie van het lid Michon-Derksen (VVD) 2 , 3 , vóór het zomerreces een wetsvoorstel in consultatie brengen waarmee een aanvullende strafbaarstelling rond het fenomeen doxing wordt geïntroduceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Westerveld over het bericht ‘Farmaceuten keken niet naar de bij effecten van coronavaccins op vrouwen’

MPs Ellemeet and Westerveld asked whether regulators EMA and CBG examine sex-specific side effects of COVID-19 vaccines, whether halved doses for young women are being studied, and whether interaction effects and raw trial data should be required. The minister answered that sex was recorded and subgroup analyses were done, that a sex-specific safety analysis for AstraZeneca was still awaited, that research on the rare side effect is ongoing, and that full clinical reports are already published so no extra requirement is needed.
An additional requirement is not necessary.
Een extra eis is niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Özütok over het bericht ‘De anti-abortusbeweging haalt vrouwen over tot het nemen van gevaarlijke ‘spijtpil’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the health minister about reports that anti-abortion groups pressure women into taking a dangerous 'regret pill' (progesterone) and whether such groups should be restricted, including by buffer zones around clinics. The minister stated that dispensing these drugs is restricted to pharmacists and licensed doctors, that the inspectorate enforces this, that buffer zones are for mayors to decide under the Public Manifestations Act, and that the inspectorate is investigating a Urk practice without a criminal probe yet.
As is customary, the Inspectorate makes no statements while the investigation is ongoing.
Zoals gebruikelijk doet de Inspectie hangende het onderzoek geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Ceder, Jasper van Dijk en Piri over de dreigende uitzetting van Amsterdamse modelburgers Sofia en Najoua

MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the threatened deportation of two Amsterdam-raised young women, questioning whether the IND's decision, its appeal against the court ruling and the rules for residence under article 8 ECHR were consistent with the rights of children and the courts' findings. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case, noted the IND has withdrawn the appeal and granted residence, and explained general routes and guidance for adults who grew up in the Netherlands without residence status.
As you know, I cannot go into individual cases nor into the considerations underlying the decision to lodge an appeal.
Zoals u weet kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken noch op overwegingen die ten grondslag liggen aan het instellen van Hoger Beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Ellemeet, Ceder, Kuik en Koekkoek over de mogelijke uitzetting van Tina en Jacob

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security why Tina and Jacob, Syrian-Armenians, faced deportation to Armenia and whether their family ties and residence in the Netherlands should count. The State Secretary declined to discuss the individual case on privacy and confidentiality grounds, explained the IND's general approach to dual nationals and safe third countries, and noted that the IND had granted a residence permit.
As said, I cannot go into the individual case.
Zoals gezegd kan ik niet ingaan op de individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over mondzorg in het basispakket

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health minister about adding dental care to the basic insurance package, including costs, premiums, access for low-income people, and productivity losses. The minister answered that evidence is insufficient to confirm dental care saves costs elsewhere, that adding it would raise premiums by about 15 euro per year, and that a new monitor of oral health will start in 2022.
I consider it important that structural information becomes available on the oral health of people in the Netherlands.
Ik vind het van belang dat er structurele informatie beschikbaar komt over de mondgezondheid van mensen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de publicatie van de scorekaart van Farma ter Verantwoording

The MP asks the health minister about a Farma ter Verantwoording scorecard rating pharmaceutical firms on COVID-19 drugs, including licence transparency, production costs, technology sharing and fair global access. The minister replies that licence agreements are confidential, that the scorecard categories are one-sided, and that policy relies on transparency pressure, access benchmarks and EU joint procurement, while committing to no specific new action.
A licence agreement is generally a confidential agreement between two parties.
Een licentieovereenkomst is in de regel een vertrouwelijke overeenkomst tussen twee partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht 'Medische hulpmiddelen: de patiënt betaalt de rekening'

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care whether medical aids prescribed as medically necessary must be reimbursed, whether insurers are squeezing supplier prices, who is responsible for patients getting the right aids, and whether producers are leaving the market. The Minister explained the medical indication and insurance coverage rules, said insurers face lower prices and the Bestuurlijk Overleg Hulpmiddelenzorg is tackling transparency, and noted no concrete signals of supply risk, with insurers responsible for alternatives.
For the BOH, patient associations also regularly conduct surveys to collect bottlenecks.
Ten behoeve van het BOH worden door patiëntverenigingen ook regelmatig enquêtes uitgevoerd om knelpunten te verzamelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Özütok, Kuiken en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Onverwacht zwanger door nieuw koperspiraaltje'

MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about reports of unexpected pregnancies and expulsions linked to the Ballerine copper IUD, including how adverse events are reported, what risk assessment is underway, and how EU medical device rules and notified body oversight will protect patients. The Minister answered that the IGJ is analysing the reports, that a MEBI alert is planned, and that the EU MDR applying from May 2021 will tighten requirements, while acknowledging room for improvement.
Furthermore, I call on healthcare providers, manufacturers and patients to continue reporting their complaints and side effects related to medical devices through the available channels.
Verder roep ik zorgverleners, fabrikanten en patiënten op hun klachten en bijwerkingen met betrekking tot medische hulpmiddelen te blijven melden via de beschikbare kanalen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht 'Medewerker Shell krijgt meer korting op zorgverzekering dan thuiszorgmedewerker'

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether collective discounts in supplementary health insurance cause cross-subsidy, whether such discounts should be abolished, and how average discounts compare between care workers and business employees. The minister said supplementary insurance is outside the basic-package statute and insurers may set premiums, acknowledged that most collective discounts lack care-related justification and amount to cross-subsidy, and announced a legislative process to abolish the collective discount for the basic insurance.
I have no insight into the average collective discount that care workers versus business employees receive.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de gemiddelde collectiviteitskorting die zorgmedewerkers versus medewerkers uit het bedrijfsleven ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Ellemeet over de laatste ontwikkelingen betreffende COVID-19

MPs Klaver and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Health about COVID-19 test capacity, lab shortages, PPE shortage claims in elderly care, and the shifting testing targets. The minister answered that testing capacity now exceeds demand, that shortages were due to multiple causes, and that the PPE guidelines were not driven by scarcity, while acknowledging the testing targets were revised upward after demand surged and admitting the answers were late.
I do not have figures on what share of the critical/other COVID-19 category is carried out for healthcare personnel.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over welk deel van de kritieke/overige Covid-19 categorie uitgevoerd wordt voor personeel in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Smeulders en Buitenweg over Coronatestlijn

MPs from GroenLinks asked the ministers about reports that staff of the coronavirus testing helpline could access personal data beyond what their tasks required, about WhatsApp data sharing, training, outsourcing to Teleperformance, unpaid hours and working conditions. The government answered that access is necessary for the job, that logging and confidentiality agreements safeguard privacy, that GGD-GHOR is responsible, and that labour conditions are for employers and social partners, with the Inspectie SZW available for complaints.
Care in handling personal data is of course of great importance.
Zorgvuldigheid is bij het omgaan met persoonsgegevens uiteraard van groot belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen, Ellemeet, Kerstens en Ploumen over de anti-abortus lobby van de Krijgsmacht Bisschop

MPs asked the State Secretary of Defence whether the Military Bishop's letter calling abortion 'child sacrifices' fits Defence norms, whether the Military Ordinariate is funded by Defence, and whether he will talk to the bishop about using his title for political lobbying. The government answered that the statements do not fit Defence values, that the title is not an official Defence title and the bishop is responsible for his own statements, that the Ordinariate receives no Defence funding, and that it will not separately engage with the bishop on the matter.
No, these statements do not fit within the norms and values of Defence.
Nee, deze uitlatingen passen niet binnen de normen en waarden van Defensie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de toelatingsprocedure van medicijnen voor kankerpatiënten

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Medical Care why cancer medicines reach the Dutch market months later than in the US and how the EMA and Dutch reimbursement procedures could be sped up. The Minister acknowledged the tension between speed and care, pointed to a parallel assessment pilot, argued that Dutch uptake of oncolytics is relatively quick compared with most EU states, and promised to review the sluis procedure for expensive drugs with the Zorginstituut.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht 'Onrust over geheime vaccinonderhandelingen'

The MP asks about secret EU negotiations for COVID-19 vaccine contracts, including liability waivers for manufacturers such as AstraZeneca, the identity of negotiators, and profit margins. The minister replies that EU product liability law is fully respected, negotiators are bound by confidentiality, pricing is withheld, and the government will keep the Chamber informed in general terms.
Information relating to financial aspects of each contract, such as price agreements, falls under the confidentiality obligation.
De informatie die betrekking heeft op financiële aspecten van elk contract zoals prijsafspraken, valt onder de geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Tv-spotje voor anti-abortusweek; critici noemen wervingsactie ‘misleidend'

MP Ellemeet asked whether a TV spot for an anti-abortion week, criticised as misleading, should be banned or acted against, and whether French-style rules on abortion information are an option. Minister De Jonge declined to judge the spot's content, pointed to the advertising code and its Commission as the existing remedy, and rejected French-style criminal rules as unnecessary and undesirable.
It is not for me to judge the content of the TV spots concerned.
Het is niet aan mij een oordeel te geven over de inhoud van de betreffende tv-spotjes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht 'VWS hielp met taaleis Duits lab van de testmarkt te weren'

An MP asked the health minister why the ministry imposed a Dutch-language requirement (a Dutch-speaking arts-microbioloog attached to the lab) that reportedly kept a German lab out of the COVID-19 test market, and whether this was justified and in line with EU law. The minister answered that the requirement derived from professional care standards under the wkkgz, was not meant to exclude parties, that no labs were excluded on that basis, and that German labs were contracted once test demand rose in August.
I want to emphasise that these requirements were not intended to keep parties out of the market, and that is not how it turned out.
Ik wil benadrukken dat deze eisen niet bedoeld waren om partijen te weren van de markt, en het heeft zo ook niet uitgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Van den Berge over het bericht ‘Ook kunstenaars in Oost-Nederland hekelen scheve verdeling kunstsubsidies’

MPs Ellemeet and Van den Berge asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the regional imbalance in performing arts subsidies (54% to Amsterdam, almost none to the eastern and northern regions) and what will be done to prevent cultural decline in Oost-Nederland. The Minister replied that extra funding of EUR 15 million per year will go to 71 institutions with positive advice but insufficient budget, and that infrastructure in Flevoland, Friesland, Drenthe, Zeeland, Limburg and Overijssel will be strengthened, with more regional spread than before.
I am adding the province of Overijssel to that.
Daar voeg ik de provincie Overijssel aan toe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Bromet en Ellemeet over G4 EA H1N1-virus en het bericht ‘RIVM houdt ontwikkeling van Chinees varkensvirus goed in de gaten’

MPs Klaver, Bromet and Ellemeet asked the ministers why RIVM is not preparing for the G4 EA H1N1 swine flu virus despite its pandemic potential, how vaccines could be produced, and what sources RIVM monitors. The ministers answered that human-to-human transmission has not been observed, vaccine production takes 4-6 months via WHO-coordinated surveillance, and that no link exists with African swine fever.
It is currently not known how Chinese employees and pig farmers were infected. That is a Chinese matter and we have no information about it.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend op welke manier Chinese medewerkers en varkensboeren zijn besmet. Dat is een Chinese aangelegenheid en we hebben daarover geen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Ellemeet en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Minister Van Engelshoven eindigt subsidie op de MBO card’

Three GroenLinks and PvdA MPs asked the education minister why she ended the MBO Card culture subsidy despite the Berenschot evaluation recommending strengthening it, and how this fits her culture policy ambitions. The minister answered that the subsidy goal was not met, so continuing state funding is not appropriate, and she will instead provide 500,000 euro yearly to a general cultural education scheme, while stating she remains committed to integrated culture education.
If the subsidy objectives of the MBO Card have not been achieved, I do not think it makes sense to then continue the MBO Card with government subsidies.
Als de subsidiedoelstellingen van de MBO Card niet zijn behaald, vind ik het niet geheel in de rede liggen om vervolgens met overheidssubsidies het voortbestaan van de MBO Card te continueren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Renkema over de snelle toename van het aantal nieuwe COVID-19 besmettingen

MPs Ellemeet and Renkema asked the health minister about the rapid rise in COVID-19 infections, the reproduction number, enforcement, communication, quarantine for travellers and hospital capacity. The minister answered that the rise reflects loosened measures and regional outbreaks, promised intensified communication and continued monitoring, but declined a NL-Alert and a legal travel quarantine.
It is being examined how a message on the basic rules can be added to radio and television in the short term.
Er wordt gekeken hoe er op korte termijn een uiting over de basisregels aan kan worden toegevoegd op radio en televisie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Ellemeet over het datalek bij de infectieradar website

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the health minister how he reacted to Formdesk's claim that it received no warning about the Infectieradar data leak, and why the ministry's account of the security checks differed from its earlier statements. The minister answered that RIVM implemented the fix Formdesk advised, that a second flaw was only found on 6 June, and that RIVM now concedes an extra test could have caught it, while stating there is no remaining disagreement with Formdesk.

In hindsight, RIVM concludes that this problem could have been noticed on 25 March if an extra test of this risk had been carried out after implementing the measure advised by Formdesk's supplier and before the Infectieradar was placed online.

Achteraf gezien concludeert het RIVM dat dit probleem op 25 maart opgemerkt had kunnen worden indien ná implementatie van de door de leverancier van Formdesk geadviseerde maatregel en vóór het online plaatsen van Infectieradar een extra test op dit risico was uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Ellemeet over het bericht 'Patiënten de dupe van medicijnwisseling'

MPs Van Gerven (SP) and Ellemeet (GroenLinks) asked the Minister for Medical Care about patients harmed by forced drug switching, the CBG list of drugs not to be switched, the cost savings from switching, the stalled agreement with parties, drug shortages, purchasing by insurers, and national procurement. The minister answered that switching is handled case by case, a CBG list is coming this year, savings are substantial, shortages are a global problem addressed by a five-month stock and temporary measures, and no conclusion on centralised purchasing has been reached.
I have asked the College ter Beoordeling van Geneesmiddelen (CBG) to draw up a list of medicines that should preferably not be switched.
Ik heb het College ter Beoordeling van Geneesmiddelen (CBG) gevraagd een lijst op te stellen van geneesmiddelen die bij voorkeur niet gewisseld zouden mogen worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet en Renkema over de berichten ‘Verpleeghuizen wilden al vroeg testen maar werden geweigerd’, 'Protocol voor contactonderzoek kent twee grote zwakke plekken' en ’Inval-minis

Greens MPs asked the health minister about nursing homes being denied COVID-19 testing, the contact-tracing protocol, staffing needs, and the procurement of protective equipment through the national LCH consortium. The minister answered most questions with figures and explanations, while declining to give some data (such as the Germany, Belgium and France mask purchase figures) and deferring on the one-by-one timing request.
No, I do not have this overview at the moment.
Nee, dit overzicht heb ik op dit moment niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven, Ploumen en Ellemeet over de Inclusieve Vaccin Alliantie

Three MPs asked the Minister of Health how the Inclusive Vaccine Alliance relates to the COVID-19 pool and ACT, whether it undermines global access, and how prices and pharmaceutical deals would be controlled. The minister answered that the initiatives are complementary, that the Alliance includes solidarity with low- and middle-income countries, and that price and supply agreements are being pursued, but gave no firm commitments on joining the pool or conditioning public funding.
I believe several paths must be pursued to make a safe and effective COVID-19 vaccine available as quickly as possible.
Ik ben van mening dat er verschillende paden bewandeld moeten worden om zo snel mogelijk een veilig en effectief vaccin tegen COVID-19 beschikbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Van der Staaij over de financiering van ziekenhuizen en over het bericht ‘NVZ: ‘VWS laat ziekenhuizen en verzekeraars vrij worstelen over geld’

MPs Ellemeet and Van der Staaij asked about a 47% fall in hospital care revenue during COVID-19, whether hospitals should be fully compensated, whether all hospitals are protected from bankruptcy, and whether the financing system should change. Minister Van Rijn answered that insurers' continuity payments and cost reimbursement are in place, the NZa supervises insurers, a Contourennota on the system is postponed to autumn, and the regime for larger providers is still being worked out.
With the continuity contribution and extra-cost scheme there is compensation, so hospitals need not get into financial difficulties because of the coronavirus crisis.
Met de continuïteitsbijdrage en meerkostenregeling is er sprake van compensatie, waardoor ziekenhuizen niet vanwege de coronacrisis in financiële problemen hoeven te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Ellemeet over de berichten dat KLM weer wil gaan vliegen op diverse Europese steden

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked the ministers whether KLM's plan to resume flights to European cities, including COVID-19 hotspots, was sensible given travel restrictions, and about cabin safety, masks and staff protection. The minister answered that entry rules, RIVM-based airline protocols, travel advice and mask guidance address the risks, and that KLM had not consulted RIVM or the OMT.
As far as I am aware, KLM has not held consultations with the RIVM and OMT about expanding flights to European cities.
Voor zover mij bekend heeft KLM geen overleg gevoerd met het RIVM en OMT over uitbreiding van vluchten naar Europese steden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over continuïteit en kwaliteit van de ziekenhuiszorg in de regio

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the continuity and quality of hospital care in the Achterhoek region amid conflict between two hospitals, including calls for a ministerial regional role and a regional vision. The Minister answered by appointing a facilitator, noting IGJ supervision of Santiz, and saying the regional process should lead to a shared vision within the current system.
I have informed the House of Representatives about this in a letter of 27 May 2020.
Ik heb de Tweede Kamer hierover geïnformeerd via een brief op 27 mei 2020.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Ellemeet en Renkema over de berichten ‘Expertisecentrum kreeg vorig jaar recordaantal euthanasieverzoeken’ en ‘Jongeren die in 2017 zelfmoord pleegden vaak verstrikt in web van

MPs Westerveld, Ellemeet and Renkema asked the Health Minister about reports on record euthanasia requests at the Expertise Centre and on young people who died by suicide after being caught in the care system, asking about youth euthanasia rules, unrecorded self-harm and suicide prevention policy. The minister answered that most youth requests reflect a need for help rather than a death wish, provided statistics on youth requests and rejections, and said the government will present a new national suicide prevention agenda this year.
The Expertise Centre does not keep data on this.
Hier houdt het Expertisecentrum geen gegevens over bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Van Ojik , Van der Lee, Özütok, Van den Berge, Buitenweg en Westerveld over de coronacrisis

MPs from GroenLinks asked the government about COVID-19 measures, including drug shortages, ventilator procurement, religious gatherings, Hungary's emergency law and EU funds, tourism in the Wadden area, sex workers' access to support, and charity funding. The government answered most questions substantively, declining to ban religious gatherings in non-public places for lack of legal basis and deferring some matters to EU or regional bodies.
The cabinet emphasises that there is currently no reason to ban religious gatherings of fewer than thirty people.
Het kabinet stelt voorop dat er thans geen aanleiding is voor een verbod op religieuze bijeenkomsten van minder dan dertig personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Renkema, Kröger, Diks en Snels over de coronacrisis

GroenLinks MPs asked the government about COVID-19 testing supplies (the Roche lysis buffer recipe and shortages), protective equipment, support for healthcare and other vital workers, homeless shelter rules, transport measures, and international debt relief and aid for developing countries. The minister answered in detail: the Roche recipe was made available to government, testing capacity is being coordinated through a taskforce and special envoy, and Nederland committed EUR 100 million to COVID-19 response in developing countries.
One of the first concrete results of the Special Envoy's efforts is that the company Roche has made the recipe available to the government.
Eén van de eerste concrete resultaten van de inzet van de Speciaal Gezant is dat de firma Roche het recept ter beschikking heeft gesteld aan de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Ellemeet over het tekort aan openbare bibliotheken

MPs Asscher and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the shortage of public libraries, including five municipalities with no library and the Council for Culture's advice to legally require each municipality to have one. The minister says every resident should have access to a full library within reasonable distance, will pursue fixes through a convenant with municipalities, provinces and the library sector, and does not rule out amending the Wsob later, but declines to make municipal libraries a legal requirement for now.
I want to follow a phased approach here. My aim is to close gaps in the system via the convenant with the other governments and the library sector.
Ik wil hier een gefaseerde aanpak volgen. Het is mijn inzet via het convenant met de andere overheden en het bibliotheekveld lacunes in het stelsel te dichten.
Antwoord de vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Özütok over veel transgenders gaan zelf aan de slag met hormonen, met alle risico's van dien

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about transgender people self-administering hormones because of long waiting lists, including advice, support, waiting-list reduction and data on complications. The Minister advised against self-medication, pointed to GP and support organisations, reported new endocrine care capacity and a planned 2021 follow-up study, and said GPs can take on part of the hormone follow-up.
I do not have figures on the number of medical complications among transgender persons as a result of self-medication.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over het aantal medische complicaties bij transgender personen ten gevolge van zelfmedicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ’Zorginstelling Woerden dreigt gehandicapt stel uit elkaar te halen: ‘Het is mensonterend’’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that a care institution in Woerden would separate a disabled couple, questioning the nursing qualifications required for assisted ventilation and whether residents could stay. The minister said the provider must offer alternative housing, arranged temporary care, and that the required staffing and decisions are the provider's responsibility, with wage and recruitment questions answered by pointing to sector agreements.
I cannot go into the specific medical and nursing care and procedures that the seven clients need at the individual level.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de specifieke medische en verpleegkundige zorg en handelingen die de zeven cliënten op individueel niveau nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over zorgen om verantwoord wisselen medicijnen

An MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about concerns over safe medicine switching and whether the talks on responsible switching collapsed alongside the GVS reform, and how patients without the means to pay a co-payment could switch safely. The minister answered that parties could not agree on all points, the talks were not 'stopped' by parties walking out, that the two developments are unrelated, that a co-payment-free option will exist in each cluster, and that he will make the list of risky switches more binding and seek to avoid co-payments for strictly medical reasons.
I want to give this list a more binding character.
Ik wil deze lijst een meer bindend karakter geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht “Die man kent onze zoon helemaal niet”

An MP asked whether care institutions use court proceedings to remove family members as guardians or administrators, whether guardians are financially dependent on institutions, and whether mediation should be mandatory before removal. The minister says such petitions are about 20 per year, sees no reason to restrict access to court, notes conflict-of-interest safeguards exist, and declines to mandate mediation.
I agree that conflicts between care institutions and administrators/mentors should preferably be resolved outside the court.
Ik ben het ermee eens dat conflicten tussen zorginstellingen en bewindvoerders/mentoren bij voorkeur buiten de rechter om worden opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het sluiten van de afdelingen van het Streekziekenhuis Koningin Beatrix

MPs Ellemeet asked whether the government accepts that the Winterswijk hospital (Santiz, formerly Streekziekenhuis Koningin Beatrix) plans to close departments despite merger promises, and how paediatrics, acute obstetrics, eating-disorder care and inter-tier cooperation will be protected. The minister answered that the merger was approved in 2016 and that the hospital board must give clarity on its implementation; acute obstetrics cannot close as the hospital is classed as sensitive, a regional working group has been set up, and the board has paused its decision on concentrating paediatrics and obstetrics.
I consider it important that the parties involved in the Achterhoek jointly go through a careful process and take the time for it.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de betrokken partijen in de Achterhoek gezamenlijk een zorgvuldig proces doorlopen en hier de tijd voor nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj en Sneller, Ellemeet en Özütok over het bericht 'Rutte informeert Tweede Kamer onjuist over kunstverkoop Oranjes'

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks asked the Prime Minister about reports that the Munnicks van Cleeff atlas, a Raden Saleh painting and other art from Princess Juliana's estate were sold or kept out of museums against advice, and about the handling of the estate and the tax-credit scheme. The government answered that legal constraints on privacy and tax confidentiality limit disclosure of the estate settlement, that the atlas sale was not subject to a binding guarantee of staying in the Netherlands, and that the policy on displaying art acquired via the scheme is not legally binding but policy-based, with a commitment to follow the advisory committee's report.
As I noted in answer to question 2, various statutory provisions prevent a full account of the concrete settlement of the estate among the various private heirs and other parties.

Zoals ik in antwoord op vraag 2 heb opgemerkt staan verschillende wettelijke voorschriften er aan in de weg volledig in te gaan op de concrete afwikkeling van de nalatenschap tussen de verschillende particuliere erfgenamen en andere betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot transgenderzorg

MPs Ellemeet and Özütok asked the Minister of Medical Care about long waiting times in transgender care, the limits of the quartermaster's approach, cross-border lessons, insurer information, a new patient survey, and underuse of the breast augmentation subsidy. The Minister acknowledged long waits, said he cannot give a date for meeting the Treek norms, and listed steps such as extending the quartermaster's mandate, asking insurers to report, and planning a new patient survey in 2021.
I share your concern that waiting times in transgender care are still very long.
Ik deel uw zorgen over het feit dat de wachttijden in de transgenderzorg nog steeds erg lang zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over glucosesensoren

An MP asked the Minister whether he had seen a Kassa broadcast and an article on eligibility rules for continuous glucose monitoring, and whether he would ask the Zorginstituut to re-examine CGM reimbursement. The Minister answered that FGM and rt-CGM are already reimbursed for eligible patients, that he wanted to await the Ronde Tafel quality standard and the Zorginstituut's FGM assessment first, and that following two adopted motions he will now ask the Zorginstituut for a separate study on broader CGM reimbursement.
In accordance with the motions, I will put such a question to the Zorginstituut.
Conform de moties zal ik het Zorginstituut een dergelijke vraag voorleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Ellemeet over de ingezonden brandbrief in het NRC van 67 zorgprofessionals ‘Laten we de duurste ziekte aanpakken – dementie’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister about a open letter from 67 care professionals urging greater focus on preventing dementia, including claims about lifestyle-related risk and possible savings. The minister acknowledged the letter, said prevention is part of existing programmes and the Nationaal Preventieakkoord, and declined to make a sugar tax a priority while offering to talk with the initiators.
We are, however, willing to enter into discussion with the initiators.
Wel zijn wij bereid met de initiatiefnemers het gesprek aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Asscher over inclusiviteit in de podiumkunsten en de overige culturele sector

MPs Ellemeet and Asscher asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about inclusiveness in performing arts and culture, including accessibility for disabled concert-goers, the new diversity code, funding, and building accessibility. The minister answered that accessibility is a shared sector effort, outlined a sector meeting and follow-up steps including a 2020 accessibility study, and listed government and sector funding while stating that building accessibility is primarily the owner's responsibility under existing rules.
In addition, I will commission a study in 2020 to map the accessibility of the cultural sector.
Daarnaast zal ik in 2020 een onderzoek laten uitvoeren om de toegankelijkheid van de cultuursector in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht dat medische hulp voor - en onderzoek naar mensen met niet-westerse achtergrond achterblijft

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Medical Care whether symptoms of conditions more common in non-Western populations are missed by doctors, whether funding and attention for non-white diseases is insufficient, and what the ministry is doing about it. The minister replied that the ministry does not distinguish between white and non-white conditions, points to existing rare-disease policy, European reference networks, research programmes and patient-organisation subsidies, and does not commit to new targeted measures.
The ministry has no insight into the time and attention devoted to non-white conditions, because policy does not distinguish between these conditions.
Het ministerie heeft geen zicht op de tijd en aandacht die naar niet-witte aandoeningen gaat, omdat er in het beleid geen onderscheid gemaakt wordt tussen deze aandoeningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het Kamerlid Ellemeet over de BIG-II

An MP asks the health minister about a union survey rejecting functiedifferentiatie in law, vacancies for regieverpleegkundige excluding mbo-trained nurses, staff turnover, and whether the transitional scheme of the BIG-II bill should be withdrawn. The minister answers that the survey is not representative, that employers decide vacancy requirements, that the transitional scheme's effect on turnover is being studied, and that Rinnooy Kan's advice on the bill is awaited in October 2019.
I will await the results of this exploration and will then consider how to deal with the draft bill BIG II
Ik wacht de resultaten van deze verkenning af en zal dan bezien hoe om te gaan met het concept wetsvoorstel BIG II
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Ellemeet over freelancejournalisten die onder het minimumloon werken

MPs Asscher and Ellemeet asked whether freelance journalists earning below the minimum wage, their falling per-assignment income, and calls for collective bargaining and competition-law exemptions are acceptable. The minister says fair pay is important, announces a planned statutory generic minimum rate for self-employed workers, leaves fair practice to the sector, and points to ongoing work on the Ellemeet/Asscher motion and an ACM guideline.
The cabinet therefore intends to introduce a statutory generic minimum rate so that self-employed persons can earn an income sufficient for a subsistence minimum.
Het kabinet is daarom voornemens om een wettelijk generiek minimumtarief in te voeren om zelfstandigen in staat te stellen een inkomen te verwerven waarmee in een bestaansminimum kan worden voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Analyse jaarverslagen: ziekenhuizen uit gevarenzone’

MP Ellemeet asked the health minister about a report that hospitals' finances improved in 2018, interest costs fell, and equity doubled since 2011, and whether that money should be invested in staff, ICT and innovation. The minister confirmed the improved average position, explained the WFZ's resilience criteria and the NZa early-warning system, and said investment choices rest with hospitals themselves.
I will inform your House further after the summer about the functioning of this improved early-warning system.
Ik zal uw Kamer na de zomer nader informeren over de werking van dit verbeterde systeem van vroegsignalering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Smeulders over de eerlijke betaling van kunstdocenten

MPs Ellemeet and Smeulders asked about fair pay, social security and working conditions for arts teachers, many of whom now work as self-employed freelancers, and about the state's role in arts education. The government answered that it facilitates the sector's labour market agenda and Fair Practice Code, points to planned statutory measures for self-employed workers, gives partial data on freelancers and insurance coverage, and says it will inform parliament about progress in the autumn.
I am aware that workers, and in particular self-employed workers, in the cultural sector often work under unfavourable conditions.
Ik ben me ervan bewust dat werkenden, en met name zelfstandigen, in de culturele sector vaak werken onder ongunstige voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Snels over het bericht dat het kabinet €2 miljard per jaar kan besparen op diabeteszorg (voor type 2) door betere, meer duurzame en goedkopere diabeteszorg

Greens MPs Ellemeet and Snels asked whether the government would pursue lifestyle medicine and demedicalisation to cut type 2 diabetes costs, and how this fits budget rules and prevention commitments. The minister responded that lifestyle interventions can help but their savings are not yet proven, pointed to a ZonMw research programme of 1 million euro, said GLI is in the basic package and expects further steps via the Preventieakkoord, and promised an inventory with stakeholders by year end.
I want to work with relevant field parties to inventory why certain lifestyle interventions (e.g. interventions for diabetes) are not getting off the ground or are not being scaled up.
Ik wil samen met betrokken veldpartijen inventariseren waarom bepaalde leefstijlinterventies (bijv. interventies bij diabetes) niet van de grond komen of niet worden opgeschaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Ellemeet over bodyguards die nodig zijn om vrouwen te begeleiden naar een abortuskliniek

MPs Ploumen and Ellemeet asked the health minister about volunteer bodyguards escorting women to abortion clinics and whether the government will act against increasingly militant anti-abortion demonstrators. The minister said the initiative is lawful, that protecting women is a matter for mayors, and that measures depend on local circumstances; he pointed to a recent letter and a debate instead of new measures.
Whether measures are necessary and justified depends on all relevant facts and (local) circumstances, and is therefore an assessment that can only be made locally by the mayor.

Of maatregelen noodzakelijk en gerechtvaardigd zijn, is afhankelijk van alle relevante feiten en (plaatselijke) omstandigheden, en daarmee een beoordeling die alleen lokaal door de burgemeester kan worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Westerveld en Özütok over de problemen in de transgenderzorg

Three GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about long waiting times in transgender care, the suicide risk for transgender youth, referrals to a third expert centre, self-medication, and insurers' contracting. The minister acknowledged the long waits, pointed to a care coordinator appointed by insurers and the ministry, said priority for young people was considered but left to insurers and providers, and gave partial information on capacity, timing and insurer contracting.
It is up to the health insurers and care providers, with the coordinator's advice in hand, to reduce the waiting lists for transgender care and, where necessary, set priorities.
Het is aan de zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders om, met het advies van de kwartiermaker in de hand, de wachtlijsten voor transgenderzorg terug te dringen en daarbij zo nodig prioriteiten te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Ellemeet over het rapport ‘Overpriced: Drugs developed with Dutch Public Funding’

MPs Van Gerven (SP) and Ellemeet (GroenLinks) asked the ministers whether taxpayers pay twice for drugs developed with public funding, given the SOMO report 'Overpriced', and asked about ROM investments, transparency, conditions on public funding, and alternative models such as a national drug research fund. The government acknowledged the report, said R&D is only one element of drug prices, argued that its own funding overview cannot be meaningfully summed, and said it will review conditions on revolving funds while ruling out a national drug research fund.
The report 'Overpriced: Drugs developed with Dutch Public Funding' focuses in particular on revolving funds that impose no concrete conditions.
Het rapport «Overpriced: Drugs developed with Dutch Public Funding» zoomt met name in op revolverende fondsen die geen concrete voorwaarden stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Ellemeet over het samengaan van VBOK en Siriz

MPs Ploumen and Ellemeet asked the State Secretary whether the merger of VBOK into Siriz, a counselling provider, would undermine the neutral and non-directive character of abortion choice counselling and whether funding should be reviewed. The State Secretary replied that the open house quality criteria, central training and independent expert review, together with IGJ supervision, adequately safeguard quality, and that he will monitor any new structure.
As I informed you earlier, the independent experts I will appoint will assess whether this has indeed happened as I have now agreed with the parties.
Zoals ik u eerder informeerde, zullen de onafhankelijk deskundigen die ik zal aanstellen gaan beoordelen of dit ook werkelijk is gebeurd zoals ik nu met partijen heb afgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Ploumen over onvoldoende toegang tot seksuele en reproductieve zorg voor ongedocumenteerde vrouwen

MPs Ellemeet and Ploumen asked whether undocumented women face barriers to sexual and reproductive care, including unaffordable abortion care despite the maximum tariff, and whether the government will act. Minister De Jonge replied that the maximum tariff gives clinics flexibility and financial buffers, that existing prevention programmes reach high-risk groups, and that he sees no need for additional measures.
I see no reason to take additional measures.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om aanvullende maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de petitie ‘Vergoeding vruchtbaarheidsbehandeling voor elke vrouw’

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about a petition to reimburse fertility treatment for all women, and about the sudden end of insurance coverage for donor insemination for single and lesbian women without a medical indication. The minister answered that insurers will keep covering treatments already started in 2019 and that a decision on public financing from 2020 will follow, while defending the medical-indication criterion as non-discriminatory.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Ellemeet over het bericht waarin minister Bruins aangeeft dat vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen voor alleenstaanden en lesbische vrouwen tijdelijk toch vergoed wordt

MPs Ploumen and Ellemeet asked why the minister does not immediately decide to structurally reimburse insemination for single and lesbian women, and about the timing and handling of reimbursement decisions. The minister replies that reimbursement without a medical indication cannot be funded under the Zvw, that a decision on the government's role will be taken around the summer after further analysis, and that Parliament will be informed then.
The House of Representatives will be informed around the summer about the cabinet's intentions regarding the government's role in financing fertility treatments.
De Tweede Kamer wordt rond de zomer geïnformeerd over de voornemens van het kabinet omtrent de rol van de overheid in de financiering van vruchtbaarheidsbehandelingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Samenstelling verzekerdenpopulatie bepaalt resultaat zorgverzekeraars’

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister for Medical Care about reports that insurer results depend on the composition of their insured population, the size of voluntary deductible rewards, collective discounts that attract healthy members, and risk equalisation shortcomings for chronically ill people. The Minister answers that insurers should differentiate through procurement, that the voluntary deductible effect is small, that the collective discount will be cut from 10% to 5% from 2020 and monitored, and that ex-post equalisation is not preferred.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Machtsmisbruik dreigt door datamonopolie van farmaceuten’

An MP asks the Minister for Medical Care whether the EU Falsified Medicines Directive's verification database gives pharmaceutical firms a data monopoly and whether it hinders transparency, cost and access for small suppliers. The minister denies that industry can access the database, explains the cost structure and transition rules, and says the data are pseudonymised and supervised by the IGJ.
A monopoly of the pharmaceutical industry on access to the European database is therefore not an issue.
Een monopolie van de farmaceutische industrie op toegang tot de Europese database is derhalve niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kuiken en Ellemeet over demonstranten die vrouwen intimideren voor abortusklinieken

Three MPs asked whether anti-abortion demonstrators intimidating women outside clinics is acceptable, how far demonstration rights extend, whether such conduct is criminal, and whether the government will meet clinics and municipalities. The minister said such intimidation is undesirable, that demonstrations are widespread but usually not intimidating, that municipalities can impose conditions and APV rules may cover the conduct, and that a joint meeting with clinics and municipalities will be held before the summer recess.
With due regard to the substantive responsibilities of local government, I will invite the municipalities concerned and the abortion clinics to a joint consultation before the summer recess.
Met inachtneming van de inhoudelijke verantwoordelijkheden van het lokale gezag, zal ik voor het zomerreces de betrokken gemeenten en de abortusklinieken uitnodigen voor een gezamenlijk overleg
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht dat huisartsen zorg weigeren aan woonzorghuizen voor mensen met dementie

An MP asked the minister whether it is concerning that GPs refuse care to residents of small-scale dementia care homes, and how access to 24-hour specialist care is guaranteed. The minister acknowledged GP pressure and the need for cooperation, promised a separate letter on options and financing, but did not commit to new rules or direct oversight changes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Oproep ‘noodregeling’ voor pil die hiv kan voorkomen’

MPs Ellemeet and Dijkstra asked the Minister of Medical Care whether PrEP reimbursement could start in early 2019 after advocacy groups urged an emergency arrangement, and about the pros and cons of national purchasing versus purchasing by pharmacists. The Minister said the RIVM advice was received on 18 December and is under consideration, that implementation is aimed for mid-2019, and that a decision on purchasing will be sent to the House soon.
Soon I will inform the House of my decision on how the reimbursement of PrEP will be implemented.
Binnenkort zal ik uw Kamer informeren over mijn besluit hoe de vergoeding van PrEP zal worden geïmplementeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet, Özütok en Renkema over #metoo in de culturele sector

MPs from GroenLinks asked the minister about a survey showing that 45% of respondents in the cultural sector experienced sexual misconduct, low reporting rates, and dissatisfaction with complaint handling, and what the government would do. The minister shared concern, said the sector is primarily responsible, pointed to employer duties under the Arbowet and Inspectie SZW enforcement, and committed to a meeting with stakeholders on 20 December before deciding on any measures.
I will meet with stakeholders on 20 December. Depending on this conversation and any follow-up conversations, I will look into whether I will take measures.
Ik ga op 20 december met betrokkenen in gesprek. Afhankelijk van dit gesprek en eventuele vervolggesprekken zal ik kijken of ik maatregelen ga treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Renkema en Ellemeet over de problematiek rondom (chronische) Lyme

MPs Renkema and Ellemeet asked the minister about Lyme disease: patient concerns, prevention, recognition and diagnosis, co-infections, treatment of chronic patients, and whether the Health Council should be asked for new advice. The minister answers that research and patient involvement are ongoing, that prevention and GP training exist, and that a new Health Council advice will await results of the NLe research expected in a few years.
On the basis of the outcomes I want to formulate a new request for advice.
Op basis van de uitkomsten wil ik een nieuwe adviesvraag formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Ellemeet over het anticonceptiepil-tekort en het feit dat KNMP en Bogin het niet nodig vinden de geneesmiddelenprijzen zo laag mogelijk te houden

MPs Ploumen and Ellemeet asked the Minister for Medical Care about the contraceptive pill shortage and whether pharmacist and generics bodies KNMP and Bogin contribute to the problem by resisting low drug prices. The Minister answered that supply is recovering, plans a mandatory four-month stock obligation, will report on shortage causes and inspection of late reporting, and rejected the claim that low prices cause shortages.
As I indicated in my letter of 30 November, I will also evaluate this specific case of supply problems with the contraceptive pill and inform the House of the outcome.

Zoals ik heb aangegeven in mijn Kamerbrief van 30 november jongstleden zal ik ook deze specifieke casus van de leveringsproblemen met de anticonceptiepil evalueren en uw Kamer over de uitkomst informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht over gemaakte zorgkosten in 2018 die betaald moeten worden in 2017

MP Ellemeet asked whether patients postponing care to shift deductible costs to a later year, and the opacity of DBC billing timing, call for changing the system so the deductible applies only in the year of the hospital visit. Minister Bruins answered that compensation measures exist, that Nivel data show no rise in care avoidance, and that insurers must inform patients, but declined to commit to changing the DBC system now.
Question 5: Are you willing to change the system so that the deductible is only claimed in the year the hospital visit took place?
Vraag 5 Bent u bereid om het systeem zo aan te passen dat er alleen aanspraak gemaakt wordt op het eigen risico in het jaar dat het ziekenhuisbezoek plaatsvond?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Nederlandse vrouw moet langer wachten op anticonceptiepil’

MPs Ellemeet and Ploumen asked about a shortage of contraceptive pills and whether the preferential reimbursement policy of insurers contributes to it. The minister said supply should recover in December 2018 or January 2019, that the shortage stems from production problems rather than preference policy, and that the measures taken will be evaluated.
In the working group on medicine shortages I will evaluate the measures taken to prevent medicine shortages based on the cases from 2017 and 2018.
In de werkgroep geneesmiddeltekorten zal ik de genomen maatregelen om geneesmiddelentekorten te voorkómen evalueren op basis van de casuïstiek uit 2017 en 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Ellemeet over de ondertekening van CIZ-aanvragen van wilsonbekwame cliënten

MPs Bergkamp and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Health about the signing of CIZ care applications by incapacitated clients, given delays and the lack of a clear rule on who may sign. The Minister defends the current Wlz signing rules, describes an interim CIZ practice accepting proof that guardianship is being arranged, and promises talks with ActiZ, VGN and CIZ and a clear arrangement, while rejecting any change to the Wlz itself.
I am in consultation with ActiZ, VGN and the CIZ to examine how the CIZ can process applications quickly without harming clients' interests.
Ik ben met ActiZ, VGN en het CIZ in overleg om te bezien op welke manier het CIZ snel aanvragen in behandeling kan nemen, zonder afbreuk te doen aan de belangen van cliënten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de grote stijging in burn-outs onder artsen in opleiding

An MP asks about the rise in burnout among medical residents (artsen in opleiding) and whether the health inspectorate can help reduce it. The minister confirms the concern, says the workplace and workload issues are mainly for hospitals and social partners, cites staffing shortages and planned measures, and says the inspectorate will be asked to look at working conditions.
I will bring these parliamentary questions to the attention of the IGJ.
Ik zal deze Kamervragen bij de IGJ onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘8% van de Nederlandse vrouwen koopt geen anticonceptie uit geldgebrek’

An MP asked the health minister about a report that 8% of Dutch women skipped buying contraception for financial reasons, and whether abortion is financially accessible for undocumented women. The minister acknowledged vulnerable women sometimes forgo contraception, pointed to the nationwide Nu Niet Zwanger programme funded via municipalities, said contraception is not basic insurance care, and explained that uninsured women pay abortion clinics directly under a maximum tariff set by the NZa.
I am of the view that the nationwide Nu Niet Zwanger programme reaches a large group of vulnerable women.
Ik ben van mening dat met het landsdekkende programma Nu Niet Zwanger een grote groep kwetsbare vrouwen wordt bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Ellemeet over het bericht dat de pro-life beweging Siriz geen objectieve informatie geeft aan zwangere vrouwen

MPs Ploumen and Ellemeet asked whether the government shares concerns that counselling organisation Siriz, funded for unwanted-pregnancy support, steered women with leading chat questions and whether subsidies should change. The State Secretary answered that new quality criteria and an open-house funding model will apply from 2019, that organisations may hold their values but must not steer the woman's choice, and that the matter will be discussed with the parties.
For me it is important that all choice-support conversations must meet the same quality standards.
Voor mij is het daarbij belangrijk dat alle keuzehulpgesprekken moeten voldoen aan dezelfde kwaliteitsstandaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht dat een verdienmodel voor thuiszorgtechnologie ontbreekt

MP Ellemeet asked the health minister whether the lack of a business model for home-care technology, which leaves producers with an uncertain market, is a concern and whether VWS should steer financing of specific applications. Minister De Jonge answered that reimbursement is possible within existing rules through indirect funding, negotiated tariffs and experiments, and that VWS is stimulating uptake through a planned E-health Thuis scheme, though he gave no commitment to direct central steering.
I expect to be able to inform the House about the stimulation scheme in early 2019.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer in het vroege begin 2019 over de stimuleringsregeling te kunnen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het achterhouden van informatie voor de Kamer

An MP asked the Health Minister whether the Chamber was fully informed about a dossier after a newspaper report that a Landsadvocaat memo had not been shared with parliament. The minister replied that advice from the Landsadvocaat is confidential by policy, that the minister makes an independent assessment, and that the Chamber is always informed as fully and timely as possible.
It is established policy not to share advice from the Landsadvocaat with the Chamber, as such advice, like lawyers' advice in general, is confidential.
Het is staand beleid om adviezen van de Landsadvocaat, die net als adviezen van advocaten in het algemeen vertrouwelijk zijn, niet met de Kamer te delen.
