Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de berichtgeving dat uit onderzoek blijkt dat het aansporen van hulpbehoevenden om hun omgeving in te zetten niet werkt

An MP asked whether the government will change its policy of urging vulnerable people to mobilise their own networks, given research finding this rarely yields help and may increase inequality and pressure. The minister replied that the approach is still developing, that some households need support from professionals, and that programmes such as Langer Thuis and Eén tegen eenzaamheid will be continued, without committing to a substantive policy change.
Of course attention must be paid to households that prove themselves insufficiently able to articulate their support need and/or to oversee how it is organised.
Er moet uiteraard wel aandacht zijn voor huishoudens die zelf onvoldoende in staat blijken te zijn hun ondersteuningsvraag te articuleren en/of de wijze van organiseren te kunnen overzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Renkema over het bericht dat zorgverzekeraar Menzis de behandeling van depressies voortaan vergoedt op basis van de resultaten

MPs Ellemeet and Renkema asked whether Menzis paying for depression treatment partly on outcomes risks undertreatment, patient selection and administrative burden, and whether the government would discourage it. The state secretary supports outcome-based payment in principle, says the patient group is limited to milder cases with no 'no cure, no pay', and rejects discouraging the contracts, while noting ROM measurement debates and promising monitoring with patient organisations.
I therefore do not intend to discourage this type of agreement.
Ik ben daarom niet van plan om dit type afspraken te ontmoedigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Van der Staaij, Ellemeet en Dik-Faber over de situatie dat het openbaar vervoer in dorpen niet altijd toegankelijk is voor rolstoelgebruikers

MPs from SGP, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked why the disability equality law and public transport rules exclude small buurtbussen from wheelchair accessibility requirements, and whether the government would act. The State Secretary answered that accessibility rules were written for larger scheduled buses, that provinces and municipalities are responsible for buurtbus requirements, and that accessibility of buurtbussen is an item on an action programme with stakeholders, without committing to a legal change.
The responsibility for this lies with the provinces and municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid hiervoor ligt bij provincies en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Kröger over het rapport 'Hoogspanningslijnen en gezondheid deel I: kanker bij kinderen'

MPs Ellemeet and Kröger asked whether the Health Council report linking long-term exposure to magnetic fields with childhood leukaemia and brain tumours should prompt precautionary measures extended to underground cables and existing housing. The State Secretary acknowledged the report, said magnetic fields cannot be shielded, and committed to an evaluation of the current precautionary policy and an exploration of extending it, without prejudging outcomes.
It will be evaluated how the precautionary policy for overhead lines has been implemented so far and what its societal effects are.
Er zal worden geëvalueerd hoe het voorzorgbeleid voor bovengrondse lijnen tot nu toe is uitgevoerd en wat hiervan de maatschappelijke effecten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht '#MeToo: artsen gaan niet vrijuit'

An MP asked the ministers about reports that many doctors and junior doctors have experienced sexual intimidation and that few victims report it, and about the lack of change since 2006. The government acknowledges the problem, points to employer responsibility under the Working Conditions Act, existing tools and the Werken in de zorg programme, and promises to talk with the sector about additional measures.
I, like the State Secretary of SZW, am working to ensure that employers in healthcare have an eye for this and act on it, as explained in the answer to questions 4 and 5.
Ik draag er, net als de Staatssecretaris van SZW, zoals toegelicht in het antwoord op vragen 4 en 5, aan bij dat werkgevers in de zorg hier oog voor hebben en werk van maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht 'Wordt abortus opnieuw een taboe'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health minister about a poll showing less youth support for abortion, whether abortion taboos harm women's free choice, and whether advertising with the word abortion is restricted on YouTube and Google. The minister replied that a taboo exists among young girls, pointed to the FIOM campaign and ongoing work on counselling, and explained that abortion ads are allowed on Google Ads search but not on the Display Network.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Özdil over het bericht ‘Vicieuze cirkel: groot tekort aan verpleegkundigen, maar de opleidingen hanteren studentenstops omdat er geen stageplaatsen zijn’

GroenLinks MPs asked the health and education ministers why the nursing shortage persists despite student admission stops caused by insufficient internship places, and about internship funding, student deployment as staff, and the numerus fixus. The minister answered that regional action plans, the SectorplanPlus and the Stagefonds address the shortage, that most universities of applied sciences are dropping the numerus fixus from 2019/2020, and that the admission budget for the current year cannot be increased.
Compensating staff shortages with the full deployment of interns is not desirable.
Het compenseren van personeelstekorten met de volwaardige inzet van stagiairs is niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink, Bergkamp en Ellemeet over de stageomstandigheden van studenten verpleegkundige en verzorging

MPs Hijink, Bergkamp and Ellemeet asked the minister about NU'91 survey findings on care students' internships: underpaid allowances, high workload, weak supervision, risky tasks beyond their competence, and interns filling staff shortages. The minister answered that CAO agreements should be respected but allowances need not meet minimum wage, that schools and care providers share responsibility for supervision, that interns should not fill staff shortages, and that he will bring the report to the attention of stakeholders.
I will bring it to attention.
Ik zal het onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Strijd tegen onderbetalende gemeenten in de thuiszorg’

MPs Ellemeet asked the Minister of VWS whether municipalities pay fair home-care rates and whether the Besluit reële prijs is adequate, after a newspaper claimed most municipalities pay too little. The minister disputes the newspaper's conclusion, reports that 13 signals covering 27 municipalities have been investigated by a monitoring group with no confirmed inadequate tariffs, and notes the new wage scale and cao timing.
I have asked the municipalities and providers concerned, following these research findings, to determine in further consultation how they can still properly give effect to the Besluit reële prijs.

Ik heb de betreffende gemeenten en aanbieders naar aanleiding van deze onderzoeksbevindingen verzocht in nader overleg te bepalen hoe alsnog goed invulling kan worden gegeven aan het Besluit reële prijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de toekomst van de klinische verloskunde en klinische kindergeneeskunde

MP Ellemeet (GroenLinks) asked the Minister for Medical Care about Treant hospital group's plan to close the clinical obstetrics and paediatrics departments at Bethesda Hoogeveen and Refaja Stadskanaal, and about its consultation of partners, shortages of paediatricians, ambulance response times and staff anxiety. The Minister answered that the plan is a non-final proposal, that responsibilities of the parties are set out in a separate letter, that nationally there is no paediatrician shortage, and that further research will be done.
Furthermore, there are concerns, among other things, about the freedom of choice of pregnant women, for example to give birth at home.
Verder zijn er onder meer zorgen over de keuzevrijheid van zwangeren om bijvoorbeeld thuis te bevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Voortman over het bericht 'Vluchtroutes voor mindervaliden op festivals te smal: ‘ik lig zo omver’'

MPs Ellemeet and Voortman asked whether the fire-safety rules for event venues (Bbgbop) adequately protect people with disabilities at festivals, and what the government will do about narrow escape routes. The minister replied that the national decree only sets minimum widths, that accessibility is the responsibility of organisers and municipalities, and that he will consult disability organisations on possible rule changes.
I will shortly contact the disability interest organisations to explain how the Bbgbop works and to explore together where improvements to the regulations are possible.

Ik zal op korte termijn met de belangenorganisaties voor personen met een beperking in contact treden om enerzijds de werking van het Bbgbop toe te lichten en anderzijds om samen met hen te bezien waar verbeteringen in regelgeving mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over onbetaalde banen in de culturele sector

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the high share of unpaid positions and volunteers in the cultural sector, and whether budget cuts displace paid workers. The minister acknowledged the concern, pointed to the labour market agenda, Fair Practice Code and model regulations for volunteers, but mostly declined to take direct action and left arrangements to the autonomous institutions and social partners.
Cultural institutions are autonomous enterprises with decentralised collective labour agreements.
Culturele instellingen zijn autonome ondernemingen met decentrale cao's.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Ellemeet over het bericht 'Zevende rechtszaak van Stichting GGZ Momentum tegen verzekeraar om vrije artsenkeuze: Achmea schendt artikel 13 Zorgverzekeringswet'

MPs Voortman and Ellemeet asked the minister about GGZ Momentum's lawsuits against insurer Achmea over low reimbursement for non-contracted mental health care, which may breach the free choice of provider under article 13 Zvw and shift costs to patients. The minister answered that the 75-80% reimbursement benchmark has held up in court, that NZa supervises article 13 and is investigating insurers' reimbursement, and that the government will examine contracting issues and report to parliament.
Health insurers have their own responsibility when it comes to following case law on care procurement.
Zorgverzekeraars hebben een eigen verantwoordelijkheid waar het gaat om het volgen van jurisprudentie met betrekking tot de zorginkoop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Ellemeet, Dik-Faber en Von Martels over de situatie dat het openbaar vervoer in de dorpen niet altijd toegankelijk is voor rolstoelgebruikers

MPs asked whether wheelchair users can be refused when transferring from a regular bus to a community bus, and whether the Wet personenvervoer 2000 should be amended to close a gap. The government answers there is no legal omission: the Wgbh/cz applies, community buses are deliberately outside its scope as small vehicles, the province chose not to impose further demands on volunteer-run services, and gemeenten must provide small-scale wheelchair transport instead.
There is no omission in the Wet personenvervoer 2000 that would need to be repaired.
Er is geen sprake van een omissie in de Wet personenvervoer 2000 die gerepareerd zou moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijksma,  Ellemeet en Kooiman over het bericht ‘Megawinst farmaceut zet medicijndebat op scherp’

Three MPs asked the Minister for Medical Care about reports of high profits by pharmaceutical firms, whether profits factor into drug price negotiations, how firms fulfil their social responsibility, and whether EU joint procurement could be expanded. The minister said firms should justify high prices and be transparent, called their social responsibility insufficient, declined to comment on negotiations, and pointed to ongoing BeNeLux and EU cooperation.
I do not make substantive statements about the negotiation process.
Ik doe geen inhoudelijke uitspraken over het onderhandelingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de herregistratie in het BIG-register voor profielartsen

An MP asked why profile physicians must separately re-register in the BIG register and provide an extra certified proof from the Medical Specialists Register, unlike other specialists, and whether this automatic link can be created. The minister confirms the separate procedure, says eleven of twelve profiles can use a lighter KNMG profile-register proof, is discussing digital delivery with CIBG and KNMG, and states that automatic linking applies only to legally recognised specialisms.
I am already in discussion with the CIBG, the executor of the BIG register, and the KNMG to examine whether and how these proofs can be delivered digitally.
Ik ben met het CIBG, uitvoerder van het BIG-register, en de KNMG reeds in gesprek om te bezien of en hoe deze bewijzen digitaal kunnen worden aangeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over te weinig kennis over het vrouwenhart

An MP asked the health minister about waiting times and cardiologists' limited knowledge of women's heart conditions, and whether awareness campaigns, training, women's clinics and medical research on gender differences should be stepped up. The minister acknowledged that waits are undesirable, pointed to existing gender content in cardiology training, guidelines and a ZonMw gender programme, and declined to start new awareness campaigns or assess women's clinics, leaving that to insurers.
I do not see a role for me in starting additional information campaigns.
Ik zie geen rol voor mij weggelegd om aanvullende voorlichtingcampagnes te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het delen van persoonsgegevens van gebruikers van Valys

An MP asks the minister whether Valys transport operator Transvision shares passenger personal data with Belgian firm Cubigo, and whether this is permissible under its concession contract. The minister answers that data is not shared with Cubigo, that VITA use is voluntary, that privacy is not at issue, and that information to users has been improved and a meeting with user organisations is planned.
I have raised this with Transvision and the information on the website has since been adjusted.
Ik heb Transvision hierop aangesproken en de informatie op de website is inmiddels aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Personeelstekort in de zorg is in een jaar tijd bijna verdubbeld’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health minister about reports that staff shortages in care nearly doubled in a year, with high workload driving staff out, and what role the minister would play. The minister agreed that satisfied, healthy staff are essential, pointed to an action plan on three tracks (attracting, deploying and retaining staff) and regional action plans, but gave no concrete new measures.
I share your view that satisfied and healthy employees are indispensable for solving the staff shortage.
Ik deel uw mening dat tevreden en gezonde werknemers onmisbaar zijn voor het oplossen van het personeelstekort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de Tussentijdse rapportage Schakelteam voor personen met verward gedrag

An MP asks the state secretary about the interim report of the Schakelteam on persons with confused behaviour, covering transport gaps, response times, funding, police cell use, and crisis shelter provision. The state secretary acknowledges shortcomings, outlines regional transport meetings through December 2017 and a pilot-based funding approach, and commits to informing parliament on results and on structural funding in early 2018.
On the desirability and necessity of a specific arrangement for transport with psychiatric care and its structural funding, I will inform you in early 2018.
Over de wenselijkheid en noodzaak van een specifieke regeling voor vervoer met psychiatrische hulpverlening en de structurele bekostiging ervan zal ik u begin 2018 informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over wijkverpleging

An MP asks whether the minister is aware of Zilveren Kruis's plan to require prior authorisation for uncontracted home nursing, and argues this adds bureaucracy, burdens patients who must pay upfront, and harms uncontracted providers. The minister acknowledges the letter, says the measure aims to curb cost growth and fraud and reduce pressure on the budget, notes patients can avoid it by choosing contracted providers, and says he understands the insurer's measures without committing to ask it to withdraw them.
I support Zilveren Kruis in promoting contracted care and understand that insurers introduce additional safeguards for uncontracted providers.
Ik steun Zilveren Kruis in het bevorderen van gecontracteerde zorg en heb er begrip voor dat de verzekeraars extra waarborgen inricht ten aanzien van ongecontracteerde aanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Ellemeet over beveiligde GGZ-zorg

Two GroenLinks MPs asked about shortages of secured mental health care (beveiligde GGZ), time-out beds and suitable housing, and why zorgverzekeraars may be holding back budget. The State Secretary acknowledged the shortages, pointed to agreements to raise purchasing of secured care, a sector norm due April 2018, and housing initiatives, while attributing part of the gap to insurers' contracting and providers not claiming care.

My predecessor informed you in her letter of 13 July 2017 that agreement was reached with the parties involved to immediately increase the purchasing of secured mental health care for patients who display aggressive or dangerous behaviour.

Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft in haar brief van 13 juli 2017 u medegedeeld dat met betrokken partijen de afspraak is gemaakt de inkoop van beveiligde ggz-zorg voor patiënten, die agressief of gevaarlijk gedrag vertonen, onmiddellijk te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özdil en Ellemeet over de numerus fixus in (tand)artsenopleidingen

MPs Özdil and Ellemeet asked whether the numerus fixus in dentist and doctor training causes the dentist shortage, raises specialist salaries and collective care costs, and whether more training places should be funded. The minister answered that the latest capacity study is under way with results expected end 2017 or early 2018, that the numerus fixus is considered sufficiently generous, and that integrated tariffs were introduced in 2015 to address costs, without committing to a new estimate of places.
I would prefer to await the results of this study before making statements about the number of training places needed.
Graag wacht ik de resultaten van dit onderzoek af alvorens uitspraken te doen over het aantal benodigde opleidingsplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over misbruik bij toneelopleidingen

MP Ellemeet asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about reported sexual misconduct by teachers at drama schools and whether these schools are safe learning environments. The minister acknowledged the power imbalance, reported few signals of abuse, said institutions must have complaint procedures and support systems, and described a proactive investigation at one school.
Institutions must ensure a safe environment in which students and teachers feel encouraged to report any form of unwanted behaviour.
Instellingen moeten zorgdragen voor een veilige omgeving, waarbinnen student en docent bij elke vorm van ongewenst gedrag zich aangemoedigd voelen om tot melding over te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het onderzoek “Onvoldoende doelmatigheid en transparantie in klinisch geneesmiddelenonderzoek”

MP Ellemeet asked the minister about a University of Utrecht study finding that more than half of clinical drug trials are wasted and poorly published, and whether bias, transparency and reward structures should be addressed. The minister answered that publication requirements in EU and Dutch rules already ensure results are made public, that no further measures seem necessary, and that research evaluation is governed by the SEP protocol.
Further measures therefore do not seem necessary to me.
Verdere maatregelen lijken mij dan ook niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Kooiman over het conflict tussen verloskundigen en zorgverzekeraars inzake tarieven

MPs Ellemeet and Kooiman asked whether insurers pay midwife practices in integrated care experiments the maximum NZa tariff, thereby pushing them toward integrated funding contrary to the Leijten motion, and how a level playing field and voluntariness are ensured. Minister Bruins answers that switching to integrated funding is voluntary for regions, that insurers may set their own tariffs and merely incentivise integrated contracts, and that the NZa is monitoring the contracts.
Midwives state that insurers are willing to reimburse the childbirth care agreed under integrated contracts more generously than under monodisciplinary contracts. I have no insight into this.

Verloskundigen geven aan dat zorgverzekeraars bereid te zijn om de geboortezorg die binnen de integrale contracten wordt overeengekomen ruimer te vergoeden dan binnen monodisciplinaire contracten. Ik heb hier geen inzicht in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Ellemeet over de aanhouding van een NRC-fotograaf

Opposition MPs asked the Justice Minister whether the arrest of an NRC photographer who refused to hand over photos of a fight involving a US soldier violates press freedom and proper handling of journalistic material. The minister confirmed the arrest, said apologies were offered, pointed to existing restraint rules on coercive measures against journalists, and committed to discussing the case within the prosecution service and police training.
The acting chief public prosecutor has offered apologies to both the photographer and the editor-in-chief of NRC.
De waarnemend hoofdofficier van justitie heeft zowel de fotograaf als de hoofdredacteur van de NRC excuses aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Een op de drie bijstandsgerechtigden ontvangt psychische zorg’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs whether municipalities and UWV have enough expertise to recognise and help people with psychological problems on benefits, and about the EUR 3.5 million for GGZ-UWV-municipality cooperation. The State Secretary answered that cooperation is being stimulated through regional plans and that a follow-up study on care use among benefit recipients may be repeated, but she gave no figures on post-2015 trends and no evidence on the link with strict enforcement.
I want to examine whether the same or comparable research can be repeated, so that developments in the years in which the Participation Act is in force also become visible.
Ik wil nagaan of eenzelfde of vergelijkbaar onderzoek kan worden herhaald, zodat ook de ontwikkelingen in de jaren waarin de Participatiewet van kracht is zichtbaar worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘NIVEL: Informatie Wmo voor familie verstandelijk gehandicapten ontoereikend’

An MP asked the state secretary about a NIVEL report finding that families of people with intellectual disabilities are often unaware of independent client support under the Wmo, and whether awareness campaigns for informal carers could include it. The secretary confirmed low awareness (25% in a client survey), pointed to a Koplopers project with 14 municipalities and a Movisie review of good practices, and promised to raise the signal in work with VNG and Mezzo with a report before the Christmas recess 2017.
I will ask Movisie to identify good examples among the Koplopers regarding independent client support for informal carers, discuss them with Mezzo among others, and disseminate these examples.

Ik zal Movisie vragen om goede voorbeelden te identificeren bij de Koplopers met betrekking tot onafhankelijke cliëntondersteuning voor mantelzorgers, deze onder andere te bespreken met Mezzo en deze voorbeelden te verspreiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Kwaliteit van zorg in Nederland loopt gevaar’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Health about a Rathenau Institute report warning that care quality is at risk because policy and practice lack research support, and about unclear responsibility for knowledge in municipal care policy. The State Secretary rejected any trend break in care quality, said the ministry has taken full responsibility for knowledge infrastructure, and committed to working with municipalities on a better knowledge agenda, without a concrete new step.
The department therefore has taken and continues to take its responsibility in full.
Het departement nam en neemt dus ten volle zijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Onrust in je hoofd en geen plek waar je hulp kunt krijgen’

An MP asks the minister about reports that people with acute mental health needs cannot get timely help, citing declining inpatient beds, weak ambulatory capacity, and gaps in acute care. The minister says ambulantisation is proceeding but too slowly, points to new agreements with insurers and providers under NZa supervision, and argues acute care supply is secured by the insurers' statutory duty of care rather than a legal guarantee.

I have therefore made further agreements on this with health insurers and care providers in the Waiting Times Approach for mental health care, which should lead insurers to finance good plans from mental health providers.

Ik heb dan ook nadere afspraken hierover gemaakt met zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders in de Aanpak wachttijden ggz die ertoe moeten leiden dat zorgverzekeraars goede plannen van ggz-aanbieders zullen financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Özdil over het bericht 'Een groeiend aantal basisartsen moet wachten op een vervolgopleiding'

GroenLinks MPs Ellemeet and Özdil asked the ministers of Health and Education about reports that a growing number of newly graduated basic doctors cannot obtain a specialist training place, and whether government was steering this gap. The minister answered that there is no entitlement to a vervolgopleiding, that current intake is judged sufficient for most specialties, that a Capacity Council scenario analysis is pending, and that no measures are currently planned.
In assessing what is sufficient, the projections of the Capacity Council play an important role.
Bij de beoordeling van de vraag wat voldoende is, spelen de ramingen van het Capaciteitsorgaan 3 een belangrijke rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het onderzoek dat een meerderheid van de zorgwebsites geen veilige HTTPS-verbinding heeft

An MP asked the health minister whether she accepts that care providers must secure sensitive data, whether HTTPS should be mandated for care websites as it is for government sites, whether she will engage hospitals and providers, and what further measures exist. The minister answered that HTTPS is already required under the Wbp when special personal data is processed, that care providers bear the same responsibility as government for their websites, that an action plan on patient data security addresses awareness, and that the Data Protection Authority supervises data security.
The Data Protection Authority supervises the security of personal data.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens houdt toezicht op de veiligheid van de persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht "De zorg is een goudmijn"

An MP asks the health minister about reports that care companies (zorg-BV's) pay out profits, and whether the state will investigate, tighten fines, and oversee municipal spending. The minister says she lacks an overview of profit-paying care BVs, leaves Wmo oversight to municipalities and the IGZ's existing profit-ban supervision, sees no need for new investigation or fines, and points to existing reporting.
I do not have that overview.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Özütok over het bericht 'Waarnemers: maak stembiljet verkiezingen gebruiksvriendelijker'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government about an OSCE report criticising the Dutch ballot for the March 2017 elections, including accessibility for voters with disabilities, poll worker training, assistance inside voting booths, and larger print or party logos. The Minister answered that assistance inside booths is restricted by the Electoral Act and the UN convention reservation, that a ballot-experiment bill was rejected but may be reintroduced, and that only about a quarter-threshold of accessibility criteria is unmet, with no polling station fully compliant.
I will ask the municipalities to pay more explicit attention to this rule next time when training their staff.
Ik zal de gemeenten vragen om daarbij de volgende keer nadrukkelijker aandacht te besteden aan deze regel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de internetconsultatie rondom het wetsvoorstel beroepenregulering

MP Ellemeet asked why the planned autumn 2016 internet consultation on the professional regulation bill was delayed, whether the two nursing profiles would be implemented, and what the transitional arrangements and titles for nurses would be. Minister Schippers explained the delay as due to careful sounding out of the sector, confirmed support for the nursing profiles, and deferred details on titles and transitional rules to the bill to be consulted later.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet inzake het bericht dat de NPO de zendtijd van Argos en Reporter wil halveren

MP Ellemeet asked the State Secretary for Education, Culture and Science about the reported NPO plan to halve broadcast time for Argos and Reporter, and about targets, research on investigative journalism, and budget transparency. The State Secretary confirmed the reports, affirmed the importance of investigative journalism, explained that NPO evaluates programmes on a combination of factors, and said no specific budget for investigative journalism can be isolated from the broader news and opinion budget.

It is not really possible to state explicitly what the budget development for investigative journalism has been, because this budget is often part of an overall budget in which editorial departments largely decide for themselves how it is spent.
Het is niet goed mogelijk om expliciet voor onderzoeksjournalistiek aan te geven wat de budgetontwikkeling is geweest, omdat dit budget vaak onderdeel is van een totaalbudget
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht dat zorgcentrum Vinkenoord mogelijk de deuren moet sluiten

An MP asked whether residents of care centre Vinkenoord would have adequate alternative care if the centre closed due to financial problems, and whether local initiatives could help. The state secretary answered that the care reform keeps people in the region, that local closures are situational, and that the national government supports citizen initiatives mainly through the right to challenge in the Wmo 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht dat er kritiek is op de Europese grensbewaking naar aanleiding van een nieuwe ramp met een migrantenschip

An MP asked whether the government shares UNHCR criticism that the shift from Mare Nostrum to the narrower Frontex Triton mission contributed to a deadly migrant shipwreck, and whether it will push for more humane border policing and more rescue capacity. The Minister replied that Triton is a border-control mission rather than a rescue mission, that rescue duties remain with states under international law, that the EU Mediterranean Task Force is working on a joint approach, and that the Netherlands will deploy a coast guard aircraft to Triton in April 2015.
The death of the migrants in the Mediterranean is a horrific event.
Het overlijden van de migranten op de Middellandse Zee is een afschuwelijke gebeurtenis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de intentieverklaring om misbruik van de Europa-route aan te kaarten bij de Europese Commissie

An MP asked whether the Dutch-Belgian intention declaration on the Europa-route abuse would be shared and whether the two-year-stay idea and six-month policy fit the Court of Justice ruling. The minister shared the declaration, argued the six-month rule is a reasonable policy rule consistent with case law, and said the Commission guidance does not set a minimum stay for the Europa-route.
If not, why not? Answer to 2 and 3: The cabinet is of the view that the Europa-route is an undesired and unintended outcome of the right to free movement of persons.
Zo nee, waarom niet? Antwoord 2 en 3 Het kabinet is van mening dat de Europa-route een ongewenste en onbedoelde uitkomst is van het recht op vrij verkeer van personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht dat hij gemeenten toch financieel gaat compenseren voor het leveren van noodopvang aan dakloze asielzoekers

An MP from GroenLinks asked why the government reversed its earlier decision and will now financially compensate municipalities for emergency shelter for homeless asylum seekers, following a Central Raad van Beroep ruling. The minister answers that the ruling obliges centre municipalities to provide basic shelter on request for a limited period, that compensation will be based on actual use and comparable costs, and that the funding source is not yet determined.

In a ruling of 17 December 2014, the Interim Judge of the Central Appeals Tribunal determined that centre municipalities must, on request, offer basic shelter to unlawfully residing foreign nationals.

In een uitspraak van 17 december 2014 heeft de Voorzieningenrechter van de Centrale Raad van Beroep bepaald dat centrumgemeenten desgevraagd sobere opvang moeten bieden aan niet-rechtmatig verblijvende vreemdelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het niet langer opvangen van gezinnen met Nederlandse kinderen in gezinsopvang locaties

An MP asked whether families with Dutch children were being excluded from family reception locations and whether this was a policy change. The State Secretary answered that Dutch children may still be housed in such locations in individual cases, that no policy change has occurred, and that such housing is a choice of the parents.
No changes have taken place with respect to this policy.
Ten aanzien van dit beleid hebben geen wijzigingen plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht ‘Zorgverzekeraars berispen dissident'

Questioner Ellemeet (GroenLinks) asks whether the health minister will object to the sector association Zorgverzekeraars Nederland rebuking insurer DSW for criticising the market power of large insurers, and how critical voices are heard. The minister declines to judge the internal matter, says individual insurers may hold differing views and that market power is for the NZa and ACM to assess, and offers ongoing talks with insurers.
I regard the correspondence as an internal matter between the association ZN and one of its members and therefore have no opinion on it.
Ik zie de briefwisseling als een interne aangelegenheid tussen de vereniging ZN en één van haar leden en heb daar derhalve geen oordeel over.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ellemeet en Bruins Slot over de vergoeding van niet-gecontracteerde zorg in academische ziekenhuizen

MPs Ellemeet and Bruins Slot asked the Minister of Health whether there is an overview of treatments at academic hospitals that are always reimbursed even when the hospital is not contracted, and how insured persons can know in advance what is covered. The Minister declined to publish a full overview, pointing to insurers' duty of care (zorgplicht) and their obligation to publish contracted providers, and explained that disputes go to the insurer, the SKGZ or the civil court.
Such an overview for all treatments and all insurers is impossible to provide in this way.
Een dusdanig overzicht voor alle behandelingen en voor alle verzekeraars is onmogelijk om zo te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over communicatie van de Sociale Verzekeringsbank inzake pgb-overeenkomsten richting gemeenten

An MP asked the state secretary about delays by the Sociale Verzekeringsbank in confirming personal budget holders' care contracts, unreachable phone lines, and the list of unconfirmed contracts sent to municipalities. The secretary acknowledged the delays, said reminder letters crossed with submitted documents, described the phone capacity fix, and announced measures to ensure timely payments in January.
In my letter of 20 January I informed you of measures prepared to make timely payment of care providers possible.
In mijn brief van 20 januari jl. heb ik u geïnformeerd over maatregelen die zijn voorbereid om het tijdig uitbetalen van zorgverleners mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over de onrust onder budgethouders over uitbetaling van het persoonsgebonden budget (pgb)

Green Left MP Ellemeet asked the state secretary about unrest among personal budget (pgb) holders over payment delays and SVB administration problems, including unreachability and missing contracts. The state secretary answered that controls were postponed to keep care payments on time, that about 50,000 budget holders are covered, that 43,000 received provisional allocations, and that controls will follow within three months.
I aim to have these controls carried out afterwards, within three months at the latest.
Ik streef er naar om deze controles uiterlijk binnen 3 maanden alsnog uit te laten voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht dat Feda Amiri na 18 jaar in Nederland alsnog is uitgezet naar Afghanistan

An MP asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the deportation of Feda Amiri to Afghanistan after eighteen years in the Netherlands, including the use of article 1F of the Refugee Convention and reliance on a 2000 country report on the Afghan security services. The State Secretary answered that individual cases are not discussed, that persons excluded under article 1F are not refugees, that no policy change or new research on the security services is planned.
It is known to your House that I consider it undesirable to provide information about individual foreign nationals.
Het is uw Kamer bekend dat ik het onwenselijk acht informatie te verstrekken over individuele vreemdelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ellemeet over het bericht dat mensen met een budgetpolis volgend jaar niet terecht kunnen bij academische ziekenhuizen

An MP asked whether budget health insurance holders would be excluded from academic hospitals and whether insurers' duty of care and transparency obligations apply. The minister replied that insurers must cover necessary care at academic hospitals even for budget policyholders, that the duty of care already covers this, and that insurers must provide transparent information under existing rules.
If people need care that can only be provided by an academic hospital, this must be provided for and will be fully reimbursed.
Als mensen zorg nodig hebben die alleen door een academisch ziekenhuis verleend kan worden, moet hierin worden voorzien en wordt deze volledig vergoed.

m: Motie Heijnen c.s. over een evaluatie in 2013
Asks the government, with the new Zuidwest-Friesland municipality and the province, to evaluate that municipality's functioning in 2013 and report to the House.
requests the government to evaluate the functioning of this municipality in 2013 with the new municipality and the province and report to the House
verzoekt de regering om in 2013 in overleg met de nieuw te vormen gemeente en de provincie Friesland het functioneren van deze gemeente te evalueren en hierover aan de Kamer te rapporteren
Amendement van het lid Bilder c.s. over het aanbrengen van een grenscorrectie tussen de gemeente Bergen en de nieuwe gemeente Venlo
Amendment adding a municipal boundary correction between Bergen and the new municipality of Venlo, departing from the usual Arhi procedure.
This amendment aims to make a boundary correction between the municipality of Bergen and the new municipality of Venlo.
Dit amendement beoogt een grenscorrectie aan te brengen tussen de gemeente Bergen en de nieuwe gemeente Venlo.
Motie Bilder c.s. over differentiatie tussen gemeenten naar takenpakket
Asks the government to include cooperation models as alternatives to municipal mergers and to propose amending the Municipalities Act to allow task differentiation among municipalities.
requests the government to make proposals to amend the Municipalities Act to allow differentiation between municipalities by task package
verzoekt de regering voorts voorstellen te doen tot wijziging van de Gemeentewet om differentiatie tussen gemeenten naar takenpakket mogelijk te maken
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Heijnen c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 18 om middelen t.b.v. opkomstbevordering bij verkiezingen voor een deel in te zetten via politieke partijen
Shifts budget from interadministrative supervision costs to funding political parties for voter turnout promotion within the budget for the Interior Ministry.
the reduction of unnecessary interadministrative administrative burdens, partly achieved by reducing the costs of interadministrative supervision
de vermindering van overbodige interbestuurlijke administratieve lasten die onder andere behaald gaat worden door het terugbrengen de kosten voor interbestuurlijk toezicht
Motie van het lid Van der Burg c.s. over maximaal twee bestuurlijke niveaus die zich met bepaalde beleidsterreinen bezighouden
Asks the government to develop initiatives so that at most two administrative layers handle particular policy fields.
at most two administrative levels deal with certain policy fields
maximaal twee bestuurlijke niveaus zich met bepaalde beleidsterreinen bezighouden
Amendement van het lid Bilder c.s. om middelen toerusting (kandidaad-)gemeenteraadsleden in te zetten via politieke partijen en hun scholingsinstituten
Moves 400 thousand euro within the interior ministry budget so councillor training runs through political parties and their training institutes.
This amendment therefore aims to use the funds for training (candidate) councillors through political parties and their training institutes
Daarom beoogt dit amendement de middelen voor toerusting van (kandidaat-)gemeenteraadsleden in te zetten via politieke partijen en hun scholingsinstituten.
Motie Kuiken c.s. over het wegnemen van beperkingen voor realistische oefeningen van de brandweer
Asks the government to investigate legal and insurance restrictions hindering realistic fire brigade exercises and how to remove them.
calls on the government to investigate to what extent the fire service is hindered by legal and insurance restrictions
roept de regering op te onderzoeken in hoeverre de brandweer op dit moment door wettelijke en verzekeringstechnische beperkingen gehinderd wordt
Amendement van het lid Heijnen c.s. om middelen t.b.v. opkomstbevordering bij verkiezingen voor een deel in te zetten via politieke partijen
Shifts part of the funding for turnout promotion at elections to be channelled through political parties.
This amendment therefore aims to use part of the funds for turnout promotion via political parties.
Dit amendement beoogt daarom de middelen voor opkomstbevordering voor een deel in te zetten via politieke partijen.
qa: Vragen van het lid Bilder (CDA) aan de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeer over berekeningen die worden gebruikt bij de risicobepaling van LPG-stations (ingezonden 22 april 2010).

An MP from the CDA asked the housing and environment minister whether she knew of an advisory council's claim that the risk calculations for LPG stations are wrong, whether the council had contacted the ministry, and what action would follow. The minister said omwonenden do not appear to face more danger than assumed, promised a position within three months after the council's response, and said no action is planned yet.
Once I have carefully studied the AGS report and received an assessment from the RIVM Centre for External Safety, I will draw my conclusions.
Zodra ik het rapport van de AGS zorgvuldig heb bestudeerd en een oordeel daarover van het Centrum Externe Veiligheid van het RIVM heb ontvangen, zal ik mijn conclusies trekken.

m: Motie Van Velzen/Azough over de wenselijkheid van terugtrekking van Amerikaanse kernwapens uit Europa
Asks the government to tell the US that it should consider withdrawing American nuclear weapons from Europe.
to consider the withdrawal of these nuclear weapons desirable.
terugtrekking van deze kernwapens wenselijk te achten
Motie Van Velzen/Azough over openheid over de aanwezigheid van kernwapens in lidstaten van de NAVO
Asks the government to press NATO to allow openness about whether nuclear weapons are present in NATO member states.
requests the government to press NATO that openness can be given about the presence of nuclear weapons in NATO member states
verzoekt de regering er bij de NAVO op aan te dringen dat openheid kan worden gegeven over de aanwezigheid van kernwapens in lidstaten van de NAVO
Motie Van Velzen/Azough over niet langer uitvoeren van de kernwapentaak
Asks the government to tell NATO that the Netherlands no longer attaches value to the nuclear weapons task and will no longer carry it.
requests the government to state within NATO that the Netherlands no longer attaches value to this nuclear weapons task
verzoekt de regering in NAVO-verband in te brengen dat Nederland niet langer waarde hecht aan deze kernwapentaak
Motie Azough over een onafhankelijke commissie van toezicht op de IND

qa: Vragen van het lid Azough (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Justitie over uitzettingen naar Irak (ingezonden 16 juni 2010).

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Justice about a group deportation of 35 former asylum seekers to Iraq on 30 March 2010, alleged detention and mistreatment in Baghdad, continued deportations to Iraq, and whether they should be suspended pending clarity and the ECtHR case. The Minister answered that the Commission (CITT) found the handover correct and no verifiable irregularities, that no suspension is warranted, and that the general situation in Iraq does not in itself violate article 3 ECHR.
The CITT confirmed that the handover of this group to the Iraqi authorities at Baghdad airport proceeded correctly.
De CITT heeft bevestigd dat de overdracht van deze groep aan de Iraakse autoriteiten op de luchthaven van Bagdad correct is verlopen.
Vragen van het lid Azough (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Justitie over staatloze Roma (ingezonden 22 april 2010).

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether around a thousand stateless Roma face serious problems, whether the 'buitenschuld' residence permit policy should apply to them, whether fundamental rights and care entitlements should be guaranteed to stateless persons, and what measures will prevent them ending up in an impossible situation. The minister denied the described picture, said the buitenschuld policy usually does not apply to Roma who can return to a country of origin, and stated that existing policy offers sufficient safeguards.
The existing policy, including the aforementioned buitenschuld policy, offers sufficient safeguards.
Het bestaande beleid, waaronder het eerdergenoemde buitenschuldbeleid, biedt voldoende waarborgen.
