An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about the crisis in maternity care (kraamzorg), including staff shortages, unmet demand, low wages and wait-duty pay, and whether market reforms are to blame. The Minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to a joint sector vision and acceleration agenda, transformation funds of EUR 9.8 million, an NZa review of insurers' duty of care, and a planned exploration of measures, while rejecting market liberalisation as the sole cause and leaving wages largely to the sector and collective bargaining.
In addition, I am currently exploring, as promised, additional measures needed to safeguard the accessibility of maternity care.
Daarnaast ben ik momenteel, zoals toegezegd 4 , bezig met het verkennen van aanvullende maatregelen die nodig zijn om de toegankelijkheid van kraamzorg te kunnen waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de uitvoering van de motie Dijk en Dobbe over maatregelen om de kraamzorg in Nederland te behouden

An SP MP asked the Health Minister whether a consultation on implementing the Dijk/Dobbe motion on keeping maternity care in the Netherlands was held and why the initiators of the union manifesto were not invited. The minister confirmed a meeting with maternity care workers organised with partner bodies, said it was one of several conversations, and agreed to talk with the initiators.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over het bericht dat 4 op de 10 mensen met een lichamelijke beperking toegankelijkheidsproblemen ervaart wanneer ze gaan stemmen

MPs Dobbe and Van Nispen asked the ministers how they respond to a Zonnebloem survey finding that four in ten people with physical disabilities face accessibility problems when voting, and about checking polling station accessibility. The government acknowledges the problem, describes the Action Plan on accessible voting, notes that 68% of polling stations certified as accessible failed some criteria in the 2024 sample, and lists short- and long-term measures, with the Kiesraad taking over accessibility checks from the 2026 municipal elections.
The Ministry of the Interior subsidises the Stichting Prokkel so that people with a mild intellectual disability can work at a polling station under supervision.

Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties geeft subsidie aan de Stichting Prokkel om mensen met een licht verstandelijke beperking onder begeleiding te laten meewerken bij een stembureau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Krul over de uitvoering van de motie Dobbe/Krul over zich ervoor inzetten om de onlineverkoop van vapes te stoppen

Two MPs asked the state secretary why the July 2025 letter on the Dobbe/Krul motion against online vape sales did not address restricting payment and delivery options, and what will be done to stop companies offering them. The state secretary admitted payment and delivery restrictions were not specifically named, pointed to an NVWA arrangement with a delivery firm and a forthcoming action plan with an update due mid-2026, and said answers could not be ready in time for the debate.
Restricting payment and delivery options was indeed not specifically mentioned, but this will be taken into account.
Het beperken van betalings- en bezorgingsmogelijkheden is inderdaad niet specifiek genoemd, maar dit wordt meegenomen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Dobbe over het artikel 'De schade van Schoof, Nederlands geld voor bijna 3.200 ontwikkelingsprojecten stopt dit jaar'

MPs Hirsch and Dobbe asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about an Investico report that about 3,200 development projects face funding cuts after the Versterking Maatschappelijk Middenveld framework ends in December 2025, including child labour projects and delays in access to the new Focus framework. The State Secretary rejects the claim that projects are being stopped, says the new framework starts in the first half of 2026 with EUR 600 million available, and states no extension with extra budget will be provided, while noting the government will not implement a motion for a transitional scheme.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Dobbe over de kansen en risico’s van het gebruik van AI in de zorg

Two SP MPs asked the health minister about the risks of AI in healthcare, including reports of clinicians losing skills (deskilling) and whether AI could replace one radiologist in breast cancer screening. The minister acknowledges both opportunities and risks, points to training, inspectorate oversight and AI-literacy duties, and says AI in breast screening is being prepared for use around 2028 with no change to recall intervals.
Healthcare institutions are themselves responsible for choosing and safely deploying AI applications within their organisation.
Zorginstellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de keuze voor en veilige inzet van AI toepassingen binnen hun organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het niet naleven van sancties tegen Rusland door Nederlandse internetproviders

Dobbe (SP) asked whether the government knew Dutch internet providers were not complying with EU sanctions against Russian propaganda media, and what it would do about low compliance and the lack of parliamentary insight into enforcement. The minister answered that non-compliance was known, that the matter is for the Public Prosecution Service, that the government is in ongoing talks with the European Commission on clarifying the ban, that it does not discuss individual cases for privacy and investigation reasons, and that over 50 criminal investigations have been started.
The cabinet does not address individual cases for reasons of privacy, the interest of (criminal) investigation, and because establishing possible violations is ultimately a matter for the court.

Het kabinet gaat niet in op individuele gevallen om redenen van privacy, in het belang van (strafrechtelijk) onderzoek en omdat het vaststellen van mogelijke overtredingen uiteindelijk aan de rechter is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over dat Israël humanitaire hulp Gaza verder gaat beperken met registratiesysteem

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about Israel's new INGO registration system that could restrict humanitarian aid in Gaza, including grounds for refusal, collection of staff personal data, and what the Netherlands will do. The government answered that it shares serious concerns, has raised the issue bilaterally and with partners, considers the personal-data demands likely in breach of the GDPR, rejects a unilateral arms embargo, and outlines limited sanctions and medical evacuation measures.

The cabinet is not in favour of an arms embargo, partly because it wishes to continue allowing exports of components for purely defensive systems that do not affect Gaza or the West Bank, in line with the Kahraman motion, as long as such transactions pass the regular EU arms export criteria test.

Het kabinet is geen voorstander van een wapenembargo, mede omdat het kabinet de uitvoer van onderdelen voor systemen met een puur defensieve werking, die niet raakt aan de situatie in de Gazastrook of op de Westelijke Jordaanoever, conform de motie Kahraman (motie 21 501-02, nr. 3170 ) wil blijven toestaan zolang dergelijke transacties de reguliere toets aan de Europese wapenexportcriteria doorstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de Nederlandse en Europese inzet m.b.t. de burgeroorlog en humanitaire catastrofe Soedan

Dobbe (SP) asks the Foreign Minister about Dutch and EU action on the war and humanitarian catastrophe in Sudan, including siege of El Fasher, Colombian mercenaries and UAE links, and possible sanctions or arms embargo. The minister answers that the Netherlands pushes diplomacy, humanitarian funding and EU measures, but cannot confirm reports about mercenaries or UAE involvement and sees no need for an arms embargo on the UAE.
An arms embargo on the UAE is not an option.
Een wapenembargo op de VAE is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht ‘Achterhoekse ouderenzorg gaat op de schop: dit is wat er gaat veranderen’

Dobbe (SP) asked the state secretary for health how care for elderly people in the Achterhoek would be affected by plans for clustered 'zorgbuurten', including whether conditions like training or moving house could be imposed and whether cost cutting drives the plans. The state secretary said all eligible elderly must get care including in rural areas, that training and moving must never be conditions, and that the plans stem from local cooperation with no cuts figures known, while staff shortages are acknowledged as a factor.
I have no insight into any possible cuts intended with the plans described in the news report.
Ik heb geen zicht op eventuele bezuinigingen die beoogd zijn met de in het nieuwsbericht beschreven plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de Freedom Flotilla actie en de bescherming van Nederlandse burgers

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the Freedom Flotilla's attempt to break Israel's blockade of Gaza, Dutch citizens aboard, possible Israeli interception, and consular assistance. The minister said the government shares humanitarian concerns, argues that professional aid organisations need land access, notes the flotilla's aid is largely symbolic, and reports having warned Israel and informed it of Dutch nationals aboard without committing to further concrete action.
At this moment there is insufficient information about the interception of the ship to reach a definitive judgement.
Op dit moment is onvoldoende bekend over de onderschepping van het schip om tot een definitief oordeel te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het gebrek aan verbetering van de positie van mensen met fibromyalgie

An MP asks why fibromyalgia patients have seen little improvement despite parliamentary motions and the Health Council advice. The minister responds that the motions were executed, the Zorginstituut found insufficient evidence for physiotherapy coverage, research prioritisation and clinical guidelines lie with professional bodies, and lists ongoing guideline work and a SZW protocol for hard-to-objectify conditions.
In the autumn, the Minister of SZW will inform the House about the actions taken to implement the motion.
In het najaar informeert de Minister van SZW de Kamer over de acties ter uitvoering van de motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over bericht dat er plannen zijn voor militaire inzet in Oekraïne

MP Dobbe asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reports of detailed plans for military deployment in Ukraine, including NATO involvement, conditions, UN mandate, parliamentary consent and exit strategy. The government confirmed Dutch participation in military planning via the Coalition of the Willing, said any deployment is conditional and subject to parliamentary information under Article 100 of the Constitution, and declined to commit to prior parliamentary consent.
Once there is agreement between the parties on ending hostilities and implementation comes into view, your House will be informed in accordance with Article 100 of the Constitution.

Op het moment dat er sprake is van overeenstemming tussen de partijen over een beëindiging van vijandelijkheden en tenuitvoerlegging in zicht komt, zal uw Kamer conform artikel 100 van de Grondwet worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het rapport van het WODC over huwelijksdwang, achterlating en vrouwelijke genitale verminking

MP Dobbe asked the government about the WODC report 'Over Grenzen' on preventive protection orders for forced marriage, abandonment and FGM, including whether it will adopt the report's recommendations, criminalise glorification of FGM, and exempt reconstructive surgery from the deductible. The State Secretary says the report will be answered in a policy response later this year, that glorification and incitement of FGM are already partly punishable with an implementing bill pending, and that a research extension exempting reconstructive surgery from the deductible is underway until 2027.
In this policy response all conclusions and recommendations will be addressed in more detail.
In deze beleidsreactie zal op alle conclusies en aanbevelingen nader worden ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Dobbe over het bericht ‘Ouderen onnodige lang in het ziekenhuis’

MPs Dijk and Dobbe (SP) asked the health minister about a report that elderly patients stay in hospital unnecessarily long, and about related staffing, funding and care-organisation issues. The ministers answered that they are working with partners on primary care, care coordination, short-term care and a national framework for nursing-home admission, while denying that bureaucratic or financial barriers are the main cause and rejecting a reversal of Wlz budget cuts.
It is important that elderly people receive appropriate care and that a (too long) stay in hospital is prevented.
Het is belangrijk dat ouderen passende zorg ontvangen en dat een (te lang) verblijf in het ziekenhuis voorkomen wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over het belang van verslavingsartsen en de resultaten van een enquête hierover

SP MPs Dobbe and Van Nispen asked the health minister about a VVGN survey showing addiction doctors want the two-year training extended by one year with interdisciplinary placement, and whether that is needed. The minister acknowledges the signals, will ask the CGS for its view on necessity, and says extension would require NZa recalculation of funding if deemed necessary for starting competence.
That is why I will also ask the College Geneeskundige Specialismen (CGS) of the KNMG to give its view on this necessity in the short term.
Daarom zal ik ook het College Geneeskundige Specialismen (CGS) van de KNMG op korte termijn verzoeken om zijn visie te geven op deze noodzakelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht ‘Anna (14) blijft altijd als baby, toch krijgt ze plots veel minder zorg: vader Jonas vreest zijn baan te moeten opzeggen’

MP Dobbe (SP) asks why about half of recent extension requests for additional home care (meerzorg) are refused, what this means for families, and whether regional differences are acceptable. The State Secretary acknowledges the hardship, cites a small sample showing refusals, says no national refusal figures are available yet, and commits to clearer, more uniform rules with care offices and the Zorginstituut.
Currently I do not have national figures on the percentage of refusals of additional care requests in the home situation.
Momenteel beschik ik niet over landelijke cijfers over het percentage afwijzingen voor meerzorg-aanvragen in de thuissituatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat de kraamzorg in Nederland onder druk staat

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the Health Minister how she would respond to reports that maternity care is under pressure, citing workload, working conditions and pay for maternity carers, and shortages leaving families without the care they need. Minister Tieman answered that staffing shortages are a sector-wide problem, pointed to the joint vision, convenant and acceleration agenda of insurers and providers, said the IGJ has no direct evidence that shortages cause incorrect care, and committed to monitoring developments and looking seriously at any obstacles the parties encounter.
I will continue to follow the progress of the measures taken.
Ik blijf de voortgang van de genomen maatregelen volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over doorvoer van wapenonderdelen naar Israël via de Rotterdamse haven

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about F-35 component shipments to Israel via the Rotterdam port, including whether exports had been stopped since the 2024 court ruling, the discrepancy between Maersk and Rotterdam's statements, and whether licences to Israel would be revoked. The government answered that exports were halted after the court ruling, that transit without transshipment is only notifiable, that three licences were revoked in July 2025 due to changed security risks, and that it sees no need for an EU or national arms embargo.
That is why the three licences were revoked at the end of July 2025.
Daarom zijn de drie vergunningen eind juli 2025 ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Dobbe over het artikel 'Nederland levert militair materieel aan dubieuze regimes'

MPs Hirsch and Dobbe asked the government about arms exports to regimes with human rights concerns, including Egypt, the IOB evaluation, the Aachen treaty and the 2023 lifting of national restrictions on Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Turkey. The minister answered that export licences are assessed against the EU Common Position criteria, that a clear risk leads to refusal, and that the 2023 changes aimed at European defence cooperation without weakening the criteria.
It follows from the EUGS that where a clear risk of such use is identified, a licence application must be refused.
Uit het EUGS vloeit voort dat, daar waar een duidelijk risico op dergelijk gebruik wordt vastgesteld, een vergunningaanvraag dient te worden afgewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over The Hague Group

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the newly formed The Hague Group of Global South states, Dutch engagement with it, US sanctions on UN rapporteur Albanese, and whether the Netherlands would arrest Netanyahu. The minister answered that the Netherlands was informed in January 2025, has not been formally invited to join, and will comply with ICC arrest obligations while regretting other European states' refusals.
The Netherlands is obliged, both under the Rome Statute and the Dutch ICC Implementation Act, to process a request for arrest and surrender.
Nederland is, zowel op basis van het Statuut van Rome als de Uitvoeringswet Internationaal Strafhof, verplicht om een verzoek tot aanhouding en overlevering in behandeling te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Dobbe, Teunissen en Piri over het bericht 'Nederland schrapt marineleveringen aan Israël, 'risico op ongewenst eindgebruik’

MPs Dassen, Piri, Dobbe and Teunissen asked the Foreign Minister about the withdrawal of three export licences for naval parts to Israel and related licensing and reporting questions. The government answered that the licences were revoked because the transactions no longer passed EU arms-export review given the risk of use in Gaza, while providing lists of remaining and refused licences and acknowledging some reporting delays.
The government will provide the relevant licences with a short explanation of the revocation.
Het kabinet zal de betreffende vergunningen voorzien van een korte toelichting op de intrekking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat Oekraïne wapenexporteur wil worden.

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reports that Ukraine wants to become a weapons exporter, the risks of human rights violations, possible Dutch investments in Ukrainian arms production, and whether the export criteria should now apply. The minister answered that export policy is a national competence, that the Dutch MoU covers only purchases for the Ukrainian armed forces with use and transfer restrictions, and that Dutch export criteria and weapons treaties still apply.
Arms export policy is a national competence.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het behoud van ziekenhuiszorg in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen

The SP MP Dobbe asked whether the minister's earlier answers mean that the hospitals in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen will keep full IC, SEH and acute obstetric care and that their plans will not reduce care, and what the hospitals' restructuring plans mean for the Terneuzen daughter centre. The minister answers that no decisions have been taken, that the hospitals must communicate transparently after consultation, and that national politics does not decide which care a hospital offers.
As also indicated in earlier letters, national politics is not about which care a hospital offers.
Zoals ook in eerdere brieven 2 3 is aangegeven, gaat de landelijke politiek niet over welke zorg een ziekenhuis aanbiedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht ‘Ondanks crisisjaar bij ZorgSaam werd top organisatie maximaal beloond’

An SP MP asked the health minister how bonuses and severance pay for former ZorgSaam board members could be maximal while care in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen was being scaled back. The minister answered that the board pay is set under the WNT norms, that pay stopped after the 2024 departures, and that no care is being cut.
The remuneration of these board members stopped after their departure in 2024.
De bezoldiging van deze bestuurders is na hun vertrek in 2024 gestopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over militaire oefeningen met bekabelde drones in Natura 2000-gebieden

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister whether military exercises with fibre-optic-controlled drones take place in Natura 2000 areas, what environmental damage and cleanup arrangements apply, and whether Defence will ensure gentle treatment of nature. The State Secretary answered that Defence does not currently possess fibre-optic drones and has not exercised with them in Natura 2000 areas, that environmental effects are considered in procurement and cleanup rules exist, and that Defence balances military use with nature conservation.
No, Defence currently does not possess fibre-optic controlled drones and has not exercised with them in Natura 2000 areas.
Nee, Defensie beschikt op dit moment niet over glasvezel aangestuurde (ook wel fiber optic ) drones en heeft hier niet mee geoefend in Natura 2000-gebieden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Paternotte, Boswijk, Dassen, Dobbe en Teunissen over het artikel 'Europese Unie stelt in gelekt rapport zèlf oorlogsmisdaden in Gaza vast, toch blijft het stil over sancties tegen Is

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about a leaked EU report on alleged war crimes in Gaza and the lack of sanctions against Israel. The minister answered that the report does not itself draw the conclusions, but the government considers bombing civilian objects and starvation as methods of warfare violations of humanitarian law, has initiated an evaluation of Israel's compliance with Article 2 of the Association Agreement, and supports suspending the trade part of the agreement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat de EU Israëls grootste investeerder is

MP Dobbe asks the Foreign Minister about reports that the EU is Israel's largest investor, whether EU and Dutch economic leverage and export trends undermine pressure on Israel over Gaza and the occupation, and whether the EU-Israel association agreement should be suspended, Dutch firms barred from economic activity in occupied territory, and a full arms embargo imposed. The minister confirms Eurostat figures showing EU investment of 72.1 billion euro, notes Dutch investment is largely routed through multinationals and shell entities, describes existing pressure and dialogue efforts, commits to suspending the trade part of the association agreement at EU level and to expanding the discouragement policy, but declines a full arms embargo, citing existing export controls.
At EU level the Netherlands is working towards suspending the trade part of the Association Agreement with Israel.
Op EU-niveau zet Nederland zich in voor opschorting van het handelsdeel van het Associatieakkoord met Israël
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht ‘EU-ministers nemen geen maatregelen tegen Israël, houden opties op tafel’

MPs asked the Foreign Minister what the Netherlands pushed for at the 15 July EU Foreign Affairs Council on Israel, whether it proposed sanctions, what concrete humanitarian aid commitments were agreed with Israel, and what action follows if Israel fails to comply. The minister answered that the Netherlands backed implementation of the EU-Israel humanitarian access deal, announced national measures (ambassador summoned, two ministers declared persona non grata, support for trade measures and a third sanctions package), and listed the agreed access commitments, though the answer on the source of the truck figures was vague and did not address military operations.
As announced in the letter to the House of 28 July, the cabinet has decided to proceed to concrete measures.
Zoals aangekondigd in de Kamerbrief van 28 juli jl. heeft het kabinet besloten over te gaan tot concrete maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het aangevraagde CAVV-advies inzake de verplichting van het voorkomen van genocide

An SP MP asked whether the government had received the CAVV advice on third states' duty to prevent genocide and, if so, whether it would send it to parliament within two weeks. The minister confirmed receipt on 4 August and said the advice is being studied, with a reply to follow as soon as reasonably possible.
The cabinet will send this CAVV advice to the House together with a cabinet response.
Het kabinet stuurt dit CAVV advies tezamen met een kabinetsreactie aan de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de kabinetsbrief afspraken met Israël over verantwoording over de situatie in Gaza

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the Foreign Minister how and when the government will act on suspending the trade part of the EU-Israel Association Agreement, why it ties this to the humanitarian access deal, and about summoning the Israeli ambassador, sanctions on individuals, humanitarian funding, the ban on settlement trade and medical evacuations from Gaza. The minister answered that the Netherlands will keep lobbying in Brussels for suspension, that the humanitarian deal was a step in the right direction, that the ambassador was summoned on 29 July, and that settlement trade measures are better taken at EU level, while committing to explore medical evacuation support.
The cabinet will continue to press for this in the appropriate Brussels forums and in bilateral contacts with other EU member states.
Het kabinet zal zich hiervoor blijven inzetten in de daarvoor geëigende Brusselse gremia en in bilaterale contacten met andere EU-lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe, Piri, Teunissen, Van Baarle, Paternotte en Dassen over het Nederlandse busbedrijf EBS en banden met de illegale bezetting van de Palestijnse Gebieden

MPs asked the government about Dutch bus operator EBS, owned by Israel's Egged Transportation, which the UN lists in connection with settlements, and whether Dutch public money paid through student travel products and provincial concessions amounts to assistance to the occupation. The government confirmed the facts, restated its discouragement policy on economic ties with settlement businesses, said it has no insight into the financial flows between EBS and Egged, and declined to take concrete steps beyond encouraging decentralised authorities to follow the policy.
The cabinet has no insight into the business relationship and financial flows between EBS and Egged Transportation Ltd. and therefore cannot make statements about them.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op de zakelijke verhouding en financiële stromen tussen EBS en Egged Transportation Ltd. en kan hier dus geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over het bericht dat chronisch zieken worden opgejaagd door vooringenomen controles van de Belastingdienst

Opposition MPs Dobbe and Dijk asked whether Tax Authority checks on deductions for specific healthcare costs profile chronically ill people with low incomes as high-risk, and how many people must repay amounts wrongly claimed. The State Secretary answered that checks target errors rather than fraud, that the authority does not profile on chronic illness, and that a simplification review of the regulation is underway.
Because of the importance for supervision, I cannot say exactly how the automated selection instruments work.
Vanwege het belang voor het toezicht kan ik niet precies zeggen hoe de geautomatiseerde selectie-instrumenten werken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het dreigende verlies van zorgaanbod in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen

An SP MP asked the health minister how she will respond to signals that Zeeuws-Vlaanderen may lose hospital care, whether it is acceptable for emergency and acute obstetric care to disappear, and how local voices are included. The minister answers that she is in contact with the hospitals, that 24/7 acute care will not disappear under the planned cooperation, that stakeholders will be involved later, and that she is preparing regulation and a handreiking on changes to regional care.
My aim is to start the public consultation on this legislation in September 2025.
Mijn inzet is erop gericht om de consultatie van deze wetgeving in september 2025 te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Dobbe over het bericht dat de tweelingbroer van de staatsecretaris van Defensie directeur wordt van een drone-bedrijf

SP MPs asked the Defence minister whether the Defence state secretary's twin brother taking a job at a drone company, while the army invests millions in drones, creates a conflict of interest, and what safeguards exist. The minister answered that the appointment was known within Defence, cited existing post-employment and integrity rules, and promised the state secretary would be cautious in direct contacts with AI Armaments.

Furthermore, the State Secretary will be restrained in direct contacts with AI Armaments, and specific communication about and/or specific cooperation with AI Armaments falls under the responsibility of the Minister.

Verder geldt dat de Staatssecretaris terughoudend zal zijn in directe contacten met AI Armaments en dat specifieke communicatie over en/of specifieke samenwerking met AI Armaments onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de Minister valt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de bouw van 22 nieuwe Israëlische nederzettingen op illegaal bezet Palestijns land

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the Foreign Minister about the Israeli approval of 22 new West Bank settlements, Israeli statements about preventing a Palestinian state, the ICJ advisory opinion, and possible sanctions, trade halts and recognition of Palestine. The minister condemned the approval and the statements, said the Dutch position on settlements is unchanged, described existing discouragement policy and EU-level efforts, and declined to commit to recognition or a full trade ban, citing EU competence.
The cabinet continues to exert pressure on Israel, both bilaterally and within the EU, to reverse this decision and the settlement policy more broadly.
Het kabinet blijft zowel bilateraal als in EU-verband druk uitoefenen op Israël om dit besluit, en het nederzettingenbeleid in den brede, terug te draaien en stop te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de vergoeding van fysiotherapie als behandeling van endometriose

An SP MP asked why physiotherapy for endometriosis is not reimbursed under the basic health insurance package and whether it should be added. The Minister answered that effectiveness evidence is insufficient, asked the Zorginstituut to review the evidence, and declined to add physiotherapy to the basic package for now while offering to reconsider parts if shown effective.
That is why I am not willing to fully add physiotherapy to the basic package.
Daarom ben ik niet bereid om fysiotherapie alsnog volledig op te nemen in het basispakket.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Dobbe over het bericht 'Winstnorm kan niet voorkomen dat zorggeld naar Porsches en paarden gaat'

MPs Dijk and Dobbe asked the minister whether profit-making in healthcare should be legally limited, whether a total ban on profit distribution is the answer, and whether oversight and transparency of care providers should be improved. The minister rejects a blanket profit ban, points to the pending Wibz bill, a planned exploration of licensing for subcontractors and solo providers, a Wmo oversight improvement trajectory and expanded annual reporting, while promising further assessment rather than immediate new rules.
I therefore want to carry out an exploration of a licensing requirement for subcontractors and solo practitioners.
Ik wil daarom een verkenning uitvoeren naar een vergunningplicht voor onderaannemers en solisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe, Piri en Teunissen over het bericht dat het Internationaal Strafhof hard geraakt is door de sancties

MPs Dobbe, Piri and Teunissen asked the Foreign Minister whether the government's claimed effectiveness in supporting the International Criminal Court holds, given US sanctions reportedly crippling its work, and what concrete steps it has taken including EU blocking statute activation and asylum for affected staff. The minister answered that the Court continues most of its work, that Nederland is lobbying the US and EU partners and banks, but declined to detail confidential mitigation measures and deferred the EU anti-boycott decision to the Commission and Council.
To be successful, this work must take place in a confidential context, and therefore it cannot be discussed in much detail.
Om succesvol te kunnen zijn, is het noodzakelijk dat dit werk in een vertrouwelijke context plaatsvindt en daarom kan hier niet teveel over in detail worden getreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe, Teunissen en Dassen over de uitzetting van Nederlandse deelnemers aan de Mars naar Gaza

MPs from SP, PvdD and Volt asked the Foreign Minister about the Egyptian expulsion of Dutch participants in the March to Gaza, including passport confiscation, legal grounds, Israeli involvement, detention of demonstrators and consular assistance. The minister said the expulsion is a sovereign Egyptian matter, consular help was given, privacy prevents confirming detentions, and the government urges Israel to allow humanitarian aid.
Because of the privacy of those involved, I cannot say whether Dutch demonstrators have been detained.
Vanwege de privacy van betrokkenen kan ik niet mededelen of er Nederlandse demonstranten zijn vastgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de uitbuiting van buitenlandse zorgverleners

An MP asked the ministers about exploitation of foreign care workers providing 24-hour home care via personal budgets (pgb), including inspection, enforcement, and aftercare. The government answered that the Labour Inspectorate is investigating, outlined existing oversight and enforcement, and said it will consult the Inspectorate once its investigation is complete.
No statements are made about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken worden geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Dobbe en Dassen over het bericht ‘Trump wil duizenden illegalen naar Guantánamo Bay sturen, ook Nederlanders’

MPs from D66, GroenLinks-PvdA, CDA, SP and Volt asked the Foreign Minister whether the Dutch government knew of US plans to detain illegal immigrants, including Dutch nationals, at Guantánamo Bay without due process, whether it had contacted the US, whether consular assistance was given, and whether EU partners would press the US. The minister replied that the report appeared premature, that the US had no apparent plans to detain Dutch citizens there, and deferred the remaining questions to the answer to question 1 while promising a reply within the deadline.
There are also no indications that the United States intends to deport Dutch nationals via Guantánamo Bay.
Er zijn ook geen indicaties dat de Verenigde Staten voornemens is Nederlandse staatsburgers uit te zetten via Guantánamo Bay.
Antwoorden op vragen van de leden Dassen, Piri, Paternotte, Dobbe, Teunissen en Van Baarle over het gehouden rondetafelgesprek over de situatie in Gaza en bijbehorende position papers

MPs from Volt, GroenLinks-PvdA, D66, SP, PvdD and DENK asked the Foreign Minister whether there is a serious risk of genocide in Gaza, when the Dutch state became aware of it, and what concrete steps the Netherlands has taken to prevent or end it under the Genocide Convention, including on arms exports, sanctions and an EU association agreement review. The minister answered that the Netherlands is cautious about qualifying situations as genocide, that the duty to prevent arises upon knowledge of a serious risk without a court ruling, and listed diplomatic steps taken such as the EU review of Israel's association agreement, sanctions on two ministers, and the arms export policy, while declining to join the South Africa case.
The Netherlands is generally cautious about qualifying situations as genocide.
Nederland is in de regel terughoudend met het kwalificeren van situaties als genocide.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Dobbe over het bericht dat ongediplomeerd personeel in dienst is bij zorgverleners

MPs Dijk and Dobbe (SP) asked the minister about reports that unqualified staff, including agency workers, were deployed in care roles requiring diplomas, and about the role of agency Allround Care. The minister said care providers are responsible for checking staff competence, declined to create new routes for unqualified staff, and noted the IGJ lacks nationwide incident data and cannot supervise staffing agencies directly, though it has reported individuals for fraud.
The IGJ has informed me that there have been incidents and calamities due to the deployment of unauthorised and incompetent staff, but that it does not keep figures on this.
De IGJ heeft mij laten weten dat er incidenten en calamiteiten zijn geweest door het inzetten van onbevoegd en onbekwaam personeel, maar dat zij daarover geen aantallen bijhoudt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat Nederlandse militairen samen met Israëlische troepen deelgenomen hebben aan een door de VS geleide militaire oefening

An SP MP asked whether Dutch soldiers exercised alongside Israeli forces in the US-led African Lion 25 exercise, and whether defence cooperation with Israel should stop given alleged war crimes in Gaza. The minister replied that Dutch units trained in Senegal while Israeli units trained in Morocco without interaction, that defence cooperation is limited to materiel and knowledge exchange within pre-1967 borders with combat training excluded, and that the Israel status agreement is suspended in the Senate while arms export and import decisions are assessed case by case.
The cabinet has no insight into the precise manner in which the knowledge present within the Israeli defence industry is developed, as is the case for the defence industry in any country.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op de precieze wijze waarop de aanwezige kennis binnen de Israëlische defensie-industrie tot stand komt, zoals dat geldt voor de defensie-industrie in ieder land.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het burgerschip de Madleen dat met humanitaire hulp richting Gaza vaart

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the civilian ship Madleen carrying humanitarian aid toward Gaza, including threats of interception, the legality of aid blockades, and consular protection for a Dutch national aboard. The minister confirmed Israel was urged not to use force, consular assistance was given, Israel should allow sustained humanitarian access, and no further safe passage was currently possible.
The structural blocking of humanitarian aid to the suffering population of the Gaza Strip constitutes a violation of international humanitarian law.
Het structureel blokkeren van humanitaire hulp voor de noodlijdende bevolking van de Gazastrook vormt een schending van het humanitair oorlogsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over het bericht 'Na vier maanden strengere zzp-handhaving knelt het vooral nog in de zorg'

SP MPs Dobbe and Dijk asked the Minister of Health about strict enforcement against bogus self-employment in care, and about making employment in care more attractive. The minister said the Tax Authority will not impose fines on 2025 and will talk with businesses first, promised to pursue both tracks, and pointed to existing programmes on autonomy and a new workforce platform, but ruled out extra funds for pay increases.
I do not have figures on the number of self-employed workers who took up employment with care providers last year.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers over het aantal zzp'ers dat afgelopen jaar in loondienst is getreden bij zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Dobbe, Hirsch, Bamenga en Paternotte over het bericht 'Pentagon chief scraps program from first Trump term to boost women in security'

MPs asked the Dutch government whether it would press the United States and other partners to uphold UN Women, Peace and Security resolutions and related treaties after the US scrapped its own WPS programme, and what Netherlands itself will do to fund and implement them. The minister confirmed awareness, said the Netherlands raises these principles bilaterally and multilaterally, noted the US has not ratified CEDAW or the Arms Trade Treaty, and listed existing commitments including a small Syria grant and Defence gender-integration activities without committing to new funding.
The Netherlands speaks out in favour of implementing and complying with international agreements and treaties, both publicly and behind closed doors.
Nederland spreekt zich voor en achter gesloten deuren uit over het belang van implementatie en naleving van internationale afspraken en verdragen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Westerveld over de uitvoering van een aangenomen motie over landelijke regie pakken op de wijze van financiering van de jeugdzorg en beschikbaarheidsfinanciering de standaard make

MPs Dobbe and Westerveld asked how implementation of their adopted motion on national steering of youth care financing and making availability-based financing the standard is progressing, including research on which care types need it. The Secretary of State answered that standardisation of care types is underway with municipalities and providers, that availability-based financing is being researched, and that it can support stable, placement-based youth care while cost control limits its use for a fixed home.
Through the Youth Reform Agenda, I am working with municipalities and youth care providers on standardising the care types.
Vanuit de Hervormingsagenda Jeugd werk ik met gemeenten en jeugdhulpaanbieders aan het standaardiseren van de zorgvormen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Piri en Dobbe over geweld tegen hulpverleners

MPs Hirsch, Piri and Dobbe asked the government about attacks on aid workers in Sudan and Gaza, EU sanctions and trade talks with the UAE, accountability and the scope of Dutch jurisdiction under the International Crimes Act. The Minister condemns attacks on aid workers, says accountability is primarily a matter for the states concerned and international courts, and declines to commit to new sanctions, extra funding or state liability claims due to budget constraints and legal conditions.
Given the sensitive nature of such considerations and discussions at European level, I cannot make further statements on this.
Gezien de gevoelige aard van dergelijke overwegingen en besprekingen in Europees verband kan ik daar geen verdere uitlatingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over de crisis in de ouderenzorg

Two MPs from the SP asked the State Secretary for Health about the crisis in elderly care, including staff problems, rising compulsory admissions, a lack of small-scale alternatives, staff shortages and the pay gap. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing programmes and a forthcoming Hoofdlijnenakkoord Ouderenzorg, and rejected extra pay funding beyond the annual wage-cost contribution due to fiscal constraints.
I am currently in talks with parties in the sector to reach a Hoofdlijnenakkoord Ouderenzorg (HLO).
Ik ben op dit moment met partijen in de sector in gesprek om tot een Hoofdlijnenakkoord Ouderenzorg (HLO) te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht '150.000 extra hiv-doden in Afrika verwacht na stop hulp uit VS'

An SP MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that US aid cuts to PEPFAR could cause up to 150,000 extra HIV deaths in Africa, and about Dutch contacts, GFATM and UNAIDS responses and international advocacy. The minister answered that the impact is uncertain, that the Netherlands is in contact with the US and partners and offers flexibility on existing funds, but says there is no room for extra investment due to budget cuts.
In this context the Netherlands advocates a sharper focus on core tasks and a reprioritisation, and a medium-term reorganisation of the global health architecture.
Nederland pleit daarbij voor een scherpere focus op kerntaken en een herijking van prioriteiten, en voor een herinrichting van de mondiale gezondheidsarchitectuur op de middellange termijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Dobbe over de eerdere beantwoording van schriftelijke vragen over het risico op vrouwelijke genitale verminking en het aanzetten daartoe in religieuze context

MPs Becker and Dobbe asked about the effectiveness of border indicators, awareness campaigns, training and follow-up on female genital mutilation risks at Schiphol, and the status of related programmes and research. The government answered that indicators and training are in place, the Marechaussee sees no need for evaluation or stronger controls, campaigns ran with reach figures but no formal evaluation, and a comparative study on preventive protection orders is expected before summer 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de hervatte Israëlische aanvallen op Gaza

MP Dobbe asked whether Israel unilaterally violated the Gaza ceasefire, what concrete pressure the government applied, why no sanctions or suspension of the EU Association Agreement or arms export restrictions were pursued, whether starvation and collective punishment amount to war crimes, and what the government thinks of Israeli protests. The minister answered that Nederland pressed for a return to the ceasefire through diplomatic channels, requested an evaluation of Israel's compliance with Article 2 of the EU-Israel Association Agreement, withheld advisory documents on sanctions and export policy, and stated that Israel's humanitarian blockade conflicts with international humanitarian law.
Official advice on this concerns these elements and for that reason is not shared.
Adviezen hierover betreffen deze elementen en worden om die reden niet gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen, Piri, Boswijk, Teunissen, Paternotte, Dobbe en Van Baarle over het bericht 'No humanitarian aid will enter Gaza, Israel defence Minister says'

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister whether she condemns Israel's blocking of humanitarian aid to Gaza, whether this constitutes collective punishment or a war crime, whether UN Resolution 2417 is being ignored, whether Israel violates the ICJ provisional measures, and whether she will push for EU sanctions. The minister condemns the blockade as contrary to international law, notes the legal framework and Dutch diplomatic steps, and says a review of Israel's compliance with Article 2 of the EU-Israel Association Agreement has been requested, while stating that sanctions require EU unanimity.
The cabinet condemns the blocking of humanitarian aid and basic services such as electricity.
Het kabinet veroordeelt het blokkeren van humanitaire hulp en basisvoorzieningen zoals elektriciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Paternotte, Boswijk, Dobbe, Dassen, Van Baarle en Teunissen over de catastrofale humanitaire situatie in Gaza

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about the humanitarian catastrophe in Gaza, including whether Israel is starving the population, the risk of famine, the proposal for US-linked security firms to distribute aid, and what the government is doing. The minister answered that Israel's blockade violates international humanitarian law, that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged Israel to lift it and has asked the EU to review Israel's compliance with the Association Agreement, but that it cannot deliver aid by sea or air without Israeli consent.
Pending this, the Netherlands will not agree to extending the EU-Israel Action Plan.
In afwachting hiervan zal Nederland niet instemmen met verlenging van het EU-Israël Actieplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat lichamen van hulpverleners van de Palestijnse Rode Halve Maan zijn teruggevonden in een massagraf in Gaza

MP Dobbe asked the government how it responds to reports that Palestinian Red Crescent aid workers were found in a mass grave in Gaza, and what it will do about accountability and sanctions against Israel. The minister condemned the attack, said the Israeli army's own inquiry led to a reprimand and removal from post, backed calls for an international investigation, and declined to commit to measures such as suspending the EU-Israel Association Agreement.
The cabinet closely follows developments in the region and continually considers how best to respond, bilaterally or in a wider setting.
Het kabinet volgt de ontwikkelingen in de regio nauwgezet en beziet steeds hoe op de meest effectieve wijze hierop te reageren, bilateraal of in breder verband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Kent over het bericht dat bij voormalige bewoners van Rijnwijk verschillende vormen van kanker vaker dan gemiddeld voorkomen

MPs Dobbe and Van Kent asked the state secretary for health about reports of higher-than-average cancer rates among former residents of Rijnwijk in Arnhem, near a heavily polluting former industrial site, and why soil and health effects were not investigated earlier. The state secretary said the municipality of Arnhem and the GGD will first run an exploratory study, that earlier soil investigations found no health risk, and that a separate national study is not considered appropriate.
I think it is good that the municipality of Arnhem has the GGD explore what is going on.
Ik denk dat het goed is dat de gemeente Arnhem de GGD laat verkennen wat er aan de hand is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de mogelijke uitbreiding van het oefengebied van defensie op de Weerterheide

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Defence about possible expansion of a military training area onto the Weerterheide, including the impact of possible expropriation, public consultation, alternatives, and protection of nature. The government acknowledges the burden on residents, explains consultation steps and that expropriation is a last resort, but refuses to rule it out and declines to adopt the proposed safeguards.
In the interest of care and transparency, I cannot share these documents earlier.
In het kader van zorgvuldigheid en transparantie kan ik deze documenten niet eerder delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat hulp in het huishouden voor nieuwe Wmo-klanten in Den Bosch wordt teruggeschroefd naar eens per twee weken

Dobbe (SP) asked whether it is permissible for Den Bosch to cut home help for all new Wmo clients to once every two weeks without clear individual reasons, and how this fits the right to tailored support. The state secretary said the municipality is responsible for Wmo policy within legal bounds, that the municipality rations scarce hours to keep help available for those most in need, and that the state has no overview of similar measures elsewhere.
It is up to municipalities to shape Wmo policy and ensure appropriate support within the legal framework.
Het is aan gemeenten het Wmo-beleid vorm te geven en te zorgen voor passende ondersteuning binnen de kaders van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het uitbreiden van de militaire operatie in Gaza door Israël

MP Dobbe asked whether Israel's announced expansion of its military operation in Gaza is a red line for the Dutch cabinet, whether the cabinet condemns it, and what it will do. Foreign Minister Veldkamp answered that the Israeli ambassador was summoned, that the cabinet condemns statements by Israeli cabinet members on reoccupation, reaffirms that Gaza must not be reduced or reoccupied, and calls for a ceasefire, but did not specify any new concrete measure beyond diplomatic pressure.
The cabinet condemns statements by Israeli cabinet members that touch on the reoccupation of the Gaza Strip.
Het kabinet veroordeelt uitspraken van Israëlische kabinetsleden die raken aan de herbezetting van de Gazastrook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat de lagere vergoeding vanuit de zorgverzekeraars leidt tot de sluiting van hospices

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the lower reimbursement from health insurers, which is said to force hospices to close, is acceptable, and what concrete steps are being taken to keep hospices from failing. The State Secretary answered that talks with care providers, insurers and branch organisations are ongoing, that seven Bijna Thuis Huizen cases are being examined, that no hospice should close because of lower tariffs, and that further steps to improve palliative care access are planned, with a promise to inform parliament of the outcome.

I have invited care professionals, care providers, health insurers and branch organisations to sit down together to examine what exactly is happening here and to what extent this requires a targeted solution.

Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven, heb ik zorgprofessionals, zorgaanbieders, zorgverzekeraars en branches uitgenodigd om aan tafel te gaan om samen te bezien wat hier nu precies aan de hand is en in hoeverre dit een gerichte oplossing vraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat de gemeente Haarlem ouders vraagt om minder of zelfs helemaal niet meer te werken om de vraag naar jeugdzorg in te dammen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether Haarlem's request that parents work less or stop working to reduce youth care demand is acceptable, and about gender equality and financial consequences. The State Secretary answered that Haarlem does not ask parents to reduce work, only discusses their own capacity and problem-solving under a regional ordinance grounded in the Youth Act and case law, and that financial capacity cannot be weighed under the Jeugdwet.
The municipality of Haarlem does not ask parents to work less or stop working when parents have a youth care request.
De gemeente Haarlem stelt niet de vraag om minder of niet meer te werken, als ouders een jeugdhulpvraag hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de dreiging van vrouwelijke genitale verminking in Nederland

MP Dobbe (SP) asked about the scale and threat of female genital mutilation (FGM) in the Netherlands, prevention measures, UK-style protection orders, prosecution, and reimbursement of reconstructive surgery. The government answers that a new prevalence study is underway, lists current prevention measures, says additional measures are being explored, notes one prosecution but no convictions, and promises a study extending exemption from the own risk for reconstructive surgery.
The cabinet intends to take additional (preventive) measures aimed at female genital mutilation.
Het kabinet is voornemens aanvullende (preventieve) maatregelen te nemen gericht op vrouwelijke genitale verminking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Dobbe en Boswijk over het bericht 'Goudkoorts blokkeert de weg naar vrede in Sudan'

MPs Ceder, Dobbe and Boswijk asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about gold trade fuelling the Sudan conflict, arms diversion, Russian involvement, EU sanctions and humanitarian response. The ministers answered that the Netherlands shares the concerns, points to existing EU conflict-minerals and forced-labour rules, the CSDDD and arms embargoes, and says it is pushing for EU engagement, a contact group and humanitarian exemptions, without committing to new concrete measures on gold imports.
The cabinet expects Dutch companies to act in line with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises on responsible business conduct.
Het kabinet verwacht dat Nederlandse bedrijven ondernemen in lijn met de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen inzake maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat bij GGZ Veenendaal het omzetplafond van Zilveren Kruis/Achmea al in januari bereikt is

An SP MP asked the government to respond to reports that GGZ Veenendaal reached Zilveren Kruis/Achmea's revenue cap in January, leaving insured patients without access to mental health care for most of the year, and whether the government would hold the insurer to account. The State Secretary answered that insurers remain bound by the duty of care and must mediate patients to other providers, that the NZa supervises this duty, and that the government is considering broader measures to improve mental health care access, with a letter to parliament expected.
It is not for me to call an health insurer to account for its duty of care. The NZa independently supervises health insurers' duty of care.
Het is niet aan mij om een zorgverzekeraar aan te spreken op hun zorgplicht. De NZa houdt onafhankelijk toezicht op de zorgplicht van zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de beperkte toegang tot palliatieve zorg door de opstelling van de zorgverzekeraars

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about insurers' efficiency rules and turnover caps limiting access to palliative care at home, citing a nurse's complaint and a Trouw report on a patient who died in hospital. The State Secretary answered that insurer-provider agreements do not block dying at home, that the VGZ case appears to be a miscommunication, and that the Aanvullend Zorg- en Welzijnsakkoord will address communication on turnover caps.
No, that is not correct. As I explained in my letter of 14 March 2025, the agreements between health insurers and care providers do not impede the possibilities to die at home.

Nee, dat klopt niet. Zoals ik heb toegelicht in mijn brief van d.d. 14 maart 2025 vormen de afspraken tussen zorgverzekeraars en zorgaanbieders geen belemmering voor de mogelijkheden om thuis te sterven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat de helft van de jongvolwassenen hun mentale gezondheid niet goed noemt

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that half of young adults rate their mental health as not good, and about waiting lists in mental health care, school performance pressure, housing insecurity, and a budget cut to pandemic preparedness. The State Secretary notes that 51% rate their mental health good or very good, says youth mental health still needs attention, points to a first recovery in youth data, and promises a broader letter on mental health care access and a mental health work agenda before summer 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over bezoeken van De Eritrese ambassadeur voor de Europese Unie en de Benelux-landen aan Nederlandse steden

SP MPs asked whether local authorities were consulted about visits by Eritrea's ambassador to Amersfoort and Amsterdam, whether the visits constitute foreign interference, and whether the ambassador will be addressed. The government said municipalities were not informed in advance, that unlawful conduct would prompt firm action, and that Eritrean diplomats were previously expelled for coerced diaspora tax collection.
Municipalities Amersfoort and Amsterdam indicated that they were not informed in advance of the meetings and therefore they were not discussed within the local security triangle.

Gemeente Amersfoort en gemeente Amsterdam hebben aangegeven dat zij niet op voorhand op de hoogte waren van de bijeenkomsten en dat hier dus ook niet binnen de lokale veiligheidsdriehoek over is gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over een mogelijke wapenleverantie aan Israël door een schip onder Nederlandse vlag

An SP MP asked whether the Dutch-flagged vessel Nordic carried military goods from India to Israel, and what policy applies to Dutch-flagged ships transporting arms to Israel. The government confirmed the ship flies the Dutch flag, said it has no specific policy on arms transport by Dutch-flagged ships beyond sanctions, and reported very limited transit of military goods to Israel via Rotterdam, with the last transit notification in 2023.

The Netherlands has no specific policy on the transport of weapons by Dutch transport companies and/or ships sailing under the Dutch flag to or abroad, including to Israel, except where it falls under a sanctions measure.

Nederland voert geen specifiek beleid ten aanzien van het vervoer van wapens door Nederlandse transportbedrijven en/of schepen varend onder Nederlandse vlag naar of in het buitenland, dus ook niet naar Israël, behalve indien dat valt onder een sanctiemaatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over deelname aan de derde vergadering van staten die partij zijn bij het Verdrag inzake het verbod op kernwapens

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands is not sending an observer delegation to the TPNW meeting and whether NATO nuclear sharing and Volkel bases explain non-accession. The minister confirmed non-attendance, said nuclear sharing within NATO remains the reason for not joining, declined to disclose US weapon numbers or locations, and reaffirmed commitment to NPT-based disarmament.
For security reasons and under alliance agreements, no statements can be made about the numbers and locations of American nuclear weapons present in Europe.
Vanwege veiligheidsredenen en op grond van bondgenootschappelijke afspraken kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de uitspraken van Donald Trump met betrekking tot het etnisch zuiveren van Gaza

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Trump's call to permanently remove Palestinians from Gaza amounts to ethnic cleansing and whether the government will condemn it, and how it squares with the constitutional duty to advance international law. The minister answered that Gaza belongs to the Palestinians, that forced displacement is excluded under the G7 principles and international law, maintained the two-state position without recognising Palestine now, and committed to keep parliament informed on humanitarian access and reconstruction.
Are you willing, if there are signals that this is hindered in any way, to inform the House of Representatives immediately?
Bent u bereid om, bij signalen dat dit op welke manier dan ook wordt gehinderd, direct de Tweede Kamer daarover te informeren?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat gezinnen de prijs betalen voor structurele tekorten in de kraamzorg

MP Dobbe asked whether the government will respond to reports that families pay the price for structural shortages in maternity care, including rising unaffordable co-payments, and whether co-payments and on-call allowances should be changed. Minister Agema answered that the shortage is a sector-wide labour problem being addressed through an insurer-provider convenant and acceleration agenda, that co-payments are not the only reason for forgoing care, that abolishing co-payments (about 25 million euros) is not funded, and that pay for on-call shifts is a matter for social partners.
At national level no figures are available on the number of people and the exact reasons why they forgo maternity care.
Op landelijk niveau zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal mensen en de exacte reden waarom zij afzien van kraamzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de uitzending van het NOS journaal over vrouwelijke genitale verminking in Nederland

MP Dobbe asked the ministers of Health and Education about a NOS broadcast on rising female genital mutilation in the Netherlands, prevalence estimates, new research, prevention measures, school and asylum-centre information, mandatory reporting, community engagement, victim support, and the deductible for reconstructive surgery. The government answered that it is researching prevalence (results expected end 2025), examining protective orders and foreign measures, running existing campaigns and training, and studying a reporting duty and deductible exemption, mostly describing ongoing work without firm new commitments.
The cabinet considers female genital mutilation (FGM) a barbaric and unacceptable practice against which girls and women must be protected.
Het kabinet vindt vrouwelijke genitale verminking (vgv) een barbaarse en onaanvaardbare praktijk waartegen meisjes en vrouwen beschermd moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat het plaatsen van een spiraaltje bij de helft van vrouwen voor hevige pijn zorgt

MP Dobbe asked the Minister of Health about reports that half of women experience severe pain when an IUD is inserted, and whether pain relief should be offered as with minor dental procedures. The minister acknowledged the signal, said the NHG is revising its contraception guideline with priority (expected mid-2026), and stated that clinical decisions on pain management rest with clinicians.
I think it is good that the Dutch College of General Practitioners (NHG) has informed me that they are looking at options to improve GP policy on IUD insertion and pain reduction.

Daarom vind ik het goed dat het Nederlands Huisartsengenootschap (NHG) mij heeft laten weten dat zij kijken naar mogelijkheden om het beleid van de huisarts ten aanzien van spiraalplaatsing en vermindering van pijn daarbij te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Piri, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Eerdmans over het nieuws dat Russische geheim agenten met vissersschepen naar Nederland kunnen reizen

MPs asked whether the NVWA can fully inspect Russian fish imports, impose fines or seize cargo, and whether the government will push for a ban on Russian whitefish, sanctions on Norebo, restrictions on Russian crews and measures against financing of Russia via Dutch ports. The minister answered that inspections are risk-based within EU benchmarks, that the NVWA lacks powers over catch quotas, that no fines were issued, and that the government favours exploring a whitefish import ban while leaving options open and withholding details of its negotiating position.
It is not in the interest of the Dutch negotiating position, nor of the surprise effect necessary for sanctions to be effective, to go into more detail on the Dutch negotiating position.

Het is niet in het belang van de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie en van de voor de effectiviteit van sancties noodzakelijke verrassingseffect om in meer detail op de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over het bericht ‘Studenten boos om uitblijven loon bij stages in zorg’

Two SP MPs asked the Health Minister whether UMCs excluding certain trainees from internship pay breaches the collective labour agreement, and whether the minister will act. The minister repeatedly answered that interpreting, enforcing and complying with the CAO is for the social partners (NFU and unions), and that she will not intervene.
Responsibility for enforcing and complying with the CAO lies with the CAO parties themselves.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de handhaving en naleving van de cao ligt bij cao-partijen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat voor patiënten met gedragsproblemen en verstandelijke handicap geen geld is in de opvang

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that care for people with behavioural problems and intellectual disability lacks funding, including calls for a tariff rise of at least 15 percent for VG7 care, the risks of clients being left without care, and whether planned long-term care cuts and the Wet zorg en dwang are compatible with current tariffs. The state secretary replied that a 6.2 percent VG7 tariff increase was implemented for 2025 based on NZa cost research, that current evidence does not justify 15 percent, that coercive care must not be driven by financial motives, and that the cuts remain justified while the ministry works with providers and care offices on placement problems.
The NZa cost research currently gives no reason for a 15% increase.
Het kostenonderzoek van de NZa geeft op dit moment geen aanleiding voor een verhoging van 15%.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de uitspraak van de Raad van State over genitale verminking

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about the Council of State ruling that the Hague mayor could not use municipal powers against a mosque promoting female genital mutilation, and whether the legal framework should be changed. The government answered that FGM and its promotion are unacceptable and already criminal, that the existing legal framework is sufficient, and that no change is needed, while noting it respects the court's final decision.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Loonkloof tussen mannen en vrouwen begint al in de schoolbanken'

An SP MP asked the education and social affairs ministers about a survey showing women interns receive fewer and lower internship allowances and contracts, and about sexual harassment during internships. The minister answered that the gap largely reflects field of study, pointed to existing agreements (Stagepact, anti-discrimination programme, WEB contract rules), and declined to commission new research or announce extra measures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over twee onderzoeken van de Patiëntenfederatie en de FNV naar de problematiek rondom tekorten in de geboortezorg

MP Dobbe asked the minister about two reports on staff shortages in maternity care, covering patient experiences, the FNV finding on reduced care, a second barrier of co-payments, pay gaps and work-life balance. The minister acknowledged the problems and listed existing measures (collaboration, dashboards, convenants, staffing and pay budgets) but rejected the claim that pay gaps drive shortages and gave no firm assessment of whether the ova-budget closes the gap.
However, this research does not provide sufficient information to make firm statements about whether the ova contribution is sufficient to close the pay gap.
Dit en ander onderzoek geeft echter onvoldoende informatie om harde uitspraken te doen in hoeverre de ova-bijdrage voldoende is om de beloningsachterstand in te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de berichten dat criminelen op grote schaal actief zijn in de zorg

The SP's Dobbe asked the Ministers of VWS, OCW and Justice about reports that criminals operate on a large scale in healthcare, including fraudulent vocational certificates, unprosecuted DUO and KvK fraud reports, and whether the sector's underfunding enables abuse. The minister answered that the government is pursuing a broad integrated approach with concrete measures (stricter EVC handling, licensing extension, Wibz bill, DBA enforcement) while declining to address the underfunding claim directly and deferring follow-up info.
In line with the commitment made in earlier letters to your House, you will be informed shortly about follow-up actions by the relevant ministries to jointly curb the described abuses in healthcare.

Conform de in eerdergenoemde Kamerbrieven aan uw Kamer gedane toezegging, wordt u op korte termijn nader geïnformeerd over vervolgacties van onder andere de betrokken ministeries om gezamenlijk paal en perk te stellen aan de geschetste misstanden in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Westerveld, Paulusma, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Teunissen over de gevolgen van de overwinning van Trump voor vrouwen wereldwijd

Six MPs asked the ministers how Trump's return and the expanded Mexico City Policy (Global Gag Rule) would affect women's health and abortion access worldwide, and what the Netherlands would do to fill any gap. The minister confirmed awareness of the policy and Project 2025 but declined to speculate on US changes, pointing instead to a forthcoming development policy letter and continued Dutch commitment to partners.
The cabinet is not anticipating that.
Het kabinet loopt daar niet op vooruit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Amber (27) is hersteld maar ‘woont’ al maanden noodgedwongen in het ziekenhuis: ‘Erger dan dit kan het niet worden’'

An SP MP asked the state secretary for health about a 27-year-old patient, recovered but kept in hospital for months because no suitable housing with care could be found, and about who is responsible, cost coverage and possible links to care cuts. The state secretary said the patient has since been discharged to her own home, gave no figures on how often this occurs, explained that municipalities are responsible for housing under the Wmo and that housing shortages are a bottleneck, and pointed to the pending housing-regulation bill as the remedy.
No exact figures are known about this.
Hier zijn geen exacte cijfers over bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het advies van de Advocaat-Generaal aan de Hoge Raad inzake de export van F-35-onderdelen aan Israël

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the government about the Advocate-General's advice to the Supreme Court that the ban on F-35 parts exports to Israel may stand, including whether Israeli F-35 parts could reach Dutch channels and whether arms imports from Israel should be cancelled. The minister declined to comment on the advice while the case is pending, said no Dutch parts are known to reach Israeli jets, rejected claims of complicity in war crimes, and said defence procurement from Israel will continue where it offers the best equipment.
The cabinet cannot go into the substance of this now, as the case is still pending before the Supreme Court.
Het kabinet kan hier nu niet inhoudelijk op ingaan, aangezien de zaak nog voorligt bij de Hoge Raad.
Antwoord op vragen vragen de leden Kostić, Ram, Graus, Hirsch, Paternotte, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de wrede jacht op kangoeroes en de Nederlandse betrokkenheid daarbij

MPs from several parties asked the government about the cruel kangaroo hunt, Dutch imports of kangaroo meat and leather, and calls for an import ban. The Staatssecretaris answered that animal welfare concerns are shared, that Australia regulates its own hunting, that an import ban can only be set at EU level and must comply with WTO rules, and that a plan under a prior motion is being prepared; several answers were deferred.
Banning the import of a product from a country outside the European Union, in this case Australia, can only be arranged at European level.
Import van een product verbieden dat uit een land komt van buiten de Europese Unie, in dit geval Australië, kan alleen op Europees niveau geregeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Bamenga, Dobbe, Teunissen, Koekkoek en Van Baarle over de appreciatie van de Minister van het amendement Stoffer/Eerdmans

Six MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Aid whether her opposition to the Stoffer/Eerdmans amendment, which proposed cutting the Dutch UNRWA contribution from 19 million to zero or 9 million euro, still holds given the legal obligation to pay 19 million. The minister confirmed the amendment was revised to 15 million in 2025, and referred the substance of the appreciation questions to a letter of 6 December while declaring the timing questions no longer applicable.
On this matter your House has been informed by means of the letter of 6 December.
Hierover is uw Kamer geïnformeerd middels de Kamerbrief van 6 december jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Paternotte over VN-onderzoek in Libanon

MPs Dobbe and Paternotte asked the Foreign Minister about the November 2024 Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire and compliance, promoting justice and independent international monitoring in Lebanon, and whether the Netherlands would back a UN Human Rights Council special session on violations by all parties. The minister described the ceasefire terms and monitoring mechanism, said Nederland would raise investigating alleged violations of humanitarian law at the Foreign Affairs Council, and declined for now to initiate a special session because Lebanon had not requested one.

In accordance with the Paternotte et al. motion, I will stress at the Foreign Affairs Council of Monday 16 December 2024 the importance of thorough investigation into alleged violations of international humanitarian law.
26 ) zal ik tijdens de Raad Buitenlandse Zaken van maandag 16 december 2024 het belang van gedegen onderzoek naar vermeende schendingen van het humanitair oorlogsrecht onderstrepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het briefadvies van de Adviesraad Internationale Vraagstukken over Israëlisch-Palestijns conflict

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister 14 questions about the AIV advisory report on Dutch policy on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, including suspending the EU-Israel association agreement, halting bilateral cooperation, recognising Palestine and a national anti-antisemitism action plan. The minister answered all questions collectively by pointing to the government's separate reaction to the AIV advice, sent before the Middle East committee debate.
These parliamentary questions are answered by means of the cabinet's response to the AIV advice, which is sent to the House at the same time as this answer.
Deze Kamervragen worden beantwoord middels de kabinetsreactie op het AIV-advies die tegelijkertijd met deze beantwoording aan de Kamer wordt verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de catastrofale situatie in het Zamzam vluchtelingenkamp in Soedan

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the catastrophic situation in Zamzam camp in Sudan, including aid levels, air drops, an arms embargo, diplomacy, reconstruction, gender-sensitive aid, and sexual violence and accountability. The Minister answered that extra emergency funds were provided, that land access is preferred over air drops which are ruled out, that the government pushed for a Sudan-wide arms embargo, and that it supports accountability mechanisms and documentation of atrocities.
Air drops are truly a last resort when other options have been exhausted.
Luchtdroppingen zijn echt een laatste redmiddel als andere opties uitgeput zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'VN tikt Nederland op de vingers: de postcode van je woonplaats bepaalt hoe goed de zorg is'

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the State Secretary for Health about UN criticism that municipal postcode determines quality of care for people with disabilities, and about variation between municipalities in Wmo support, financing, and procedures, proposing a basic municipal package. The State Secretary defended local discretion and individual tailoring, declined a separate study of variation and a national basic package for now, and pointed to a broader sustainability study, standardisation of contracts and information exchange, and financing handled by the Finance and Interior ministries.
I am currently not willing to proceed to a municipal basic package.
Ik ben op dit moment niet bereid om over te gaan tot een gemeentelijk basispakket.
