Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over het bericht Frauderende Twentse zorgondernemer gaat «gewoon» door in Drenthe: «Het liep direct al uit de hand»

MPs Dobbe and Van Nispen asked the minister how a fraudster with a history of large-scale care-fraud could again run a care provider, and how care offices check providers' past. The minister replied that screening relies on VOG, Bibob checks and care office contracting, that the Wbsrz and expanded licensing from 2025 will help, and that a Wibz bill on profit distribution and integrity is planned.
It must not be possible that someone responsible for abuses in care simply becomes active in care again.
Het moet niet kunnen dat iemand die verantwoordelijk is voor misstanden in de zorg, zomaar weer actief wordt in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht «Uithuisgeplaatste kinderen overgeleverd aan hardhandige invalkrachten»

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that out-of-home placed children were handed to violent, unqualified temporary staff at a youth care provider, and about the provider's oversight, the role of staffing agencies, and whether the sector's market structure causes such practices. The State Secretary condemned the practices, said the IGJ inspection report is due in early 2025, stated the provider remains ultimately responsible for staff qualifications, said the IGJ lacks powers over staffing agencies, and rejected the link to marketisation.
The IGJ has no powers to supervise placement or staffing agencies.
De IGJ heeft geen bevoegdheden om toe te zien op bemiddelings- of uitzendbureaus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe en Westerveld over de antwoorden op eerdere vragen over het opleggen van budgetplafonds aan Pro Persona door de zorgverzekeraars

MPs Dobbe and Westerveld asked the State Secretary whether budget caps imposed by health insurers on Pro Persona mental health care are effective, why the minister cites treatment-norm safeguards that are often breached, and what the effects of such caps are on patients served and on access. The State Secretary answered that caps help insurers allocate scarce staff, that safeguards exist but are insufficiently effective, that the NZa is monitoring insurers' duty of care, and that no detailed effect data exist, while committing to further measures and talks with the affected client councils.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff, Slagt-Tichelman, Westerveld, Paulusma, Krul, Dijk, Dobbe, Bikker, El Abassi, Kostić, Koekkoek en Eerdmans over de Nota van Wijziging op de Ontwerpbegroting van het Ministerie van

MPs from multiple parties asked the health ministry, in a set of written questions on the 2025 budget amendment, about cuts to the Stagefonds Zorg, borstprothesen subsidy, SOV care for the uninsured, Veelbelovende zorg, sports funding and the generic staff cut. The minister's answers defend the cuts as efficient or minimal in impact, give partial figures, and state that several effects are still being examined.
It is not known for how many unique patients the subsidy scheme for medically necessary care for the uninsured (SOV) is used.
Het is niet bekend voor hoeveel unieke patiënten gebruik wordt gemaakt van de subsidieregeling medisch noodzakelijke zorg aan onverzekerden (SOV).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht «Ouderen komen zonder hulp te zitten in zomervakantie: «Zoveel mogelijk proberen zelf te doen»»

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport how older people can be left without home help during the summer, whether the municipality of Eindhoven meets its Wmo care duty, and how shortages and the 2026 Gemeentefonds cut relate to this. The State Secretary acknowledged staff shortages, said the municipality and providers are doing their utmost, found no failure of the care duty, and pointed to planned labour-market and access measures without committing to a concrete new step.
I have received no signals that the municipality of Eindhoven is insufficiently fulfilling its care duty.
Ik heb geen signalen ontvangen dat gemeente Eindhoven haar zorgplicht onvoldoende naleeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over het bericht dat het OM de criminaliteit in de zorg niet meer aan kan en er jaarlijks voor 10 miljard wordt gefraudeerd

MPs Dobbe and Van Nispen asked the Health and Justice ministers how they respond to reports that the Public Prosecution Service cannot handle healthcare crime and that around 10 billion euros is defrauded yearly, and what they will do about it. The minister answers that tackling care fraud is a priority, lists planned measures (new licensing grounds, data sharing, profit-distribution conditions, a review of open-house contracting, and stricter inspection of diplomas), and promises further letters and a bill in 2025.
I agree with the questioners that commercial interests of care providers or investors must never take precedence over the public interest in care and youth assistance.
Ik ben het eens met de vragenstellers dat commerciële belangen van zorgaanbieders of investeerders nooit vóór het maatschappelijk belang van zorg en jeugdhulp mogen gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over het bericht «Blokkade in Amsterdamse zorgketen door omzetplafonds vvt»

MPs Dobbe and Dijk (SP) asked about Amsterdam care providers halting admissions after reaching turnover caps, and whether caps block access to geriatric rehabilitation and palliative care and conflict with insurers' duty of care. The State Secretary says caps are an insurer tool to allocate scarce capacity, that insurers must arrange alternative timely care under the duty of care supervised by the NZa, and that the government will examine legislative changes to make palliative care a regular part of care.
It is the task of health insurers to allocate this scarce staff capacity and scarce resources as well as possible and ideally to ensure they reach the people who need care most.

Het is de taak van zorgverzekeraars om deze schaarse personele inzet en schaarse middelen zo goed mogelijk te verdelen en idealiter terecht te laten komen bij de mensen die de zorg het hardst nodig hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Boswijk over het wegschrijven van verwijzingen naar genderbeleid en SRGR in antwoorden op schriftelijke vragen

MPs Dobbe and Boswijk asked whether the ministry's edits to earlier written answers, which removed or softened references to Dutch gender policy, SRGR and investment in women's rights, changed policy. The minister answers that the edits are textual only, that women's rights, gender equality and SRGR remain part of Dutch foreign policy priorities, and that development policy details will follow later.
The mentioned changes are textual and do not represent a change in policy.
De genoemde wijzigingen zijn tekstueel en houden geen wijziging van beleid in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Kent over de uitspraak dat Oekraïne Nederlandse F-16’s in mag zetten in Rusland

MPs Dobbe and Van Kent asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about reports that Ukraine may use Dutch F-16s on Russian territory, including the decision process, escalation risks, sanctions, frozen assets and peace talks. Minister Brekelmans confirmed Ukraine may use them within international law, declined to disclose cabinet deliberations or escalation analyses, and gave general, largely non-specific answers on sanctions and peace efforts.
The deliberations of the Council of Ministers are secret.
De beraadslagingen van de Ministerraad zijn geheim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat de kwaliteit van de langdurige zorg voor ouderen thuis volgens de IGJ nog vaak onder de maat is

An MP from the SP asks the State Secretary for Health how she responds to IGJ findings that home-based long-term care for older people is often substandard, whether market fragmentation causes this, and whether the shift from institutional to home care is still responsible. The State Secretary acknowledges the concerns, points to good practice and support programmes, and says she will investigate new care-suitable housing options for older people who fall between institutional and home care.
For me it is important that the quality of home-based Wlz care is increased in those places where it is not yet in order.
Voor mij is het belangrijk dat de kwaliteit van Wlz-zorg thuis wordt vergroot op die plekken waar dit nog niet op orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de humanitaire situatie in Soedan

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the official famine finding in Sudan, obstructed humanitarian access, diplomatic consequences, aid funding amid budget cuts, and arms export controls. The minister answered that the famine finding was shocking but not unexpected, that obstruction of aid violates humanitarian law, and that Netherlands is pressing parties and the EU on access, while noting multi-year aid commitments and deferring the effects of 2025 cuts to the budget.
The effects of the 2025 cuts under the coalition agreement will be communicated to you with the 2025 draft budget.
Over de effecten van de bezuinigingen uit het Hoofdlijnenakkoord in 2025 wordt u bij de ontwerpbegroting 2025 geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Dijk over het bericht ‘Kwart verzorgenden denkt aan stoppen’

Two MPs from the SP asked the health minister about a survey showing a quarter of care workers considering quitting, covering workload, salaries, administrative burden, budget cuts and the staffing norm in nursing homes. The minister acknowledged the problem, outlined plans on administrative relief, digitalisation and a leidraad on work pleasure, but declined to raise salaries beyond existing OVA funds and said she cannot influence the quality standard's staffing norm.
It is therefore not within my power to carry out the wish to maintain the staffing norm.
Het ligt daarom niet binnen mijn mogelijkheid om de wens de personele bezettingsnorm te handhaven uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat er onvoldoende budget is in 2024 voor de langdurige zorg

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the Minister of Health about a report that the NZa projects insufficient 2024 long-term care (Wlz) budget, and whether the 310 million euro cut and the rejected restoration amendment were responsible. The state secretary denied a cut, said the Wlz budget was raised by 201 million euro structurally to cover the shortfall, and declined to guarantee that no further cuts would be made.
There is no question of extra cuts of 310 million on the Wlz budget.
Er is geen sprake van extra bezuinigingen van 310 miljoen op het Wlz-kader.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Westerveld over het opleggen van budgetplafonds aan Pro Persona door de zorgverzekeraars

MPs Dobbe and Westerveld asked the state secretary about budget caps imposed on Pro Persona GGZ by health insurers and whether this conflicts with insurers' duty of care amid long mental health waiting lists. The state secretary says caps are a legitimate tool for allocating scarce capacity, insurers retain a duty of care and must refer patients elsewhere, and he is discussing improvements with the sector without intervening in contracts.
Making agreements, including on budget caps, is a matter between individual providers and individual health insurers.
Het maken van afspraken, ook over budgetplafonds, is een zaak tussen individuele aanbieders en individuele zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de behandeling van Palestijnse gevangenen in Israëlische gevangenissen

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reported collective punishment and mistreatment of Palestinian detainees in Israeli prisons, including administrative detention, unlawful combatant classification of Gaza detainees, lack of access for ICRC and family, and alleged abuse at Sde Teiman. The minister acknowledged concern, said the Netherlands raises detention standards with Israel and supports independent investigation, and reported diplomatic outreach to secure access for the ICRC, without committing to a new formal condemnation.
The cabinet takes reports of alleged violations of international law, including international humanitarian law, extremely seriously.
Het kabinet neemt signalen van vermeende schendingen van het internationaal recht, inclusief het humanitair oorlogsrecht, uiterst serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de Israëlische aanval op een school in Gaza

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about an Israeli strike on a school in Gaza, reported casualties, Israel's alleged targeting rules, EU statements, and steps to hold Israel to international humanitarian law. The minister said the government lacks verified casualty figures, condemned violations regardless of perpetrator, supports ceasefire negotiations and humanitarian aid, and noted funding for ICC and OHCHR evidence-gathering, but declined to judge the lawfulness of specific strikes.
The cabinet does not have verified information on the specific numbers of civilian casualties.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over geverifieerde informatie over de specifieke aantallen burgerslachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Dobbe over het bericht 'Zorgen over verkeerde hulp aan eenzame mensen door 'aanbestedingscircus'

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health about reports that competitive tendering of loneliness support produces offers that do not really help lonely people and breaks care relationships, and about the status of a motion to abolish mandatory tendering. The Minister answered that municipalities choose how to finance such help, that tendering is not legally mandatory, that continuity can be safeguarded through contract design and monitoring, and that the Ketenbureau will be strengthened to support municipalities.
There is no general statutory obligation in the social domain to tender.
Er is geen algemene wettelijke verplichting in het sociaal domein om aan te besteden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Van der Burg, Boswijk, Dobbe, Teunissen en Dassen over het bericht “Rusland zet onafhankelijke krant The Moscow Times op zwarte lijst”

MPs from several parties asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Asylum and Migration about Russia placing the independent Moscow Times on a blacklist and the risks to Russian journalists working for it. The minister confirmed awareness of the report and said that emergency visas are possible in exceptional cases within existing policy frameworks, reaffirming support for press freedom.
This entails that within existing policy frameworks, and carefully tested against the Visa Code, visas can in exceptional cases be issued where there are compelling or humanitarian reasons.

Daar hoort bij dat binnen de bestaande beleidskaders, en daarbij zorgvuldig getoetst aan de Visumcode, het in uitzonderlijke gevallen mogelijk is visa te verstrekken als daar zwaarwegende of humanitaire redenen voor zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Piri, Kahraman, Paternotte, Dobbe, Van Campen en Ceder over het vredesproces tussen Armenië en Azerbeidzjan

MPs asked the government about the Armenia-Azerbaijan peace process, including the trilateral meeting in Washington, Azerbaijan's demand to amend Armenia's constitution, and what the Netherlands could do to speed up a deal. The minister said the government urges both sides toward a durable agreement based on mutual recognition of territorial integrity, declined to comment publicly on negotiating positions, and noted EUMA's de-escalating role and a mandate running to February 2025.
However, it is not in the interest of the negotiating parties to publicly address their negotiating positions in this answer.
Het is echter niet in het belang van de onderhandelende partijen om in deze beantwoording publiekelijk in te gaan op de onderhandelingsposities van de partijen bij de vredesbesprekingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de annexatie van Palestijns grondgebied op de Westelijke Jordaanoever door Israël

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about Israel's annexation of about 270 hectares in the West Bank, including whether it violates international law, Smotrich's remarks, the two-state solution, bilateral sanctions and the implementation of the Piri motion. The minister answered that Israel's settlement policy violates international law, condemned the decision, reviewed EU-Israel association agreement steps, rejected national sanctions in favour of EU action, and reported EU sanctions on violent settlers.
No, I am not in favour of national measures.
Nee, ik ben geen voorstander van nationale maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de gevolgen van budgetplafonds in de ggz

Dobbe (SP) asked the Minister about the effects of insurers' budget caps in mental health care, including administrative burden, patients left unhelped amid long waiting lists, and whether the caps will be abolished. Staatssecretaris Karremans answered that he lacks detailed insight into individual contracts, that caps can improve efficiency, that he does not share the view that fewer patients are helped, and that he will discuss accessibility with the sector without abolishing the caps.
In principle I am not aware of the agreements that individual health insurers and individual care providers make with each other in contracts.
In beginsel ben ik niet op de hoogte van de afspraken die individuele zorgverzekeraars en individuele zorgaanbieders in contracten met elkaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Kent over het nieuws dat omwonenden van zware industrie structureel hogere zorgkosten hebben

MPs Dobbe and Van Kent asked the government how it will respond to reports that residents near heavy industry pay on average 7 percent more in healthcare costs, and what it will do to protect them. The government says health effects of industry are known and points to the Actieagenda Industrie en Omwonenden, existing permit and enforcement reforms, and studies by RIVM, but rejects charging polluting firms directly for residents' healthcare costs.
That is therefore an incentive for the cabinet to work on further improving the living environment for residents near industry.
Dat is voor het kabinet dan ook een aansporing om te werken aan het verder verbeteren van de leefomgeving voor omwonenden van de industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht Nederland zorgt niet goed voor kwetsbare kinderen: ‘We zakken als land door het ijs’

An SP MP asked the state secretary how the government will respond to a KidsRights report saying the Netherlands is failing vulnerable children, including cuts to youth care and rising child poverty. The state secretary answered that the government is working on the issues through the Hervormingsagenda Jeugd, vaccination measures and child-rights monitoring, and rejected the claim that youth care cuts are unjustified.
I see this report as a call on the cabinet to properly safeguard children's rights.
Ik zie dit rapport als een oproep aan het kabinet om kinderrechten goed te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de situatie op het voormalige terrein van de Hoenderloo Groep

An SP MP asked the state secretary about the situation at the former Hoenderloo Groep site, including safety of youths, fragmentation of youth care across 342 municipalities, and unclear placement oversight. The state secretary answered that Apeldoorn has set up a local platform, the IGJ is conducting oversight, and a bill on regional cooperation in youth care is pending, while placing responsibility mainly with municipalities and providers.
Whether the care provided is now appropriate for the young people living on the former Hoenderloo Groep site is something I cannot assess.
Of de geboden zorg nu passend is voor de jeugdigen die nu op het terrein van de voormalige Hoenderloo Groep verblijven kan ik niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe, Piri en Teunissen over het opzeggen van het verdrag inzake clustermunitie door Litouwen

Three MPs asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs whether he knew of Lithuania's withdrawal from the Convention on Cluster Munitions, whether he shared the coalition's concerns, and whether he would urge Lithuania to reverse its decision. The minister confirmed the withdrawal, said the Netherlands regrets it, and reported that the government has already raised concerns with Lithuania, which points to its security situation, while noting that the withdrawal takes effect after a six-month period following notification to the UN.
The cabinet has already had contact with Lithuanian authorities about the withdrawal from the convention.
Het kabinet heeft reeds contact gehad met Litouwse autoriteiten over het opzeggen van het verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht ‘Mevrouw Verheijden (88) moest halsoverkop weg uit verzorgingshuis’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about an 88-year-old resident who had to move suddenly from a care home run by Zuyderland after staff sick leave, questioning staffing, cuts and the risk of repeated moves. The government answered that the unit was temporarily closed due to combined sick leave, that residents will return by end of October, and that the budget decision is deferred to the 2025 budget.
I have not received any concrete signals about this.
Ik heb hierover geen concrete signalen ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat er een nieuwe rechtszaak komt over het exportverbod voor F-35 onderdelen naar Israël

MP Dobbe asked the government about reports of a new lawsuit over the export ban on F-35 parts to Israel, and whether parts could still reach Israel via transit countries. The minister answered that it is not considered likely that parts made in the Netherlands reach Israeli F-35s, relying on confidential data, and that the court ruling is being implemented via amended licences while the government keeps the F-35 programme going.
The cabinet bases this conclusion on confidential data.
Het kabinet baseert deze conclusie op vertrouwelijke gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat het Regionaal Autisme Centrum (RAC) in Helmond en Tilburg stopt met behandeling en het stellen van diagnoses bij 18-plussers

MP Dobbe asks the minister how the government responds to the closure of the Regionaal Autisme Centrum in Helmond and Tilburg for adults, and whether insurers are meeting their duty of care. The state secretary attributes the closure to staff shortages, points to insurer referral services, says the NZa and regional parties are responsible, and declines to meet regional providers and insurers.
It is for the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) to assess whether health insurers meet their duty of care.
Het is aan de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) om te beoordelen of zorgverzekeraars aan hun zorgplicht voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Dobbe over het bericht dat de gemeente Arnhem bij 3300 inwoners opnieuw gaat bekijken of zij recht blijven hebben op huishoudelijke hulp

MP Dobbe asked about Arnhem's plan to re-assess 3,300 residents' entitlement to home help, and about the waiting lists, budget and mantelzorg implications. The state secretary answered that municipalities bear responsibility under the Wmo, that the reassessment aims to direct capacity to the most vulnerable, that the government will monitor the situation and the Wmo sustainability study will report in autumn 2024.
It is primarily up to the municipal council to supervise this.
Het is primair aan de gemeenteraad hierop toe te zien.
Antwoord op vagen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat in Gambia genitale verminking weer legaal dreigt te worden

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Nederland will speak out against a bill that would legalise female genital mutilation in Gambia, and what diplomatic tools are used, including questions on whether human rights are framed as Western impositions and on rights pressures elsewhere. The minister replied that parliament had rejected the bill, that the Netherlands opposes it mainly through quiet diplomacy led by local civil society, and that the embassy and EU have raised it with the Gambian government and monitor rights pressures worldwide.
The Netherlands therefore speaks out against revoking the ban on female genital mutilation through quiet diplomacy.
Nederland spreekt zich daarom middels stille diplomatie uit tegen het intrekken van het verbod op vrouwelijke genitale verminking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat inspecties signaleren dat criminele netwerken de zorg hebben ontdekt

An SP MP asked the health and education ministers how they will respond to inspection findings that criminal networks have infiltrated healthcare through staffing agencies and fake diplomas, including whether oversight will be improved and whether profit-making in care should be curbed. The minister acknowledges the concern, promises to inform parliament in autumn about follow-up measures, rules out statutory profit caps on legal grounds, and proposes a bill allowing conditions on profit distribution.
Your House will be informed about this in the autumn.
Uw Kamer zal hier dit najaar over worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de problemen bij Esdégé Reigersdaal

An SP MP asked about staff and relative complaints at the Esdégé Reigersdaal Klaverweide location, the failed mediation, whether the board and supervisory board take responsibility, and whether the IGJ and affected parties were consulted. The Staatssecretaris answered that the board is primarily responsible, that the IGJ is monitoring the situation and the organisation is working on improvement measures, and that individual IGJ cases cannot be disclosed.
The IGJ does not make any statements about the content of the reports or ongoing supervision.
Over de inhoud van de meldingen of lopend toezicht doet de IGJ geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat Unilever nog steeds tientallen miljoenen verdient aan Rusland

An SP MP asked whether Unilever's continued earnings in Russia, reported in the media, breach sanctions and whether the government would investigate sanctions compliance. The minister declined to judge individual cases, said enforcement is for prosecutors and courts, and rejected a separate compliance investigation while pointing to a forthcoming debate and letter.
It is established practice that no statements are made about individual cases.
Het is staande praktijk dat er geen uitspraken worden gedaan over individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de berichtgeving dat Defensie een miljoenenorder overweegt bij het Israëlische bedrijf Elbit.

MP Dobbe asked the Defence Minister whether the ministry was considering a multi-million order from Elbit Systems, an Israeli firm whose weapons may be used in occupied territories, and asked about related arms imports and Israel's compliance with international law. The minister confirmed the planned Elbit self-protection system for the Embraer C-390M, said Defence needs Israeli equipment for operational reasons, stated the government has no visibility on how Israel uses its weapons, and listed past Israeli procurements.
The cabinet has no visibility on where Israel deploys these weapons.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op waar Israël deze wapens inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat 73% van de zorgverleners aangeeft dat de tijd die ze aan administratie besteden de laatste vijf jaar is toegenomen

An SP MP asked the health minister how she responded to an FNV survey showing 73% of care workers report rising administrative time and to the low perceived follow-up on their complaints, and whether a more fundamental approach to bureaucracy is needed. The minister acknowledged the problem, defended the existing [Ont]Regel de Zorg programme and announced an intensified approach, but declined to commit to meeting the FNV, leaving it to her successor.
I leave it to my successor whether or not to enter into discussion with the FNV about the results of this research.
Ik laat het aan mijn opvolger al dan niet in gesprek te gaan met de FNV over de resultaten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Dobbe over ontwikkelingen in Jemen

MPs Ceder and Dobbe asked the government about humanitarian needs in Yemen, stalled peace talks, follow-up on a motion to pursue war crimes investigations, and the abolition of the national arms export presumption of denial for Saudi Arabia and the UAE. The ministers answered that Nederland remains a substantial humanitarian donor with no additional funding planned, supports the UN envoy and multilateral efforts, could not secure support in the Human Rights Council for a war crimes investigation, and maintains strict arms export review under EU rules.
The Netherlands will continue to support the mandate of the UN envoy and to consistently draw attention to this forgotten conflict in multilateral settings.
Nederland blijft het mandaat van de VN gezant ondersteunen en in multilateraal verband voortdurend aandacht vragen voor dit vergeten conflict.
Antwoord op de leden Bamenga, Hirsch, Dobbe, Koekkoek en Ceder over het bericht ‘Nederlands bedrijf negeert ernstige schendingen in Saudi-Arabië’

Five MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about an Amnesty International briefing alleging that a Dutch company, with government support, contributed to human rights violations in Saudi Arabia linked to The Line project, and about IMVO due diligence, trade missions, the CSDDD and Amnesty's recommendations. The minister answered that the government takes such findings seriously, that due diligence is the companies' own responsibility, that the trade mission self-scans raised no reason for further inquiry, and that conditions for government support would be reinforced in practice without tightening the framework.
The cabinet takes the findings of civil society organisations, including Amnesty International, seriously.
Het kabinet neemt bevindingen van maatschappelijke organisatie waaronder Amnesty International serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de kernwapentaak van de F-35

MP Dobbe (SP) asked whether nuclear weapons are in the Netherlands now that the F-35 has taken over the nuclear mission from the F-16, whether the B61-12 is present, and how this fits with NPT disarmament obligations. The government declined to disclose numbers, locations and certification details for security reasons, rejected the claim that the motion Van Dijk on transparency was insufficiently implemented, and argued the B61-12 is not a new weapon.
As your House is aware, on the basis of allied and legally binding agreements no statements can be made about the numbers and locations of US nuclear weapons present in Europe.

Zoals uw Kamer bekend, kunnen op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken geen mededelingen worden gedaan over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Voor miljarden aan zorgfraude gepleegd, maar pakkans nihil: ’En zorgpremies stijgen steeds meer’

The MP Dobbe asks the minister how the government will tackle healthcare fraud, whether market organisation of care and open-house constructions make fraud easier, and whether budget cuts combined with billions lost to fraud is consistent. The minister answers that fraud will be addressed through the Wbsrz, the Wibz bill and extended licensing, rejects the claim that cuts double-hit care, and says the Wibz bill and a study on open-house models are underway, while rejecting a ban on profit distribution and the claim that abolishing market forces would reduce fraud.
I find it reprehensible that public healthcare funds are being abused and that patients are the victims.
Ik vind het verwerpelijk dat er misbruik wordt gemaakt van publieke zorggelden en dat patiënten daar de dupe van worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat er in vapes van Nederlandse kinderen giftige metalen, kankerverwekkende stoffen en veel meer nicotine zit dan wettelijk is toegestaan

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health how the government will address vapes containing toxic metals, carcinogens and excess nicotine, and how sales to minors and the industry will be controlled. The State Secretary answered that these products are unacceptable, that the NVWA has removed 3.6 million vapes from the market, that enforcement powers and fines will be increased, and that a neutral packaging requirement and a list of banned additives are coming.
The NVWA is the supervisory authority under the Tobacco and Smoking Products Act, which covers vapes.
De NVWA is de toezichthouder op de Tabaks-en rookwarenwet, waar de vapes onder vallen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Jos de Blok: ‘VWS en NZa hebben Buurtzorg stelselmatig buitengesloten’'

An SP MP asked the minister whether VWS and the NZa excluded Buurtzorg, why Omaha was not used for home-care funding, and whether client profiles are more burdensome than alternatives. The minister answered each question, saying talks with Buurtzorg will continue, that Omaha was judged unsuitable for funding linkage, and that client profiles are only a supporting tool, with the registration obligation to be dropped per the Joseph-Agema motion.
I will also, when the experiment continues in modified form following the Joseph-Agema motion adopted by your House, contact field parties again, including Buurtzorg.

Ik zal ook bij het vervolg van het experiment, dat gewijzigd zal worden naar aanleiding van de door uw Kamer aangenomen motie Joseph-Agema 3 , weer contact opnemen met veldpartijen, waaronder Buurtzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat de financiële problemen in de jeugdhulp steeds erger worden

An SP MP asked the state secretary for health, welfare and sport how the government will respond to reports from the Jeugdautoriteit that financial problems in youth care are worsening, and whether planned cuts should be reconsidered. The state secretary answered that the report is nuanced, pointed to existing continuity arrangements, a subsidy scheme and a transition fund, and said the 2025 cut was not carried forward while the 2026 measure is for the next cabinet to decide, with a expert commission advising in 2025 and 2028.
I will of course continue to monitor this closely.
Ik blijf dit uiteraard nauwgezet monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de aanpak van zorgfraude in Tilburg

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the minister how the government responds to reports that Tilburg's fraud enforcement against care providers was arbitrary, whether providers can defend themselves, and whether national bodies should take over care fraud oversight from municipalities. The minister says legal remedies (objection, appeal, ombudsman, civil claims) exist, points to joint measures and pilot projects, and rejects a centralised approach, while noting that excessive profit distribution will be tackled through a bill.
If there is a decision as referred to in the General Administrative Law Act, legal remedies such as objection and (higher) appeal are open within the administrative law framework.
Indien sprake is van een besluit als bedoeld in de Awb, dan staan er binnen de bestuursrechtelijke kaders rechtsmiddelen open zoals bezwaar en (hoger) beroep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht ‘Neem vrouwen serieus. Verbeter de pijnbestrijding bij het plaatsen van een spiraal’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about pain relief when fitting an IUD (spiraal), and whether women's care is undervalued. The Minister replied that the NHG standard advises oral painkillers and does not recommend local anaesthetic or sedation due to insufficient evidence and risks, and committed to passing the concern to the NHG and Stichting Ava and to a ZonMw knowledge programme on women-specific conditions.
I will put Stichting Ava, author of the opinion piece 'Take women seriously. Improve pain relief when fitting an IUD', in contact with the NHG so they can discuss good care when fitting an IUD.

Ik zal Stichting Ava, schrijver van het opiniebericht «Neem vrouwen serieus. Verbeter de pijnbestrijding bij het plaatsen van een spiraal», in contact brengen met het NHG zodat zij in gesprek kunnen over goede zorg bij het plaatsen van een spiraal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over De toename van geweld in de zorg

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health whether she would respond to NU'91's call for work stoppages after violence against care workers, why safety measures are often missing, what steps she takes, and whether she knows the root causes of rising violence. The minister supports the work stoppage initiative, points to employers' Arbowet duties and a sector-based approach, promotes filing police reports, but says she knows of no research into root causes and will not commission it given the caretaker cabinet.
I am not aware of any research into the underlying causes of aggression in care.
Er is mij geen onderzoek bekend naar de onderliggende oorzaken van agressie in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht ‘Honderden lichamen ontdekt in massagraven in Gaza, maar onderzoek bijna onmogelijk’

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports of mass graves in Gaza and whether independent investigation is being obstructed by Israel, and about preservation of evidence and accountability for war crimes. The minister supports independent investigation, says Israel has not yet admitted investigative teams, and points to Dutch funding for the ICC and OHCHR while noting the ICC's investigations are confidential.
The cabinet cannot judge the precise nature and extent of the evidence collected so far by the Office of the Prosecutor of the ICC.
Het kabinet kan geen oordeel vellen over de precieze aard en omvang van het tot op heden door de Aanklager van het Strafhof vergaarde bewijsmateriaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de resolutie van de VN veiligheidsraad over een wapenstilstand in Gaza

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about UN Security Council resolution 2728 on a Gaza ceasefire, including whether non-compliance should trigger Dutch sanctions, whether F-35 parts and a defence status agreement with Israel should be halted, and the Chief of Defence's visit to Israel. The government answered that it urges compliance bilaterally and multilaterally, points to the Court of Appeal ruling on F-35 parts it is implementing, says the SOFA is separate from the resolution, and declined to give details on the Qatar-mediated negotiations.
The Netherlands is however not part of these negotiations. I therefore cannot give you further details.
Nederland is echter geen onderdeel van deze onderhandelingen. Ik kan u daarom verder geen details geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de vergoeding van reconstructieoperaties bij besneden vrouwen

An MP asked why reconstructive surgery for women who underwent FGM is not covered for all, whether the deductible applies, and whether it can be waived. The minister agrees FGM is serious abuse and that financial barriers are undesirable, says surgery is covered only with somatic complaints, and plans a one-year pilot to compensate the deductible, though no decision is taken yet.
For that reason I intend to implement the amendment submitted by the former members Bergkamp and Raemakers (D66).
Ik ben mede daarom voornemens om het door de (voormalige) leden Bergkamp en Raemakers (D66) ingediende amendement 3 uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de ontstane situatie bij de zorglocatie Abel Tasman in Heerhugowaard

An SP MP asked the health minister about unrest, dismissals and forced transfers of staff at care location Abel Tasman in Heerhugowaard, and its effect on care quality, including why staff worked months without a clustermanager. The minister said the board is responsible, the inspectorate (IGJ) was aware of the problems before the press reports and is monitoring, and the provider reports interim staffing measures and recruitment.
The IGJ cannot make substantive statements about the ongoing supervision.
Over het lopende toezicht kan de IGJ geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het marineschip Zr.Ms. Holland en humanitaire hulp aan Gaza

An SP MP asked why the navy ship Zr.Ms. Holland was returned from the Gaza region, what humanitarian aid efforts were made, and how the government will implement the adopted motion on airdrops and ship deliveries to Gaza. The minister answered that Holland was pre-positioned for possible evacuation or a maritime corridor, that the corridor had not materialised in time, that Dutch airdrops with Jordan were carried out, and that overland access remains the priority with Israel blocking adequate access.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de levering van F-35 onderdelen aan Israël

An SP MP asked the Foreign Trade and Development Minister about F-35 parts deliveries to Israel after a court ban, including whether the ministry is seeking alternative routes, and about export licences for military and dual-use goods to Israel since 7 October 2023. The government denies seeking alternative routes, says it is in regular contact with F-35 partners, reports that no new licences for Israeli end use were approved and one military export was refused, and answers licence-by-licence questions largely by listing data.
There has been no request to seek alternative routes to still be able to deliver F-35 parts to Israel.
Er is niet gevraagd naar alternatieve routes te zoeken om alsnog F-35-onderdelen te kunnen leveren aan Israël.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over de beïnvloeding van de Eritrese diaspora door de Eritrese regering

MPs Dobbe and Van Nispen asked whether the Eritrean government influences its diaspora in the Netherlands, what measures will prevent this, and whether a new investigation is planned. The minister answers that the evidence of pressure is mixed, that the OBI approach and earlier measures remain in place, that diaspora taxation cannot be banned under current law, and that no new investigation is planned beyond the earlier study.
The cabinet acknowledges that the social pressure Eritreans in the Netherlands apparently experience cannot be ignored.
Het kabinet erkent dat de sociale druk die Eritreeërs in Nederland kennelijk ervaren niet kan worden genegeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over de hervatting van de financiering van UNRWA door de Verenigde Staten

An SP MP asked the minister whether the US had resumed UNRWA funding, whether it was urging other countries to do so, and whether the Netherlands should resume its own funding given UNRWA's risk-mitigation measures and the status of the investigation. The minister answered that UNRWA USA, an independent non-profit, resumed fundraising, that the US government speaks publicly about UNRWA's importance, and referred to the April 2024 letter on the investigation without giving a fresh update; the request to answer before a committee debate was not met.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat Friese gemeenten miljoenen tekortkomen op jeugdzorg

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that Frisian municipalities face multi-million shortfalls in youth care budgets, asking about causes, effects on young people, and whether the planned 511 million euro cut should be scrapped. The State Secretary said municipalities are responsible for their own finances, pointed to the Hervormingsagenda Jeugd and a planned 2025 expert review, declined to give a list of municipalities with shortfalls, and referred to the Voorjaarsnota for the cut.
I do not have an overview of which municipalities have a shortfall in youth care.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht van welke gemeenten een tekort op jeugdzorg hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht ''Zo wil niemand leven', zegt zorgexpert over verwaarloosde Renny'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about reports that Renny, a care recipient with complex needs, lives in neglectful conditions despite a 2019 warning, and about possible links to budget cuts in long-term care. The Minister called the situation distressing, said IGJ was informed, a new multidisciplinary meeting was scheduled, and denied any cuts to disability care while acknowledging reversal of certain cuts.
The IGJ makes no further statements about ongoing supervision or reports.
Over lopend toezicht/meldingen doet de IGJ geen nadere mededelingen.
Antwoord opvragen van de leden Van Nispen en Dobbe over het bericht 'Rechter gefrustreerd: klinieken willen verward persoon niet opnemen'

Two SP MPs asked, after a court ruling, how the government will ensure a man with a court-ordered care measure is placed in a secure care facility rather than left homeless, and what is being done about the wider placement problem. The minister answered that a place was found and the man admitted from 29 March 2024, acknowledged that secure specialist places are scarce, and said a work agenda and a letter on the Wzd and forensic care alignment will follow before summer.
As far as we are aware, that information is also not registered.
Voor zover ons bekend wordt die informatie ook niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht dat er bij een Nederlandse wapeninzet in Afghanistan in 2007 mogelijk zes burgerslachtoffers zijn gevallen

An SP MP asked the Defence Minister about possible civilian deaths from a 2007 Dutch fire-support action in Afghanistan, including why they were not disclosed, and about related 2009 incidents and a 2016 Mosul investigation. The minister explained the 2007 incident was omitted from a 2009 registration, outlined what was known, and said the 2009 matter is under prosecutorial review while an internal Mosul investigation is ongoing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over de berichten 'Recordaantal meldingen van personen met verward gedrag in 2023' en 'Duizenden kwetsbaren wachten op plek beschermd wonen'

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of health and justice about rising reports of people with confused behaviour reaching police and about waiting lists for protected housing, asking whether ggz shortages and funding cuts cause these trends. The minister answered all 14 questions in substance, rejecting a causal link to ggz capacity and maximum waiting times, while acknowledging long waits and listing existing programmes.

I do not have data on how many homeless people who come into contact with the police over confused behaviour are on a waiting list for protected housing or have previously been admitted to a ggz institution.

Ik beschik niet over gegevens over hoeveel mensen die dakloos zijn en in aanraking komen met politie vanwege verward gedrag, op een wachtlijst voor beschermd wonen staan of eerder opgenomen zijn geweest in een ggz-instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Tuinman, Boswijk, Dobbe, Van Oostenbruggen, Nordkamp en Dassen over vrouwen in de krijgsmacht

Seven MPs asked the state secretary about women's advancement, part-time service, childcare, uniforms, sexual misconduct, the frontline role of women and veterans' support in the armed forces. The answers describe incremental measures such as a new part-time leave variant, modular training, a new combat uniform system and a 2023 harassment report count, and state that operational experience is not a formal condition for promotion.
Participation in deployments is not a condition for promotion in rank.
Deelname aan uitzendingen is niet voorwaardelijk om door te groeien in rang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht "Maartje Kraamzorg trekt de stekker eruit, kraamzorg in Twente moet hulp zoeken voor 160 gezinnen"

An SP MP asked the minister about the closure of Maartje Kraamzorg in Twente, which leaves about 160 families needing other midwifery care, and about low insurer tariffs, workforce shortages and future guarantees of kraamzorg. The minister says insurers and providers are responsible, that the NZa and IGJ had no prior signals, that the preferred insurer is working with other providers to place clients, and that a follow-up to the sector convenant is being negotiated.
I made inquiries with the NZa and IGJ. They indicate that they had not previously received signals about the discontinuation of Maartje Kraamzorg.
Ik heb navraag gedaan bij de NZa en IGJ. Zij geven aan dat zij niet eerder signalen hebben ontvangen over het wegvallen van Maartje Kraamzorg
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Gezinshuiszorg faalt: kwetsbare kinderen onvoldoende beschermd'

MP Dobbe (SP) asked the state secretary and minister about a news report that vulnerable children in family-home youth care were insufficiently protected, questioning the IGJ's oversight, the lack of a reliable count of family homes, the case for a profit ban, and measures against abuses. The state secretary acknowledged the failures, explained risk-based inspection and the planned bills and measures, but rejected a general profit ban.
That is why it is also essential that municipalities set quality requirements during contracting, as laid down in the Quality Criteria for Family Homes.
Daarom is het ook essentieel dat bij de contractering gemeenten kwaliteitseisen stellen zoals neergelegd in de Kwaliteitscriteria Gezinshuizen.
Antwoord op  vragen van het lid Dobbe over het gebruik van artikel 100 van de Grondwet met betrekking tot de aanvallen in Jemen

An MP asks the Foreign Minister why Article 100 of the Constitution was not invoked, how the US self-defence justification applies, and who decides on 'compelling reasons' for not informing parliament in advance of the Houthi strikes support. The minister answers that the deployment rests on international law and Article 97, that the one staff officer falls outside the Article 100 framework, and that prior notification was withheld for operational security.
The letter of 12 January 2024 stated that the Minister of Defence and I did not inform the House in advance of the operation because of the confidentiality of the operation.
In de Kamerbrief van 12 januari 2024 is aangegeven dat de Minister van Defensie en ik de Kamer omwille van de vertrouwelijkheid van deze operatie niet voorafgaand aan de operatie hebben geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Dobbe over de doorvoer van onderdelen van F-35’s of andere wapensystemen aan Israël

An MP (Dobbe, SP) asked the ministers about the transit of F-35 parts and other weapons systems to Israel via Woensdrecht, including the amendments to the NL009 general licence, whether other weapon components were shipped after 7 October 2023, and whether the licence is subject to periodic review against EU export criteria. The ministers answered that the licence was amended in 2021 (technical) and 2024 (following a court ruling), that no other weapon parts are stored at the warehouse, that two individual licences were granted after 7 October, and that annual re-review of general licences is not required, though the government will appeal the court ruling.
An annual mandatory review of valid general licences against the EUGS criteria is not considered necessary by the cabinet.
Een jaarlijkse verplichte toets van de geldige algemene vergunningen aan de criteria van het EUGS acht het kabinet niet noodzakelijk
Antwoord op vragen van lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Utrecht bezuinigt miljoenen op zorg en ondersteuning: 'De financiële situatie is ernstig''

Party MP Dobbe asked the state secretary for health, welfare and sport how the government reacts to news that Utrecht is cutting millions from care and support, and whether central funding lags behind rising care demand, including the 2026 funding cliff. The state secretary replies that municipalities are financially autonomous and responsible for balanced budgets, points to ongoing talks on municipal finances, the Hervormingsagenda Jeugd, the reintroduction of income-dependent Wmo contributions from 2026 and a houdbaarheidsonderzoek of the Wmo 2015, but gives no municipal-level figures.
I do not have an overview of municipalities that intend to cut spending in the social domain.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht van gemeenten die voornemens zijn om te bezuinigen op het sociaal domein.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Grote zorgen bij medewerkers GGD Noord- en Oost-Gelderland: ‘Ik heb zoiets nog nooit eerder meegemaakt’'

An MP asked the state secretary for Health about reports of severe staffing and morale problems at GGD Noord- en Oost-Gelderland, including whether similar signals exist elsewhere, staff turnover, municipal funding, and structural solutions. The state secretary answered that the inspectorate has monitored the infectious disease unit since 2022 with improvements noted, that GGDs are primarily accountable to municipalities, and that broader public health reform will be discussed with a next cabinet.
Given the chosen division of responsibilities in the system, VWS sees no role for itself in carrying out such an investigation.
Vanwege de gekozen verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling in het stelstel ziet VWS geen rol voor zichzelf om dergelijk onderzoek op te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Meer jonge vrouwen op eerste hulp na zelfverwonding of suïcidepoging'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health about the reported 50 percent rise in young women treated at emergency departments for self-harm or suicide attempts, along with ongoing research, prevention measures, aftercare, and mental health care contracting and insurer waiting lists. The Minister attributed the trend to multiple societal causes, described existing prevention programmes and research, and answered that insurer contracting is improving with an evaluation planned for spring 2024.
Your House will be informed about the outcomes of this evaluation.
Uw Kamer wordt over de uitkomsten van deze evaluatie geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Kent over kernwapenoefeningen op luchtmachtbasis Volkel

MPs Dobbe and Van Kent asked whether the 312 squadron at Volkel takes part in NATO nuclear sharing, whether it has trained on the B61-12 bomb since 2021, and whether the F-16 is planned to carry it, and about the timing of F-35 transition and bomb deliveries. The ministers confirmed Nederland's NATO nuclear task at Volkel but declined to give details on training, transition timing, or weapons numbers and locations, citing security and alliance arrangements.
For security reasons, no statements can be made about details relating to the Netherlands' nuclear weapons task.
Om veiligheidsredenen kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over details die verband houden met de kernwapentaak van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dobbe over het bericht 'Bejaarden met dementie urenlang in hun eigen poep achtergelaten: ‘Onmenselijk hoe mijn moeder is behandeld’'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care about a newspaper report on residents with dementia left in soiled clothing for hours at care home Kalorama, and about its financial problems, understaffing, use of short-trained temporary staff, and whether staffing norms and care funding should be protected. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports Nederlandse interest via a letter to the Commission without formally responding to the call, that no funds are reserved for a gigafactory, and that reallocation within departmental budgets is being explored to meet the 30 June requirement.
Via a letter to the European Commission, the Ministry of Economic Affairs will then shortly support the importance of AI gigafactories and Dutch interest.

Six MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture whether the German Stoffstrombilanzverordnung, a nutrient balance regime for farms, could inform the Dutch design of an enforceable nutrient balance and emissions targets, and whether the Dutch government would engage German authorities and report back. The minister answered that the German scheme is similar to the planned Dutch balance, that Dutch data sources exist, that lessons will be drawn, and that the minister is willing to talk with Germany and inform parliament if this yields insights.
I am willing to discuss this with the German government. If this leads to additional insights, I will inform you about it.
Ik ben bereid hierover in gesprek te gaan met de Duitse overheid. Indien dit tot aanvullende inzichten leidt, zal ik u hierover informeren.

The minister said the label is no longer used, that no list of such farms exists or is shared, that the ministry lacks the farm-location data, and that the other points are for the policy process.
Because of uncertainty about the performance of low-emission stable techniques, my predecessor made an exception in October 2023 for two housing systems.

MP Holman asked the State Secretary for Agriculture about the NVWA's enforcement numbers (fines and warnings by sector, including slaughterhouses), whether its conduct is lawful and proportionate, staffing and work climate, and inspector discretion. The State Secretary gave detailed figures and largely stated that the NVWA acts lawfully and proportionately, promising to make the turnover-related fine more broadly applicable.
Yes. The NVWA acts within the framework of the law and of legal principles such as proportionality and equal treatment.
Ja. De NVWA treedt op binnen de kaders van de wet en van rechtsbeginselen zoals evenredigheid en rechtsgelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Holman over stikstofvergunning plasticfabrikant

MPs Van Campen and Holman asked the minister about a court ruling forcing the province of Brabant to reduce the unused nitrogen permit space of plastics producer Sabic, asking about legal basis, precedent, and national nitrogen policy. The minister answered that the court's order is conditional, that the province must decide anew, that precedent is only relevant if upheld on appeal, and that the government is pursuing structural emission reduction, while committing to inform parliament on a motion about intern salderen.
I will inform you shortly about the implementation of this motion.
Over de uitwerking van deze motie zal ik u op korte termijn informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Holman over de publicatie verkenning rekenkundige ondergrens gedaan door TNO en UvA

Opposition MPs Holman and Boomsma asked the agriculture minister whether the current 0.005 mol/ha/year nitrogen deposition threshold is scientifically justified, how quickly a justified threshold could be introduced, and what steps will ease permit granting and help PAS-melders before their 1 March 2025 deadline. Minister Wiersma answered that no scientifically justified threshold has yet been found, that follow-up research is being commissioned, and that she will set out next steps and timelines in the coming weeks, while the other questions are answered largely by reference to ongoing work.
In the coming weeks I will work out the next steps.
De komende weken ga ik de vervolgstappen uitwerken.

Asks the government to urge the NPO to publicly describe how each broadcast programme contributes to public broadcasting values.
to urge the NPO to publicly describe for each programme on public broadcasting how it contributes to the NPO's public values
om aan te dringen bij de NPO om bij ieder programma op de publieke omroep openbaar te beschrijven hoe dit programma bijdraagt aan de publieke waarden van de NPO
Motie van de leden Aartsen en Sneller over een onderzoek naar belemmerende voorwaarden voor radiozenders
Asks the government to investigate loosening or abolishing outdated licence conditions for commercial radio stations and report to parliament.
requests the government to investigate whether the restrictive conditions for commercial radio broadcasters can be eased or abolished
verzoekt de regering om te onderzoeken of de belemmerende voorwaarden voor commerciële radiozenders versoepeld dan wel afgeschaft kunnen worden
Motie van het lid Sneller c.s. over de NLPO-plannen voor een pilot voor een lokaal toereikend media-aanbod
Asks the government to validate the NLPO's plans for a pilot on local media provision, examine how it can be funded within current budgets, and inform the House soon.
requests the government to validate the NLPO's plans for such a pilot
verzoekt de regering, de plannen van de NLPO voor een dergelijke pilot te valideren
Motie van de leden Aartsen en Asscher over het voortbestaan van bibliotheken in kleine kernen
Asks the government to study how good regional examples of keeping libraries open can be applied more widely to secure libraries in small villages.
requests the government to investigate whether and how good examples from regional practice can be applied more broadly
verzoekt de regering, om te onderzoeken of en hoe goede voorbeelden uit de regionale praktijk breder toegepast kunnen worden
Motie van de leden Bergkamp en Aartsen over een nationaal museum voor de presentatie van design en designerfgoed
Asks the minister to ask the Raad voor Cultuur, in its advice on the future basic cultural infrastructure, whether a national design museum is possible.
requests the Minister, in the advice request to the Council for Culture on the upcoming basic infrastructure, also to explicitly inquire about the possibilities for a national museum
verzoekt de Minister, in de adviesaanvraag aan de Raad voor Cultuur over de komende basisinfrastructuur ook expliciet te informeren naar de mogelijkheden voor een nationaal museum
Motie van het lid Aartsen over ondersteuning van volkscultuur en immaterieel erfgoed
Asks the government to create a scheme within the Cultural Participation Fund supporting folk culture and intangible heritage, including associations, shooting clubs and guilds.
requests the government to develop a scheme within the Cultural Participation Fund supporting folk culture and intangible heritage
verzoekt de regering, om binnen het Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie een regeling te ontwikkelen ter ondersteuning van volkscultuur en immaterieel erfgoed
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls, Thijssen, Kröger, Kostić en Teunissen over de Joint Letter of Intent met Tata Steel, de fors hogere uitstoot van Tata Steel, staalslakken en de forse salarisverhogingen van direc

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA and the Partij voor de Dieren asked about Tata Steel's higher emissions in 2024, the Joint Letter of Intent with the state, executive pay rises amid job cuts, and steel slag use across the Netherlands. The government answered that the emission rise may reflect new measurements and reporting, that the permit procedure is still pending, that a steel slag taskforce and a reporting obligation are being set up, and that pay policy is for the company to decide, though the JLoI requires a reasonable pay policy to be specified later.
The cabinet understands that this article and its headline raise questions.
Het kabinet snapt dat dit artikel en deze kop vragen oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić en Koekkoek over de getekende Joint Letter of Intent met Tata Steel

MPs Kostić and Koekkoek asked about the signed Joint Letter of Intent with Tata Steel, covering government liability, the closure of the coke-oven plant KGF2, enforcement, health protection for residents, emissions history, and the €2 billion subsidy risk. The ministers answered that the JLoI contains only inspanningsverplichtingen with opzeggronden, that binding result obligations will follow in a later maatwerkafspraak, and that health goals and public consultation are part of the process.
Through the JLoI the parties can be held to the inspanningsverplichtingen, but the results cannot yet be enforced.
Door de JLoI kunnen partijen aan de inspanningsverplichtingen worden gehouden, maar kunnen de resultaten nog niet afgedwongen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over ‘de rechterlijke uitspraak dat Nederland burgers onvoldoende beschermt tegen landbouwgif’

MP Kostić asks the government how it will respond to a court ruling that the Netherlands inadequately protects residents from pesticide use near homes, including whether it will apply the precautionary principle, correct the Ctgb's approach, reinstate the pesticide bill and ban spraying near housing. The minister replies that the ruling is a non-final civil case with no direct effect on other crops, rejects the claim of failure by the legislature and the Ctgb, points to ongoing research and existing rules, and declines to commit to new bans or a fixed timeline.
The ruling is not final; a merits procedure and cassation are possible.
De uitspraak is niet onherroepelijk, o.a. een bodemprocedure en cassatie zijn mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over alternatieve plannen voor Tata Steel Nederland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the government about the Wijmond business case for alternative uses of the Tata Steel IJmuiden site, including financial risks of the Green Steel plan, reductions of pollution, soil remediation liability and housing and nature scenarios. The state secretary answers that the government remains committed to the Green Steel plan and ongoing negotiations, does not consider new research necessary, and declines to disclose negotiation details.
The cabinet cannot make further public statements about what forms part of the negotiations on tailored agreements.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar geen verdere mededelingen doen over wat onderdeel is van de onderhandelingen over maatwerkafspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de vervolging van Eternit door het Openbaar Ministerie

An SP MP asks the government about the criminal prosecution of Eternit for manslaughter, the performance of the government-funded Instituut Asbestslachtoffers (IAS) and whether a statutory asbestos fund is needed, and whether the 2016 asbestos ban bill will be re-submitted. The state secretary declines to comment on the prosecution (a matter for the court), rejects the claim that the IAS is failing, and says no new asbestos ban bill is planned given existing EU REACH rules and a voluntary roof-removal strategy.
It is for the court to judge in this case.
Het is aan de rechter om in deze zaak te oordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wingelaar over het Eindrapport Plastic Tafel

An MP asks whether the Plastic Table package reaches the 30% circular plastics goal for 2030, and about investment losses, bank confidence, the binding nature of measures, and industry 'game changers'. The government answers that the 30% figure is now an aspiration rather than a norm, that most measures are voluntary and effects uncertain, and that it is studying which proposals to legislate, while promising to report back on Prinsjesdag.
No overview is available of the number of investments, patents and capacity in chemical recycling and bio-based plastics production.
Er is geen overzicht beschikbaar van het aantal investeringen, patenten en capaciteit van chemische recycling en biogebaseerde productie van plastics.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Aartsen over de ontwikkelingen rondom zelfstandige zorgprofessionals (zzp’ers in de zorg) onder andere zoals beschreven in het artikel van RTL ’In maand tijd ruim 4000 minder zzp

MPs Tielen and Aartsen (VVD) asked ministers of Health and Social Affairs about the drop in self-employed care workers and the enforcement against bogus self-employment, asking for definitions, examples, signals from the sector, and flexibility options such as regional employment and VAT-exempt pools. The ministers answered that the legal test is the Civil Code employment definition applied to all circumstances, that model agreements remain valid until 2029, that the sector has so far reported limited effects, and that they are working with the sector on regional employment models and VAT clarification.
The cabinet will respond in the short term on the case examples drawn up by the LHV, as far as possible before the committee debate on self-employed workers of 3 April.
Over de hiervoor door de LHV opgestelde casuïstiek zal het kabinet op korte termijn reageren, voor zover mogelijk voor het commissiedebat zzp van 3 april a.s.

Antwoord op vragen die leden Aartsen, Inge van Dijk, Vijlbrief, Rikkers en Flach over het bericht “Hoge Raad: bij beoordeling of sprake is van arbeidsovereenkomst geldt geen rangorde tussen de mee te wegen omstandigheden

Five MPs asked the minister how the Supreme Court ruling that no hierarchy exists among factors in classifying employment, including entrepreneurship, affects the online tool hetjuistecontract.nl, Belastingdienst practice, government hiring of freelancers and the VBAR bill. The minister answered that the tool already covers external entrepreneurship, that no change or takedown is needed, that the Belastingdienst weighs all factors, and that the VBAR follow-up will be communicated soon.
Because, in line with the Supreme Court ruling, all factors are weighed in the web module, there is no reason to take the web module offline.
Omdat, in lijn met de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad, alle gezichtspunten worden meegewogen in de webmodule, is er geen reden om de webmodule offline te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Van Eijk over schijnzelfstandigheid bij de UHT

MPs Aartsen and Van Eijk (VVD) asked whether the UHT childcare benefits recovery body stopped working with self-employed contractors from 1 April 2025, why it withdrew its offer to pay fines for intermediaries, and how it assesses bogus self-employment under the Deliveroo criteria. The government answered that UHT still uses self-employed workers where legally possible, applies an internal risk framework, withdrew the fine-compensation offer after tax-compliance concerns, and sees no legal-certainty problem.
As you know, your House asked the government to implement as well as possible the motion of 1 October 2024 by MP Boon (PVV).
Zoals bekend heeft uw Kamer de regering gevraagd om zo goed mogelijk uitvoering te geven aan de Kamermotie van 1 oktober 2024
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het bericht “Belastingdienst weegt persoonlijk ondernemerschap zelden mee in oordeel over schijnzelfstandigheid. ‘Onjuiste toepassing’”

An MP asks whether the Tax Authority properly weighs the Deliveroo criterion of external entrepreneurship in assessing employment relationships, and whether its practice treats it as subordinate. The State Secretary answers that all criteria including external entrepreneurship are weighed holistically, that the Tax Authority follows the Supreme Court, and that it will clarify its online communication and case examples.
The Tax Authority assesses employment relationships using this framework and weighs all considerations, including external entrepreneurship.
De Belastingdienst beoordeelt arbeidsrelaties aan de hand van dit afwegingskader en weegt alle gezichtspunten inclusief het extern ondernemerschap mee.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen, Rikkers-Oosterkamp en Vijlbrief over signalen dat de belastingdienst zich niet houdt aan de handhavingsstrategie van de zachte landing en geen waarschuwingen geeft bij de handhavi

MPs from VVD, BBB and D66 asked whether the Tax Authority is following the agreed soft-landing enforcement strategy on sham self-employment, including giving warnings before audits. The State Secretary answered that such signals had not reached them, described the warning practice and the lack of formal registration, and provided the requested counts of visits and audits while promising to report progress in a separate letter.
The number of letters is not centrally registered.
Het aantal brieven wordt niet centraal geregistreerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen, Van Eijk en Flach over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst zelf zich niet gaat houden aan de wet DBA en van belastinggeld ook de boetes en naheffingen gaat betalen

MPs Aartsen, Van Eijk and Flach asked why the Dutch government's own Dienst Toeslagen (UHT, the childcare benefits restoration operation) would keep using potential bogus self-employed workers after 1 January 2025, despite rules requiring the rest of the market to stop, and whether it would pay fines and back-payments with public money. The government answered that it regrets the situation, will keep deploying such workers into 2025 and possibly 2026 to avoid delaying compensation, will offer brokers reimbursement of fines, has no budget provision for these, and will report on the scale of self-employed use across government later in 2025.
The cabinet does not consider it exemplary behaviour for government organisations to act in breach of the law.
Het kabinet vindt het niet van voorbeeldgedrag getuigen dat overheidsorganisaties in strijd met de wet handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Aartsen over de gepresenteerde Agenda voor Werkend Nederland

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Aartsen asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Agenda for Working Netherlands, covering middle incomes, the work-pays-more norm, marginal tax pressure, childcare costs, self-employed workers and the reachability of government services. The minister replied that the agenda is organised by policy domain, that existing and planned measures support middle incomes, and that many questions depend on case-by-case assessment or future decisions.
However, the cabinet does not follow a norm that workers always end up better off than non-workers.
Het kabinet volgt echter geen norm dat werkenden er altijd meer op vooruitgaan dan niet-werkenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het niet uitnodigen van zzp-vertegenwoordigers bij het Catshuis-overleg met de sociale partners van 21 november jl.

MP Aartsen asked why self-employed (zzp) organisations were not invited to the Catshuis consultation with social partners on 21 November 2024, and whether they are treated as full social partners. The minister answered that the consultation was with the central employer and employee organisations and the SER chair, that self-employed interests are handled through other consultations, and that no agreements were made on the labour market package, DBA enforcement, BAZ, Vbar or pensions.
However, no organisations representing only self-employed persons were invited to this consultation.
Er zijn voor dit overleg echter geen organisaties uitgenodigd die enkel zelfstandigen vertegenwoordigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over de keuzehulp van het ministerie van SZW over schijnzelfstandigheid

MP Aartsen asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the SZW webmodule for assessing employment relations (schijnzelfstandigheid), its legal status, its fit with the Deliveroo criteria, its relation to the entrepreneur check and proposed VBAR law, and consultation with self-employed groups. The minister replies that the webmodule is only an indication offering no legal certainty, that it is being reviewed in light of pending Supreme Court questions, and that the Rijk is tightening its approach to false self-employment.
No certainty can be derived from this indication.
Aan deze indicatie kan geen zekerheid worden ontleend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over de eisen van de vakbonden om minder te werken

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether a four-day work week with higher pay, demanded by unions, would reduce labour supply and the economy, and how this fits government policy to increase working hours. The minister answers that no macroeconomic calculation exists, that the effects are hard to quantify, promises an agenda for workers, and states that wage bargaining is for social partners and the government should not intervene in CAO agreements.
No macroeconomic calculation is available for the introduction of a four-day work week with wage increases.
Voor de invoering van een vierdaagse werkweek met loonstijging is geen macro-economische doorrekening beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het niet betrekken van zzp-organisaties bij de totstandkoming van het regeerprogramma

An MP asks why the government consulted employer and employee bodies but not self-employed (zzp) organisations when drafting the coalition programme, and whether it will invite zzp organisations to talks in the polder. The minister answers that the SER now has six reserved seats for self-employed representatives, that several self-employed organisations were consulted, and that the Stichting van de Arbeid is a private body that sets its own composition.
As indicated above, the position of self-employed persons in the SER has structurally improved with the recent expansion of seats.
Zoals hierboven aangegeven is de positie van zelfstandigen in de SER met de recente zeteluitbreiding structureel verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Rajkowski over de huiverigheid van werkgevers om kunstmatige intelligentie in te zetten

MPs Aartsen and Rajkowski asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and Economic Affairs about Dutch employers' reluctance to deploy AI, including its role in easing labour shortages, comparisons with Poland, Germany and Belgium, and government support. The ministers answered that AI offers productivity gains and labour-shortage relief, pointed to existing programmes (AiNed, ROBUST, NL AIC), and announced an SER advisory request and an exploration of an AI advisory council.
It is expected that a proposal will be sent to your House this autumn.
Naar verwachting wordt dit najaar een voorstel aan uw Kamer verstuurd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijk en Aartsen over het bericht van de Hoge Raad: ‘Gratis verstrekking gezonde lunchmaaltijden aan werknemers valt voor de loonbelasting onder de gerichte vrijstelling voor Arbovoorzie

MPs Van Eijk and Aartsen asked whether the Supreme Court ruling that free healthy lunches fall under the tax exemption for occupational health provisions should be read broadly, and what the government will do to stimulate such lunches. The State Secretary answered that the ruling concerns pre-2022 rules, that since 2022 the exemption covers only mandatory occupational health provisions, that employers can provide healthy lunches using the WKR free space, and that the government sees no need or plan to change tax law, though an Arbo-regulation simplification plan is underway.
The cabinet considers it a good initiative that employers invest in keeping their staff healthy by providing healthy lunch meals.
Het kabinet vindt het een goed initiatief dat werkgevers zich door gezonde lunchmaaltijden te verstrekken inzetten om hun personeel gezond te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het bericht ‘Veel ergernis over rechtszaken over verplicht pensioen: ’Dit is niet te doen voor ondernemers’’

MP Aartsen (VVD) asked the minister for Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about court disputes over mandatory industry pension participation, including criteria used in mandatory-participation decisions, retroactivity, faillissement and scope-definition problems. The minister declined to provide lists or counts she does not hold, stated that the scope is for social partners to define, and rejected a generic uniformity requirement while pointing to advisory tools.
