Procedures conducted between a mandatory industry pension fund and an employer are procedures to which my ministry is not a party.
Procedures die worden gevoerd tussen een verplichtgesteld bedrijfstakpensioenfonds en een werkgever zijn procedures waar mijn ministerie geen partij bij is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over "de representativiteit van werknemers tijdens het cao-proces"

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about declining union membership undermining representativeness at collective bargaining, and whether all workers should be involved in CAO negotiations. The minister replies that support for unions and CAOs is stable, that the SER advice is endorsed, and that existing scope for tailoring is sufficient, while promising broader dialogue on workers' involvement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen, Aartsen en Erkens over het bericht ‘Drugsmaffia biedt ‘hulp’ aan Limburgse horecaondernemers die sinds de watersnood problemen hebben’

Three VVD MPs asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that drug gangs were offering 'help' to Limburg hospitality businesses struggling after the 2021 floods, covering compensation, prevention, RIEC analysis, information sharing and cross-border criminal approaches. The minister answered that affected hospitality entrepreneurs awaited no pending compensation decision, described existing prevention campaigns and cooperation, and said no specific sector analysis or concrete RIEC signals existed.
Yes, the report is known to me.
Ja, het bericht is mij bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Aartsen over het bericht 'Rondtrekkende bendes vaker betrokken bij diefstallen in Nederland'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Aartsen asked the Justice Minister about reports that travelling criminal gangs are increasingly involved in thefts, including the share of non-Dutch suspects, cooperation with European and non-European countries, the Taskforce Mobiel Banditisme, Europol's role and prevention measures. The minister answered in detail that suspect data is limited, that a 25 percent figure applies only to cases where a suspect is identified, that existing cooperation and information-sharing mechanisms are adequate, and that the mobile banditry approach is now embedded in the Actieprogramma Veilig Ondernemen.
Yes, I will also address the progress of the approach to mobile banditry in the next half-yearly report.
Ja, ik zal in het volgende halfjaarbericht ook ingaan op de voortgang van de aanpak van mobiel banditisme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het bericht 'Bedrijven €200 mln. duurder uit door regels die ministeries vorig jaar invoerden'

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about reports that new government rules raised costs for businesses by €200 million, and about the Adviescollege Toetsing Regeldruk's (ATR) findings that regulatory burden is insufficiently addressed and that many draft laws were rated negatively. The Minister answers that regulatory burden is already actively monitored through ATR advice, MKB-tests and the Beleidskompas, that ATR advice is not binding, that a permanent ATR with an expanded role is being prepared, and that no central record is kept of where MKB-tests are skipped.
I am currently preparing a proposal for the founding law of the Adviescollege toetsing regeldruk.
Ik bereid op dit moment een voorstel voor de instellingswet voor het Adviescollege toetsing regeldruk voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over de toepassing van de MKB-toets bij wetgeving

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs for an overview of when the SME test (MKB-toets) was applied to new legislation this cabinet term, why it was skipped in some cases, and when all legislation would be tested for SME feasibility. The minister listed about 20 laws and regulations tested, said the test is targeted rather than mandatory for all legislation, and explained the 'apply or explain' rule and the grounds for not applying it, without centrally tracking skipped cases.
It is not centrally tracked for which legislation no SME test was carried out.
Er wordt niet centraal bijgehouden bij welke regelgeving er geen MKB-toets is gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Idsinga over de door de fiscus gestuurde aanmaning naar ondernemers

MPs Aartsen and Idsinga asked the State Secretary of Finance about the tax authority's letters warning entrepreneurs of payment arrears on corona tax debts, asking how many were sent, why the arrears amount was not stated, and how to avoid unnecessary warnings. The State Secretary answered that about 80,000 entrepreneurs received a letter, that the arrears amount was omitted because the system cannot compute it in mass mailings, and described a phased process including debt overviews, a helpline, and eventual withdrawal of payment arrangements.
The exact amount of the payment arrears was not included, because it is not possible for the Tax Authority to process this amount in mass messages.
Daarbij is niet het exacte bedrag van de betalingsachterstand opgenomen, omdat het voor de Belastingdienst niet mogelijk is dit bedrag in massale berichten te verwerken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over de uitspraak van het College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven van 20 september 2022 omtrent de Tegemoetkoming Vaste Lasten

MP Aartsen (VVD) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a CBb ruling that startup entrepreneurs were wrongly refused the TVL fixed-cost allowance for Q4 2020, asking how many were affected, why no remedy was given, and whether they will be compensated. The minister answered that the number affected cannot be determined, that earlier steps (a Q1 2021 starters scheme and a reference-period option from Q2 2021) were taken, and that the ruling does not require reopening decisions, which she says is no longer legally possible after the scheme ended.
How many of these companies were rejected due to the absence of the reference period is not known.
Hoeveel ondernemingen daarvan zijn afgewezen als gevolg van het ontbreken van de referentieperiode is niet bekend.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het gevaar dat er een Nederlands filiaal van de Londense shariarechtbank Al-Haddad wordt geopend en Nederlanders naar het VK afreizen om daar shariarecht te laten spreken

An MP asked the government whether a Dutch branch of the London sharia court Al-Haddad should be prevented, how many Dutch Muslims use sharia arbitration abroad, and what concrete steps will protect vulnerable women and neighbourhoods. The minister called religious courts overriding Dutch law unacceptable, said the Public Prosecution Service can act and that existing law allows dissolving organisations threatening public order, but said no data exists on use of foreign sharia courts and gave no new concrete measures.
I have no authority or legal basis to investigate this at the level of individuals.
Ik heb geen bevoegdheid of grondslag om hier, op persoonsniveau, onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Van Strien over het artikel 'Hoe Rick Engelkes coronamiljoenen incasseerde voor een spookmusical'

MPs Aartsen and Van Strien asked about a newspaper report that a producer received corona compensation for a ghost musical that was not scheduled in the corona period and had no tickets sold. The State Secretary explains the provisional allocation under Compensatieregeling 3, the Fonds Podiumkunsten's assessment, the later accountability and clawback process, and that no other signals of misuse have been received.
The Fonds Podiumkunsten assesses the accountability and can set the subsidy lower and recover funds.
Het Fonds Podiumkunsten beoordeelt de verantwoording en kan de subsidie lager vaststellen en middelen terugvorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over ondernemers die als gevolg van zwangerschap in de referentieperiode van de TVL, geen of verminderd aanspraak maken op TVL

MP Aartsen asked whether entrepreneurs who could not claim TVL corona support because pregnancy left them without representative reference-period revenue should be covered by the hardship clause, and whether they should be contacted. The minister answers that RVO's hardship commission cannot make categorical exceptions, but a targeted hardship clause was introduced for TVL Q4 2021 allowing an alternative reference quarter for those on pregnancy/childbirth leave.
Under this article it is not possible to make categorical exceptions to the conditions of the TVL.
Het is op grond van dit artikel niet mogelijk om categorale uitzonderingen op de voorwaarden van de TVL te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het feit dat RVO bij het toekennen van TVL kijkt naar groepsverbondenheid waardoor veel ondernemers amper tot geen coronasteun krijgen omdat ze meerdere zaken hebben

MP Aartsen asks why RVO considers group affiliation when granting the TVL fixed-cost subsidy, which leaves many entrepreneurs with several businesses with little or no support, and whether this is fair and can be changed retroactively. The minister answers that EU state-aid rules require treating affiliated companies as one undertaking subject to the aid ceiling, that SME groups can still apply per legal entity, and that large groups file one application per group, while declining to change the rules retroactively.
For that reason, RVO looks at group affiliation when granting TVL.
Om die reden kijkt RVO bij de toekenning van TVL naar groepsverbondenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Beukering-Huijbregts, Romke de Jong, Tielen en Aartsen over de signalen die zij ontvangen m.b.t. de steunmaatregelen voor zzp’ers

MPs asked whether municipalities impose wealth and viability tests on self-employed applicants for support beyond what the government intends, and about income losses and reskilling. The minister acknowledges reports of excessive information requests, says municipalities have decentralised responsibility and are being asked to limit requests to what is necessary, and largely defends the simplified Bbz scheme without reinstating the earlier TOZO.

Where signals reach the ministry that municipalities are requesting too much information, this is investigated, and if unnecessary information is indeed requested, the VNG is asked to contact the municipality concerned.

Daar waar bij het ministerie signalen binnenkomen dat gemeenten (te)veel informatie zouden uitvragen, wordt dit uitgezocht en als blijkt dat er inderdaad onnodige informatie wordt uitgevraagd, wordt de VNG verzocht contact hierover op te nemen met de betreffende gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Aartsen over "het rapport van de Nationale Ombudsman over ondernemers die in de knel komen als gevolg van corona"

MPs Romke de Jong and Aartsen asked the ministers about the Ombudsman's report on entrepreneurs in financial difficulty due to COVID support schemes, including TONK, SBI-code problems, debt relief and repayment. The State Secretary says the knelpunten are acknowledged, describes fixes (TONK budget doubled, SBI-code adjustments, second reference period, flexible repayment terms) and commits to assisting the Ombudsman.
I am always willing to assist the National Ombudsman in his investigation at his request.
Ik ben altijd bereid om de Nationale ombudsman op zijn verzoek bij te staan in zijn onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong en Aartsen over het bericht 'Winkelleegstand loopt snel op door corona'

MPs Romke de Jong and Aartsen asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about rising shop vacancy in big cities due to COVID-19, including the government's plans and support for municipalities. The State Secretary acknowledged the rising vacancy and negative effects, pointed to the Retailagenda platform, a G6 exploration with three ministries, and the 100 million euro Impulsaanpak Winkelgebieden, while offering no firm new commitments beyond ongoing work.
It is expected that the results of this will form the basis for a subsequent administrative process.
Naar verwachting zullen de resultaten hiervan de basis vormen voor een bestuurlijk vervolgtraject.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Aartsen over het bericht 'Booking paste bonusregels aan voor miljoenenbeloning top'

PVV MPs asked the State Secretary about plans for a reception centre for 200 asylum seekers and housing for 400 labour migrants in Deelen, questioning whether residents' concerns about nuisance and crime would be taken into account and whether the plan would be stopped. The State Secretary said talks with the municipality of Ede, COA and the owner are ongoing, that residents' concerns are being addressed in operating agreements, and that she rejects generalising asylum seekers as criminals while welcoming the extra reception capacity.
I dissociate myself from the suggestion that all asylum seekers are guilty of nuisance, crime or terror.
Ik neem afstand van de suggestie dat alle asielzoekers zich schuldig maken aan overlast, criminaliteit of terreur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en Aartsen over het bericht 'Coronavirus bereikt onze winkels: producten worden duurder'

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports of higher retail prices during the early coronavirus pandemic, including whether price regulation was applied, the causes of price rises, and shortages affecting medicines and medical supplies. The state secretary answered that no overviews of price-regulating firms are known, that no concrete signs of serious consumer harm have emerged, and pointed to general economic support packages and letters on medicine supply and stockpiling.
No overviews are known to me of businesses and shops that may have applied price regulation at the start of the coronavirus pandemic.
Mijn zijn geen overzichten bekend van bedrijven en winkels die mogelijkerwijs prijsregulering hebben toegepast aan het begin van de coronapandemie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Aartsen over de steunmaatregelen voor de bruine vloot

MPs Aukje de Vries and Aartsen (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about support measures for the historic sailing vessel ('bruine vloot') sector, including what was meant by statements at a March 2021 symposium, the delayed opening of the scheme, sector losses, EU state aid talks, consultations and reopening conditions. The State Secretary answered that the scheme would open around end of June 2021 after EU state aid talks led to using the de minimis regulation, that the sector lost about 77% of turnover in 2020, and that reopening steps are set out in the phased plan.
I understand the impatience of entrepreneurs and am glad that in my letter of 27 May 2021 I could indicate that the scheme is expected to open at the end of June.
Ik snap het ongeduld van ondernemers en ben blij dat ik in mijn brief van 27 mei 2021 hebben kunnen aangeven dat de regeling naar verwachting eind juni open kan worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Aartsen over de 'Reactie van de Kamer van Koophandel (KVK) op de petitie de Goede Zaak over privacy'

Two VVD MPs asked why the government is consulting on privacy of home addresses in the Trade Register rather than simply implementing their motion to shield residential addresses from public view, and whether the consultation scope and timeline are adequate. The state secretary answered that full implementation is not possible under EU law and Wwft obligations, that the motion is only partly feasible, that a broad consultation will explore all interests, and that a first indication of solutions is expected before the summer recess.
The motion cannot, as stated, be implemented in full because that is not (fully) possible.
De motie kan, zoals gezegd, niet onverkort worden uitgevoerd omdat dat niet (volledig) mogelijk is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Aartsen over de steunmaatregelen voor de bruine vloot

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate why a EUR 15 million support scheme for the historic 'bruine vloot' sailing charter fleet had not yet been opened, and when entrepreneurs would receive funds. The State Secretary answered that a supplementary scheme is still being developed, requires EU state-aid approval, and is expected to open by end of Q2 2021, while existing COVID support measures are also available to these entrepreneurs.
I am in discussion with the European Commission on whether this scheme fits within the state-aid frameworks for culture and preservation of heritage.
Ik ben met de Europese Commissie in gesprek of deze regeling past binnen de steunkaders voor cultuur en instandhouding van het erfgoed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Aartsen over de steunmaatregelen voor de bruine vloot

MPs Aukje de Vries and Aartsen asked the State Secretary about delays in the support scheme for the historic 'bruine vloot' sailing ships, mooring fees, and whether existing aid is sufficient. The State Secretary answered that a targeted scheme is being developed subject to European Commission approval, that existing TVL/TOGS aid already reaches many operators, and that some questions are deferred or fall to municipalities.

After a positive opinion from the Commission, the scheme can be further elaborated and published, and the House will be informed, after which the scheme, as announced in my letter of 17 February, can open at the end of the second quarter.

Na een positief advies van de commissie kan de regeling nader worden uitgewerkt, gepubliceerd en zal de Kamer worden geïnformeerd, waarna de regeling, zoals aangekondigd in mijn brief van 17 februari jl., eind tweede kwartaal kan worden opengesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het bericht dat de startersregeling Tegemoetkoming Vaste Lasten (TVL) pas medio mei open zal gaan

MP Aartsen asked why the TVL starter scheme for businesses registered between October 2019 and June 2020 will not open until mid-May, why Q4 2020 is not compensated, and what prospects exist for affected entrepreneurs. The state secretary explains that the scheme's design, EU pre-notification and system-building take time, that Q4 is not compensated to avoid double subsidy, and points to other measures and a forthcoming economic recovery letter.
I do not consider compensating the fourth quarter of 2020, whereby these companies would again receive double subsidy, defensible compared with other companies that can use only one of the schemes.

Ik vind het vergoeden van het vierde kwartaal van 2020, waarbij nog een keer al deze ondernemingen dubbele subsidie zouden ontvangen, niet verdedigbaar ten opzichte van andere ondernemingen, die slechts van één van de regelingen gebruik kunnen maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Aartsen over “signalen van kleine werkgevers die recht hebben op compensatie voor de transitievergoeding, maar niet in staat zijn de transitievergoeding vóór te financieren”

MPs Tielen and Aartsen asked the Minister of Social Affairs about small employers unable to prefinance the transition payment (transitievergoeding) for dismissals after long-term illness, and whether UWV could advance compensation. The Minister acknowledged the problems but refused to change the compensation schemes or allow UWV advance payments, citing legal and administrative complications, and said the start date of the illness-based scheme is not yet known.
However, it is not yet possible at this time to indicate when the compensation scheme for business termination due to illness of the employer can enter into force.
Het is op dit moment echter nog niet mogelijk om aan te geven wanneer de compensatieregeling bedrijfsbeëindiging wegens ziekte in werking kan treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Aartsen over ''pensioenfondsen die hurende ondernemers het vel over de oren halen''

MPs Amhaouch and Aartsen asked whether pension funds that own shops and restaurant premises are pressing tenant entrepreneurs hit by the COVID crisis with rent increases and indexation, and what the government will do. The minister says pension funds generally do not own such property, that most tenants reached individual accommodation deals, that pain should be shared fairly, and that the government keeps talking with the parties but leaves negotiations to private actors.
It is not centrally recorded how many and which pension funds own shop and restaurant premises, or how many and which invest in shop and restaurant property.
Er wordt niet centraal bijgehouden hoeveel en welke pensioenfondsen eigenaar zijn van winkel- en horecapanden en hoeveel en welke pensioenfondsen beleggen in winkel- en horecavastgoed.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over de passage in Kamerstuk 35420, nr. 235 waarin staat dat ondernemers tot eind maart moeten wachten tot zij TVL kunnen aanvragen vanwege het feit dat de Europese Commissie dan pa

An MP asked why TVL support for small businesses and non-SME firms was delayed until the European Commission approved the scheme, and whether advances could be paid meanwhile. The minister explained the Commission's approval timeline, that advance payments are not permitted under the General Administrative Law Act and EU Treaty rules, and that the scheme opened on 15 February.
It is not possible to pay advances because under the General Administrative Law Act subsidies may only be granted on the basis of a statutory provision.
Het is niet mogelijk voorschotten uit te betalen omdat volgens de Algemene wet bestuursrecht subsidies alleen op grond van een wettelijk voorschrift mogen worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Aartsen en Van der Linde over de problemen die vuurwerk-ondernemers ondervinden bij het verkrijgen van voorfinanciering bij banken

MPs asked whether fireworks entrepreneurs face refusals of pre-financing by banks, whether state guarantees could help, and when compensation for storage and transport costs will be paid. The government answered that existing guarantee schemes are available, that only one concrete case of bank refusal is known, and that the fireworks subsidy (TSVC-19) will open for applications from 31 March to 3 May 2021 with payments after the window closes.
I am aware of one concrete case where this was directly related to (im)possibilities for pre-financing in relation to the design of the compensation scheme.
Ik ben bekend met één concrete casus waarbij dit direct samenhing met (on)mogelijkheden voor voorfinanciering in relatie tot de vormgeving van de compensatieregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Aartsen over het bericht 'gemeente als huurbaas geen pretje'

MPs Koerhuis and Aartsen (VVD) asked whether it is true that businesses cannot negotiate lower rent with the municipality of Amsterdam, whether other large municipalities have similar policies, and whether municipalities should be urged to give tenants tailored relief during COVID. The state secretary replied that Amsterdam offers rent deferral, interest-free repayment and cancellation for bankrupt tenants, and announced a 10 million euro fund for rent discounts, but gave no overview of other municipalities and said municipalities must decide their own role.
No overview is available of the rent discount policy for businesses during the coronavirus period of all municipalities with more than 100,000 inhabitants.
Er is geen overzicht beschikbaar van het beleid inzake huurkorting voor ondernemers in coronatijd van alle gemeenten met meer dan 100.000 inwoners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen, Tielen en Nijkerken-De Haan over problemen die ondernemers ervaren bij het lopende steun- en herstelpakket

Three VVD MPs asked the government about business complaints over implementation problems in the COVID support packages (TVL, NOW, starters, TONK), including quarterly calculation, excluded starters, events and retail schemes, and capacity. The State Secretary answered that the government is aware of gaps, lists sector consultations and adjustments made, explains why monthly calculation and full starter support were not feasible, and promises further information and wider publicity on the TONK.
At present the cabinet has no insight into the size of this group or exactly which businesses fall under it.
Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen zicht op de grootte van deze groep en welke bedrijven hier precies onder vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini over het bericht "Bruine vloot op de waakvlam – verdeling van 15 miljoen euro ingewikkeld en tijdrovend"

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers why the EUR 15 million support scheme for the historic 'bruine vloot' sailing charter fleet is complex and slow, and when shipowners will get clarity. The government answered that generic COVID support has been extended and that a separate subsidy for unique maintenance and operating costs of historic ships is being developed, with timing to be set with RVO.nl.
I will inform your House about this.
Hierover zal ik uw Kamer informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over de uitspraak van het College van Beroep voor Bedrijfsleven (CBB) die ondernemers die bezwaar hebben gemaakt tegen de afwijzing van coronasteun in het gelijk heeft gesteld

An MP asked the State Secretary about CBB rulings that entrepreneurs must be assessed on all SBI codes, not just the first, when denied TVL corona support, and about how many objections and cases are pending. The government confirmed RVO will re-assess the three cases and some objections, promised to inform affected entrepreneurs, but gave no firm timeline and said the CBB controls its own ruling schedule.
All entrepreneurs who have objected on this point will be informed of this.
Alle ondernemers die op dit punt bezwaar hebben gemaakt zullen hier over worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Middendorp en Aartsen over de uitvoering van de compensatieregeling eHerkenning

VVD MPs asked why businesses that obtained standard eHerkenning before the special Belastingdienst login became available must downgrade it, possibly at cost, to claim compensation, and about the status of the scheme. The Secretary of State answered that downgrading is free at five of six providers, that 1014 claims had been filed and paid by 25 January 2021 (no split by route possible), and that the Belastingdienst contacted about 540 organisations unable to register in the Trade Register.
RVO cannot see, when logging in with the specific eHerkenning Belastingdienst means, whether this was first a generic eH3 login means.
RVO kan bij het inloggen met het specifieke «eHerkenning Belastingdienst» middel niet zien of dit eerst een generiek te gebruiken eH3 inlogmiddel is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini over het bericht 'Soarch by brune float: Taseine 15 miljoen stipe is der noch hieltyd net'

Three VVD MPs asked why their earlier questions on the EUR 15 million aid scheme for the charter 'brown fleet' shipping operators remain unanswered, why the scheme is delayed, and when operators will receive funds. The item is a notice that the questions were answered during the 26 January 2021 model question hour, with the answers not reproduced in this text.

The written questions from MPs Aukje de Vries, Aartsen and El Yassini (all VVD) on the report 'Soarch by brune float: Taseine 15 miljoen stipe is der noch hieltyd net' were answered during the model question hour of 26 January 2021.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Aartsen en El Yassini (allen VVD) over het bericht «Soarch by brune float: Taseine 15 miljoen stipe is der noch hieltyd net' zijn beantwoord tijdens het modelinge vragenuur van 26 januari 2021
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Koopmans en Aartsen over 'Spanje wil tweede instorting toerisme voorkomen'

MPs Dijkstra, Koopmans and Aartsen (VVD) asked whether safe travel corridors and rapid testing could revive tourism, following reports on Spain's Semana Santa operation, and how the EU and other parties could set criteria. The minister said the current COVID situation rules out reopening tourism now, promised to make necessary travel safer via negative test certificates and a possible shorter quarantine, and said a possible Schiphol–Atlanta corridor is being explored.
Therefore, at this moment there is no question of restarting tourism.
Daarom is op dit moment geen sprake van het weer op gang helpen van toerisme.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Aartsen over het bericht Providers gaan bedrijven waarschuwen voor beveiligingslekken'

MPs Yesilgoz-Zegerius and Aartsen asked whether the NBIP, designated as an OKTT, can receive threat information from the NCSC and why the Digital Trust Center cannot yet do so for non-vital businesses. The government answers that NCSC can already share threat information with NBIP within legal limits, that a DTC designation is being prepared with a target start early next year, and that a WODC study on the landelijk dekkend stelsel has been commissioned.
The Ministry of EZK is working on the preparatory work for this. The aim is for this new service to start early next year.
Het Ministerie van EZK is bezig met de voorbereidende werkzaamheden hiervoor. Het streven is dat deze nieuwe dienstverlening begin volgend jaar kan starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het bieden van perspectief aan ondernemers na de gedeeltelijke lockdown en het onderzoek naar aanleiding van het OMT-advies over restaurants

An MP from the VVD asked the government how it would respond to the OMT advice on restaurants and the promised talks with hospitality and events sectors about prospects after the partial lockdown, including progress on FieldLab initiatives. The government answered that talks with sector representatives are ongoing, that segmented measures are being discussed, that FieldLab programmes for events are being developed with a possible start in January, and that the RIVM advice on the events FieldLab is pending.
The cabinet would like sectors to come forward with new initiatives if these can offer new prospects.
Het kabinet ziet graag dat sectoren zich melden met nieuwe initiatieven als die nieuwe perspectieven kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen, Van den Bosch en Veldman over het toestaan en mogelijk maken van winterterrassen als reddingsboei voor horecaondernemers

VVD MPs asked whether winter terraces with covers and heaters could serve as a lifeline for hospitality businesses, whether municipalities should be encouraged to allow them, and what rules apply to tents and canopies under Covid measures. The government agreed terraces help and that municipalities should weigh allowing them, said it is a local decision, and explained that open-sided terraces count as outdoor locations, though it keeps no overview of municipal decisions.
Such an overview is not kept.
Een dergelijk overzicht wordt niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Van der Linde over een tweede betaalpauze door banken

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs whether banks' refusal of a second generic payment holiday during the second lockdown, and the shift to case-by-case support, endangers viable firms, and how DNB's financial stability warnings and the Tax Authority's payment arrangements are handled. The minister answered that banks now assess clients individually, that the financial sector is resilient, and that the government is extending support schemes and debt-relief measures for entrepreneurs.

The cabinet will make efforts in the coming period to develop joint guidelines with large creditors, including banks, for a more flexible treatment of restructuring requests from entrepreneurs affected by the corona crisis.

Het kabinet spant zich de komende periode in om met grote schuldeisers, waaronder de banken, gezamenlijke richtlijnen te ontwikkelen voor een soepelere behandeling van saneringsverzoeken van ondernemers die door de coronacrisis zijn geraakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Aartsen over het bericht 'Na corona komt het foute geld'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Security and Economic Affairs ministers how the government protects businesses weakened by COVID-19 against criminal 'foute helpers' and dirty money, and what has been done after a RIEC survey found about 10 percent of entrepreneurs had been approached by an unknown investor. Minister Grapperhaus replied that awareness campaigns, public-private platforms and the Actieprogramma Veilig Ondernemen are under way, that EU-level work is being pursued, and that the topic will be raised at the December JBZ Council, but the answer was late and gives no concrete new legislative or oversight measures.
I acknowledge that as a result of the coronavirus pandemic, the risks of abuse by criminals towards businesses are increasing.
Ik onderken dat als gevolg van de coronapandemie risico’s van misbruik door criminelen richting het bedrijfsleven toenemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Van den Bosch over de problemen in de kermisbranche en dat er ondanks de versoepelingen veel kermissen niet doorgaan

Two VVD MPs asked why many fairground events were not going ahead after the July 2020 easing of COVID rules, asking about economic damage, municipal reasoning, safe 'corona-proof' organisation and central support. The government answered that roughly half of fairs could proceed, that permitting is a municipal matter in consultation with safety regions, and that the national government and VNG provide handreikingen and platform support without taking over the decision.
Granting permits for a fair is a local matter, and the evaluation is that initially it is as well.
De vergunningverlening van een kermis is een lokale aangelegenheid en de evaluatie is dat in eerste instantie ook.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Veldman over de registratieplicht in de horeca en de mogelijkheid om mensen te weigeren die niet mee werken aan de registratieplicht

MPs Aartsen and Veldman asked whether hospitality operators may refuse guests who do not cooperate with the COVID-19 contact-registration obligation, and about how details of that obligation were communicated and whether operators were involved. The state secretary answered that guests cannot be refused for withholding contact data because consent must be voluntary under the GDPR, while refusal is allowed for breaches of safety rules such as the 1.5-metre distance, and that operators were not involved in drafting the obligation but were informed in advance.
It is very important that hospitality operators can ensure the measures to combat infections are properly implemented.
Het is heel belangrijk dat horecaondernemers ervoor kunnen zorgen dat de maatregelen om besmettingen tegen te gaan, goed uitgevoerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het bericht ‘Strandpaviljoens mogen deze winter blijven staan, maar geen omzet draaien’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the decision to let beach pavilions stay up over winter without trading, and whether beach operators fall under her responsibility and what savings and extended opening would mean. The government replied that responsibility is shared across ministries and provinces/municipalities, that staying up is a one-off measure with conditions, and that it cannot give specific figures or commit to extended winter opening, though other aspects are still being worked out.
I cannot give you specific information on how much savings this yields for the beach pavilion operator.
Ik kan u geen specifieke informatie geven hoeveel besparing dit voor de strandpaviljoenhouder oplevert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Banken klagen over hoge kosten Geldmaat’

MPs Van der Linde and Aartsen asked why Geldmaat's ATM fee rates are confidential, whether smaller banks pay the same per-transaction fees, and how this fits competition law. The minister answered that the rates are kept confidential for commercial reasons, that smaller banks should keep open and non-discriminatory access, and that the government and ACM are monitoring the issue, with no firm new measure yet.
These mutually agreed rates were not published because of their commercially confidential nature.
Deze onderling overeengekomen tarieven werden niet gepubliceerd vanwege het bedrijfsvertrouwelijke karakter hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer, Aartsen en Van der Linde over het bericht 'AFM waarschuwt voor schulden bij leasen van een auto of wasmachine’

MPs asked the government about AFM warnings on debt risks from private leasing of cars and appliances, including its size, contract terms, consumer information, BKR registration and whether it should fall under AFM supervision. The minister answered that private lease is unregulated and growing, outlined existing self-regulation and information, and committed to talks with market parties and the AFM on possible measures.
I will ask the AFM and other relevant parties to provide more insight into, among other things, the growth of private lease, the causes of this growth and the risks for consumers.
Ik zal de AFM en andere relevante partijen vragen om meer inzicht te geven in onder andere de groei van private lease, de oorzaken van deze groei en de risico's voor consumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Aartsen over de berichten ‘VS van plan uit WTO-onderdeel te stappen‘ en ‘Chinese bussen kunnen bij aanbesteding niet worden geweerd‘

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether Dutch and provincial authorities can exclude bidders from non-GPA countries such as China from public tenders, and about reports the US may leave the WTO procurement agreement. The government replied that exclusion of non-GPA bidders is legally possible under EU and WTO rules, that the Noord-Holland and Overijssel bus cases involved private purchases rather than tenders, and that it is pursuing an International Procurement Instrument while supporting the GPA.
It is possible for Dutch and other European contracting authorities to reject bids from third countries that are not party to the WTO Government Procurement Agreement.
Het is voor Nederlandse en andere Europese aanbestedende diensten mogelijk om inschrijvingen te weigeren uit derde landen die geen partij zijn bij de Overeenkomst inzake overheidsopdrachten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht 'Politie waarschuwt voor vals geld met carnaval, mogelijk via AliExpress gekocht'

MPs Aartsen and Yeşilgöz-Zegerius asked about police warnings on counterfeit 50-euro notes possibly bought via AliExpress, and what is being done about such platforms and fraud. The minister answers that counterfeit sales are illegal and monitored by customs, police and DNB, that DNB has asked several Dutch parties to stop offering unauthorised reproductions, that a meeting with Alibaba is pending, and that public information already exists so no extra campaign is planned.
I therefore cannot report (monthly) on the offer on an individual platform.
Ik kan daarom niet (maandelijks) rapporteren over het aanbod op een individueel platform.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Yeşilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht ‘Ondernemers durven politie niet in te schakelen en zwijgen over afpersing‘

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Aartsen asked about reports that entrepreneurs do not report extortion to police, including how many reported cases and advice-line contacts exist and what will be done to raise reporting and protection. Minister Grapperhaus answered with registration figures, advice-line statistics, outreach efforts and a promise to inform the Chamber further on a public-private approach.
I am consulting with partners on how reports from entrepreneurs can be handled in an accessible and safe way.
Ik ga met partners in overleg over hoe meldingen van ondernemers op een toegankelijke en veilige manier kunnen worden opgepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wiersma en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Hoe de Facebook-CEO zichzelf zou inperken‘

Two VVD MPs asked the government about a report on Facebook's CEO resisting regulation, algorithm audits, tax reform for tech firms, unfair competition from big tech, innovation effects of acquisitions, and tech employment in the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered each question, mostly stating existing policy, pointing to ongoing EU and OECD processes, and making a moral appeal to tech firms, without committing to new concrete measures.
For the latest state of affairs I refer you to the State Secretary of Finance.
Voor de laatste stand van zaken verwijs ik u graag naar de Staatssecretaris van Financiën
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Belastingdienst heeft geen btw-id voor starters: 'Ik zit weken op zwart zaad'

Two VVD MPs asked why startup sole traders were waiting weeks for VAT identification numbers and what the government would do about backlogs, staffing and the Belastingtelefoon. The State Secretary answered that the two-week target is not being met for some, that backlogs have been cleared, that extra capacity was deployed, and that the new number system was introduced for privacy reasons with a fully new system timing still undetermined.
There is currently no exact date that can be given for when the entirely new system will be built and implemented.
Er is op dit moment nog geen exacte datum aan te geven wanneer het geheel nieuwe systeem gebouwd en geïmplementeerd gaat worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over de nieuwe Kleine Ondernemersregeling (KOR)

MPs Lodders and Aartsen asked the State Secretary for Finance about the low uptake of the new small-business VAT scheme (KOR), the basis for the 200,000 estimate, the lack of VAT on invoices, the EUR 20,000 threshold and the three-year lock-in, and whether the scheme would be adjusted. The State Secretary answered that the scheme is an administrative simplification, that the threshold was chosen for budget neutrality, that uptake will only be assessed in an evaluation in 2021, and that no change is currently planned.

As indicated in the answer to question 6, it can only be determined after the announced evaluation to what extent the number of registered entrepreneurs (positively or negatively) deviates from the expected number and what the possible cause is.

Zoals aangegeven bij het antwoord op vraag 6 kan pas na afloop van de aangekondigde evaluatie vastgesteld worden in hoeverre het aantal aangemelde ondernemers (positief of negatief) afwijkt van het verwachte aantal en wat daar mogelijk de oorzaak van is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Kamer van Koophandel vertrekt uit Drenthe’

Two MPs asked the state secretary about the closure of the Chamber of Commerce office in Emmen, Drenthe, and whether startups can register without visiting a branch. The state secretary answered that closure is part of a planned national reorganisation toward five physical offices and more digital services, and declined to reverse the decision or introduce an alternative registration route soon.
It is not desirable that a different option for starting entrepreneurs to register with the KVK comes available in the short term.
Het is niet wenselijk dat er op korte termijn een andere mogelijkheid voor startende ondernemers komt om zich te kunnen inschrijven bij de KVK.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Wiersma en Aartsen over de berichten ‘Alibaba zwemt in het geld na beursgang in Hongkong’ en ‘Tarieven voor pakjes uit China verhogen’

Three VVD MPs asked about Alibaba's Hong Kong listing and higher postal tariffs for China parcels, raising unfair competition, product safety and CE-marking enforcement. The state secretary replied that tariff harmonisation applies from 2020 with a phased self-declared rate system to 2021, that the EU should use its market power and possibly stricter oversight of platforms, and that the government is consulting the SER and the Commission on platform liability.
The cabinet believes the EU should better use its market power to enforce a level playing field in trade with third countries through new and existing instruments.
Het kabinet vindt dat de EU haar marktmacht beter moet inzetten om met nieuwe en bestaande instrumenten een gelijk speelveld in de handel met derde landen af te dwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Middendorp en Aartsen over de eHerkenning en het artikel ‘MKB en VNO-NCW: gedupeerden nieuw aangiftesysteem compenseren’

MPs Lodders, Middendorp and Aartsen (VVD) asked the Finance, Interior and Economic Affairs ministers about internal resistance at the Tax Administration to eHerkenning, its costs, the fate of about 60,000 businesses lacking a suitable login, and whether small firms can keep filing free. State Secretary Vijlbrief answered that concerns were addressed, that about 540 organisations cannot obtain eHerkenning, that proactive deadline extensions and an older portal for VAT remain, and that a further letter on support for small firms would follow.
The Tax Administration proactively grants extensions to employer-liable businesses that are legal entities and last filed via the old business portal.

De Belastingdienst verleent proactief uitstel voor ondernemers die aangifteplichtig zijn voor de loonheffingen, rechtspersoon zijn en hun laatst ingediende aangifte hebben gedaan via het oude ondernemersportaal van de Belastingdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over het niet meer kosteloos doen van loonaangifte voor ondernemers door de invoering van eHerkenning

Two VVD MPs asked why employers must now use eHerkenning, which costs roughly 40 to 45 euro, to file payroll returns for free-of-charge tax filing, and whether this conflicts with the goal of reducing administrative burden. The minister replied that the government chose mandatory eHerkenning for sensitive payroll data under the Wet digitale overheid, that costs are shared among users and providers, and that the scheme reduces burden with frequent use, but offered no reconsideration.

That is why, for payroll returns from 1 January 2020, the security level 'substantial' applies and a login means with a corresponding reliability level must therefore be used, in this case eHerkenning level 3.

Daarom geldt ter zake van loonaangiften per 1 januari 2020 beveiligingsniveau «substantieel» en moet dus gebruik worden gemaakt van een inlogmiddel met een overeenkomstig betrouwbaarheidsniveau, in dit geval eHerkenning niveau 3.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Aartsen over de berichten ‘Hoe T-Mobile zichzelf in de voet schoot met omweg dataverkeer’ en ‘Klachten bij toezichthouder over traag internet bij T-Mobile‘

MPs Weverling and Aartsen asked the State Secretary about reports that T-Mobile routed Dutch data traffic via Germany, lowering response speed, and about net neutrality and the role of the ACM. The State Secretary answered that the rerouting was largely reversed, that the ACM is independent and may examine interconnection under net neutrality rules, and that no further investigation of other providers is planned.
The ACM is an independent regulator. For the sake of that independence, I do not consider it appropriate to comment on the desirability of any investigation.
De ACM is een onafhankelijk toezichthouder. Ten behoeve van die onafhankelijkheid acht ik het niet verstandig om mij uit te laten over de eventuele wenselijkheid van enig onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Aartsen over het bericht dat een Chinees bedrijf een aanbesteding voor het aanleggen van een metrolijn in Stockholm heeft gewonnen

MPs Weverling and Aartsen asked whether Chinese state-owned firms bidding below cost on European public tenders, such as a Stockholm metro contract, distort competition and whether the government will act on reciprocity. The government answered that existing EU procurement rules allow abnormally low bids to be rejected, that it supports the EU International Procurement Instrument and a level playing field instrument, but gave only general commitments and referred to earlier letters.
The cabinet is currently pursuing a non-discriminatory instrument aimed at promoting a level playing field to address this problem.
Het kabinet zet momenteel in op een non-discriminatoir instrument gericht op het bevorderen van een gelijk speelveld om dit probleem wel te adresseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over de te lange betaaltermijnen van grote bedrijven aan kleine ondernemers

An MP asks the State Secretary about large companies paying small and medium businesses late, with payment terms rising to 41.4 days, and urges shortening the statutory term to 30 days, stronger enforcement and possible fines or reprimands. The government says the figures show no improvement, will tighten the rules once the evaluation of the Wet betalingstermijnen grote bedrijven is completed, and expects to report around the turn of the year.
I expect to be able to inform the House around the turn of the year about the outcomes of this.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer rond de jaarwisseling te kunnen informeren over de uitkomsten hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over de Wet modernisering kleineondernemersregeling (KOR)

MPs Lodders and Aartsen asked about the implementation of the modernised small business scheme (KOR), its turnover threshold of €20,000, and the consequences of a CJEU ruling on margin-scheme dealers. The State Secretary answered that the scheme takes effect on 1 January 2020, outlined the communication campaign, defended the threshold as budget-neutral and comparable within the EU, and said the scheme will be evaluated and the threshold adjusted if warranted.
However, it is necessary that the new article 24 of the Implementing Decree VAT 1968, as it would enter into force on 1 January 2020, be withdrawn.
Wel is het noodzakelijk dat het nieuwe artikel 24 Uitvoeringsbeschikking OB 1968, zoals dat in werking zou treden per 1 januari 2020, wordt ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Nijkerken- de Haan over regeldruk bij volkscultuur en het adviesrapport Vermindering regeldruk bij evenementen in Limburg

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about red tape on volkscultuur (folk culture) events, citing a Limburg province report on regulatory burdens for organisers. The minister acknowledged the pressure of regulation on folk culture and immaterieel erfgoed communities, and committed to a round table with the Ministry of Interior and the Limburg province to identify bottlenecks and draft an action plan.
I agree with you that folk culture and intangible cultural heritage inspire.
Ik ben met u eens dat volkscultuur en immaterieel erfgoed inspireren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Kwint over tal van constructies om het salarisplafond (WNT-norm) bij de publieke omroep te omzeilen

MPs Aartsen and Kwint asked whether public broadcasters use contracting constructions, such as external producers paying presenters, to circumvent the WNT salary cap, and how side-job registers are kept and published. The minister answered that he has no overview of the contracts, that the broadcasters report no such constructions, and that oversight of the Governance Code and registers lies with CIPO and the Commissariaat voor de Media.
Because contracts do not have to be submitted to me, I have no overview.
Omdat overeenkomsten niet aan mij voorgelegd hoeven te worden, heb ik geen overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Aartsen, Van der Molen en Van der Graaf over de problemen bij het Commissariaat voor de Media

MPs from D66, VVD, CDA and ChristenUnie asked the minister about problems at the Commissariaat voor de Media, including a reprimand of a board member, his side job at Mail.ru, the handling of a dismissed member, and the continuity of the board. The minister acknowledged inadequate information provision, said no consequences were attached to the reprimand, defended the Mail.ru side job as not objectionable for now, and promised to review the wachtgeld and side-job rules with the new chair.
However, I conclude that in this case the provision of information was not sufficient, as it has since emerged that I did not have certain information.
Wel concludeer ik dat in dit geval de informatievoorziening niet voldoende was nu achteraf is gebleken dat ik bepaalde informatie niet had.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Van der Linde en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Veel schade door ‘bitcoin-advertenties’ met nepuitspraken BN’ers’

MPs from the VVD asked ministers about misleading bitcoin advertisements using fake quotes from well-known Dutch people, the scale of resulting harm, whether police, prosecutors, the AFM and social media platforms can act, and what tools exist to identify advertisers and protect consumers and the persons whose names are misused. The government answered that the advertisers are unknown, reported about 1.7 million euro in reported damage, explained existing criminal, consumer-law and civil remedies, and said crypto-assets generally fall outside AFM supervision and no new national regulation is advised.
It is not known who or which organisations commissioned the placement of these misleading advertisements.
Het is niet bekend wie of welke organisaties opdrachtgever zijn van plaatsing van deze misleidende advertenties.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Lodders over volkscultuur die door de Belastingdienst ongelijk wordt behandeld, als niet cultuur wordt erkend en zodoende geen gebruik kan maken van het gunstige lage btw-tarief

Two VVD MPs asked whether folk culture (parades, carnival associations, shooting guilds) is treated unequally by the Tax Authority, which allegedly does not recognise it as culture and so excludes it from the reduced 9% VAT rate. The State Secretary answers that the VAT rate depends on a closed list in Tabel I of the Wet OB, not on recognition of culture, so there is no unequal treatment and folk culture can qualify where it meets the listed activities.
As the enumeration of these items shows, there is no distinction by type of culture in applying the reduced rate.
Zoals uit de opsomming van deze posten blijkt, bestaat er bij de toepassing van het verlaagde tarief geen onderscheid in het soort cultuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Middendorp over de bunker Seyss Inquart

MPs Aartsen and Middendorp asked why the sale and repurposing of the Seyss-Inquart bunker proceeds before the government's promised vision and action plan on WWII heritage, and how this relates to the Beckerman motion. The State Secretary replied that a Nota van Uitgangspunten is not a final sale, that no irreversible steps will be taken before 1 October 2019, and that the sale continues while the motion is implemented in that sense.

No irreversible steps are being taken in the current sale process before the Minister of Education, Culture and Science has presented the promised vision and action plan on Second World War heritage (by 1 October 2019 at the latest).

Er worden geen onomkeerbare stappen gezet in het onderhavige verkoopproces, vóórdat de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (OCW) de toegezegde visie met actieplan voor het erfgoed van de Tweede Wereldoorlog heeft gepresenteerd (uiterlijk 1 oktober 2019).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Lodders over het bericht dat journalisten aangifte moeten doen

Two VVD MPs asked the minister whether journalists threatened in Flevoland can easily file criminal complaints, and whether police could refuse to record threats as too hard to prove. The minister condemned threats against journalists, said a complaint must always be possible, outlined an action plan with police and prosecutors, and noted a new reporting point and tougher sentencing guideline.
A journalist, or anyone else, who wishes to file a complaint about a criminal offence must have the opportunity to do so in all cases.
Een journalist, of ieder ander, die aangifte wil doen van een strafbaar feit, moet daar in alle gevallen de mogelijkheid toe hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf , Aartsen en Van der Molen over de werkwijze van het NPO-fonds

MPs asked the Minister of Education and Media about the opaque NPO Fund procedure, including anonymous advisory committee members, undisclosed committee composition, possible conflicts of interest and limited objection options. The Minister answered that the NPO board is responsible for the procedure, that NPO keeps anonymity to protect advice quality, that conflicted members are excluded, and that the fund will better publicize existing exclusion and discussion options.
The working method and procedure of the NPO Fund is the responsibility of the NPO board of directors.
De werkwijze en procedure van het NPO-fonds is voor verantwoordelijkheid van de raad van bestuur van de NPO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het bericht dat de beloning van Van Nieuwkerk binnen de regels is en geen schijnconstructie

MP Aartsen asked the minister whether NPO's review of the pay of presenter Van Nieuwkerk and BNNVARA ignored possible use of outside producer MediaLane, why NTR outsourced College Tour, and about costs and disclosure. The minister said the NPO review found no pay construction, the outsourcing was a business decision, costs rose only modestly, and cost detail is reported at genre level.
Reporting costs per programme adds no value to transparency about salaries.
Opgave van de kosten per programma heeft geen toegevoegde waarde voor de openheid over salarissen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Aartsen en Laan-Geselschap over het kraken van het Fort bij Velsen in de gemeente Beverwijk door oud-ADM-krakers

VVD MPs asked whether the government will act against squatters who occupied the listed Fort bij Velsen, whether the owner filed a complaint, and whether monumental buildings should get priority for eviction and damage recovery. Minister Grapperhaus said squatting is illegal, the owner filed a report, a court allowed eviction, and no change to prosecutorial priorities for monuments is planned, while withholding details on individual cases.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele zaken doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Koopmans over het bericht dat de Egyptische ambassade het Couperushuis in Den Haag in verval laat

MPs Aartsen and Koopmans asked whether foreign embassies in The Hague are letting monumental buildings, including the Egyptian embassy at the Couperushuis, fall into disrepair, and what can be done given diplomatic inviolability. The minister answered that the municipality supervises upkeep, that the ministry escalates via diplomatic channels and recall as a last resort, that the Egyptian embassy has explained its steps and trust in a positive outcome has grown, and that four embassies are still under discussion.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not supervise maintenance, but addresses embassies at the municipality's request.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken houdt geen toezicht op het onderhoud, maar spreekt op verzoek van de gemeente ambassades aan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Van Nispen over het bericht dat slechte arbeidsomstandigheden en uitbuiting bij nagelsalons geen prioriteit hebben bij de Inspectie SZW

MPs Aartsen and Van Nispen asked why the Inspectorate SZW does not prioritise exploitation, illegal employment and underpayment in nail salons despite its stated priorities and warnings from the National Rapporteur on Human Trafficking and the Public Prosecution Service. The government replied that the Inspectorate runs a risk-based programme covering the wellness sector including nail studios, that 29 salons were inspected with violations found in half, that enforcement and signals receive continued attention, and that cooperation with police and partners exists, though exploitation is hard to detect.
Within this programme there is indeed attention for the wellness sector, and within it for nail studios.
Binnen dit programma is er wel degelijk aandacht voor de wellnessbranche, en daarbinnen voor nagelstudio's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Aartsen over de berichten "Nederland gaat gewetensvol om met roofkunst" en "Twijfel over teruggave is verwerpelijk"

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Aartsen asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the restitution of Nazi-looted art and the balancing of emotional interests and museum interests in the Restitutions Committee's advice. The minister answered that the ample reasonableness-and-fairness framework is consistent with the Washington Principles, that victims' interests should come first, and that restitution is advised when rightful ownership and looting are clearly established.
In 2020 the policy will be evaluated again.
In 2020 wordt het beleid weer geëvalueerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Aartsen over het bericht 'Geen Nederlandse media meer op Europese nepnieuwslijst'

MPs Kwint and Aartsen asked whether Dutch media had been excluded from EU East StratCom's EUvsDisinfo list, whether the Dutch government would send a letter on it, whether Dutch journalists would stop appearing on the list, and who funds EUvsDisinfo. The minister replied that no Dutch sources remain on the website after assurances from the EEAS, that she assumes no future Dutch press articles will appear, and that the taskforce is funded from the EEAS communication budget within the general EU budget, without a copy of the agreement being provided.
There is no copy of that.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Aartsen over het bericht dat John van den Heuvel wegens dreiging niet meer in de studio van RTL kan verschijnen

MPs Sneller and Aartsen asked why journalist John van den Heuvel could no longer appear in the RTL studio due to threats and how this squares with the agreement on protecting journalists. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the decision was a proportionate local security assessment by the Amsterdam triangle, that press freedom is not curtailed, and that the agreed journalist-protection measures are being implemented.
There is, however, no question of Mr Van den Heuvel being denied the right to speak or being advised against expressing himself (on television).
Er is echter geen sprake van dat dhr. van den Heuvel het woord wordt ontnomen of hem wordt afgeraden zich (op televisie) te uiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Aartsen over het onderzoek van TNO waaruit blijkt dat asbesthoudende vensterbanken veilig zijn te verwijderen in de laagste risicoklasse

MPs Ziengs and Aartsen asked the state secretary about TNO research suggesting asbestos window sills can be removed under the lowest risk class, the cost implications, and the governance of the SMA-rt instrument managed by Ascert. The state secretary answered that a pilot and a redesign of the instrument are being prepared, while acknowledging ongoing disputes about oversight and Ascert's representativeness.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over het incident waarbij een WNL-journalist is belaagd en bedreigd in Zoetermeer

An MP asked the minister about a WNL journalist who was harassed and threatened in Zoetermeer by a group of twenty people, and whether journalists can report threats and how safety is protected. The minister condemned the intimidation, said journalists should be able to work safely, and described a steering group with the NVJ, editors, prosecutors and police plus funding for protection, though no reporting point exists.
There is no reporting point for journalists who are threatened, but a steering group on tackling aggression and violence against journalists has been established
Er is geen meldpunt voor journalisten die bedreigd worden, maar er is een stuurgroep aanpak Agressie en geweld tegen Journalisten opgericht
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Nieuwe belasting op attracties voor dagjesmensen’

MPs Lodders and Aartsen asked about Amsterdam's plan for a new levy on attractions aimed at day-trippers, and the limits central government sets on municipal tax autonomy. Minister Ollongren answered that municipalities can set tourist and recreation levies autonomously within legal limits, that the effects on businesses and subsidised institutions are not yet known, and that the Amsterdam alderman will first consult residents.
At this stage there is insufficient knowledge of the measure Amsterdam wishes to introduce to say anything about its potential effects on entrepreneurs or their turnover.
In dit stadium is onvoldoende bekend over de door de gemeente Amsterdam gewenste maatregel om iets te kunnen zeggen over de potentiële effecten ervan op ondernemers of hun omzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Remco Dijkstra over het in Nederland houden van het vliegend erfgoed De Catalina

MPs Aartsen and Dijkstra asked whether the government would act to keep the historic Catalina aircraft in the Netherlands before its sale to a US buyer. The minister answered that the aircraft has no protected status, that no other party has yet offered to fund the purchase, and that a request must come from a heritage institution to the Mondriaan Fonds before a decision can be made.
I am willing to take action, but I depend on the willingness of the parties involved to come up with a good proposal and submit it to the Mondriaan Fund.
Ik ben bereid om actie te ondernemen, maar ben daarbij afhankelijk van de bereidheid van de betrokken partijen om met een goed voorstel te komen en dit in te dienen bij het Mondriaan Fonds.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de veiligheidsrisico’s van windturbines op land

An MP asked whether the Dutch Safety Board has investigated fire and safety risks of onshore wind turbines, how safety, firefighting and disaster response are assured for turbines of 130 metres and higher, how residents are informed, how cleanup and compensation after an incident are handled, and whether a national risk analysis will be made. The government answered that the Safety Board has not investigated such risks, that safety is ensured through existing environmental-law rules and local competent authorities, that the firefighting approach is limited for turbine fires, that information and cleanup are the responsibility of the initiator, operator and regional authorities, and that it sees no reason for a national risk analysis at present.
At this moment I therefore see no reason to draw up a national risk analysis for wind turbines of 130 metres and higher.
Op dit moment zie ik daarom geen aanleiding een landelijke risicoanalyse op te stellen voor windturbines van 130 meter en hoger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Vuurwerkshows in gevaar na afsteekverbod: 'Dit gaat niet lukken''

An MP from BBB asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about shortages of qualified pyrotechnicians, long permit procedures, and the practical feasibility and legal details of the planned exemption regime for associations under the Wet veilige jaarwisseling. The State Secretary answered that professional shows are a market matter, that the exemption does not require a pyrotechnician qualification, and deferred most detailed questions (storage, requirements, registration) to a Besluit expected in early 2026.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Huidekooper over het bericht over een recordaantal grote storingen op het spoor waarbij ProRail waarschuwt voor jarenlange hinder

An MP asked the state secretary about the record number of major rail disruptions, the causes including maintenance backlogs and ICT problems, and whether procurement rules and staff shortages hamper repairs. The state secretary attributes the rise mainly to technical faults and third-party causes, says the causes are still under ProRail analysis, and commits to continued consultation with ProRail on reducing major disruptions.
I am awaiting ProRail's ongoing analysis so that it becomes clear which factors play the largest role in the increase in the number of impactful disruptions.
Verder wordt de lopende analyse van ProRail afgewacht, zodat helder wordt welke factoren de grootste rol spelen in de toename van het aantal impactvolle verstoringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schutz over het bericht over een recordaantal grote storingen op het spoor waarbij ProRail waarschuwt voor jarenlange hinder

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the rising number of major rail disruptions and ProRail's warning of years of nuisance, including flexibility of maintenance contracts, ICT, staffing, procurement rules and timelines. The State Secretary answers that ProRail is still analysing the causes, will share its analysis by year-end, and that concrete measures and timelines will be discussed afterwards, while noting new flexible contracts for small-scale maintenance and that EU procurement rules are for the Commission to revise.
Before we discuss specific solutions for the rise in high-impact disruptions, the outcomes of ProRail's analysis will be awaited, which will be shared with IenW by the end of this year.

Voordat we over specifieke oplossingen praten in het kader van de stijging van impactvolle verstoringen, worden de uitkomsten van de analyse van ProRail afgewacht, die voor het einde van dit jaar met IenW wordt gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over het bericht 'Plasticgigant zweeg decennialang over PFAS-lozingen'

MPs Gabriëls asked the minister how enforcement of PFAS discharges by Sabic in the Westerschelde could lead to penalties, given that the company only informed authorities in 2022 and had earlier warnings. The minister confirmed the facts, explained the enforcement framework (LHSO), said sanctions are for the competent authority and the Public Prosecution Service, and committed to answering a motion-related question by end of Q1 2026.
The Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management does not itself impose sanctions.
Het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat legt zelf geen sancties op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Moinat over het krantenartikel 'Inspectie is helemaal klaar met bedrijven: statiegeld op flesjes moet fors omhoog, anders megaboete'

An MP asked the state secretary whether the inspectorate's push to raise the bottle deposit to 30 cents, and its penalties on Verpact, shift costs onto consumers instead of fixing machine failures first. The state secretary answered that raising the deposit is undesirable, that Verpact must improve the system and prefers positive incentives, and that Verpact's new package offers rewards for returns instead of a higher deposit.
Verpact has received an adjusted order from the ILT for this purpose.
Verpact heeft daarvoor een aangepaste last van de ILT ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić en Gabriëls over de staalslakkenkwesties

MPs Gabriëls and Kostić asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about steel slag use: whether soil rules will be tightened for leaching of non-regulated substances, why rules were not updated sooner, whether a permit requirement or total ban is warranted, liability of Tata Steel, classification as waste versus by-product, and Natura 2000 risks. The State Secretary replied that a temporary emergency regulation restricts risky uses, a notification duty is coming, the soil rules are under review, and that no retroactive ban or total prohibition is planned for now.
If there are new scientific insights into the substances relevant to properly mapping the risks of a building material in use, I will review this again.
Als er nieuwe wetenschappelijke inzichten zijn over de stoffen die van belang zijn om de risico’s van een bouwstof bij toepassing goed in beeld te brengen zal ik dit opnieuw bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over de berichten ‘Staalslakken op veel meer plekken gevonden: aantal locaties bijna verdubbeld’ en ‘Waar komen verwijderde staalslakken terecht? “Geen zicht op”’

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management how the government responds to press reports of more than a hundred locations where steel slag was used as construction material, whether the ministry knew of them, and what will be done to find and clean up such sites and control reuse of removed slag. The state secretary answers that the ministry had no registration duty and only learned via existing records and an ILT investigation, lists eight measures including a reporting duty from spring 2026, a joint approach with IPO, VNG and water boards, and states that no permit applications have been received.
There is no reporting, information or registration obligation for the application of steel slag.
Er is geen meld-, informatie- of registratieplicht voor het toepassen van staalslakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Olger van Dijk over demonstraties op het spoor

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management, together with the Justice Minister, about Extinction Rebellion activists occupying railway tracks at Amsterdam Centraal, how the government prepared for and responded to the announced action, and how it will prevent future disruption of transport hubs. The government answered that it condemns track occupation, describes contacts with police, municipal authorities, NS and ProRail, notes that pre-emptive arrest requires a suspicion of a criminal offence, and points to a handling framework and a pending research study on the legal basis for restricting demonstrations.
Completely preventing demonstrators from entering the track proves extremely complex in practice.
Het volledig voorkomen dat demonstranten het spoor betreden blijkt in de praktijk uiterst complex.
Antwoord op vragen van lid De Hoop over de bereikbaarheid van zorginstellingen met het openbaar vervoer, naar aanleiding van de opheffing van bushalte Mooiland in Doorwerth

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about the accessibility of care institutions by public transport after the planned removal of bus stop Mooiland in Doorwerth, and whether bus stops near care facilities will be protected. The State Secretary answered that the province of Gelderland has decided to keep the stop, that public transport accessibility is the responsibility of the concession-granting authority, and that regional accessibility analyses will follow.
Responsibility for the decision whether or not to remove bus stops lies with the concession-granting authority.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de afweging van het wel of niet opheffen van bushaltes berust bij de concessieverlenende overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pierik over de PwC speelveldtoets die de afval- en recyclingsector heeft laten uitvoeren op het invoeren van €567 miljoen extra heffingen op afval

An MP asked the government about a PwC level-playing-field study showing the proposed €567 million waste levies could harm recycling competitiveness, push waste export and endanger the Aramis CCS project. The government acknowledged these risks, pointed to ongoing work with the waste sector on alternative measures and a decision planned for spring 2026, but gave no firm commitment to change the levy design now.
That is precisely why the cabinet, together with the sector in the Waste Sector Working Group, is exploring alternative arrangements that better support the circular economy.
Juist daarom is het kabinet, samen met de sector in de Werkgroep Afvalsector, bezig met het verkennen van alternatieve invullingen die de circulaire economie beter ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over het bericht ‘OP wil alsnog volledige sanering vervuilde grond Havenhoofd en Veerdam, maar dat lijkt een utopie’

An MP asks the state secretary about contaminated soil under houses at Havenhoofd and Veerdam in Papendrecht, including late disclosure to residents, gas meters, and the call for a fact-finding inquiry. The state secretary answers that the soil was remediated with a clean layer, that monitoring showed a stable end state, that the provincial competent authority is responsible, and that further questions should go to the provincial and municipal authorities.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en De Hoop over het bericht dat ambtenaren regels omzeilden om PFAS-grond van Schiphol weg te werken

MPs Gabriëls and De Hoop asked the state secretary whether officials bypassed rules to dispose of heavily PFAS-contaminated soil from Schiphol at the Aalsmeerderbrug site, and about temporary storage, health risks and remediation. The state secretary answered that the soil was lightly contaminated, the competent authority was the municipality of Haarlemmermeer via the ODNZKG, the soil was moved to Rozenburg and met applicable norms, and referred several questions to the competent authority; the answer to the question on the committee debate was that it could not be completed in time.
For that reason I refer you for further substantive questions about the course of events to the competent authority.
Om die reden verwijs ik voor verdere inhoudelijke vragen over de gang van zaken graag naar het bevoegde gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Veltman over de uitvoering van de CBb-uitspraak inzake de HRN-concessie

An MP asks the state secretary how the court ruling on NS's high-speed rail concession is implemented, including equal access for MaaS platforms, independent review, consultation, and whether NS's commercial services are cross-subsidised. The secretary replies that the concession was amended to make reseller terms transparent and non-discriminatory, that independent experts reviewed it, and that the government does not fully disclose internal separation details beyond stating that NS keeps separate accounts.
The CBb will decide on the progress of the procedure on the basis of that.
Het CBb zal aan de hand daarvan beslissen over de voortgang van de procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls en Kröger over het bericht dat wetenschappers twijfelen aan de maatregelen tegen stank en zoutzuur van het bedrijf ICL

MPs Gabriëls and Kröger asked the State Secretary about reports that scientists doubt ICL's measures against odour and hydrochloric acid emissions, including repeated exceedances of permit limits and possible cancer links. The State Secretary answered that enforcement lies with the province of Noord-Holland and the Omgevingsdienst Noordzeekanaalgebied, which imposed a penalty of 500,000 euro and will tighten permit conditions, while declining to commission a cancer study and pointing to the responsibility of the competent authority.
It is for the competent authority to assess this.
Het is aan het bevoegd gezag om dit te beoordelen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gabriëls over de gang van zaken rondom het toepassen van staalslakken met schadelijke gevolgen voor milieu en daarbij volksgezondheid en de rol van het Ministerie, Rijkswaterstaat en andere
